31489.s: The bill creates a single statutory framework for paying members of advisory colleges and other commissions, letting the minister grant a per-meeting or fixed monthly fee and setting further rules by general administrative order. It also repeals article 14 of the Kaderwet adviescolleges and preserves existing ministerial rules and decisions under the old regimes.
31489.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by noting that a standalone general administrative order is only exceptionally acceptable under current legal doctrine, so the core rules are placed in the statute with a basis for further rules.
q: For this reason it is proposed to regulate the fee arrangements for committees partly at statutory level and to provide a basis for setting further rules by or under a general administrative order.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld de regeling met betrekking tot de vergoedingen voor commissies deels op het niveau van de wet te regelen en voorts een grondslag te bieden voor het vaststellen van nadere regels bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: granting per-meeting or fixed monthly fees to committee and advisory college members
further rules on the fees in article 2(1)
p: The minister decides by ministerial decision which members receive fees and whether per-meeting or fixed, within the categories set by the statute.

parties: Asks whether the bill's delegation to AMvB-level rules is clear and whether the maximum fee should be tied to the prime minister's salary.

These members are surprised by the proposal to regulate the Vacatiegeldenbesluit partly at the level of the law and to provide a basis for setting further rules by or pursuant to a general administrative order.

Deze leden verbazen zich wel over het voorstel om het Vacatiegeldenbesluit «deels op het niveau van de wet te regelen en voorts een grondslag te bieden voor het stellen van nadere regels bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur».
Asks whether departments can set up commissions with more generous fees and whether work may shift to consultants outside government, and how that could be prevented.
How can such a shift be prevented?
Hoe kan een dergelijke verschuiving worden voorkomen?
Asks how civil servants involved in advisory bodies are treated under the rijksambtenaren rules and what authority relationship applies to them.
What authority relationship exists between a civil servant involved in the work of an advisory body or commission and the minister of the department to which it belongs?

Welke gezagsverhouding is er tussen een ambtenaar, die betrokken is bij de werkzaamheden van een adviescollege of commissie en de minister van het departement, waar het adviescollege of de commissie onder valt?
Considers the fees too high and wants commissions set up only in exceptional cases, with a maximum equal to a Member of Parliament's salary.
A maximum fee equal to the salary of a Member of Parliament is more than sufficient for members of an advisory body or commission.
Een maximumvergoeding gelijk aan het salaris van een Kamerlid is voor leden van een adviescollege of commissie meer dan voldoende.

31579.s: The bill implements EU Services Directive 2006/123/EC in Dutch law, creating a central electronic point of contact and information point, cross-border administrative cooperation and mutual recognition of documents, plus a tacit-approval (lex silencio positivo) regime for permits and a consumer information duty for service providers. It amends the General Administrative Law Act and related laws to set deadlines and tacit approval mechanisms.
31579.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for flexible technical implementation and because the directive's requirements vary across sectors and technology, with the central point's details left to later rules.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative order, further rules may be laid down on the set-up, maintenance, operation and security of the central point of contact.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld met betrekking tot de inrichting, instandhouding, werking en beveiliging van het centraal loket.
d: rules on set-up, operation and security of central point of contact
rules on set-up, operation and security of consumer information point
ordering and accessibility of information by competent authorities
deletion periods for messages sent via central point
technical requirements for connection to central point
technical requirements for internal market information system and data protection
implementing measures for electronic exchange of information between member states
further rules implementing Commission decisions on information duties
p: Permits the administrative body to extend the decision deadline once for a limited period, with reasons given to the applicant.

Allows the administrative body to attach conditions to or withdraw a tacit (lex silencio positivo) permit within six weeks where needed to prevent serious harm to the public interest, subject to compensation.

parties: Asks that municipalities and other subnational authorities be bound to timely and correct implementation, and asks for a law enabling this so the central government is not liable for their errors.
Such a law is necessary to ensure that subnational authorities stay on track and that the central government does not have to bear the costs of their mistakes.
Een dergelijke wet is noodzakelijk om er voor te zorgen dat medeoverheden goed bij de les blijven en de rijksoverheid niet moet opdraaien voor door hen gemaakte fouten.
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State's criticism of lex silencio positivo and to explain when the rule applies and what 'compelling reasons of general interest' means.
Can the government respond to the Council of State's criticism of the application of lex silencio positivo, the PvdA members ask.
Kan de regering ingaan op de kritiek van de Raad van State met betrekking tot de toepassing van de Lex silencio positivo, zo vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie.

Worries that the scope of the directive is unclear, that special personal data may be processed through the warning mechanism, and that tacit approval harms third-party and public interests, citing the Council of State and SER.

When the SER and Council of State state that the directive's scope is unclearly delimited and the government already foresees a clean-up law, these members fear no one has yet been able to assess the impact adequately.

Wanneer de SER en de Raad van State stellen dat de totale reikwijdte van de dienstenrichtlijn een onduidelijke afbakening heeft en de regering nu reeds voorziet dat een veegwet noodzakelijk zal zijn om eerder ontstane hiaten te ondervangen, dan vrezen deze leden dat niemand tot nu toe afdoende in staat is geweest de impact van deze richtlijn en de daaruit volgende wet op waarde te schatten.
Asks for an overview of national gold-plating, the implementation timeline, the single point of contact format and the additional information obligations on service providers.
The VVD members ask the government for an overview of all national gold-plating added in the bill, with a justification for each.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering om een overzicht van alle nationale koppen die in het wetsvoorstel zijn aangebracht, graag met een motivering per kop.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Dienstenwet implementing the EU Services Directive, supporting its aim but raising points on national carve-outs, territorial scope, overriding reasons of general interest, refusal grounds, the selection mechanism for scarce permits, enforcement, and the lex silencio positivo. The minister's nader rapport accepted most points, rejected the advice to restrict the positive fictitious decision in art. 4:20a, and explained the choices made.
concerns: Advice to clarify the definition of 'dienst' and 'lidstaat' and to align wording with the Directive was adopted.
Advice to replace the open-ended definition of overriding reasons of general interest with a dynamic reference to case law and to drop the words 'of worden' was followed.
Advice to remove the refusal ground for electronic submissions via the central desk, which the Directive does not provide, was followed.

Advice to implement the selection mechanism for scarce permits (art. 12) in the Act was partly followed: art. 32 now requires temporary permits, but the rest was left to sector legislation and the Aanwijzingen.
Advice to specify in art. 4:20a the cases in which a positive fictitious decision is excluded was rejected, as case-by-case assessment is preferred.

Advice to address in the explanatory memorandum the gap between tacit permit creation, entry into force and publication, and the effect on appeal periods, was followed by supplementing the explanation.
Advice to clarify the territorial scope of the Directive, including EEA, Switzerland and the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, was followed in the explanatory memorandum.
Advice on enforcement of obligations by all competent authorities, including non-governmental bodies, was addressed by pointing to a forthcoming bill on enforcement against sub-state entities.
Numerous redactional remarks were adopted, except the proposed change to art. 46(4), which the government declined.

31700-XI.s: This is the 2009 budget bill for the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment (VROM), setting the departmental budget statement, the budget statement for the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit baten-lastendienst, and the budget statement for the Waddenfonds. It also requires the explanatory notes to present policy-article-level information for the VROM budget.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment (XI) belonging to this act for the year 2009 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer (XI) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31768.s: The bill amends the Wft and the Faillissementswet so that, when a bank, investment firm or supervised financial institution enters an emergency regime, surseance or bankruptcy, claims for compensation under the deposit and investor safety-net schemes are settled separately from the estate, with no joint liability of DNB and the estate. It also requires administrators to notify DNB of depositors and investors and to reserve amounts for interim payouts pending DNB's determination of compensation.
31768.j: The memorandum justifies the rules by noting that DNB has no discretionary power over compensation decisions and that joint liability is implausible given the origin of the scheme.
q: DNB has no discretionary power in determining the compensation and the trustees have an extremely limited freedom in accepting or rejecting claims.
DNB heeft geen discretionaire bevoegdheid bij de vaststelling van de vergoeding en de curatoren hebben een uiterst beperkte vrijheid bij het al dan niet erkennen van vorderingen.

parties: Asks how large the problem was, why the bill comes now, and whether DNB's joint liability and supervisory role are affected; also asks why the Raad van State advice on excluding DNB's liability was not followed.
Is it not possible, however, to regulate this outcome within the current law instead of through this bill?
Is het echter niet mogelijk om deze uitkomst binnen de huidige wet te regelen in plaats van via dit wetsvoorstel
Asks for empirical evidence behind assumptions about creditor behaviour, the extra burden on the estate, the Icesave application, and whether a shorter deadline for claims would be an alternative.
The justification of the chosen solution relies on assumptions about the behaviour of creditors.
Er wordt in de beargumentering van de gekozen oplossing gesteund op aannames over het gedrag van schuldeisers.
Welcomes the equal-treatment goal but asks whether a simpler solution exists, whether the EU directive could be revisited, and how long DNB needs to determine payouts.
These members do wonder whether a simpler solution is possible.
Deze leden vragen zich wel af of er geen eenvoudigere oplossing mogelijk is.

v.summary: The Council of State supports the bill amending the Wft and Faillissementswet so that a depositor's claim on the estate and a deposit guarantee compensation claim against DNB are treated equally, but advises clarifying through the Wft that DNB and the estate are not jointly liable, better motivating the proposal, and clarifying the cross-border position of branches of EU-based financial institutions. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts the drafting and motivation points, amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly, but declines to exclude DNB's liability as beyond the scope of this urgent bill.
concerns: Article 136 Faillissementswet only applies if joint liability exists, so the exclusion of joint liability should be regulated explicitly in the Wft rather than by referring to Article 136 Fw.

The Council suggests also excluding DNB's liability as deposit guarantee administrator, in line with a recital of Directive 94/19/EC; the government declines this as beyond the scope of the bill given its urgency.
The explanatory memorandum should give an independent justification for the choice to equalise the positions of depositors and DNB, beyond improving DNB's recourse.
The memorandum should clarify the meaning of applying the regime to branches of financial institutions seated in other Member States, given that such firms are wound up under home-state rules.
A redactional remark in the annex on the wording of Article 3:265c(2) Wft is noted and taken into account.

31792-V.s: This bill amends the 2008 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) and the baten-lastendienst CBI budget, adjusting appropriations and revenues in connection with the autumn budget memorandum (Najaarsnota). It contains no delegation of rule-making power, only the budgetary amounts and the standard entry-into-force and promulgation clauses.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2008 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

31795.s: The bill amends the Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning so that municipalities must explain clearly the choice between an in-kind support and a cash alternative, and must ensure consultation on staff transfer between home-care providers. It also adjusts the municipal council's power to set rules and charge personal contributions and removes the general administrative-law procedure for certain non-in-kind support.
q: Title 4.2 of the General Administrative Law Act does not apply to the non-in-kind support and the financial allowances.
Op de voorziening anders dan in natura en de financiële tegemoetkomingen is titel 4.2 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht niet van toepassing.
d: municipal rules on individual support and eligibility
p: Title 4.2 of the General Administrative Law Act no longer applies to non-in-kind support and financial allowances, reducing citizens' procedural protection against municipal decisions.

parties: Worries the bill reduces local policy freedom and asks for clarity so citizens know their options and that the financial allowance is comparable to in-kind care.
They regret that an amendment must follow so soon after the law's introduction.
Zij betreuren het dat zo snel na invoering van de wet tot wijziging moet worden overgegaan.
Asks why citizens must be informed only before choosing a non-in-kind option and how quality equivalence and information are monitored.
These members agree with the government that the citizen's position in receiving domestic care under the Wmo must be adequately safeguarded.
Deze leden zijn met de regering van mening dat de positie van de burger bij het ontvangen van huishoudelijke verzorging in het kader van de Wmo adequaat geborgd dient te worden.
Welcomes recognition of care recipients and workers but asks how alfa-helpers are informed of risks and who is responsible for quality and supervision.
They ask how and by whom alfa-helpers are informed about the lack of employment conditions and the risks regarding pension accrual, income loss during illness, etc.
Zij vragen hoe en door wie de alfahulpen worden ingelicht over het gebrek aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, de risico's die zij lopen ten aanzien van pensioenopbouw, inkomensverlies bij ziekte etc.
Says the bill is a vote of distrust toward local government and that dropping the pgb from the statute ignores the Chamber's earlier wish to anchor the pgb right in law.
Why was the pgb not kept in the statutory text? Does the government share the VVD view that the choice of a pgb must remain an unqualified right under the Wmo for every client?
Het pgb in de wettekst niet gehandhaafd? Deelt de regering de mening van de VVD-fractie dat de keuze voor een pgb onverkort een recht moet blijven binnen de Wmo voor iedere cliënt?
Sees the three options and information duty as steps in the right direction but says quality care is still not guaranteed.
However, as far as the PVV is concerned there is still no guarantee of good, high-quality care, and care is still cheap and stripped down.
Echter, wat de PVV-fractie betreft is er nog steeds geen garantie voor goede, kwalitatief hoge zorg, en dat er nog steeds sprake is van goedkope en uitgeklede zorg.
Stresses the statutory right of clients to choose between in-kind care and the pgb and asks why the term pgb is removed and how the choice is guaranteed.
The ChristenUnie members attach great value to the Wmo provision establishing the municipal duty to offer clients entitled to an individual provision a choice between in-kind care and the pgb.

De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie hechten sterk aan de bepaling in de Wmo waarin de gemeentelijke plicht is vastgelegd om cliënten die recht hebben op een individuele voorziening de keuze te bieden tussen zorg in natura en het pgb.
Cannot agree with any encroachment on freedom of choice and asks for a guarantee that the pgb stays equally accessible and for the reasons behind the wording.
They cannot agree to such an encroachment on freedom of choice.
Met een dergelijke inbreuk op de keuzevrijheid kunnen zij niet instemmen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wmo to create a third option for home help, a financial contribution allowing the citizen to hire an alfahulp, and to require information duties and consultation on staff transfers. The government's nader rapport accepts several points, partly followed, rejecting others such as the need for the bill and its financial effects.
concerns: The Raad questioned the added value of the third option (financial contribution for an alfahulp) since a pgb already allows this, and asked for a reasoned justification.
The Raad asked for a substantiated justification of the mandatory information duty for municipalities, since such detailed statutory norms do not fit the Wmo's municipal discretion.

The Raad considered the restriction on alfahulp use a broader labour market question not suited to priority treatment for one sector, and disputed the need for the bill given the lack of evidence of problems.
The Raad asked for analysis of the labour market effects of allowing only employed staff in home care and the capacity risks raised by the VNG.
The Raad found the financial effects insufficiently motivated, expecting cost increases and advising against anticipating the SCP advice on the macro budget.
The Raad asked for fuller insight into how the entry-into-force timing affects multi-year contracts and existing employment contracts with alfahulpen.
The Raad asked that the statutory consultation duty between old and new providers be justified, as it goes beyond the Wmo framework.

31858.s: The bill repeals several water-management laws (Wet verontreiniging oppervlaktewateren, Wet verontreiniging zeewater, Grondwaterwet, Waterstaatswet parts, Wet op de waterhuishouding) and amends many others to align them with the new Waterwet, including moving water-bed contamination rules into the Waterwet and adding a new pollution levy and a Binnenvaartwet chapter on waste-oil financing. It also removes provincial approval and administrative appeal for certain waterschap decisions and allows ministerial and provincial rules to be set by general administrative order and ministerial regulation.
31858.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by technical detail, flexibility for implementing EU water directives, and coordination with the Waterwet's general framework.
q: By or under general administrative order, norms may be set for rijkswateren and, in view of international obligations or supra-regional interests, for regional waters for the functions to be assigned to water systems under chapter 4.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen voor rijkswateren en, met het oog op internationale verplichtingen of bovenregionale belangen, voor regionale wateren normen worden vastgesteld voor de overeenkomstig hoofdstuk 4 aan watersystemen toe te kennen functies.
d: norms for functions of water systems, regional provincial ordinance
designation and boundaries of water systems under state management
rules on preparation and content of national water plan
criteria for water bed quality as obstacle to desired area quality
exemption from groundwater extraction permit by provincial ordinance
measurement, sampling and analysis rules for pollution units
exemptions from groundwater levy and further levy rules
further rules for implementing the Rhine/inland navigation waste treaty
p: Provincial ordinances may designate non-waterschap bodies as managers of non-state water systems and exempt them from several Waterwet duties.
The water manager may order landowners and polluters to carry out investigations and temporary safety measures on contaminated water beds and banks.
The minister may use administrative coercion for enforcement whenever tasks are assigned to him, even if another body holds enforcement responsibility.
Compensation claims for groundwater damage must first go through a provincial investigation, and claimants may have to assign their rights against third parties.
The state may recover remediation costs from polluters and unjustly enriched persons, subject to judicial moderation.
Planning-damage compensation under the Wet ruimtelijke ordening is excluded where a Waterwet compensation claim exists, shifting the claim to the water manager.
Provincial approval and administrative appeal against many waterschap decisions are abolished, leaving only court review.
Administrative coercion may be used to compel cooperation with inspectors.

parties: Asks whether the broad definition of surface water bodies creates duplicate regulation and whether ACTAL should be asked to test administrative burdens.

Following earlier remarks on the definition of surface water bodies, the CDA members believe ACTAL should be asked to carry out a test so that it can be stated with certainty that the Act has no effect on administrative burdens.</reasoning_effort>
Ook naar aanleiding van eerdere opmerkingen over de definitie van oppervlaktewaterlichamen zijn de leden van de CDA-fractie van mening dat de ACTAL alsnog gevraagd moet worden een toets uit te voeren
Asks how to prevent local cost increases for water boards and whether structural national funding for sediment remediation is reserved.
The PvdA members, like the VVD members, want to know how it will be prevented that the new legal framework leads to local cost increases for water boards.</reasoning_effort>
De leden van de PvdA-fractie willen, evenals de leden van de VVD-fractie, weten hoe wordt voorkomen dat het nieuwe wetgevingskader leidt tot lokale lastenverzwaring voor waterschappen
Doubts enforcement capacity and worries that inspections focus on paper quality systems rather than on-site checks; questions the absence of clear criteria for drier shore areas.
This can create a paper reality in which quality appears perfectly in order while practice looks quite different.</reasoning_effort>
Zo kan er een papieren werkelijkheid ontstaan, waar de kwaliteit prima in orde lijkt, terwijl de praktijk er heel anders uit ziet.
Asks why indirect discharges fall under two laws and how many firms need individual permits; asks for exemption of already treated water from the pollution levy.

The VVD members ask why indirect discharges into a sewer system are placed under the Environmental Management Act while the final discharges from that system fall under the Waterwet.</reasoning_effort>
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom er is bepaald dat indirecte lozingen in een rioolstelsel onder de Wet Milieubeheer vallen
Asks about the muskrat and beaver control financing and whether transfer to water boards causes local cost increases for citizens and firms.
The PvdA and ChristenUnie members ask how it is guaranteed that the transfer of control does not lead to local increases in charges.</reasoning_effort>
De leden van de PvdA- en ChristenUnie-fractie vragen hoe gewaarborgd wordt dat de overdacht van de bestrijding niet leidt tot lokale lastenverzwaringen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the Invoeringswet Waterwet be revised, notably to coordinate water and soil protection more closely in transition areas, clarify groundwater boundaries, justify the budget regime for regional waterbodies, reconsider the sanctioning approach, and fill several omissions and transitional gaps. The government's nader rapport accepts most remarks, adding substantive amendments, while defending its position on groundwater, the budget instrument, and transitional law.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the boundary between the Waterwet and the Wet bodembescherming for groundwater unclear and asks for a clearer competence regime; the government keeps the boundary but clarifies it.

The Afdeling asks that overlapping water and soil competences be coordinated substantively, not only procedurally, to ensure integrated protection; the government points to existing consultation duties and a new assessment framework under the Wbb.

The Afdeling asks for transparent budgeting of funds for regional waterbodies, avoiding a fragmented set of grants next to the Provinciefonds; the government explains the planned decentralisation grant.

The Afdeling asks that the preference for criminal sanctioning be reconsidered in light of the Justice Minister's note on sanction choice; the government now explains why criminal sanctions are retained for now and that administrative fines may be introduced later.

The Afdeling notes omissions in the bill such as sanction priority rules and amendments to the Wet milieubeheer, and asks for transitional rules for existing water agreements and ministerial directions; the government adds the provisions or explains why transitional law is not needed.
The Afdeling makes numerous redactional remarks, most of which the government adopts, except on two points it explains.

31867.s: The bill adds article 8:40a to the General Administrative Law Act, making the electronic-communication rules of chapter 2.3 applicable to communication with administrative judges and allowing an AMvB to set further rules on electronic traffic and videoconferencing with the bestuursrechter. It also makes a minor cross-reference change in the General Tax Act and sets entry into force by royal decree.
31867.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by saying that electronic procedure is still underdeveloped and that pilots and practice must first clarify how it can best be organised before detailed rules are fixed.
q: In our view there is still too much uncertainty about how electronic traffic with the administrative judge can best be organised to arrive at specific rules.
Naar ons oordeel bestaat momenteel nog teveel onduidelijkheid over de wijze waarop het elektronisch verkeer met de bestuursrechter het best kan worden ingericht, om te komen tot specifieke regels.
d: further rules on electronic traffic with the administrative judge
further rules on use of videoconferencing

parties: Asks for uniformity across courts and an evaluation after two years, and questions court discretion to choose electronic procedure, arguing it creates confusion and risk for citizens.
Each court has the freedom under the proposed Article 2:15 of the General Administrative Law Act to choose whether to offer electronic proceedings.
Elk gerecht heeft namelijk de vrijheid om op basis van het voorgestelde artikel 2:15 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb) te kiezen voor de mogelijkheid van elektronisch procederen.
Asks how electronic procedure can proceed without clear form, and whether procedural errors by citizens could lead to unequal treatment across judges.
Is there then not a case of legal inequality, since administrative judges may react differently to procedural errors by citizens who do not know exactly how electronic procedure works?

Is er dan geen sprake van rechtsongelijkheid, aangezien de bestuursrechters verschillend kunnen reageren op procedurefouten van de burger die niet precies weet hoe de procedure ten aanzien van elektronisch procederen is?
Insists citizens must always keep the choice of paper procedure and never be forced into electronic correspondence, and asks about security and confidentiality.
For these members it is crucial that people always retain the option to choose paper and are never forced to use electronic correspondence.
Voor deze leden is het cruciaal dat mensen altijd de mogelijkheid blijven behouden voor papier te kiezen en dat men nooit gedwongen wordt van elektronisch verkeer gebruik te maken.

Notes the government could set rules by itself or delegate them by decree without consulting parliament, asks about consequences when a judge does not follow a procedure regulation, and about security of court databases.
Do these members understand correctly that the government can set these rules itself and also choose to delegate them? If so, they want to know why the House of Representatives need not be consulted.

Begrijpen deze leden het goed dat de regering deze regels zelf kan stellen en er ook voor kan kiezen ze te delegeren? In dat geval willen zij graag weten waarom de Kamer als volksvertegenwoordiging hier niet over hoeft te worden geraadpleegd.
Asks the government to respond to the Council of State's warning that lack of detailed regulation produced divergent practice among municipalities, and why the same will not happen with the courts.
On what basis does the government believe the situation the Council of State identified at municipalities under the Webv will not arise with the introduction of this law for the administrative judge?

Op grond van welke overweging is de regering van mening dat de door de Raad van State geconstateerde situatie bij de gemeenten met betrekking tot de Wet Elektronisch bestuurlijke verkeer zich niet zal voordoen bij de introductie van de Wet Elektronisch verkeer met de bestuursrechter?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that extending Awb section 2.3 electronic communication to administrative courts is broadly endorsed but needs uniform rules, clarity on signatures, costs and the non-admissibility risk under art. 2:15(4), and a supplemented explanatory memorandum. The minister's nader rapport largely rejects specific rules for now, argues the signature requirement is already covered via art. 3:15a BW, defers financial estimates, and agrees only to nuance the passages on sending by fax and on refused electronic filings.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for uniform rules to prevent divergent practice across courts, while the government prefers to defer specific rules and start consultation with the courts instead.

The Afdeling says the electronic signature requirement of art. 6:5 Awb is unresolved and should be regulated, whereas the government argues art. 3:15a BW already applies and rejects binding signature rules.
The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum set out the organisational and financial consequences of digital procedure, but the government considers financial calculations premature.
The Afdeling warns that art. 2:15(4) on refusing electronic filings can cause problems and asks for clarification; the government agrees to nuance the memorandum without a firm conclusion.
The Afdeling says the fax-summons interpretation in the memorandum must be nuanced; the government agrees to adjust the passages on sending under art. 8:37 Awb.

31876.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 and the Tabakswet to implement the revised EU Audiovisual Media Services Directive, relaxing advertising rules, introducing rules on product placement and sponsorship, and extending regulation to commercial on-demand media services. It also gives the Commissariaat voor de Media powers to set further rules on product placement and advertising through ministerial regulation, and allows certain transitional rules to be set by ministerial regulation pending legislation.
31876.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial regulation for new forms of commercial communication as a temporary bridge until legislation on the subject is enacted.
q: Regulation by ministerial regulation under this article is of a temporary nature.
Regulering in een ministeriële regeling op basis van dit artikel, is van tijdelijke aard.
d: detailed rules on product placement in programmes
rules on forms of audiovisual commercial communication pending legislation
further rules on making short extracts of events available
p: Allows the minister to set rules on new forms of audiovisual commercial communication by ministerial regulation, bypassing legislation for an open-ended period.
Moves the criteria for supervision costs from statute to ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks about scope of providers' responsibility, jurisdiction over Luxembourg-based channels, compensation for lost advertising revenue, and subtitling obligations.
The CDA members note that cable operators and providers fall outside the scope of the law because they only pass on programmes and have no editorial responsibility.

De leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat de kabelaars en providers niet vallen onder de werkingssfeer van de wet omdat zij uitsluitend programma's doorgeven en geen redactionele verantwoordelijkheid hebben.
Asks whether the distinction between linear and non-linear services can be minimised, which parts deviate from the directive, and about NOS acquisition rights and the flash-report right.
The members ask the government for a complete overview of the parts where the directive is followed or where the directive's norm is deviated from.
De leden vragen de regering om een compleet overzicht van de onderdelen waar conform richtlijn wordt gehandeld of waar van de norm uit de richtlijn wordt afgeweken.

Opposes EU-imposed policy that prevents Dutch control over television, opposes loosening advertising rules and the commercialisation of children's programming, and asks why the government does not implement motion Kant.
They consider it a bad thing that a large part of the content of this bill is imposed by European rules, so the Netherlands cannot determine its own television policy.
Zij vinden het een slechte zaak dat een groot deel van de inhoud van dit wetsvoorstel wordt opgedrongen door Europese regels.
Questions the constitutional basis under Article 7 Grondwet for on-demand services and asks how the Commissariaat voor de Media will supervise advertising and what supervisory costs apply.
In this context they ask how linear media services and on-demand media services should be viewed in light of Article 7 of the Constitution.
Zij vragen zich in dit verband af, hoe de lineaire mediadiensten en de mediadiensten op aanvraag gezien moeten worden in het licht van artikel 7 Grondwet.

Asks for explanation of the narrow reading of the directive, the decision not to ban logos in children's programmes, and why commercial on-demand services are excluded from the alcohol advertising ban.
These members ask the government to explain further why commercial on-demand media services are exempted from the provision that no alcohol advertising may be broadcast between 06.00 and 21.00 hours.

Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten waarom commerciële mediadiensten op aanvraag zijn uitgezonderd van de bepaling dat tussen 06.00 uur en 21.00 uur geen alcoholreclame mag worden uitgezonden.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill implementing the Audiovisual Media Services Directive be adapted, because on-demand commercial media services are not fully covered (art. 3sexies(1)(f)) and the conditions for short extracts of major events, including the ban on compilations for sports overviews, may conflict with the Directive. The government's reply accepted the cross-reference fix, rejected the claim on (e) as a misunderstanding, and clarified the extract rules in the explanatory memorandum while adopting the drafting remarks.
concerns: Art. 3.7(2)(a) was not applied to on-demand commercial services, so art. 3sexies(1)(f) was not implemented; the bill was amended to add the cross-reference.
The Council considered art. 3sexies(1)(e) also unimplemented for on-demand services; the government said this rests on a misunderstanding and the alcohol rules are covered via the Advertising Code.

The restriction on compilations of short extracts in news programmes and sports competition overviews may conflict with the Directive's free choice of extracts; the government clarified the memorandum and reordered the provisions but kept the restriction.
Redactional remarks on the transposition table, commencement provisions, and the cross-references were incorporated into the bill and explanatory memorandum.

31894.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer to implement EU Regulation 1272/2008 (CLP) on classification, labelling and packaging of substances and mixtures, adding a new title 9.3a that designates the competent body for article 45 tasks by ministerial regulation, makes specified CLP provisions criminally enforceable, and removes overlapping national labelling and packaging rules. It also makes related amendments to other laws and adds enforcement provisions in chapter 18.
31894.j: The memorandum justifies the amvb route for criminal enforcement as a temporary delegation needed because gaps in the list of sanctionable provisions may emerge, to be followed quickly by a statutory regulation.
q: Because of the temporary delegation to the lower level of an amvb, violations of the CLP provisions designated there fall in the 'light' category of the WED.
Vanwege de tijdelijke delegatie naar het lagere niveau van amvb, vallen overtredingen van de daarbij aangewezen bepalingen van de CLP-verordening in de categorie «licht» van de WED.
d: designation of body performing CLP article 45 tasks and rules on how it performs them
designating further CLP provisions whose breach is criminally punishable
Artikel 9.2.3.2 (as amended by article III, H/I)
rules on labelling of products containing certain substances or mixtures
p: Allows an amvb to make additional CLP provisions criminally enforceable, which would otherwise require a statute, with the amvb lapsing after one year unless a bill is submitted.

parties: Asks what framework governs the joint enforcement strategy and programme and whether tasks are delegated to other organisations.
What is the framework for that enforcement strategy and programme and how is it determined?
Wat is het kader voor die handhavingstrategie en het programma en op welke wijze wordt dit bepaald?
Questions the usefulness of the central EU database and who controls compliance and with what priority, and asks about criteria for priority labelling set by whom.
Who checks compliance with this obligation and with what priority?
Wie controleert de naleving van deze verplichting en met welke prioriteit?
Wants assurance the government does not go beyond what the EU requires, and questions the costs for SMEs and follow-up on quick-scan recommendations.
it does not go further in implementing this regulation than what the EU requires
zij bij de uitvoering van deze verordening niet verder gaat dan wat door de EU wordt verplicht

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill should explicitly name the Minister of VROM alongside 'Onze betrokken Minister' in article 18.2b Wm, given the Wm's system where VROM is 'Onze Minister'. The government disagreed, arguing that 'Onze betrokken Minister' ordinarily includes VROM, and accepted only the drafting remark on citing the EU regulation.
concerns: The Raad advised explicitly naming the Minister of VROM alongside 'Onze betrokken Minister' in article 18.2b Wm and reviewing other chapter 18 provisions for enforcement by 'Onze Minister'; the government rejected this, holding that 'Onze betrokken Minister' covers VROM.
The Raad suggested replacing 'preparaten' with 'mengsels' in article 17.6 Wm; the government declined because that provision implements Directive 2004/35/EC and will not be amended.
The Raad advised deleting duplicate article III, part T, which the government accepted by adding the EU regulation's details to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

31948.s: The bill abolishes the ministerial preventive no-objection statement (verklaring van geen bezwaar) for incorporations and articles amendments of public and private companies under Dutch Civil Code Book 2, and replaces it with continuous ex post control of a broader set of legal persons under the renamed Wet controle op rechtspersonen. The Minister of Justice may issue risk notifications (risicomeldingen) to a designated group of enforcement bodies, which may use and receive personal data including on family members, with secrecy obligations and confidentiality rules set by general administrative order.
31948.j: The memorandum justifies the shift by arguing that the preventive no-objection check is ineffective and easily circumvented, while continuous risk-based control with data linkage is needed to prevent abuse of legal persons and terrorist and money-laundering financing.
q: The preventive supervision not only has gaps, but is also relatively easy to circumvent.
Het preventieve toezicht vertoont niet alleen leemtes, maar valt daarenboven ook betrekkelijk eenvoudig te omzeilen.
d: Artikel II, C/E (Wet documentatie vennootschappen art. 5 lid 1; art. 6 lid 2; art. 7)
designation of recipient bodies and permitted disclosures of risk notifications and data
exceptions to confidentiality of risk notifications
p: Artikel II, B and F (art. 2 lid 3; art. 5 lid 1)
The Minister may ex officio issue risk notifications about legal persons and their managers based on combined data from open and closed sources, widening executive surveillance without a prior check.
Data may be recorded on other persons determining policy and on relatives of managers where needed for network analysis, extending the reach of state data collection to third parties.
Recipients of risk notifications are bound by secrecy and records are kept for two years, but the secrecy duty can be lifted by general administrative order, allowing use as evidence in court.
Data from the Justitiële Informatiedienst, UWV, police and the tax authority may be passed on for risk notifications, overriding normal confidentiality rules.Annual review of necessity is required.
Artikel I, A-P (BW Book 2 repeals; arts. 174a, 284a)
Removal of the preventive no-objection statement removes an ex ante ministerial check and the associated appeal routes, though appeals against remaining decisions move to the Rotterdam court and CBb.

parties: Asks whether a less sweeping option than ongoing control was considered, whether risk profiles could leave most entities unchecked, and how long risk reports may be retained.
Instead of the radical shift to a system of permanent supervision, the government could also have proposed less far-reaching options.
In plaats van de radicale ommezwaai naar het systeem van permanent toezicht, had de regering ook minder vergaande opties kunnen voorstellen.
Questions how risk reports lead to criminal investigations, how family members' data is retained and reviewed, and whether affected persons can access the data behind a risk report.
What is then the chance that a person concerned gets access to the data that gave rise to a risk report?
Wat is dan de kans van slagen dat een betrokkene inzage krijgt in de gegevens die aanleiding vormden voor een risicomelding?
Asks whether the new control will be effective, how staffing will cope, what 'use' of a risk report means, and who will supervise deletion of family members' data.
They ask the government who will supervise the actual deletion of this data.
Zij vragen de regering wie er gaat toezien op het daadwerkelijk verwijderen van deze gegevens.

Supports combating misuse but questions the error margins of automated and manual risk analysis, the use of data on friends and business partners, privacy limits under EVRM and the Grondwet, and whether designated enforcers should be set by law rather than by general administrative order.
These members further ask to what extent data on parents, children and grandchildren may be processed and where the limit lies under article 8 of the ECHR.

Deze leden vragen voorts in hoeverre de verwerking van gegevens van ouders, kinderen en kleinkinderen verwerkt mogen worden en waar hier de grens ligt met artikel 8 van het Europees Verdrag tot Bescherming van de Rechten voor de Mens en Fundamentele Vrijheden (EVRM).

v.summary: The Raad van State supports the bill replacing preventive company-approval supervision with permanent risk-profile screening of legal persons, but raises effectiveness concerns and serious privacy objections, especially to screening parents, children and grandchildren of persons linked to companies and to retention periods. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice: it adds a clause limiting family data to where relevant, adds an annual review of retained data, and requires recipients to delete unused risk reports after two years, while defending the family-screening scope with BIBOB experience.
concerns: The Raad doubts the effectiveness of the new screening system since it is unclear whether and how risk reports will be used by enforcement bodies; the government adds explanation and describes improvements and a handhavingsgremium.

Screening of parents, children and grandchildren of persons linked to companies is a far-reaching privacy intrusion requiring a pressing social need; the government keeps the scope but commits to annual review and possible adjustment of risk profiles.
The restrictions on family data processing stated in the explanatory memorandum are absent from the bill text; the government adds a new paragraph and amends the provisions to align them.
Retention of personal data in identifiable form exceeds necessity under data protection law; the government adds an annual review of retained data and a deletion obligation.
The bill does not oblige recipients of risk reports to delete them after the two-year use period; the government adds an obligation for recipients to delete unused risk reports.
Editorial remark that the explanatory memorandum should clarify that the risk analysis is part of the risk report; adopted.

31957.s: The bill establishes the legal framework for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba as public bodies (openbare lichamen) within the Dutch state, setting out which former Netherlands Antilles regulations remain applicable through an annexed list and how transitional law is handled. It also introduces emergency-powers provisions for the islands and several delegation grounds allowing lower-level regulations (AMvB and ministerial regulations) in health, agriculture, social welfare and youth care.
31957.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the small population and geographic distance of the islands, the need for quick, locally adapted rules, and the temporary nature of delegation pending later formal legislation.
q: First, there may be constitutional objections to not adopting an Antillean regulation, departing from the starting point of the Final Declaration.
Ten eerste kunnen er grondwettelijke bezwaren zijn om in afwijking van het uitgangspunt van de Slotverklaring een Antilliaanse regeling niet over te nemen.
d: youth care provision on the islands
animal disease control, imports, identification, slaughter
mandatory health insurance coverage and premium
infectious disease control measures incl. isolation, quarantine, closure of premises
amending the annex list of applicable regulations
amending transferred regulations within one year after transition
temporary arrangements that may deviate from the statute within one year
p: Allows the Prime Minister, by royal decree in extraordinary circumstances, to bring emergency provisions into force without a declared state of emergency, subject to a bill to parliament afterwards.
Lets a minister deviate from statutes by ministerial regulation for up to one year after transition, with a later duty to propose corrective legislation.
Authorises AMvB measures for infectious disease control including isolation, quarantine and closure of premises, without parliamentary approval.
Excludes most of the General Administrative Law Act for decisions by Dutch-seated bodies, replacing it with the local administrative court regime, which keeps judicial review available locally.

parties: Questions the proposal to amend formal laws and general administrative measures by ministerial decision, a year-long parliamentary exception, and whether fundamental-right matters (home entry, education freedom, welfare) get adequate statutory basis.
Even for unique legislative operations like this, these members believe the primacy of the legislature should be the starting point.
Zelfs bij unieke wetgevingsoperaties als deze dient, menen deze leden, het primaat van de wetgever uitgangspunt te zijn.
Asks on what criteria Antillean regulation is judged adequate, and whether the Tweede Kamer can meaningfully pronounce on the final list of applicable rules given late ministerial amendments.

Do the PvdA members understand correctly that for practical reasons the Tweede Kamer will therefore not be able to pronounce on the definitive list of regulations that will apply to the BES islands after the transition?

Zien de leden van de PvdA-fractie het goed dat om praktische redenen de Tweede Kamer zich derhalve niet zal kunnen uitspreken over de definitieve lijst van regelgeving die voor de BES-eilanden na de transitie tot openbaar lichaam van toepassing zal zijn?

Finds it unacceptable that important social security and public health rules will be set by general administrative measure with little parliamentary involvement, and questions the criteria for choosing statute versus lower regulation.
The VVD members find this unacceptable.
De leden van de VVD-fractie achten dit niet aanvaardbaar.
Asks when the government will send the promised amendment on education laws and requests a long-term education plan, without focusing on checks.
When does the government expect to send this amendment note to the Tweede Kamer?
Wanneer verwacht de regering deze nota van wijziging naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen?

Asks about the consequences of excluding most of the General Administrative Law Act for objections, possibly slowing review for Dutch residents, and about the distinction between limited and general emergency states.
Is the risk not high that the presence of two kinds of administrative law will slow down the assessment of objections, which could also have negative consequences for residents of the Netherlands?

Is het risico niet groot dat de aanwezigheid van twee soorten bestuursrecht vertragend zal werken bij de beoordeling van bijvoorbeeld bezwaarschriften, wat ook negatieve gevolgen kan hebben voor de inwoners van Nederland?
Argues the constitutional requirement that the right to welfare assistance be regulated by statute is not met by a general administrative measure, and wants the arrangements on onderstand set in law.
In the view of the GroenLinks members, the Council of State rightly points out that the Dutch Constitution requires that the right to assistance be regulated by statute.
Naar het oordeel van de leden van de Groenlinks-fractie wijst de Raad van State er terecht op dat de Nederlandse Grondwet verlangt dat het recht op bijstand bij wet wordt geregeld.

Holds that setting welfare entitlement by administrative measure fails the constitutional statutory requirement and asks when it should be regulated by law; also asks why youth-care obligations are not imposed.
The ChristenUnie members are of the view that this constitutional obligation is not met by adopting a general administrative measure.
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie zijn van mening dat aan deze grondwettelijke verplichting niet wordt voldaan door het vaststellen van een algemene maatregel van bestuur.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Invoeringswet openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba, raising objections on delegation bases (personal data, youth care, education, public health), applicability of Dutch administrative law, state emergency law, and transitional law. The government's nader rapport largely accepts the advice, amending the bill (scrapping several delegation bases, converting education ordinances into statutes, applying the Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES, and adding transitional provisions for island staff).
concerns: Delegation of personal data basic administration rules to AMvB violates Article 10 of the Constitution; the government removed the delegation and converted the ordinance into a statute.
Broad delegation for education in AMvB and ministerial regulation conflicts with Article 23 of the Constitution; the government scrapped the delegation and moved education regulation to statutes.
Inspection powers to enter homes without consent lack the procedural safeguards required by Article 12 of the Constitution; the government clarified that homes are excluded from non-consensual entry.
Regulation of destitution support (onderstand) must be set by law under Article 20(3); the government kept only main elements in the bill and left detail to an AMvB, adding a criterion.

Unclear which administrative law applies to decisions by Dutch bodies affecting the islands; the government revised Article 3 to apply the Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES and removed opt-out clauses.
Open-ended experimental and price-fixing delegations to the Crown were narrowed or removed.
Transitional rules for decisions and personnel of island bodies were inadequate; the government added provisions for transfer of island staff under equivalent terms.
State emergency law applying to both parts of the Kingdom and unclear authority allocation was clarified, though the six-year sunset was not fully justified and was dropped.
Redactional comments and several cross-reference corrections were incorporated.

31965-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget schedule for the Other High Colleges of State and Cabinets (IIB), adding funds for the Raad van State and the Nationale ombudsman and other items, effective 1 June 2009. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, only budget adjustments.
q: The budget schedule for the Other High Colleges of State and Cabinets for 2009 is amended, as shown in the schedule attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat inzake de Overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31966.s: The bill suspends the statutory indexation of child benefit amounts (kinderbijslag) due on 1 July 2009, keeping them at the 1 January 2009 level. It also redefines the price index base for the next indexation on 1 January 2010 to the April 2009 consumer price index, with effect from 1 July 2009.
31966.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension by the need to control spending on child benefit.
q: it is desirable, in connection with controlling expenditure on child benefit, to omit the indexation of the child benefit amounts as of 1 July 2009
wenselijk is in verband met de beheersing van de uitgaven aan kinderbijslag de indexering van de bedragen voor de kinderbijslag per 1 juli 2009 achterwege te laten

parties: Accepts the measure given its budgetary yield and small purchasing-power effect; raises no check-related point.
Given the yield of this measure and since it has a small effect on purchasing power, these members can agree with this measure.
Gezien de opbrengsten van deze maatregel en aangezien de maatregel een gering effect op de koopkracht heeft, kunnen deze leden instemmen met deze maatregel.
Asks for broader insight into purchasing-power effects on lower-income and benefit households over several years.
Said members would like broader insight into the consequences of this proposal for people who have to get by on an income below modal.
Genoemde leden willen graag een breder inzicht in de gevolgen van dit voorstel voor de mensen die rond moeten komen van een inkomen lager dan modaal.
Opposes cutting child benefit during the crisis, arguing it hurts low-income families, and asks why savings were not made income-dependent.
For the members of the SP faction it is incomprehensible that the government chooses to cut child benefit.
Voor de leden van de SP-fractie is het onbegrijpelijk dat de regering ervoor kiest om te bezuinigen op de kinderbijslag.
Understands the need for savings but questions whether 2010 indexation is assured and asks for an overview of cumulative purchasing-power effects and implementation costs.
Can the government say with certainty that indexation will take place in 2010?
Kan de regering met zekerheid zeggen dat in 2010 wel geïndexeerd zal worden?
Asks for explanation of overspending in the kindgebonden budget and of budget uncertainty linked to the future consumer price index.
In the implementation of the child-related budget (WKB) overspending has been found from 2009 onwards, according to the explanatory memorandum.
In de uitvoering van het kindgebonden budget (WKB) zijn vanaf 2009 overschrijdingen geconstateerd, aldus de memorie van toelichting.

31975.s: The bill updates the Dutch Seafarers Manning Act to refer to the 2008 EU minimum training directive (2008/106/EC) in place of the 2001 directive, and adds a ministerial power to set the entry-into-force date and rename the directive by ministerial decision published in the Staatscourant. It also makes the bill retroactive to 23 December 2008.
31975.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as necessary to implement the EU directive and to adjust references in related regulations, and states the bill does not change burdens on business or citizens.
q: On 23 December 2008 directive no. 2008/106/EC entered into force.
Op 23 december 2008 is in werking getreden richtlijn nr. 2008/106/EG
d: alternative entry-into-force date for amendments to the manning directive
renaming the directive and changing references to its parts
p: The minister may set a different date for amendments to the EU directive to take effect in Dutch law, bypassing the default timing in the statute, subject only to publication in the Staatscourant.

31993.s: The bill changes the Fonds economische structuurversterking by replacing its funding formula with a long-term system based on the value of natural gas reserves and a voedingspercentage set by law, and broadens the categories of investment projects eligible for funding. It also allows fund contributions to decentralisation grants and the BTW-compensatiefonds, with ministers gaining discretion over conditions tied to municipal and provincial project execution.
31993.j: The memorandum justifies the new formula as giving stable fund revenue given finite gas reserves, and says the grant route is needed so a general decentralisation grant can be funded while requiring that the receiving authority carry out a qualifying project.
q: In a structure using a decentralisation grant there is no longer any financial accountability or audit by subnational governments to the state, nor any possibility of recovery.

In een structuur met toepassing van een decentralisatie-uitkering is er geen sprake meer van een financiële verantwoording en accountantscontrole door medeoverheden aan het rijk, noch van de mogelijkheid tot terugvordering.
d: reporting rules for municipal and provincial project progress under decentralisation grants
p: Allows fund money to flow into decentralisation grants to municipalities and provinces, a channel that reduces the financial accountability and clawback the earlier earmarked funding carried.
Permits a general contribution to the BTW-compensatiefonds budget departing from the standard rule in that fund's law, without a stated parliamentary check.

parties: Asks how the FES funding is secured after 2012, which parts are fixed, and how firmly a substantial share of gas revenues can be anchored in investment.
What options does the government see to more firmly anchor that a substantial part of gas revenues will also be invested in the economic structure after 2012?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om steviger te verankeren dat een substantieel deel van de aardgasbaten ook na 2012 in de economische structuur wordt geïnvesteerd?
Asks how the FES procedure could be democratised, how parliament can gain insight into projects and selection, and why the parliamentary role is limited.
How could the House be involved in the selection of FES-worthy projects and the final choice that is made?
Hoe zou de Kamer betrokken kunnen worden bij de selectie van FES-waardige projecten en de uiteindelijke keuze die gemaakt wordt?
Questions the basis of the 1.7 billion minimum and the lack of a link between actual financing sources and the fund, and the effect on general budget stability.
In general, the SP members miss the link between the actual financing sources used to feed the fund and the fund's endowment.
In het algemeen missen de leden van de SP-fractie de relatie tussen de daadwerkelijke financieringsbronnen die worden ingezet om het fonds mee te voeden en de voeding van het fonds.
Asks for responses to the Council of State advice, whether the government will follow it, and how the proposed statutory minimum and per-cabinet funding decisions work.
Furthermore, these members ask whether the government intends to follow the Council of State's advice regarding the use of gas revenues for the fund rather than for its own political preferences.

Voorts vragen deze leden of de regering voornemens is het advies van de Raad van State op te volgen in relatie tot de besteding van de aardgasgelden ten behoeve van het fonds in plaats van ten behoeve van eigen politieke voorkeuren.
Warns about procyclical effects and uncertainty in gas revenue estimates, and asks how the value-of-gas assumptions and the discount rate could be corrected.
What consequences arise if the estimate turns out to be inaccurate?
Welke gevolgen treden op indien de schatting onnauwkeurig blijkt te zijn?
Asks why the government departs from the advice of the Study Group on budget space to abolish the FES bridge, and how project selection could be opened up with stakeholder input and evaluation.
These members ask what the reason is that the government departs from the advice of the budget space study group.
Deze leden vragen wat de reden is dat de regering afwijkt van het advies van de studiegroep begrotingsruimte.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the Wet FES amendment on the funding formula and eligible investment categories be reconsidered, notably regarding use of gas revenues outside the FES and fixing the funding percentage by delegation rather than in statute. The government's nader rapport accepts the point on fixing the percentage in law, rejects the criticism on gas revenue use and provides further figures, and adopts the advice against decentralisation grants from the FES, though it allows them with conditions tied to a FES project.
concerns: The Afdeling holds that the funding percentage is essential and belongs in statute rather than being set by ministers, and the government amended the bill so the percentage is fixed by law.

The Afdeling finds insufficient quantified information on gas revenues and their allocation, and asks that debt redemption be considered; the government promises a consolidated annual overview and points to integrated future budget decisions.

The Afdeling advises against allowing FES funds to flow to provinces and municipalities as decentralisation grants because this undermines the investment purpose of the Act; the government accepts this only with conditions requiring a FES project.
The Afdeling asks for clarity on the periodicity of revising funding percentages in view of the need for stability; the government clarifies the six-paragraph mechanism in article 2.

The Afdeling advises not to include a provision on Council of Ministers deliberation already regulated by the rules of procedure; the government does not further address this beyond noting it moots the point.

32123-XI.s: The bill formally establishes the 2010 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (VROM), the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit baten-lastendienst, and the Waddenfonds. It also allows the VROM budget explanatory notes to present budget information per policy article rather than per article as the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 normally requires, as part of a government experiment.
32123-XI.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as necessary for an experiment to improve political accountability, to be evaluated in 2010.
q: The experiment will be evaluated in 2010.
Het experiment zal worden geëvalueerd in 2010.

32222-XI.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statements of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (XI) and of the Wadden Fund, aligned with the Autumn Memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry into force as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (XI) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer (XI) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32389.s: The bill reduces and simplifies central government supervision of provinces and municipalities by revising the generic instruments of annulment and substitute action (indeplaatsstelling) in the Provinciewet and Gemeentewet, and removing many sector-specific supervisory provisions in other statutes. It also transfers some supervisory powers to ministers and makes provisions for appeal and information duties regarding such interventions.
32389.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need to reduce supervisory burden, remove sector-specific supervision and strengthen provincial and municipal autonomy, relying on the existing generic instruments as a sober, proportionate alternative.
q: Supervisory interventions will in principle be limited to generic instruments in the Provinciewet and Gemeentewet and applied only where there is conflict with law or the general interest.

Toezichtinterventies zullen in beginsel beperkt worden tot generieke instrumenten in de Provinciewet en de Gemeentewet en alleen dan worden toegepast indien er strijd is met het recht of het algemeen belang
d: provincial bodies deciding in place of a delegated commission
minister substitutes provincial bodies that fail to perform statutory duties
rules on systematic information provision on provincial implementation
minister exercises municipal supervision powers for listed statutes
rules on information provision on municipal implementation
p: Ministers and the Crown may take over provincial and municipal duties directly when bodies fail to perform, with a notice period and an appeal route to the Council of State.
Ministers can request or assume enforcement powers over municipalities in listed statutes when a weighty general interest is at stake, shifting them from provincial to ministerial supervision.
Royal decrees annulling local decisions may impose substitute decisions and bar new decisions, and set deadlines for compliance.
Substitute-action powers over water boards are extended to the environmental act, applying the provincial and municipal regimes.
Removes the inspector's independent role and several enforcement instruments, and excludes objection procedures against certain decisions, concentrating enforcement in the competent authority.
Lists statutes (social welfare, environment, health) under which ministers take over municipal supervisory powers.

parties: Asks whether specific supervisory provisions will be reintroduced in future laws, whether the Minister of BZK will be involved, and how the interventieladder and substitution/annulment will work in practice.
Will the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations be involved (consultation or consent) if a sector minister considers including a specific supervisory provision in a bill?

Wordt de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties er bij betrokken (overleg dan wel toestem ming), als een vakminister overweegt om in een bepaald wetsvoorstel een specifieke toezichtsbepaling op te nemen?

Supports giving lower governments room, but wants clear criteria, tight framing of annulment and substitution, and reassurance that the Rijk's override does not undermine provincial judgement or state unity.
At the same time, the PvdA members note hesitations from VNG, IPO and the Council of State about whether the powers are framed tightly enough in the present proposal.
Tegelijk constateren de leden van de PvdA-fractie aarzelingen bij VNG, IPO en Raad van State of de bevoegdheden op de nu voorliggende wijze strak genoeg ingekaderd zijn.

Supports horizontal trust and fewer inspections but asks how the interventieladder, the role of municipal councils and provincial states, and the scope of substitution and annulment will function, and why the Natuurbeschermingswet override powers should be dropped.
Asks how the cultural shift toward generic instruments will be achieved, what the added value of escalation to a higher layer is, and how central government keeps oversight of policies it finances.
Horizontal accountability means control close to policy implementation. But much policy is financed by the national government.
Horizontale verantwoording betekent controle dicht bij de uitvoering van het beleid. Maar veel beleid wordt door de landelijke overheid gefinancierd.
Welcomes simplification and horizontal checks but asks whether generic instruments will be overused, how often they will be applied, and for explicit evaluation criteria and objectivity safeguards.
Nevertheless, the aforementioned members pose several questions to clarify the present bill.
Desalniettemin stellen de voornoemde leden enkele vragen ter verduidelijking van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel.

Wants central supervision of provinces' supervision of municipalities not to go too far, asks for clearer definition of 'zwaarwegend algemeen belang' for ministerial substitution, and asks how provinces can resist misuse; also asks for a built-in evaluation clause.
They consider it a good thing that, following the Council of State's advice, it was decided to make this possible only in case of a weighty general interest.
Zij vinden het een goede zaak dat naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State is besloten om dit alleen mogelijk te maken bij een zwaarwegend algemeen belang.
Endorses the bill's starting point and has no questions.
They endorse the starting point of the bill. They have no questions regarding the bill.
Zij onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van het wetsvoorstel. Zij hebben naar aanleiding van het wetsvoorstel geen vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the nota van wijziging to the Wet revitalisering generiek toezicht, raising objections to delayed entry into force of provincial ordinances under the Wilg, to ministerial rule-making powers in the Jeugdzorg act, and to the terminology of ministerial co-involvement in the Wgr. The government's nader rapport follows the advice on these points, dropping the delay, the ministerial regulations and the terminology change, and applies the redactional remarks.
concerns: Delayed entry into force of provincial ordinances (eight-week moratorium) amounts to a de facto approval requirement, an unjustified exception to the generic supervision regime, and was dropped.

Ministerial regulations on the exercise of provincial instruction powers and on the provincial youth-care policy framework are too detailed and add no value beside the national framework; they were dropped.
Ministerial co-involvement terminology in Wgr articles 102 and 103c should be 'in overeenstemming met', not 'gezamenlijk'; the proposed change was withdrawn.
Numerous redactional remarks on cross-references, numbering and transitional provisions were incorporated.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill revitalising generic interbestuurlijk toezicht in the Provinciewet and Gemeentewet, raising objections on indeplaatsstelling, dual supervision, rights protection, and evaluation. The government's nader rapport accepts many points, partly follows others, and rejects the proposal to bind the Crown and to restrict the national minister's power only partly.
concerns: Advice to limit the minister's power under artikel 124a to exceptional cases; government adds a 'zwaarwegend algemeen belang' criterion instead of a full enumeration.
Advice to drop resultaatsverplichtingen as object of supervision was not followed; government retains them, arguing that time limits otherwise make indeplaatsstelling ineffective.
Advice to restrict the power to annul decisions based on annulled generic regulations to EU state-aid subsidy rules was rejected as discretion suffices to protect legal certainty.
Advice to remove the appeal to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak against refusal of the Crown to annul was accepted; the Raad's view that judicial review is unsuitable was adopted.
Advice to limit appeal against indeplaatsstelling to the taakverwaarlozend bestuursorgaan, and to clarify remedies, was accepted.
Redactional comments on wording of articles 121 to 124f and the bijlage were largely incorporated.
Advice on a statutory evaluation clause, longer evaluation period and overgangsrecht: government explained no statutory clause was chosen and added transitional provisions only for the 2012 transfer.

32395-V.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting obligations, expenditures and receipts across policy articles following the spring memorandum. It also sets the effective date of the amendment and provides for retroactive effect to 1 June 2010 under certain publication timing.

32398.s: The bill establishes a legal framework for forensic mental health care within criminal law, covering placement, indication, funding and oversight of institutions treating offenders with psychiatric disorders or intellectual disabilities. It aims to better connect forensic care with general mental health care and reduce recidivism, while centralising placement power and institutional powers with the Minister of Justice.
32398.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and central placement powers by the need for unified, person-oriented care, consistent indication, and the minister's ministerial responsibility for public safety and execution of sentences.
q: The starting point is to connect as much as possible with existing legal frameworks, structures, powers and responsibilities.
Het uitgangspunt is om zoveel mogelijk aan te sluiten bij bestaande wettelijke kaders, structuren, bevoegdheden en verantwoordelijkheden.
d: designating other care forms as forensic care
categories of persons receiving forensic care
management, designation conditions, security and housing rules for institutions
contract content, financing and data processing rules
fine amounts, placement, transport and supervision rules
performance descriptions and tariff categories set by ministers after NZa advice
minister may give instructions to private institution board, take over management, suspend director
p: The Minister may instruct, take over management of, or suspend the director of private institutions designated for compulsory psychiatric care, bypassing their supervisory boards.
Placement of forensic patients is decided by the Minister of Justice based on an indication, with the minister setting conditions and imposing fines on institutions.
The Minister may temporarily transfer forensic patients to other institutions for up to seven weeks, extendable by four weeks, for safety or treatment reasons.
The Minister may order transfer of a prisoner to a psychiatric hospital for as long as necessary, with an involuntary admission permit required unless the patient consents.
Article 37 of the Criminal Code is amended so a criminal judge may grant a compulsory psychiatric admission permit under the Bopz, subject to the statutory criteria.
Supervision of compliance with forensic care conditions is assigned to the public prosecution service and the Minister may commission reintegration services.

parties: Asks whether the bill emphasises containment over care and whether matters delegated to general administrative orders (amvb) can be clarified.
Members of the VVD group have received signals from practice that the drawback of this law is that it places heavy emphasis on control rather than on care.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben signalen uit de praktijk gekregen dat het bezwaar van deze wet is dat er fors op beheersing wordt gezet en niet op zorg.
Criticises the market-based contracting model, the minister's dual role as client, financer and quality controller, and the Council of State's objections.
In this situation the ministry wears two hats: it holds the implementation, the financing and the control in its hands.
Het ministerie heeft in deze situatie een dubbele pet op: hij heeft de uitvoering, de financiering en de controle in handen.
Asks about the number of prisoners with psychiatric disorders, the expected effect on recidivism, and how forensic and regular care connect.
Members of the PVV group ask how many people are admitted each year to the prison system with a psychiatric disorder or intellectual disability.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen hoeveel personen er in het gevangeniswezen jaarlijks worden opgenomen met een psychische stoornis of verstandelijke beperking.

Supports continuity of care but questions why the minister needs directive powers over contracted institutions and why scarp contracting conditions cannot suffice; worries about the burden of registration and inspection.
Is it then not strange that the minister also has directive power over the contracted institutions (article 3.3), they ask.
