Is het dan niet vreemd dat de minister daarnaast ook zeggingskracht heeft in de gecontracteerde instellingen (artikel 3.3.), zo vragen zij.
Worries about financial incentives, marketisation, bureaucracy, the DBBc funding system, and the access of detainees to care and fees.
In addition, the members of the SP group are concerned about financial incentives and market forces in forensic care and the accompanying bureaucracy.
Daarnaast maken de leden van de SP-fractie zich zorgen over financiële prikkels en marktwerking in de forensische zorg en daarmee gepaard gaande bureaucratie.
Agrees with the Council of State that broad delegation of fundamental-rights limitations to lower regulation is inappropriate and that the indication procedure is premature.
The members of the D66 group agree with the Council of State that the delegation provisions in the bill should be struck out.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn het eens met het standpunt van de Raad van State dat de delegatiebepalingen uit het wetsvoorstel ... dienen te worden geschrapt.
Supports the bill's premise but raises points on implementation and asks about new providers entering the market and quality assurance.
They endorse the starting point of the bill, but at this stage do make some remarks on the elaboration of the bill.
Zij onderschrijven het uitgangspunt van het wetsvoorstel, maar maken in dit stadium wel enige opmerkingen bij de uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks for clarity on the relation between the Bvt and the new law, the scope of the open-ended regulatory power in article 3.4, and the use of directive powers over private institutions.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet forensische zorg, criticising the lack of demonstrated link to stated goals, market-based intramural procurement, the unclear indication procedure, legal protection gaps and data protection, and advised reconsidering the bill. The minister's nader rapport accepts several points (explanatory memorandum expanded, data provisions tightened, clarifications on instructions and categories of institutions) but rejects others, including the call for judicial appeal against refusal of machtiging and the advice to abandon market-based intramural procurement.
concerns: The Raad doubted the bill would achieve its stated goals of rehabilitation, recidivism reduction and safety; the minister expanded the explanatory memorandum on objectives.
The Raad advised against a market-based procurement model for intramural forensic care because competition is unrealistic; the minister disagreed and pointed to contracting experience.
The indication procedure for advice and decision was premature and unclear, and the Raad advised reconsidering it with the judiciary and field; the minister announced a reconsideration.
Release after expiry of the criminal title should not require ministerial authorisation; the minister kept the requirement as an administrative safeguard.
Refusal of ministerial authorisation or consent should be appealable to a court under Article 5(4) ECHR; the minister rejected judicial appeal as of little added value.
Ministerial power to appoint a member of a tbs-institution's supervisory board blurs internal and external supervision; the minister argued the board's deliberation rules are unaffected.

Scope of forensic care should be fixed in the law rather than delegated to AMvB, given coercive treatment and restrictions of fundamental rights; the minister kept the delegation for future expansion.
Coercive admission must not be possible on a public prosecutor's order without a judge; the minister accepted clarification that a strafbeschikking cannot impose dwangopname.
Remaining fragmentation of legal protection across several courts should be simplified; the minister partly accepted this and proposed later reforms.
Indication-decision appeals under the AWBZ framework are ill-suited to forensic care; the Raad advised a different appeal route, which the minister addressed in the indication reconsideration.
Data provisions on medical and criminal data were too general and conflicted with the prohibition on processing special data; the minister tightened the data provisions and moved detail to an AMvB.
Doctors should not be obliged to disclose medical confidences where no overriding interest; the minister removed the overrides, subject to a possible future duty when needed.
Patient rights under the Wbp, civil code and Penitentiary Principles Act should be explained in the explanatory memorandum; the minister added this.
Legal status of patients should be harmonised across institution types; the minister deferred this to a second tranche.
Penitentiary psychiatric centres offer limited care and cannot yet be a full alternative; the minister clarified the care model and inspection.
Observation provisions borrowed from the Code of Criminal Procedure are too vague and should be written out in full; the minister said this would be addressed via the indication procedure.
Emergency procedure lacks time limits and an appeal route; the minister's response addressed the procedure in the indication reconsideration.
Explanatory memorandum should be made more structured and consistent; the minister partly reorganised and clarified it.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the second amendment to the Wet forensische zorg, which allows obtaining medical records of suspects refusing pro justitia examination without consent, breaching medical confidentiality; it advised splitting this provision into a separate bill, consulting relevant bodies, and motivating proportionality and subsidiarity under Article 10 of the Constitution and Article 8 ECHR. The government's reply rejected splitting the bill, but accepted seeking further advice from relevant organisations and adding an explanation of compatibility with constitutional, ECHR and data protection rules.
concerns: The Afdeling argued the medical-records provision is alien to the framework law and risks delaying its 1 January 2013 entry into force, advising a separate bill; the government rejected splitting it.

Insufficient advice from relevant bodies (College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens, Raad voor de Rechtspraak, NOvA, RSJ) on a provision breaching medical confidentiality; government followed by seeking urgent advice from these organisations.

The provision interferes with private life (Art. 10 Constitution, Art. 8 ECHR) and processes sensitive personal data, and the explanatory memorandum lacks justification of proportionality and subsidiarity; the government added an explanation of compatibility with these rules.
Minor redactional changes and additions were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

32479.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act so that, for the household waste charge, the liable person is clarified in cases of room rental and sequential use. The change lets the municipal official designate the liable household member and lets the lessor or grantor of sequential use charge the fee on to the occupant.
32479.j: The memorandum justifies the change by a practical charging problem in room rental where essential shared facilities are used jointly, so the municipal power to designate the liable member is made explicit.
q: Part b aims to solve the charging problem that arose in practice, particularly with room occupancy.
Onderdeel b beoogt het in de praktijk gebleken heffingsprobleem bij met name kamerbewoning op te lossen
d: designation of liable household member by municipal official

parties: SP supports the goal of collecting the waste charge from room rentals but asks how collection and access for individual room residents should be arranged and whether statutory requirements are needed.
They endorse the rationale behind the proposed solution for collecting the waste charge on room rentals.
Zij onderschrijven de ratio achter de voorgestelde oplossing voor het innen van de afvalstoffenheffing bij kamerverhuur.

32488.s: The bill reintroduces links between the expropriation procedure and the planning procedures in the Spoedwet wegverbreding, Tracéwet, Waterwet and Wet ruimtelijke ordening, so that summons to expropriated parties can only be issued after the planning decision is adopted. It also provides that expropriation judgments may only be entered in public registers once the planning decision has become irrevocable, confirmed by a Raad van State ruling or secretary's declaration.
32488.j: The memorandum explains that the decoupling had been criticised because property could transfer before expropriation was definitively necessary, and the bill restores the coupling to address this.
q: This bill provides for the reintroduction of links between the expropriation procedure and procedures regulated in the Spoedwet wegverbreding, the Tracéwet, the Waterwet and the Wet ruimtelijke ordening.

Dit wetsvoorstel voorziet in de hernieuwde invoering van koppelingen tussen de onteigeningsprocedure en procedures zoals geregeld in de Spoedwet wegverbreding, de Tracéwet, de Waterwet en de Wet ruimtelijke ordening.
p: Artikel I (Spoedwet wegverbreding art. 16); Artikel II (Tracéwet art. 20b-20c); Artikel III (Waterwet art. 5.14); Artikel IV (Wet ruimtelijke ordening art. 3.36b)

Expropriated parties' ability to be summoned and judgments taking effect are tied to the planning decision becoming irrevocable, which strengthens legal protection against premature transfer of ownership.

32500-IXA.s: This bill formally establishes the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the National Debt (Nationale Schuld, IXA), setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros and fixing the entry-into-force rules. The accompanying explanatory memorandum details interest costs, debt issuance, redemptions and cash management projections for 2010–2015.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2011 belonging to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32587.s: The bill establishes a central national diploma register under the Wet op het onderwijstoezicht that electronically provides diploma data from higher education, vocational education, adult secondary education, NT2 and integration exams to the holder, institutions, government bodies and third parties. It also sets retention periods, correction procedures, and authorisation and data-protection supervision for the register.
32587.j: The memorandum justifies the register and the disclosure powers by fraud reduction, reduced administrative burdens, and the efficiency of public bodies' statutory tasks, and cites the CBP privacy advice.
q: Secondly, data from the diploma register may be provided to (publicly funded) education institutions and the College voor examens for the purpose of application, enrolment or examination of the person concerned.

Ten tweede kunnen via het diplomaregister gegevens worden verstrekt aan (bekostigde) onderwijsinstellingen en het College voor examens, ten behoeve van de aanmelding, inschrijving of examinering van de betrokkene.
d: authorisation of staff processing diploma register data
fees for electronic and written data provision from the register
Artikel 24n lid 1 onder a-d (Artikel I C)
dates set by royal decree (koninklijk besluit) from which diplomas enter the register
dates may be set differently per type of institution and examination
p: Government ministers and the inspectorate may access diploma data without the holder's consent where needed for their statutory tasks, with aggregated use for budgeting pseudonymised.
Named public bodies (BIG register manager, inburgering information system, UWV) may request diploma data without the holder's consent for their statutory tasks.
The minister must log disclosures for twenty years and inform the holder on request of disclosures to public bodies, institutions or third parties.

parties: Asks how the privacy and security of the register are safeguarded, including against hackers and misuse of DigiD access.
Questions which government bodies and third parties such as employers may access the register without the diploma holder's consent, and under what conditions.
Weighs the trust gained from a central register against the privacy risks of central state storage and asks about citizens' access, correction and complaint procedures.
Set against the trust in a diploma's value is the danger to graduates' privacy when their data are stored centrally by the government.
Tegenover het vertrouwen in de waarde van een diploma staat het gevaar voor de privacy van gediplomeerden wanneer hun gegevens centraal door de overheid worden opgeslagen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill establishing a national diploma register but raises concerns about disclosure of diploma data abroad and about notification and correction rights, advising alignment of the text with the Personal Data Protection Act and removal of a correction fee. The government's reply accepts most points, revising the text on data transfers, correction rights and the removal of the fee, and makes several drafting changes.
concerns: Data transfer outside the EU should be aligned with the Personal Data Protection Act's rule permitting transfer on the data subject's explicit request, and the government replaced third-party transfers with transfer to the diploma holder only.

Data subjects must be informed of registration of their diploma data so they can check and correct it; the government clarified the explanatory memorandum to say general information will be provided at issuance and entry into force.
Correction costs should not be charged to data subjects who were not individually notified; the government removed the option to charge a fee for correction.
Several redactional remarks on definitions, article headings, placement of the personal number definition and article references were incorporated.

32677.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Anna Paulowna, Niedorp, Wieringen and Wieringermeer into a new municipality called Hollands Kroon, with transitional arrangements for elections, court districts, police and safety regions. The explanatory memorandum justifies the merger by the vulnerability of the existing municipalities in enforcement capacity and service demands.
32677.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by arguing that the existing municipalities lack sufficient supervision and enforcement capacity and that growing juridification and service demands require larger scale.
q: The municipalities concerned increasingly face a lack of sufficient supervision and enforcement capacity and are unable to resolve this within existing budgets.
De betrokken gemeenten kampen in toenemende mate met gebrek aan voldoende toezichts- en handhavingsmogelijkheden en zijn niet in staat om dit alles binnen de bestaande begrotingen op te lossen.

parties: Wants the bill handled quickly to avoid a one-year delay of the merger, without raising checks on the executive.
The VVD members want to prevent the merger of the municipalities from being delayed by a year.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen namelijk graag voorkomen dat de samenvoeging van de gemeenten een jaar wordt vertraagd.
Asks how local communities and residents in Niedorp will have participation and inspraak, and whether residents were properly consulted.
First, there are signals that the participation procedures were not followed.
Allereerst zijn er signalen over het niet navolgen van de inspraakprocedures.

Questions the government's reasoning on the lack of consent from some councils, the provincial decision, and the advice of the Kiesraad and Raad voor het openbaar bestuur on the length of council terms.
The CDA members ask the minister to respond to the advice of both councils and their reasoning.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de minister in te gaan op de adviezen van beide raden en hun argumentatie.
Argues the merger lacks local support, especially in Niedorp, and asks the government to hold off and organise a representative referendum.
These members ask the government to suspend this merger proposal and ask the municipality of Niedorp to organise a representative referendum.
Deze leden vragen de regering dit voorstel voor herindeling aan te houden en de gemeente Niedorp te vragen een representatieve volksraadpleging te organiseren.
Questions whether the 1,078 negative objections in Niedorp show that public support is too limited.
Can the conclusion be justified, based on the 1,078 negative objections in this municipality, that public support is too limited?
Is op basis van de 1 078 negatieve zienswijzen in deze gemeente de con clusie te rechtvaardigen dat het maatschappelijk draagvlak te beperkt is?
Asks whether the requirement that mergers be bottom-up applies also to societal support, not only administrative consent, and asks for justification on election timing.
The ChristenUnie members ask how the lack of societal support in Niedorp fits with the principle, also in the coalition agreement, that mergers should take place from the bottom up.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen hoe het ontbreken van maatschappelijk draagvlak in Niedorp zich verhoudt tot het uitgangspunt – ook in het regeerakkoord – dat herindelingen van onderop plaatsvinden.

32695.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure to allow a writ of summons (exploot van dagvaarding) to be filed electronically with the court registry. Details on when and how electronic filing is allowed, and on reliability and confidentiality, are left to a general administrative order (algemene maatregel van bestuur).
32695.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for staged introduction and technical detail on security and data handling, agreed with the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
q: By general administrative order it is determined in which cases the claimant may file a writ of summons electronically.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt bepaald in welke gevallen de eiser een exploot van dagvaarding elektronisch kan indienen.
d: cases and conditions for electronic filing of writs of summons
I (artikel 125 Rv, derde lid, tweede volzin)
rules on reliability and confidentiality of electronic filing

parties: Asks whether the Raad voor de rechtspraak's point that electronic delivery needs rules on the form of the writ is answered, and wants a fuller digitisation framework beyond writs alone.
They ask when the government intends to do this.
Zij vragen wanneer de regering dit van plan is te doen.
Asks how the court can verify that an electronic message is authentic, complete and unaltered, and why the defendant has no access to the document.
They ask how this verification will take place.
Zij vragen op welke wijze deze controle zal plaatsvinden.
Insists that people who wish must always be able to inspect, submit, receive and send documents on paper, and warns of fraud and false writs leading to default judgments.
These members stress that abuse in filing a writ of summons must be prevented.
Deze leden benadrukken dat er voor gezorgd moet worden dat misbruik bij het indienen van een exploot van dagvaarding moet worden voorkomen.

32710-IV.s: This bill amends the 2010 departmental budget statement for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the associated budget statement for services operating on a baten-lastenstelsel, with figures in thousands of euros. It sets out the revised budget totals, the realised figures and the resulting slotwet adjustments for the policy and non-policy articles.
q: Receipts turned out higher than budgeted.
De ontvangsten zijn hoger uitgevallen dan begroot.

32767.s: The bill raises the statutory pension age under the General Old Age Pensions Act (AOW) from 65 to 66 for persons reaching 65 on or after 1 January 2020, and raises the accrual start age from 15 to 16. It makes consequential changes to the income tax and wage tax acts, reducing certain tax-facilitated pension accrual rates and raising the age and deelnemingsjaren limits for the 40-year occupational pension scheme.
32767.j: The memorandum justifies the change by population ageing, shrinking workforce and the need to secure long-term support for the AOW, not by any delegation of power.
q: Only in this way can public support for the AOW be secured for the future.
Alleen zo kan het draagvlak voor de AOW voor de toekomst worden veiliggesteld.

parties: Supports longer working lives but asks about transition rules, flexible pension timing, and implementation costs.
The VVD members have taken note with interest of the present bill and endorse the importance of working longer to keep old-age provision sustainable and affordable.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het onderhavige wetsvoorstel en onderschrijven het belang van langer doorwerken in relatie met de beschreven problematiek om de oudedagsvoorziening toekomstbestendig en betaalbaar te houden.
Disappointed the bill was sent to the Chamber despite a very negative Council of State advice and an unclear pension accord; asks why the government did not wait.

The PvdA members are surprised that, despite a very negative advice from the Council of State and an unclear elaboration of the pension accord, the bill was nevertheless sent to the House of Representatives.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn verbaasd dat ondanks een zeer negatief advies van de Raad van State en een nog onduidelijke uitwerking van het pensioenakkoord, het voorliggende wetsvoorstel toch naar de Tweede Kamer is gestuurd.
Asks questions on measures for older workers outside the labour market and on costs of the Aio supplementary income scheme.

The PVV members further ask whether the government can give insight into the increase in costs of the supplementary income provision for the elderly (Aio) resulting from leaving the 50-year accrual period for a full AOW pension unchanged.

De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen verder of de regering inzicht kan geven in de toename van de kosten van de Aanvullende inkomensvoorziening ouderen (Aio) als gevolg van het ongewijzigd laten van de opbouwperiode van 50 jaar voor een volledig AOW-pensioen.
Accepts the age increase but asks for coherent package, flanking policy, and clarity on transitional treatment of workers under the Witteveen framework.
The CDA members ask the government why these points were not all presented together in one package in a bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering waarom deze punten niet allemaal gezamenlijk in een pakket in een wetsvoorstel naar voren zijn gebracht.
Opposes the age increase as unnecessary and unfair; argues it hits lower-income and heavy-job workers and asks for a right to extend employment beyond 65 and protections for cross-border workers.
The SP members have taken note with great disappointment of the bill. Raising the AOW age is unnecessary, unreasonable and therefore undesirable.
De leden van de SP-fractie hebben met grote teleurstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel. Het verhogen van de AOW-leeftijd is onnodig, onredelijk en daarom ongewenst.
Finds the increase too limited to address ageing and presses the government on the Council of State's criticism of the gap between problem urgency and the bill's scope.

The D66 members note that the Council of State judges the discrepancy between, on the one hand, the scale and urgency of the ageing problem, and on the other, the limited scope and pace of the bill, to be too large.

De leden van de D66-fractie constateren dat de Raad van State oordeelt dat de discrepantie tussen enerzijds de omvang en urgentie van de vergrijzingsproblematiek, en anderzijds de beperkte maatvoering en tempo van het wetsvoorstel te groot is.
Wants the bill assessed on sustainability, intergenerational fairness, heavy jobs and participation measures, and asks for intergenerational effects to be mapped.
The GroenLinks members ask the government to map the intergenerational effects of the bill.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen de regering om de intergenerationele effecten van het wetsvoorstel in kaart te brengen.
Accepts the need for later retirement but questions the procedure, the one-year increase versus 67 or life-expectancy linking, the 2020 start date, and the legal basis for penalising emigrants.
Does the government share the view of the ChristenUnie members that the process is not very careful and transparent, and is certainly no model example in this government's aim to reduce bureaucracy?

Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie dat het proces niet erg zorgvuldig en transparant is, en zeker geen schoolvoorbeeld is in het streven van deze regering om de bureaucratie terug te dringen?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised against the bill raising the AOW pension age from 65 to 66 in 2020 combined with tightening the Witteveen pension tax facility, as the pace and scale were disproportionate to the demographic problem and risked public confidence in the AOW. The government's reply rejects the criticism, defends the first step as proportionate, and states it remains open to further steps via a social partners' agreement.
concerns: The Council questioned whether the modest 2020 increase to 66 adequately addresses life expectancy gains and labour shortages, and the government's reply defends it as a first step with social partner talks ongoing.

The Council saw a discrepancy between the urgency of the problem and the scale and pace of measures, and the government's reply disputes this while noting openness to a later age of 67 or life-expectancy linkage.

The Council asked for reasoning on the reduced sustainability contribution (0.3% GDP versus 0.7% in the earlier bill) and on intergenerational burden-sharing and AOW financing, which the government answered by pointing to its overall fiscal consolidation and argued against further fiscalisation.
The Council asked for analysis of the effects of the earlier-starting Witteveen cut on people reaching 65 before 2020, and the government added this to the explanatory memorandum.

The Council asked for the practical consequences of the longer accrual period and lower accrual rates for pension schemes and their financial effects, which the government addressed in the explanatory memorandum.
The Council asked for the underpinning of the 700 million euro yield estimate, which the government explained and added to the explanatory memorandum.

32776.s: The bill approves the 2010 Tokyo tax treaty between the Netherlands and Japan on avoiding double taxation of income, together with its protocol, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and is limited to the European part of the Netherlands.
32776.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by its expected positive effect on Dutch business activity in Japan and by the clear allocation of taxing powers and dispute-settlement procedures it provides.
q: The limits of the taxing powers of both countries are clearly defined and a good basis has been laid for consultation and dispute resolution.
De grenzen van de heffingsbevoegdheden van beide landen zijn duidelijk vastgelegd en er is een goede grondslag gelegd voor overleg en geschillenbeslechting.

parties: Asks whether several treaty provisions conflict with EU law and wants answers to the NOB's unanswered questions for legal certainty.
From the perspective of legal certainty, the VVD members request answers to the questions the NOB raised in this public document.
Vanuit de optiek van rechtszekerheid, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie een antwoord op de vragen die door de NOB in dit openbare stuk zijn gesteld.
Broadly positive about the updated treaty and asks only short clarifying questions on differences with other treaties and treaty shopping.
In general the members are therefore positive about the treaty and only a few brief clarifying questions remain.
In het algemeen zijn de leden dan ook positief over het verdrag en resteren er slechts enkele korte verhelderende vragen.
Welcomes the treaty as an improvement but asks detailed questions on pension taxation, dividend exemptions and stock exchange recognition that bear on fair treatment of taxpayers.
Is it correct that the lower withholding taxes under the treaty do not apply where a foreign parent holds preferred shares in a Dutch subsidiary.
Klopt het dat de lagere bronheffingen uit het verdrag niet van toepassing zijn in de situatie dat een buitenlandse moeder preferente aandelen houdt in een Nederlandse dochter.

Criticises the government's one-sided focus on lowering withholding taxes, asks how parliament was informed during negotiations, and questions the absence of anti-abuse measures and the budget impact.
Can the government indicate how the House of Representatives was informed by the government over the whole period about the progress of the negotiations?
Kan de regering aangeven op welke wijze de Tweede Kamer gedurende die hele periode is geïnformeerd door de regering over de voortgang van de onderhandelingen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill approving the Japan-Netherlands double tax treaty but raises four remarks on the explanatory memorandum: the taxing right for shipping, the beneficial-owner concept, the interest definition, and the residual-income article. The government's reply states that each of the four points was followed by amending the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum wrongly states that taxing rights are allocated to the state where the enterprise is established rather than where the operator or owner is established; the government amended it.
The meaning of 'beneficial owner' is unclear given the OECD commentary and Dutch Supreme Court case law; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The explanatory memorandum's basis for not following domestic interest qualifications, including late-payment penalties, is unclear given the treaty's reference to domestic law; the memorandum was amended.
The residual-income article is likely to apply to income from third countries, which the explanatory memorandum underplays; the memorandum was amended accordingly.

32780-X.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adjusting expenditure and commitment amounts in line with the spring memorandum. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2011.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32785.s: The bill merges the Wet identificatie bij dienstverlening BES, the Wet melding ongebruikelijke transacties BES and the Wet grensoverschrijdende geldtransporten BES into one Wwft BES law against money laundering and terrorist financing in the Caribbean Netherlands. It sets customer due diligence, reporting duties for unusual transactions, cross-border cash declaration, and an expanded enforcement toolkit (aanwijzing, dwangsom, bestuurlijke boete) for the supervisory authority.
32785.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to respond quickly to market developments and new risks, and for effective regulation in line with FATF recommendations.
q: here it was chosen to set the level at ministerial regulation in order to be able to respond quickly to changing circumstances or new insights
hier is gekozen voor het niveau van ministeriële regeling om snel in te kunnen spelen op veranderende omstandigheden of nieuwe inzichten
d: amend annex A list of services
rules on risk profiles and monitoring
amend annex B on records to keep
rules on data processing by the reporting office
exemption for carriers from cash declaration
custody and handling of seized cash
manner of reporting frozen assets to Nederlandsche Bank
p: Supervisory authority may report suspected money laundering findings to the reporting office despite secrecy rules.
Customs officers may detain cash for up to seven days, extendable once, without judicial authorisation.
Supervisory authority gains power to impose directions, penalty payments and administrative fines up to USD 250,000 or 500,000, with administrative appeal available.
Reports made in good faith cannot ground prosecution and reporting parties are shielded from liability, with strict secrecy on reports.
Minister may grant exemptions from the confidentiality prohibition to designated supervisory and marechaussee officers.

parties: Asks on what grounds the minister of Finance and the minister of Security and Justice, and the supervisor, may grant exemptions from client due diligence, and whether the criteria will be anchored in law for legal certainty.
Can the government explain further on what basis an exemption or waiver can be granted?
Kan de regering nader toelichten op basis waarvan vrijstelling of ontheffing kan worden verleend?
Questions how misuse by lawyers, notaries and tax advisers is prevented and who supervises them, and whether the supervisor's capacity to carry out its tasks has been confirmed.
How is abuse prevented? Who supervises that?
Hoe wordt misbruik voorkomen? Wie houdt daar toezicht op?

Asks why the BES islands fall outside the Dutch Wwft, why the bill is being introduced so quickly given communication problems, and what the implementation costs are and which body controls compliance.
Does this bill not actually increase complexity rather than reduce it?
Wordt met dit wetsvoorstel de complexiteit niet juist bevorderd in plaats van verminderd?
Asks how supervision will be strengthened to enforce the rules, what role DNB will have, and to what extent the BES islands already meet FATF recommendations.
Can the government explain why this is so?
Kan de regering toelichten waarom dit zo is?

Asks for an overview of differences with the Dutch Wwft, whether supervisors have one, how much is left to lower regulation, and what the consequences for supervision are of defining scope by services rather than service providers.
Can the government provide an overview of this after all, these members ask
Kan de regering daar alsnog een overzicht van geven, zo vragen deze leden

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wwft BES bill on preventing money laundering and terrorist financing in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, asking for better alignment with the Douane- en Accijnswet BES and inclusion of definitions in Article 1.1. The minister's reply reports that all advice was followed, with the cross-border cash transport rules and enforcement provisions adjusted accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for better alignment between the bill's cross-border cash transport rules and the Douane- en Accijnswet BES, which the government followed by removing duplicated enforcement provisions.
The Afdeling advised moving definitions in Article 4.1 that apply across chapters to Article 1.1, which was adopted.
The Afdeling made several editorial remarks, including removing a paragraph number and clarifying the term controle-zone, which were incorporated.

32839.s: The bill amends the Warmtewet (heat supply act) to replace the dual pricing system with a single maximum price set by the competition authority, introduce supplier licensing, a return-on-investment monitoring and correction regime, and emergency intervention powers for the minister. It also adjusts metering, dispute, enforcement and fining provisions and extends related energy-efficiency rules to cooling networks.
32839.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as necessary to guarantee heat supply and prevent excess profits, with the emergency procedure meant to apply only when a supplier cannot meet its obligations.
q: Articles 12b and 12c of the bill give the minister the power to secure heat supply through an emergency procedure where a heat supplier or producer cannot meet its legal obligations.

Artikel 12b en artikel 12c van het voorstel regelen de bevoegdheid van de minister om middels een noodprocedure de levering van warmte te borgen in het geval dat een warmteleverancier of producent niet aan zijn wettelijke verplichtingen kan voldoen.
d: elements and calculation method of maximum heat price
rules on disconnection of heat consumers and preventive measures
rules on connection contribution to existing heat networks
policy rules on return calculation and reasonable return
requirements for metering devices and data security
content and procedure of licence application
criteria and procedure for licence revocation
rules on separate accounting and annual reporting
compensation for gas network connection costs
requirements and possible levy or ban on waste heat discharge
royal decree bringing rate-of-return provisions into force
p: The minister may order a supplier to take measures, impose administrative coercion, and appoint a person to take over supplier operations on grounds of continuity risk, with limited statutory criteria.
The minister may designate emergency suppliers and order producers to supply heat, with a general duty of cooperation imposed on everyone.
The competition authority may impose administrative fines of up to 450,000 euro or 1% of turnover for listed violations.
The competition authority may discount excess returns through correction factors in future supplier tariffs.
Ministerial licensing of heat supply with discretion to attach conditions and modify or transfer licences.

parties: Asks whether the performance test and tariff system can be simpler and whether the Raad van State advice to regulate the performance test by AMvB is followed.
Why does the government not follow the Council of State's advice to regulate the detailed performance test in a general administrative order (AMvB)?
Waarom volgt de regering niet het advies van de Raad van State om de nadere uitwerking van de rendementstoets te regelen in een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB)?
Asks how the NMa will assess reasonableness of returns and whether infrastructure investments may be taken into account.
These members ask in what way the NMa will precisely test reasonableness and whether, and how, infrastructure investments may be taken into account.
Deze leden vragen wel op welke manier de NMa de redelijkheid precies gaat toetsen en of, en zo ja op welke wijze, daarbij rekening gehouden mag worden met infrastructurele investeringen.
Asks who controls the NMa's performance test, whether the cabinet can influence it through policy rules, and whether the reporting duty suffices.
The CDA members ask who is supervising here.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen wie hier nu controleert.
Argues the bill does not solve all practical problems, asks for NMa oversight of network quality and maintenance, and for legal protection of consumers in disputes and emergencies.
These members find it very contrived to include the performance test in the law but have it take effect only later, possibly.
Deze leden vinden het erg gekunsteld om de rendementstoets wel in de wet op te nemen, maar pas op een later tijdstip (eventueel) in werking te laten treden.
Asks why the government replaced the ministerial regulation with an NMa policy rule rather than an AMvB, as the Council of State advised, and questions municipal powers.
Why did the government not choose a general administrative order, including a link to the results of the first performance monitor and a pre-consultation procedure?
Waarom heeft de regering niet gekozen voor een algemene maatregel van bestuur, inclusief koppeling aan de resultaten van de (eerste) rendementsmonitor en voorhangprocedure?
Asks whether the NMA-principle is applied, whether NMa supervision is effective after the two-year delay, and what sanctions exist against excess profits.
Is the NMa sufficiently able to exercise effective supervision even after applying the performance test after two years?
Is de NMa voldoende in staat om ook na het toepassen van de rendementstoets na twee jaar effectief toezicht te houden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a novella amending the draft Warmtewet (heat supply act), mainly criticising the premature inclusion of a return-rate test for heat suppliers, the delegation of key choices to the minister, the lack of privacy safeguards for smart heat meters, the vague 'reasonable tariffs' norm, and the dispute resolution rules. The minister's reply largely accepted the criticisms on delegation, smart meters, emergency procedure and dispute resolution, but kept the return-rate test and the parliamentary pre-consultation on its entry into force.
concerns: The Afdeling considered the return-rate test premature and advised deleting article II, as its necessity, effectiveness and administrative burden were not sufficiently clear; the government moved the test to article 7 but kept it.

Key choices on the return-rate test, such as defining reasonable return, were left to the minister, which the Afdeling said required a statutory basis; the government left the details to the NMa by policy rule.
The smart heat meter rules lacked sufficient safeguards for privacy and remote-reading restrictions present in electricity and gas law; the government added provisions on refusal and remote reading.
The vague norm of 'reasonable tariffs' for smart meters was not explained or specified, raising enforcement concerns for the NMa.
The relationship between the minister's emergency powers and the NMa's powers was unclear; the explanatory memorandum was clarified.
Dispute resolution provisions omitted the fairness, cost and procedural requirements of the ministerial regulation; the article was amended accordingly.
The Afdeling saw no ground for parliamentary involvement in setting the entry-into-force date via a pre-consultation procedure; the government kept the procedure.
Various drafting and terminological comments were made in an annex, largely adopted, and the representative-organisation criteria were flagged as needing statutory basis.

32857.s: The bill requires schools and education institutions across primary, secondary, special, and vocational education to keep a register of listed incidents such as violence, weapons possession, discrimination, threats and drug-related conduct. Detailed definitions and registration rules may be set by general administrative order (AMvB).
32857.j: The memorandum justifies the AMvB by saying that uniform and clear definitions of incidents are needed for a well-functioning registration system, since some incidents such as bullying are partly subjective.
q: Therefore unambiguous and clear definitions of the various incidents are elaborated in a general administrative order to realise a well-functioning registration system.
Daarom worden eenduidige en duidelijke definities van de verschillende incidenten uitgewerkt in een algemene maatregel van bestuur om een goed werkend registratiesysteem te realiseren.
d: Artikel 16a lid 4 WPO (also Art. 21a WPO BES, 27a WEC, 24c1 WVO, 53a WVO BES, 1.3.9 WEB, 1.3.6 WEB BES)
detailed definition of incidents and registration method

parties: Asks why a national system with uniform criteria is needed and whether the Inspectorate could oversee existing registrations, given the extra workload and red tape.

The members would like to know why, given the function of incident registration, a national picture is necessary and whether this does not create disproportionate extra workload for the Inspectorate of Education.

Graag vernemen de leden waarom, gezien de functie van incidentenregistratie, een landelijk beeld noodzakelijk is en of dit niet een onevenredige extra werkdruk oplevert voor de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Supports mandatory registration of serious incidents to give the Inspectorate better insight, but asks the government to respond to the VO-Raad's objections that the bill ignores existing practice.
The bill does not take sufficient account of existing practice and current legislation.
Het wetsvoorstel houdt te weinig rekening met de bestaande praktijk en huidige wetgeving.
Supports the bill's aims and the need for national insight into incidents, while asking about the follow-up to the research and representativeness of the pilot.
Moreover, these members share the need to have insight at national level into the extent and type of incidents occurring at schools.
Bovendien delen deze leden de behoefte om op landelijk niveau inzicht te hebben in de mate en de soort van incidenten die zich op scholen voordoen.

Accepts that registration requires adequate information but asks about a trial evaluation period, the narrow definition limited to injury, and whether reporting to criminal authorities should be mandatory.
Is the government considering an evaluation period to assess whether the system is workable in practice, the members ask.
Overweegt de regering een evaluatieperiode toe te passen om te bezien of het systeem als zodanig werkbaar is in de praktijk, zo vragen de leden.
Doubts that registration guarantees safety, and raises concerns about possible linking of personal data, pressure on teachers to not report crimes, and whether incidents end up in personnel files.
Is it excluded that through mandatory registration incidents more quickly end up in a personnel file, these members ask.
Is het uitgesloten dat door verplichte registratie incidenten sneller in een personeelsdossier terecht komen, zo vragen deze leden.
Questions the necessity and administrative burden of the statute, asks why only incidents with physical injury are covered, and asks who checks compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act.
Many small administrative burdens ultimately add up to a large administrative burden.
Heel veel kleine administratieve lasten tellen uiteindelijk op tot veel administratieve lasten.
Questions whether a legal duty to register is needed, whether it burdens schools, and whether pupil personal data are adequately protected and the legal basis for processing them.
Why must schools adapt their current registration practices to a uniform requirement, while these schools have often created a safe school climate in their own way?
Waarom moeten scholen de huidige werkwijze van registratie aanpassen aan een uniforme eis, terwijl deze scholen vaak op eigen wijze een veilig schoolklimaat hebben gecreëerd?
Argues the government has not justified that a mandatory registration is the least intrusive means on school autonomy and questions the legal basis for imposing it nationally.
They miss this weighing in the explanatory memorandum.
Zij missen deze afweging in de toelichting.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill requiring schools to keep a registration system of (violent) incidents, questioning its necessity, effectiveness, feasibility, the processing of personal data, the scope of the duty, and the data exchange, and advised reconsidering the bill. The minister's reply largely accepted the remarks: it added information on school safety and feasibility, clarified that the registration is anonymous, specified the scope via regulations, and clarified data sharing, while maintaining that a mandatory registration is needed rather than a sample survey.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the necessity of the bill and whether a representative sample survey could achieve the aims; the government added information but maintained that a mandatory register is needed.
The Afdeling asked for attention to the feasibility of the registration duty for schools; the reply added pilot findings and remarks on support and communication to schools.

The Afdeling noted that personal data could be recorded under the bill without a legal basis; the government clarified the registration is anonymous and that the Wbp applies to voluntary personal data.
The Afdeling asked for clearer scope and form of the registration duty, including the distinction between serious and minor incidents, to be set out in the explanatory memorandum and the regulations.

The Afdeling noted the lack of a statutory basis for transmitting registration data to a research bureau and unclear access for internal and external bodies; the reply pointed to existing provisions and clarified access.

32875.s: The bill makes the Dutch Research Council (NWO) subject to the general framework act for independent administrative bodies (Kaderwet zbo's), with the minister gaining appointment, budget approval, annual account and regulation-approval powers over NWO's governing board. It also removes the regional boards' own funding authority, shifting it to the general board by mandate, and repeals several statutory provisions.
32875.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the advice of the interdepartmental team on Kaderwet bodies to use ministerial powers cautiously, and by aligning NWO with the general framework act.
d: allocation of research funds via regional boards by mandate
appointment of NWO board members by minister under Kaderwet
application of Kaderwet zbo's to NWO with exception of art. 15
p: The minister gains a general power to amend NWO's institutional plan and budget ministerial policy rules, and the automatic approval of budgets after two months is removed.
The minister may reduce state contributions to NWO where funds were misspent or work was not properly performed.
The minister may withhold approval of the annual account if it is not sufficiently in line with the institutional plan.

33298.s: The bill reduces the maximum duration of benefits paid to political office holders under the Algemene pensioenwet politieke ambtsdragers from four years to three years and two months, matching the maximum unemployment benefit (WW) period. Transitional provisions keep the old duration for dismissals before the law takes effect on 1 September 2012.
33298.j: The memorandum justifies the change by stating it is desirable to limit the maximum benefit duration to the WW maximum; no delegation or new powers are justified.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable to limit the maximum duration of benefits to political office holders to the maximum duration of a WW benefit;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is de maximumduur van de uitkering aan politieke ambtsdragers te beperken tot de maximumduur van een WW-uitkering;

parties: Asks why the bill hard-codes the three years and two months instead of referring generally to the WW, and whether applying the change to sitting office holders is reasonable given their legitimate expectations.
Why was no transitional arrangement chosen for sitting political office holders?
Waarom is niet gekozen voor een overgangsvoorziening voor zittende politieke ambtsdragers?

Critical of the bill's approach, questions the 'normalisation' framing and the 1 September 2012 entry into force, and requests a legal opinion from the landsadvocaat on possible litigation over interference with existing legal positions.
The PvdA members would like to receive further legal advice on this interference with an existing legal position.
Gaarne zouden de leden van de PvdA-fractie een nader juridisch advies ontvangen over dit ingrijpen in een lopende rechtspositie.
Considers the bill incomplete, with part of the changes deferred to a separate bill, and criticises the government's careless consultation and unclear financial effects.
The fact that the bill is incomplete, as shown by the passage stating that part of the intended changes will be regulated in a separate bill, is a warning sign in that respect.

Het feit dat het wetsvoorstel incompleet is, wat blijkt uit de passage waarin staat dat een gedeelte van de voorgenomen aanpassingen in een separaat wetsvoorstel wordt geregeld, is wat dat betreft een teken aan de wand.

Supports the principle that office holders should contribute, but asks for a fuller motivation of the interference with existing legal positions, given possible judicial review and the need to keep office attractive.
The CDA members ask the government to elaborate the intended motivation, also given the durability of the bill if tested by the court.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering de bedoelde motivering nader uit te werken, mede gelet op de houdbaarheid van het wetsvoorstel in geval van toetsing door de rechter.
Welcomes the reduction of the benefit scheme for politicians and asks why the general WW, Ziektewet and WIA rules are not applied to them instead of special arrangements.
These members welcome the reduction of the benefit scheme for politicians and believe that rules made by politicians should apply to everyone.
Deze leden juichen het toe dat de wachtgeldregeling voor politici wordt versoberd en zijn van mening dat regels die politici maken voor iedereen moeten gelden.

Asks the government to justify further, in line with the Raad van State, why the legal position including that of current office holders is being restricted, and asks for timing of the separate bill and cost estimates.

Consider asking the government, in line with the Raad van State's remarks, to give further justification for why the legal position scheme, including that of current office holders, is being restricted.

geven de regering in overweging, in lijn met de opmerkingen van de Raad van State, een nadere onderbouwing te geven over de vraag waarom de rechtspositieregeling, waaronder die van huidige ambtsdragers, wordt ingeperkt.

Questions whether changing the rules mid-term without a transitional period is compatible with government reliability and the legitimate expectations of sitting office holders, and asks for evidence on effects on attractiveness of office.
Is it not better, from the standpoint of government reliability, to have the new rules take effect at the start of a new term?
Is het vanuit het oogpunt van betrouwbaarheid van de overheid niet beter om de nieuwe regels in te laten gaan bij de ingang van een nieuwe periode?

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on a bill capping the post-office severance benefit (wachtgeld) for political office holders at the WW maximum of three years and two months, objecting that the rationale for aligning with unemployment benefits was not explained, that retroactive effect and lack of grandfathering affecting sitting office holders were insufficiently justified, and that consultation with local government bodies was inadequate. The government's reply (nader rapport) states that the bill was amended: retroactivity was dropped with grandfathering for benefits already started, the entry-into-force date of 1 September 2012 was fixed in the text, and consultations with the relevant associations were held.
concerns: The Council objected to retroactive reduction of already-granted benefit entitlements and asked for justification under Article 1 of the First Protocol ECHR; the government dropped retroactivity and applied grandfathering to benefits already started.
The Council found no adequate motivation for the retroactive effect to 1 May 2012, as no announcement effects or abuse were shown; the government accepted this and removed the retroactive effect.

The Council asked for fuller justification of aligning political office holders' benefits with WW and for attention to the place of the measure within the broader legal status of political office holders; the government expanded the explanatory memorandum but largely maintained its position that the Appa is a distinct regime needing periodic adjustment.
The Council advised consulting the VNG, IPO, Unie van Waterschappen and mayors' organisations; the government reports that such consultation has since taken place.
The Council noted that immediate effect would suffice given the timetable before the September 2012 elections, and the government adopted a 1 September 2012 entry-into-force date in the bill.

33478.s: The bill adds a separate offence of terrorism financing to the Dutch Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands Criminal Code, with penalties of up to eight years' imprisonment or a fine, and raises sentences by half where listed offences are committed with terrorist intent. It also makes conforming amendments to the Extradition Act, the anti-money-laundering laws and the unusual transactions reporting laws so they refer to the new offence.
q: This act shall enter into force on a date to be set by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: entry into force date set by royal decree

parties: Welcomes the standalone offence but asks whether conditional intent suffices and whether the term 'voorwerpen' should be replaced with 'goederen' for legal clarity; also asks about the maximum penalty relative to other states.

The VVD members are very pleased that financing terrorist activities, which are experienced as extremely shocking and socially disturbing, will be included as an autonomous criminal offence in the Criminal Code.

Het stemt de leden van de VVD-fractie zeer tevreden dat het financieren van terroristische activiteiten, die als buitengewoon schokkend en maatschappelijk verontrustend worden ervaren, als autonoom strafbaar feit zal worden opgenomen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht.

Asks whether the bill is necessary given the UN treaty and the College van procureurs-generaal's view, whether double criminality causes real problems for mutual legal assistance, and how financial institutions and intent would be treated.
The College van procureurs-generaal also concludes in its advice that the current regulation already meets the conditions set out in the FATF Interpretive Note (binding interpretation).
Ook het College van procureurs-generaal concludeert in haar advies dat de huidige regelgeving reeds voldoet aan de voorwaarden gesteld in de Interpretive Note (verbindende uitleg) van de FATF.
Supports the bill's aim and believes a separate offence has a stronger deterrent effect.
The PVV members endorse the purpose of the bill and believe a separate offence of terrorism financing has a stronger deterrent effect.

De leden van de PVV-fractie onderschrijven de strekking van het wetsvoorstel en zijn van mening dat van een afzonderlijke strafbaarstelling van het financieren van terrorisme een meer afschrikkende werking uitgaat.

Questions the justification for the conditional-intent standard and broad scope, the proportionality of the eight-year maximum, and the impact on property rights and defence rights under the Kadi case.
What consequences does the ruling in this case have for the government's intention, as laid down in this bill?
Welke consequenties heeft de uitspraak in deze zaak op het voornemen van de regering, zoals neergelegd in dit wetsvoorstel?
Supports the standalone offence for alignment with most FATF members, but asks how intent will be proven in practice, how other European courts apply it, and how prosecutions have gone.

They can agree with the choice for a standalone offence, since the Netherlands would thereby align with the approach in most FATF member states, which in practice will lead to greater recognisability and usability.

Zij kunnen instemmen met de keuze voor een zelfstandige strafbaarstelling, aangezien Nederland daardoor in de pas loopt met de wijze van strafbaarstelling in het merendeel van de FATF-lidstaten, hetgeen in de praktijk zal leiden tot grotere herkenbaarheid en bruikbaarheid.
Asks why the BES islands were not consulted, whether the government will monitor the bill's added value with a possible evaluation, and whether it can be withdrawn in consultation with the FATF.
Can the government closely monitor the added value of this bill, and is there scope for a possible evaluation in that context?
Kan de regering scherp toezien op de toegevoegde waarde van dit wetsvoorstel en is er in dat kader ruimte voor een mogelijke evaluatie?
Supports firm action against terrorism financing but asks whether the current rules have caused prosecutions to fail and how intent and retroactive financing would be assessed.
They endorse the importance of taking firm action against every form of terrorism.
Zij onderschrijven het belang dat er stevig wordt opgetreden tegen elke vorm van terrorisme.

v.summary: The Council of State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill creating a standalone offence of terrorist financing but raised remarks on the intent requirement, the sentencing level for financing preparatory offences, and consultation of the BES island authorities. The government's reply accepted the intent remark by clarifying the explanatory memorandum, justified the eight-year maximum sentence, explained why consultation of the BES authorities was not undertaken, and incorporated the drafting remarks.
concerns: The intent requirement in the proposed article 421 Sr appears broader than the 'with intent or knowledge' standard of the UN Convention, so the explanatory memorandum should address it; the government clarified intent and aligned with the Convention.

The Council asked the explanation to address the relation between the proposed eight-year maximum and existing lower penalties for preparatory offences facilitating terrorism; the government justified the eight-year maximum by reference to FATF proportionality standards.

The government did not consult the BES island executive authorities on the proposed amendments to BES legislation as required by the Wet openbare lichamen; the Council advised doing so, and the reply only states consultation was omitted because of the nature of the change.
Redactional remarks were incorporated, including adding 'verzamelen' to article 421 and correcting cross-references and numbering.

33496.s: The bill abolishes six Frisian municipalities (Boarnsterhim, Gaasterlân-Sleat, Heerenveen, Leeuwarden, Lemsterland, Skarsterlân) and creates three new ones (De Friese Meren, Heerenveen, Leeuwarden), with boundary changes to Súdwest-Fryslân. It also sets transitional rules on elections, taxes, staff, archives and safety-region membership.
33496.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the small size and financial vulnerability of Gaasterlân-Sleat, and states that the provincial financial assessment of the new municipality is adequate.
q: This council expressed the aim of a reorganisation, among other things because of the limited size and financial vulnerability of the municipality.
Deze raad sprak hierin uit te streven naar een herindeling, onder meer vanwege de beperkte omvang en financiële kwetsbaarheid van de gemeente.
d: correcting obvious errors in municipal boundary description

parties: Asks whether the boundary correction added after the draft was published affects the validity of the procedure under the Arhi law.
What does this approach mean for the validity of the reorganisation procedure?
Wat betekent deze handelwijze voor de geldigheid van de herindelingsprocedure?
Objects that the normal careful procedure was set aside for the boundary correction and asks what lessons follow and whether the added objection option resolves the defects.
for this decision the normal careful procedure was set aside
voor dit besluit de normale zorgvuldige procedure aan de kant gezet is
Says irreversible steps were already taken before Parliament decided, undermining its scrutiny role, and objects to the boundary correction imposed on residents.
This is a serious disregard of the position of the House of Representatives and makes the scrutinising role of parliament impossible.
Dit is een ernstige miskenning van de positie van de Tweede Kamer en maakt de controlerende rol van het parlement onmogelijk.
Says residents of two villages were overrun by the boundary correction, were not properly heard, and asks the government to reconsider it and consult residents.
Residents of two villages, currently part of Skarsterlân, are very dissatisfied with the proposed boundary correction.
Inwoners van een tweetal dorpen, thans behorende bij Skarsterlân, zijn zeer ontstemd over de voorgestelde grenscorrectie.
Asks for responses on resident objections, lack of stated necessity, a seven-day provincial decision without public inspection, and withheld documents.
These members explicitly ask the government to address concerns about a possibly improperly conducted procedure.
Deze leden vragen hierbij nadrukkelijk aan de regering om zorgen rondom een mogelijk onzorgvuldig uitgevoerde procedure weg te nemen.
Not convinced by the justification for the boundary correction; asks for the procedure to be described and compared with the regular one.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government to describe the procedure followed and compare it with the regular procedure
De leden van de fractie van de ChristenUnie vragen de regering om de gevolgde procedure te beschrijven, te vergelijken met de reguliere procedure
Asks how the government concludes residents are oriented toward Heerenveen and whether the correction has concrete effects on residents.
These members would like to know how the government concludes that residents are more oriented toward Heerenveen.
Graag vernemen deze leden hoe de regering tot de stelling komt dat de inwoners meer georiënteerd zijn op Heerenveen.

33586.s: The bill amends the Dutch Kieswet to implement EU Directive 2013/1/EU on passive voting rights in European Parliament elections for EU citizens residing in another member state. It requires non-Dutch candidates to submit a declaration of eligibility from their home state, sets up a verification exchange with that state's authority via the Kiesraad, and routes Dutch-citizen checks through the Minister of Justice and Security.
33586.j: The memorandum justifies the procedure as required by the EU directive and as fitting the existing Kieswet system, with the Kiesraad acting as contact point; the form delegation is not separately justified.
q: By ministerial regulation a model is established for the form.
Bij ministeriële regeling wordt voor het formulier een model vastgesteld.

parties: The SP supports the aim of easier candidacy for non-national EU residents and asks whether the candidacy day could be moved two days earlier to align with the EU five-day term.
These members understand this explanation, but wonder whether it would not be possible to move the candidacy day forward by two days.
Deze leden begrijpen deze uitleg, maar vragen zich af of het dan niet mogelijk is om de dag van de kandidaatstelling twee dagen naar voren te schuiven.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the bill implementing EU Directive 2013/1 on candidacy rights for EU citizens in European Parliament elections, but raises concerns about the five-working-day deadline for fixing candidate lists and about the limits of judicial review by the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak. The government's nader rapport defends its choice of asking other member states to reply faster, rejects a later candidate-list deadline as too burdensome for voters abroad, and clarifies the explanatory memorandum on judicial review.
concerns: The Afdeling argues that a later candidate-list deadline was an option not considered, risking voters casting ballots for ineligible candidates; the government rejects postponement as too burdensome but expands the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to clarify that the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak can only review whether the central electoral board correctly received and acted on the other state's declaration, not the legality of exclusion under foreign law; the government clarified this.

33605-III.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statements (slotwet) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Cabinet, the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, and the baten-lastendienst Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, adjusting appropriations and realised figures. It is a purely budgetary adjustment with no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The change is mainly the result of the personnel establishment not being fully staffed during the year.
De mutatie is hoofdzakelijk het gevolg van een niet volledige bezetting van de personele formatie gedurende het jaar.

33658.s: The bill removes the ministerial power to designate private-law bodies whose employees participate in the ABP pension fund, by deleting the relevant provisions of the Wet privatisering ABP. It also renumbers remaining paragraphs and sets the entry into force by royal decree; already designated bodies are unaffected.
33658.j: The memorandum justifies the change by noting that very few designations have been requested recently, so the designation power can be dropped without affecting existing bodies.
q: No new B3 bodies will be designated any more, and the designation power can be removed from the WPA.
Er zullen geen nieuwe B3-lichamen meer worden aangewezen en de aanwijzingsbevoegdheid kan uit de WPA worden geschrapt.
d: Artikel I, B (artikel 3, eerste, tweede en derde lid vervallen)
designation of private-law bodies whose employees join ABP (removed)
p: Artikel I, A (artikel 2, derde lid onderdelen b en c, vierde lid vervallen)
Removes the minister's discretionary power to designate further private bodies as ABP-participating employers, while keeping existing designations in place.

33676.s: The bill amends the Dutch implementing act for the EU enforcement regulation to align it with the recast Brussels I Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012 and the Lugano Convention, abolishing the exequatur requirement so that foreign judgments, authentic instruments and court settlements become enforceable as executory titles via bailiffs. It also sets enforcement waiting periods, shortens them only on judicial order, and assigns the courts and notaries that will handle challenges and certificates.
33676.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the recast EU regulation and the Lugano Convention, with no new executive discretion claimed.
q: The leave for enforcement, also called exequatur, has been abolished.
Het verlof, ook wel exequatur genoemd, is afgeschaft.

parties: Asks what legal remedy a party has if a certificate issued under the Regulation contains an error or is wrongly refused.
What legal remedy is open to the interested party if the certificate issued under Article 53 of the Regulation contains an error or, contrary to that party's request, no certificate is issued?

Welk rechtsmiddel staat voor de belanghebbende partij open als het overeenkomstig artikel 53 van de Verordening afgegeven certificaat een fout bevat dan wel, in weerwil van het verzoek van die partij, geen certificaat wordt afgegeven?

Questions whether judicial quality and independence abroad are equal to the Netherlands, given that foreign judgments are no longer reviewed before enforcement, and asks about corruption-tainted judgments.
The aforementioned members note that the bill means foreign judgments will no longer be reviewed before they can be enforced.
Voornoemde leden merken op dat het wetsvoorstel met zich meebrengt dat buitenlandse vonnissen niet meer worden getoetst alvorens ze ten uitvoer kunnen worden gelegd.
Asks how the abolition of exequatur can avoid harming the legal protection of persons against whom recognition and enforcement is sought, and what efficiency gain there is.
How is it further ensured that abolishing the exequatur does not come at the expense of the legal protection of the person against whom recognition and enforcement is sought?
Hoe wordt er voorts voor gezorgd dat het afschaffen van het exequatur niet ten koste gaat van de rechtsbescherming van degene jegens wie erkenning en tenuitvoerlegging wordt gevraagd?

33685.s: The bill tightens criminal law against financial-economic crime by raising maximum penalties for bribery, money laundering and related offences, allowing fines up to ten percent of turnover for legal persons, and removing the separate offence of bribery of foreign officials. It also creates a faster procedure with fixed deadlines for reviewing seizure of documents covered by lawyer or notary privilege.
33685.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and procedures by the need to improve investigation of financial-economic crime and by commitments to Parliament and international obligations.
q: in order to broaden the possibilities for combating financial-economic offences
teneinde de mogelijkheden tot bestrijding van financieel-economische delicten te verruimen
p: Seizure of privileged documents is not reviewed by the investigating judge before the claimant can object, and the holder of privilege gets a complaint route to a court, with deadlines set for review.

parties: Asks whether the balance of penalties holds, the scope of the misuse-of-community-funds offence, and how privilege and information sharing limits affect investigations.
They ask whether the balance remains intact if penalties are raised for some offences but not for others.
Wel vragen zij of de verhouding in balans blijft als de strafmaat bij sommige delicten wordt verhoogd maar bij andere niet.
Asks how a broadened subsidy-fraud offence relates to a possible European Public Prosecutor and whether a separate Dutch provision would be preferable.
Does this not argue precisely for a separate statutory provision for fraud with Dutch subsidy money, with the Dutch prosecution service exclusively handling prosecution?
Pleit dit niet juist voor een afzonderlijk wetsartikel voor fraude met Nederlandse subsidiegelden waarbij het Nederlandse OM exclusief over de vervolging gaat?
Supports higher penalties and removing cost deductions, but asks whether a maximum penalty increase really changes judges' sentencing and whether minimum sentences would work better.
Could that goal not be achieved much more easily by introducing minimum sentences?
Kan dat doel niet veel makkelijker worden bereikt door het invoeren van minimumstraffen?
Supports tougher action and asset seizure, asks about the scope of private-sector bribery and how prosecutors choose between criminal and other enforcement tools.
How is the choice made in which cases criminal prosecution will be used under the proposed provision and in which cases another enforcement instrument?
Hoe wordt nu de afweging gemaakt in welke gevallen strafrechtelijk zal worden opgetreden met gebruikmaking van het voorgestelde wetsartikel en in welke gevallen met een ander handhavingsmiddel?

Questions the need for higher penalties given that courts rarely impose unconditional prison terms, asks for justification of the scope of the community-funds offence, and requests an evaluation within three years.
What these members do not follow is the need to also raise the penalty level.
Wat deze leden niet volgen is de noodzaak om ook de strafmaat te verhogen.
Asks for empirical grounding of the proposals, whether the bill addresses detection rather than just penalties, and the rationale for the 10% turnover cap.
In the view of the CDA members, the priority in combating financial-economic offences should lie in increasing the likelihood of detection.
In de ogen van de leden van de CDA-fractie dient het primaat van de opsporing van financieel-economische delicten te liggen in het verhogen van de pakkans.
Asks for a per-year overview of capacity, prosecutions, confiscated assets and detection rates over ten years, and how the turnover basis for fines is defined.
They further ask for a year-by-year overview over the past ten years of deployed capacity, the development in prosecutions, the criminal assets seized and the detection rate.
Voorts vragen zij om een overzicht per jaar in de afgelopen tien jaar van de ingezette capaciteit, de ontwikkeling van het aantal vervolgingen, het afgenomen crimineel vermogen en de pakkans.
Asks whether vague corruption norms may apply inconsistently across sectors and whether turnover-based fines could incentivize concealment of revenue.
They do ask whether the risk is not large that in one sector a certain favour or promise is seen as culpable while in another sector it is not or less so.
Wel vragen zij of het risico niet groot is dat in de ene sector een bepaalde dienst of toezegging wel als laakbaar wordt gezien, terwijl dit in een andere sector niet of minder het geval is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on a bill to strengthen the fight against financial-economic crime by raising penalties for bribery, money laundering, misuse of Community funds and habitual economic offences, and by changing the procedure for professional privilege; it finds the justifications for the penalty increases insufficient and advises revising the bill. The Minister's nader rapport responds point by point, largely defending the proposals and making some adjustments such as the Afdeling's suggested changes to the corruption provisions, the explanatory memorandum and the professional privilege procedure.
concerns: The Afdeling finds the necessity of the several penalty increases (official corruption, private corruption, money laundering, habitual economic offences) insufficiently motivated and advises substantiating them or adapting the bill; the government defends them with general and some specific arguments and made adjustments such as the sentence for active bribery of a judge and the comparison with other EU countries.

The Afdeling asks for empirical evidence on the nature and extent of the problem and on the low detection rate, which the explanatory memorandum lacks; the government supplies general reasoning and additional comparative material but no detailed empirical data.
The Afdeling asks for clarification of the 'in strijd met zijn plicht' element and of the limitation periods for habitual offences, and the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.

The Afdeling advises that the flexible fine ceiling for legal persons and the scope of misuse of public funds need further explanation; the government has partly clarified these points in the explanatory memorandum but not answered all questions, such as foreign legal persons and commercial versus fiscal turnover.

The Afdeling advises moving the broader professional privilege review procedure to a separate bill; the government declines, arguing the change is merely procedural and rights safeguards remain intact.

33748.s: The bill amends the Scheepvaartverkeerswet to raise the fine category for violating rules on mandatory shipping routes under article 31(8), from the existing category to the fourth category. It also redefines the pilotage-obligatory waterways in the Annex to cover the new Maasvlakte 2 area and related channels.
33748.j: The memorandum justifies the higher fine and the extended pilotage waterways by the commissioning of Maasvlakte 2 and the need to enforce international shipping routes.
q: This amendment concerns two matters: raising the fine category for ships that deviate from mandatory international shipping routes, and extending the pilotage-obligatory waterways in connection with the commissioning of Maasvlakte 2.
Deze wetswijziging heeft betrekking op twee onderwerpen, namelijk een verhoging van de boetecategorie voor schepen die afwijken van verplichte internationale vaarroutes
d: rules implementing treaties and international organisation decisions on shipping traffic off the Dutch coast

parties: Doubts that raising fines is effective if deviation stems from unawareness rather than deliberate intent; asks whether a warning should precede a high fine.
The VVD members have doubts about raising fines, because the cause of deviating from the route seems more due to unfamiliarity than to structural intent.
