De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben twijfels bij het verhogen van boetes, omdat de oorzaak voor het afwijken van de route eerder lijkt ingegeven door onbekendheid dan door structurele opzet.
Supports sanctions exceeding the economic gain from deviating, but asks government for detail on that gain and on unclear route information and intensified outreach.
The PvdA members support the principle that deviating from the shipping route is sanctioned with a fine higher than the economic benefit of deviating from that route.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie ondersteunen het principe dat het afwijken van de vaarroute wordt gesanctioneerd met een boete die hoger is dan het economische voordeel van het afwijken van deze route.

Asks whether the fine increase is proportionate to financial gain, under what conditions a fifth category would be considered, whether recidivism aggravates, whether information is adequate, the expected compliance and detection rate, and why no evaluation clause is included.
The CDA members ask why the bill does not include an evaluation clause.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom in het wetsvoorstel geen evaluatiebepaling is opgenomen.

Questions the effectiveness and proportionality of the proposal, the clarity of route information on charts and publications, timing of promised improvements, and whether the Coast Guard warns vessels in advance.
They note that alongside raising the fine category, the cabinet intends to intensify information about the mandatory routing system.
Zij constateren dat het kabinet naast de verhoging van de boetecategorie voornemens is de voorlichting over het verplichte routeringssysteem te intensiveren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the proposed increase of the fine for deviating from the mandatory ship routing from the third to the fifth category was insufficiently justified and excessive, and recommended better motivation or amendment. The government's reply partly accepted this by reducing the proposed increase to the fourth category, while maintaining that an increase is justified given the environmental risks and economic incentives.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the increase is necessary or effective in deterring violations, given that violations stem largely from unfamiliarity rather than deliberate intent.
The Afdeling finds the increase to the fifth category disproportionate and not justified against the nature, seriousness and economic gain of the violation.

33757.s: The bill raises court filing fees (griffierechten) in administrative and civil cases, mainly by a few percent in first instance and substantially on appeal and cassation, and adjusts the Algemene wet bestuursrecht fee amounts and the civil fee schedule accordingly. It leaves exemptions for certain categories unchanged and sets transitional rules so older proceedings keep the previous fee.
33757.j: The memorandum justifies the higher fees as necessary to finance the judiciary and to spread costs, while protecting access to the court in first instance.
q: Beside these measures, a modest increase in court filing fees cannot be avoided.
Naast deze maatregelen kan niet worden ontkomen aan een geringe verhoging van de griffierechten

parties: Asks whether the fee increase deters access to justice, whether mediation and alternatives can be stimulated, and whether the appeal-fee structure could be differentiated to address objections.
They understand that making court fees cost-covering is a sound starting point, but that the threshold for access to the courts would be raised too far for many people.
Zij begrijpen dat het kostendekkend maken van griffierechten een goed uitgangspunt is, maar dat de drempel voor toegang tot de rechter hiermee voor velen te zeer zou worden verhoogd.
Accepts a fee increase to ease court budget pressure but warns it must not unduly hinder access to justice for low-income groups, and asks about hardship exceptions and refunds on early settlement.
They also believe that raising court fees must not unnecessarily or excessively hinder access to justice.
Zij zijn ook van mening dat verhoging van griffierechten de toegang tot het recht niet onnodig of bovenmatig mag hinderen.

Argues that particulars must be able to challenge government decisions cheaply; objects to a 75% rise for low-income groups and questions the consistency of the rationale, the cumulative burden, and the lack of a hardship clause.
They are of the view that individuals must be able to challenge government decisions that concern them in court at low threshold cost.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat particulieren op laagdrempelige wijze besluiten van de overheid die hen aangaan moeten kunnen aanvechten bij de rechter.

Accepts that a lower threshold at first instance matters more, but asks about the impact on middle incomes and whether judges will increasingly have to rule on the affordability of fees, adding workload.
These members ask what the effects of the tariff increases will be for middle incomes.
Maar deze leden vragen wel wat voor de middeninkomens de gevolgen van de tariefsverhogingen zullen zijn.

Sees the bill as directly affecting access to law as part of the democratic rule of law, notes critical advisory opinions and cumulative effects of other measures, and asks for alternatives and an overview of cumulative burdens.
They are of the view that the bill directly affects access to justice as an essential part of the democratic constitutional state.
Zij zijn van mening dat het wetsvoorstel van directe invloed is op de toegang tot het recht als wezenlijk onderdeel van de democratische rechtsstaat.

Stresses that access to justice is an important principle, questions the absence of a hardship clause and the effects on appeals and cassation, and asks whether alternative dispute resolution with binding force could be stimulated.

These members consider accessibility of the law an important principle in our constitutional state and have several questions about the effects of the increase in the various fees and about dispensing with a hardship clause.

Deze leden vinden de toegankelijkheid van het recht een belangrijk principe in onze rechtsstaat en hebben meerdere vragen over de gevolgen van de verhoging van de verschillende rechten en over het afzien van een hardheidsclausule.

Asks why the government did not seek renewed advice from the Raad van State and the Raad voor de rechtspraak after a substantial change to the original bill, and whether the court fee increases restrict access to the judge.
Can this be explained? Why was that time not used to ask for advice from at least the Advisory Division of the Council of State and the Judiciary Council?
Kan dit worden toegelicht? Waarom is die tijd niet benut om adviezen te vragen aan in ieder geval de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en de Raad voor de rechtspraak
Joins the call for renewed advice from the Council of State and the judiciary council on whether earlier critical advice still applies, particularly regarding restrictions on access to the courts.

ask whether the government shares the view that it is desirable to learn at least from the Advisory Division of the Council of State and the Judiciary Council to what extent the critical advice given on the original bill is still current

vragen of de regering de mening deelt dat het wenselijk is om in ieder geval van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en de Raad voor de rechtspraak te vernemen in hoeverre de kritische adviezen die over het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel zijn gegeven nog actueel zijn
Co-signs questions on the absence of renewed advice and whether higher fees limit access to the courts.
the proposed increases in court fees restrict access to the courts
de voorgestelde verhogingen van de griffierechten de toegang tot de rechter beperken
Co-signs questions on the lack of renewed advice from the Council of State and the judiciary council after the amendment.
Is the government willing to still request advice from at least the Advisory Division of the Council of State and the Judiciary Council?
Is de regering bereid alsnog advies te vragen aan in ieder geval de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en de Raad voor de rechtspraak?
Co-signs questions on renewed advice and access to the courts under the revised fee structure.
to what extent the proposed increases in court fees restrict access to the judge
in hoeverre de voorgestelde verhogingen van de griffierechten de toegang tot de rechter beperken
Co-signs questions on the absence of renewed advice and the effect of fee increases on access to justice.
If not, why not? Is the government willing to still request advice
Zo nee, waarom niet? Is de regering bereid alsnog advies te vragen
Stresses that fees must not be so high as to materially affect access to the courts, and asks how the new fee bands were chosen and what the effect on court funding is.
They consider it important that court fees are not so high that access to the judge is materially affected.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat griffierechten niet zodanig hoog zijn dat hierdoor de toegang tot de rechter wezenlijk wordt beïnvloed.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill raising court fees (griffierechten) in civil and administrative cases, criticizing cumulative burdens, steep increases for appeal and cassation, the doubling of fees for legal persons in disputes over EUR 1 million, the absence of a general hardship clause, and the fee for registering marriage contracts. The government's reply defends the increases as necessary to protect quality and speed of justice, adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum, and declines to add a general hardship clause, though it adapts the explanatory notes on several points.
concerns: The Afdeling argues the cumulative effect of fee increases with other measures on access to the courts has not been assessed, and the government addressed this only by clarifying the explanatory memorandum while disputing the scale of the increases.

The Afdeling finds the steep increases in fees for appeal and cassation insufficiently justified as proportionate to a legitimate aim, and the government responded by adding justification in the explanatory memorandum without changing the fee levels.

The Afdeling considers the doubling and tripling of fees for legal persons in high-value cases insufficiently reasoned, and suggests linking the exemption to the size criteria of Article 2:396 BW, which the government rejected.

The Afdeling advises adding a general hardship clause because the right of access to court under Article 6 ECHR and Article 47 EU Charter requires individual proportionality assessment, but the government considers existing hardship provisions in the procedural codes sufficient.

The Afdeling asks for better justification of the large increase in the fee for registering marital property agreements, and the government clarified that it is part of a broader distribution of burdens rather than cost recovery.

33775.s: The bill amends the Dutch Warenwet (Commodities Act) to raise the maximum administrative fine, adjust ministerial powers to designate testing bodies and charge costs, add rules on advertising tattoos and piercings, and remove or simplify several provisions. It also amends the Warenwet BES for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba so that island governing colleges, rather than the national ministry, carry primary enforcement of commodity rules with the Staatstoezicht providing second-line oversight.
33775.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical implementation of EU decisions, cost recovery in line with government policy on fee charging, and effective enforcement given the limited national inspectorate presence on the islands.
q: This is in line with the cabinet position in the report Maat houden on passing on admission and enforcement costs.
Dit is conform het kabinetsstandpunt bij het rapport Maat houden voor het doorberekenen van toelatings- en handhavingskosten.
d: designation of testing and assessment bodies on request
rules implementing binding EU decisions on commodities, including environmental interest
grounds for designating, suspending, withdrawing or amending assessment bodies
amounts of cost recovery for designation and controls
minister may set a different date for entry into force of EU directive amendments
annex setting fine amounts per violation
amounts of cost recovery for controls and document requests
island governing college appoints persons to supervise compliance
island governing college grants permits instead of the minister
p: Minister may suspend the designation of a testing body, not only withdraw it, giving a graduated intervention option.
Minister may order withdrawal of non-food goods posing risks to any person, not only consumers, widening the scope of the power.
New prohibition on advertising tattoos or piercings unless material use is permitted under a licence.
Primary enforcement for all commodity rules shifts from national ministry to island governing colleges, with annual reporting to the minister and second-line oversight by Staatstoezicht.
Island enforcers may ban manufacture or sale of non-compliant goods, seize them and order destruction, with the Staatstoezicht role reduced to second line.

parties: Asks for justification of the widened powers and the effectiveness and enforceability of the tattoo and piercing advertising ban given limited inspection capacity.
The Council of State indicates that only about 1 FTE is available for checking licences and dyes used in tattooing.](Note: evidence reflects the VVD question.)
De Raad van State geeft aan dat er slechts ongeveer 1 fte beschikbaar is voor de controle op vergunning en (bij tatoeëren te hanteren) kleurstoffen.
Welcomes the higher fines and the tattoo advertising ban but asks which enforcement body will supervise and how it can intervene.
Which body will enforce both the licensing requirement and the ban on advertising services without a licence?
Welke instantie zorgt voor de handhaving van zowel de vergunningplicht als van het verbod op het aanprijzen van diensten zonder vergunning?
Asks for motivation of removed evaluation duties and ministerial consultation requirements, and reports signals of weak GGD supervision of tattoo shops.
Members of the SP faction receive signals that the GGD does not always supervise tattooing sufficiently, so illegal tattooing can persist.
De leden van de SP-fractie krijgen signalen dat de GGD niet altijd voldoende toezicht houdt op het zetten van tatoeages waardoor het illegaal zetten van tatoeages kan blijven voortbestaan.
Objects to raising maximum fines from EUR 4,500 to EUR 78,000 for non-SZW offences, leaving proportionality to delegated legislation, and questions the broad use of delegation.
These members therefore ask for an amendment so that maximum fines are not raised for offences unrelated to SZW legislation.
Deze leden vragen dan ook om een wijziging van het wetsvoorstel op dit punt, zodanig dat voor niet SZW-gerelateerde overtredingen de maximumboetebedragen niet worden verhoogd.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill but objects to the large increase of the maximum administrative fine to the fifth-category level for all Warenwet violations, and to the ban on advertising tattoos and piercings, which it finds insufficiently justified. The minister's reply explains the fine link with the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and adds justification for the advertising ban under Article 10 ECHR.
concerns: The increase of the maximum administrative fine to 78,000 euro for all Warenwet violations is not shown to be proportionate, given the link only with SZW-related regulations.
The ban on advertising tattoos and piercings restricts freedom of expression under Article 10 ECHR and needs stronger justification; the reply argues the restriction is necessary and proportionate.
The explanatory memorandum does not show why the advertising ban would make supervision more efficient or improve enforcement of the licensing requirement.
Editorial remarks on articles 13a, 13c and Article I, G are included in an annex.

33838.s: The bill approves, for the European part of the Netherlands, an Internal Agreement among EU member state governments on financing EU development aid for 2014–2020 under the ACS-EU partnership and overseas countries and territories. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
33838.j: The memorandum justifies budgeting the EDF within the EU budget as strengthening democratic control by the European Parliament and modernising relations with ACS countries.
q: Budgeting the EDF strengthens democratic control by the European Parliament, offers more flexibility and modernises the relationship with ACS countries.
Budgetteren van het EOF versterkt de democratische controle van het Europese Parlement (EP), biedt meer flexibiliteit en moderniseert de relatie met de ACS-landen.
d: approval of Internal Agreement on EDF financing 2014–2020

parties: Questions why the EDF was not integrated into the regular EU budget, the future of the ACS framework after 2020, and whether recipient countries with high incomes should receive EDF aid.
The VVD members were and remain of the view that it would have been better to include the EDF in the regular EU budget as a whole.
De leden van de VVD-fractie waren en blijven echter wel van mening dat het beter zou zijn geweest als het EOF was opgenomen in de reguliere EU-begroting als geheel.

Supports bringing the EDF under the MFF to strengthen European Parliament democratic control, but asks about the effects of lower administrative costs on monitoring and evaluation and how the Overseas Countries allocation will be used.
The PvdA members support the cabinet's view of placing the EDF within the Multiannual Financial Framework after 2020 in order to increase democratic control by the European Parliament.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen de visie van het kabinet om het EOF onder te brengen in het Meerjarig Financieel Kader (MFK) na 2020 om zo de democratische controle van het Europees Parlement te vergroten.

Questions whether the Chamber's ratification has any real effect, whether it should have received a reservation on treatment before the government consented, the late submission of the bill, and the large increase in administrative costs and the EDF's effective budget erosion.
The SP members ask the government whether, before agreeing to the Internal Agreement, the government should have made a reservation on parliamentary treatment by the Chamber.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of er voorafgaand aan het instemmen met het Intern Akkoord door de regering een behandelvoorbehoud door de Kamer had moeten worden gemaakt?

Supports moving the EDF into the EU budget but wants this sooner for democratic control; asks how binding the commitments are and proposes an additional evaluation in 2016 given critical European Court of Auditors reports.
The CDA members support this development but find that, for democratic control, it would be better if it happened sooner.
De leden van de CDA-fractie steunen deze ontwikkeling, maar vinden dat het in verband met democratische controle beter zou zijn als dit eerder zou gebeuren.

Worries about the lack of democratic control over the EDF, since the European Parliament only has a say at discharge; asks about transparency, control of spending, and how Dutch proposals to strengthen oversight fared.
The D66 members are concerned about the lack of democratic control over the EDF.
De leden van de D66-fractie maken zich zorgen over het gebrek aan democratische controle op het EOF.

33847.s: The bill amends the Dutch tax and pension laws to lower maximum pension accrual and premium rates, cap pensionable income, and introduce tax-exempt net annuities for higher earners. It also strengthens oversight of premium-setting fairness, requires new cost and premium-component disclosure, and raises the age limit of the employer premium discount for hiring older workers from 50 to 56.
33847.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated premium percentage and net annuity rules by the need to tie premiums to the aim of old-age income and to set detailed cost presentation rules in general administrative orders.
q: The elaboration of this obligation takes place by means of a general administrative order.
De uitwerking van deze verplichting vindt plaats middels een algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 5.16b, eerste lid en vierde lid, Wet IB 2001)
percentage cap on annual premium for net annuities
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 5.16, vijfde en zesde lid, Wet IB 2001)
rules on application of net annuity exemption
Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 5.16a, tweede lid, Wet IB 2001)
conditions to prevent commingling of net annuity assets
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 45a, tweede lid, Pensioenwet)
further rules on pension fund cost disclosure
p: Artikel VII, onderdelen Aa, Ab, Ba, Bb (Pensioenwet artikelen 115a, 115c, 130a, 145)
Strengthens the accountability body's advisory role and the participants' approval right over premium composition, adding disclosure duties on pension funds.
Artikel VII, onderdeel A (artikel 45a) and Artikel VIII, onderdeel A (artikel 56a)
Requires pension funds to report administrative, asset management and transaction costs in their annual report.

parties: Asks technical questions on accrual percentages, the collective net annuity arrangement and whether premium reductions will actually materialise.
Welcomes the amendments but asks for actuarial calculations, participation effects and questions DNB's supervision of generational balance and collective VUT arrangements.

Critical that the bill prioritises EU budget rules over adequate pension accrual, and questions the government's exclusion of supplementary schemes from pension funds and the DNB supervision criteria.
These members note that building a good pension is not central to the bill, but rather meeting EU budget rules.
Deze leden constateren dat de opbouw van een goed pensioen niet centraal staat bij het wetsvoorstel, maar het voldoen aan EU-begrotingsregels.
Views the bill as a severe reduction of future pension accrual and asks why net annuities can only be offered by foreign funds.
The PVV members note that the bill still implies a huge reduction of future pension accrual.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV constateren dat voorliggend wetsvoorstel nog steeds een enorme versobering van de toekomstige pensioenopbouw inhoudt.

Objects to the lower maximum accrual, the continued use of the pooled premium, the complexity of the tax system, and the unclear Box 3 and EU-law implications of net annuities; also questions feasibility of the FTK timetable.
Can the government further justify why it accepts the pension system becoming more complicated, less transparent for taxpayers, more instrumentalised and costlier to administer?

Kan de regering nader motiveren waarom zij het ingewikkelder worden van het pensioensysteem, minder transparantie voor de belastingplichtige, verdere instrumentalisering van belastingen en toename van de uitvoeringskosten voor lief heeft genomen bij dit wetsvoorstel?
Supports the bill and the premium guarantees, but insists the net annuity option must be fully voluntary and asks how DNB's generational-effect test will work.
These members believe this savings option must really be voluntary.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat deze spaarmogelijkheid ook echt vrijwillig moet zijn.
Raises concerns about the unequal treatment of pension funds versus insurers for net products and the risk of structurally shielding part of the market.
The GroenLinks members are concerned that the bill will structurally shield part of the market from pension funds.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie maken zich zorgen dat als gevolg van het wetsvoorstel een gedeelte van de markt structureel wordt afgeschermd voor pensioenfondsen.
Welcomes the compromise and the three-track approach, and asks for more insight into the generational-balance test, the premium level and the governance of the advisory body.
These members ask how it is ensured that the accountability body weighs the interests of all participants in a balanced way.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe geborgd wordt dat het verantwoordingsorgaan de belangen van alle deelnemers op een evenwichtige manier weegt.

Says the agreed changes improve the bill only marginally, objects to funding the change with money for older unemployed, and asks whether generational-balance tests will really lower premiums and how indexation limits work.
These members believe the agreements produce only very limited improvement compared with the original bill.
Deze leden menen dat de gemaakte afspraken slechts in zeer beperkte mate een verbetering opleveren ten opzichte van het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel.
Asks only a brief clarifying question on whether the voluntary scheme above EUR 100,000 falls under the second or third pillar.
They have only a single clarifying question on this, because in the first report they had already asked all their desired questions.
Ze hebben daarover slechts een enkele toelichtende vraag, omdat zij bij het eerste verslag al hun gewenste vragen hebben gesteld.
Asks about budgetary and administrative effects of allowing the net annuity in the second pillar and about communication rules and medical underwriting.
They still have a few additional questions.
Zij hebben nog enkele aanvullende vragen.

Objects that the government intervenes in social partners' contractual freedom and in the net annuity design, and asks that the FTK be sent to the House before the plenary debate so parliament can see the full budgetary picture.

Is the government willing to submit the new FTK to the House before the plenary treatment of the Witteveen framework, so that the House gains better insight into the overall budgetary picture and total generational effects?

Is de regering bereid het nieuwe FTK voor de plenaire behandeling van het Witteveenkader aan de Kamer aan te bieden, zodat de Kamer beter inzicht krijgt in het gehele budgettaire plaatje en de totale generatie-effecten?
Asks the government to clarify indexation rules for funds with recovery plans and whether the risk-partner pension option will be monitored.
The D66 members note that the government wants to leave the use or non-use of the risk-partner pension option to (representatives of) employers and employees.
De leden van de fractie van D66 constateren dat de regering het wel of niet gebruik maken van de «risicopartnerpensioenknip» aan (vertegenwoordigers van) werkgevers en werknemers over wil laten.

33856.s: The bill removes the separate rupiah-based income basis for war-victim benefits under the Wuv, so that all beneficiaries are assessed on the euro (Dutch) basis regardless of where they live. It also removes related adjustment provisions and lets the SVB amend existing decisions ex officio in the beneficiary's favour without a claim.
33856.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a direct consequence of a binding Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling and the need to avoid unacceptable benefit levels in Indonesia, with retroactive effect from the ruling date.
q: This transitional article gives the SVB, departing from Article 61(2) of the Wuv, the power to amend decisions ex officio in the beneficiary's favour.

Dit overgangsartikel geeft in het eerste lid een bevoegdheid aan de SVB om, in afwijking van artikel 61, tweede lid, van de Wuv beschikkingen ambtshalve te wijzigen in het voordeel van de uitkeringsgerechtigde
d: adjustment of Wuv bases and amounts for Indonesia
p: Allows the SVB to amend decisions ex officio, in beneficiaries' favour, without the usual procedure and without requiring a claim.

parties: Asks why the talks between the State Secretary and the Commissie Gelijke Behandeling failed and requests a long-term estimate of extra expenditure.
Which solutions were considered, and why were these solutions not workable?
Welke oplossingen hebben de revue gepasseerd en waarom waren deze oplossingen niet hanteerbaar?
Supports removing the rupiah-based criterion because beneficiaries in Indonesia must not be treated differently from those living elsewhere.
They believe no distinction may be made between beneficiaries persecuted in the former Dutch East Indies who live in Indonesia and beneficiaries who live elsewhere.

Zij vinden dat geen onderscheid gemaakt mag worden tussen uitkeringsgerechtigden die vervolgd zijn in het voormalige Nederlands-Indië die in Indonesië wonen en uitkeringsgerechtigden die elders wonen.
Questions the formal legal reasoning for choosing 20 December 2012 as the retroactive date instead of the CGB opinion of 16 August 2007, asking for the moral weight of that ruling to be addressed.
These members ask the government why it reasons only formally and legally and does not address the moral value of the ruling of 16 August 2007.
Deze leden vragen de regering waarom zij alleen formeel juridisch redeneert en niet ingaat op de morele waarde van de uitspraak op 16 augustus 2007.
Expresses trust that the government and the Sociale Verzekeringsbank will implement the law carefully.
They trust that the government and the Sociale Verzekeringsbank will implement this law carefully.
Zij vertrouwen erop dat de regering en de Sociale Verzekeringsbank op een zorgvuldige wijze deze wet uitvoeren.

Asks the government to justify choosing the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling rather than the CGB ruling as the basis for retroactive effect, given both could serve as starting points under general principles of good governance.
these members would like the government to explain further why the legal force of the CRvB was chosen instead of the CGB ruling.
zouden genoemde leden graag van de regering een nadere toelichting willen waarom er voor de rechtskracht van de CRvB is gekozen in plaats van de uitspraak van de CGB.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supports the bill removing the rupiah-based income ground in the Wuv, which the CRvB found to be indirect discrimination by national origin under ICCPR article 26, but asks the explanatory memorandum to justify the retroactive effect back to 20 December 2012. The government's reply (nader rapport) follows the advice by adding a passage on the choice of retroactivity and correcting the drafting point.
concerns: The retroactive effect to 20 December 2012 must be explained in the explanatory memorandum given the ICCPR article 26 discrimination ruling and the possibility of appeals against ex officio decisions.
The bill title should read 'Indonesisch courant' instead of 'Indonesische courant'.

33883.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer so that the CO2 emission cost-equalisation system for greenhouse horticulture applies per calendar year rather than per period, and so that any operator of a covered installation owes the compensation fee, instead of only installations in a category designated by general administrative order. It takes effect on 1 January 2015.
33883.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a technical adjustment that makes the fee payable by all covered installations from 2015, with the delegation to the Besluit kostenverevening replaced accordingly.
q: Accordingly, the first delegation basis in article 15.52 of the Wm is replaced by a provision that whoever operates an installation referred to in article 15.51 of the Wm owes a fee.

Derhalve wordt de eerste delegatiegrondslag in artikel 15.52 van de Wm vervangen door een bepaling dat diegene die een inrichting als bedoeld in artikel 15.51 van de Wm drijft een vergoeding verschuldigd is.
d: designation of installation categories owing the emission compensation fee

parties: Asks how the CO2 emissions limit is set, why only part of the greenhouse sector is in the EU emissions trading system, and how costs are divided and what the administrative burden is.
The VVD members ask how the limit for CO2 emissions is precisely determined.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de limiet voor CO 2 -emissies precies wordt bepaald.
Generally positive about the change but questions whether the collective-penalty mechanism removes firms' incentive to save energy and asks about the fee owed when the sector ceiling is exceeded.
The PvdA members ask whether the changes to the cost-equalisation system do not precisely lead greenhouse firms to stop trying to save energy.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de wijzigingen in het kostenvereveningssysteem er niet juist toe leiden dat glastuinbouwbedrijven geen poging meer doen om energie te besparen.

Opposes subsidising fossil fuel, asks for a phase-out within five years, questions enforcement, carry-over of unused emissions, and the government's leeway before the covenant is known, and asks for reinstated financial security obligations.
The SP members are not in favour of subsidising fossil fuel and therefore also not in favour of a reduced energy-tax rate on natural gas for the greenhouse horticulture sector.

De leden van de SP-fractie zijn geen voorstander van het subsidiëren van fossiele brandstof en dus ook geen voorstander van een verlaagd energiebelastingtarief voor aardgas voor de glastuinbouwsector.
Asks how the transfer of the cost-equalisation system will proceed after the abolition of the Productschap Tuinbouw, and whether the subsidies will be phased out.
The D66 members note that the Productschap Tuinbouw is being abolished.
De leden van de D66-fractie lezen dat het Productschap Tuinbouw wordt opgeheven.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill extending the CO2 cost-equalisation scheme for greenhouse horticulture (2015–2020) to all installations, not only those emitting 305 tonnes or more, raising consistency, timing and administrative-burden concerns. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepted most points, justified the broader scope and timing, and added the missing burden assessment to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks justification for why extending the scope to all installations is now proportionate, given the 2011 decision that it was not.
The timing of the bill is insufficiently justified given the sector's announced private scheme and the pending EU state-aid approval.
Administrative and enforcement burdens on the Productschap Tuinbouw, the Rijksoverheid, the courts and firms are not stated in the explanatory memorandum and should be.
A reference to the Energieakkoord of 6 September 2013 should be added to the explanatory memorandum, and minor drafting changes were made.

33892.s: The bill amends the Copyright Act and the Neighbouring Rights Act to implement EU Directive 2012/28 on orphan works, allowing libraries, educational institutions, museums, archives, film heritage institutions and public broadcasters to reproduce and make available orphan works after a diligent search. It leaves the list of sources to be consulted and the data to be reported to be set by general administrative order (AMvB) on the proposal of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science.
33892.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to keep the source list updatable at short notice and to allow national consultation with stakeholders.
q: To keep the possibility of updating the source list at short notice, the list will be included in a general administrative order to be drawn up on the proposal of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science.

Om de mogelijkheid te behouden de bronnenlijst zonodig op korte termijn te actualiseren zal de lijst in een op voordracht van de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap op te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur worden opgenomen.
d: sources to consult for diligent search for rightsholders
data to be reported to designated body and manner of reporting
p: The Minister's list of consultable sources for orphan-work searches is fixed by general administrative order rather than in the statute itself.

parties: Asks whether the compensation rule in article 16o(4) should be limited to orphan works as the Directive requires, and whether a nil compensation can be justified, to protect rightsholders and legal certainty.
It must be prevented that too quickly it is assumed the rightsholder cannot be traced and therefore misses out on fair compensation for his work.
Voorkomen dient te worden dat te snel wordt aangenomen dat de rechthebbende niet kan worden opgespoord en deze derhalve een billijke vergoeding voor zijn werk misloopt.
Supports the bill and the broader use of the exception, asking how far the situation improves and how the source list gives flexibility.
Because the safeguards in the bill provide for this, these members support the bill.
Omdat de waarborgen in het wetsvoorstel daarin voorzien, steunen deze leden het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how often the publishers' geschriftenbescherming is used and when a compensation can be nil.
Is the assumption by VOI©E among others correct that this can only occur if the rightsholder waives fair compensation?
Klopt de aanname van onder meer VOI©E dat hiervan alleen sprake kan zijn als de rechthebbende van een billijke vergoeding afziet?
Supports the bill but raises questions on rules delegated to AMvB, the source list, enforcement of the revenue restriction, and dispute routes over compensation amounts.
What is the procedure if there is disagreement over the amount of compensation? What are the objection and appeal options?
Wat is de gang van zaken als er verschil van mening optreedt over de hoogte van de vergoeding? Wat zijn hier de bezwaar- en beroepsmogelijkheden?
Asks for an exhaustive list of permitted uses of archive productions and whether alternatives to implementation were studied.
Can an exhaustive list of uses for archive productions be provided?
Kan een limitatieve lijst van gebruiksmogelijkheden voor archiefproducties worden gegeven?
Asks why the source list is set by AMvB rather than in the bill, why national rather than EU-wide, and how the revenue restriction and compensation rules are controlled.
Can the government also explain why it chose to elaborate national source lists rather than an integrated European source list?
Kan de regering tevens toelichten waarom er is gekozen voor uitwerking via nationale bronnenlijsten in plaats van een integrale Europese bronnenlijst?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering supports the bill implementing Directive 2012/28/EU on orphan works but asks that the report explain why Article 8 (temporal scope, reference date 29 October 2014) was not transposed and, if needed, adjust the bill. The government accepted this advice and also incorporated a number of drafting remarks from the advisory opinion's annex.
concerns: The Afdeling advised explaining in the explanatory memorandum why Article 8 of the directive on temporal scope was not transposed, and adjusting the bill if necessary, since implementation matters if the act enters into force after 29 October 2014.
The Afdeling's redactional annex with numerous drafting corrections to the bill and explanatory memorandum was incorporated.

33919.s: The bill amends the Wet milieubeheer and the 2013 Crisis- en herstelwet amendment act with a series of technical corrections, including new ministerial powers over end-of-waste criteria, hazardous waste categories, Kyoto project approval, enforcement allocation and environmental liability scope. It also makes minor consequential edits to the environmental law framework.
33919.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the ministerial powers as clarifications needed for EU waste law consistency and for enforcement clarity following a Raad van State ruling.
q: With the proposed amendment of the second sentence of Article 1.1(6) of the Wm, the power is added for the Minister of I&M to determine by ministerial regulation, per waste stream, that the material need no longer be regarded as waste under certain conditions.

Met de voorgestelde wijziging van de tweede volzin van artikel 1.1, zesde lid, van de Wm wordt de bevoegdheid opgenomen dat de Minister van I en M bij ministeriële regeling per afvalstroom mag bepalen dat dat materiaal onder bepaalde voorwaarden niet langer als afval hoeft te worden aangemerkt.
d: designation of other substances under Art. 10.54a
rules on Kyoto project participation approval
assigning enforcement of stoffen en mengsels rules to provinces or municipalities
assigning enforcement of rules to gedeputeerde staten or municipal executives
p: Approval for Kyoto project participation changes from mandatory to discretionary, with grounds for refusal set out in the statute and further rules left to ministerial regulation.
Removes the delegation allowing extra activities to be brought under strict liability by order in council, narrowing rather than expanding executive power.

parties: Asks the government for its response on supervision during the transition period toward the amended Fireworks Decree.

The VVD members have read the Interprovincial Consultation (IPO) reaction to the amendment and ask what the government's response is to the question of supervision in the transition period leading up to the amendment of the Fireworks Decree.

De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben de reactie van het Interprovinciaal Overleg (IPO) op de wetwijziging gelezen en vragen wat de reactie is van de regering op het vraagstuk over het toezicht in de overbruggingsperiode, toewerkend naar het moment van wijziging van het Vuurwerkbesluit.
Generally positive about the amendments but asks the government to respond to IPO concerns on temporarily placing fireworks supervision with the ministry and proposes an evaluation clause.

The PvdA members ask whether the government has listened carefully to the IPO's concerns about temporarily placing supervision with the Ministry of Infrastructure and the Environment in relation to amending the Fireworks Decree.

De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of de regering met betrekking tot het wijzigen van het Vuurwerkbesluit goed geluisterd heeft naar de zorgen van het IPO over het tijdelijk onderbrengen van het toezicht bij het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu.

Demands per-amendment justification, questions the rushed permanence of the Crisis and Recovery Act, asks why waste-category criteria and end-of-waste criteria are set by ministerial regulation rather than by law or general administrative order, and asks why the bill is not subject to a pre-consultation procedure with the House.
These members request that the government state this clearly, for each substantive amendment, as a matter of priority.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering dit, per inhoudelijke wijziging, alsnog helder en duidelijk aan te geven.
Asks the government to justify deviating from mandatory certification bodies for hazardous substances and to explain how control and enforcement would be organized.

The D66 members note that the government wants to be able to deviate from a mandatory certification body for hazardous substances and preparations when this is not regulated in the European directives.

De leden van de D66-fractie lezen dat de regering wil kunnen afwijken van een verplichte keuringsinstantie voor gevaarlijke stoffen en preparaten, wanneer dit niet geregeld is in de Europese richtlijnen.

33928.s: The bill tightens the conditions for the voluntary AOW (old-age pension) contribution scheme for past periods, requiring at least five years of prior compulsory insurance and work in the Netherlands or on the continental shelf, and excluding those insured abroad under foreign mandatory pension schemes. It also adds a hardship clause letting the Sociale verzekeringsbank deviate from the work condition where strict application would cause overriding unfairness, with transitional rules for applications before and after entry into force.
33928.j: The memorandum justifies the hardship clause by saying a strict reading could under circumstances produce disproportionate results, and it follows the standard model provision in the legislative guidelines.
q: The Sociale verzekeringsbank may deviate from the condition that the insured person performs work in the Netherlands or on the continental shelf, insofar as application, given the interest in preventing unintended use, would lead to an unfairness of overriding nature.

De Sociale verzekeringsbank kan afwijken van de voorwaarde, bedoeld in de eerste zin, dat de verzekerde in Nederland of op het continentaal plat al dan niet in dienstbetrekking arbeid verricht, voor zover toepassing gelet op het belang van het tegengaan van onbedoeld gebruik, zal leiden tot een onbillijkheid van overwegende aard.
d: ARTIKEL I, A.3 (artikel 38, eerste lid, hardheidsclausule)
deviation from work condition for voluntary contribution in cases of overriding unfairness
p: ARTIKEL I, A.3 (artikel 38, eerste lid, hardheidsclausule)
Grants the Sociale verzekeringsbank discretion to deviate from the statutory work condition where strict application would produce an overriding unfairness, limited to that standard.

parties: Asks whether the AOW purchase scheme is outdated and why the period is five rather than seven years, without raising a check concern.
Why does the government not choose to abolish the AOW purchase scheme entirely, as the SVB also advised?
Waarom kiest de regering er niet voor om de AOW-inkoopregeling volledig af te schaffen, zoals ook door de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) is geadviseerd?
Shares the Raad van State's view that the employment-history requirement conflicts with the AOW's principles and asks for a fuller justification.
The CDA members note that they share the Raad van State's view that the proposal to introduce an employment-history requirement conflicts with the principles of the AOW as a people's insurance.

De leden van de CDA-fractie merken op dat zij de mening van de Raad van State delen dat het voorstel om een arbeidsverledeneis in te voeren, op gespannen voet staat met de uitgangspunten van de AOW als volksverzekering

Supports the scheme for those building a lasting bond with the Netherlands but questions how the employment condition affects partners who cannot work and the SVB's advice to drop the foreign-periods restriction.
What consideration led the government not to honour the SVB's request to at least drop the condition that foreign insured periods cannot be purchased?
Welke overweging heeft er toe geleid om het verzoek van de SVB, om in ieder geval de voorwaarde te schrappen dat buitenlandse verzekerde tijdvakken niet kunnen worden ingekocht, niet te honoreren?
Asks why the additional requirements were added on top of the premium increase, citing the Raad van State's doubt about their necessity, and wants fuller justification.
These members also refer to the Raad van State's advice, which asks whether, in the government's view, the premium increase alone is not sufficiently restrictive.

Genoemde leden verwijzen in dit licht ook naar het advies van de Raad van State, die de vraag opwerpt of naar de mening van de regering de verhoging van de minimumpremie als zodanig niet voldoende beperkend is.
Asks the government to justify rejecting the Raad van State's view on the employment requirement and to estimate effects without it, and to address SVB complexity concerns.
These members ask for further explanation of why the government does not share this position.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere toelichting waarom de regering dit standpunt niet deelt.
Asks about the rise in buyers, their income levels, and why the SVB's advice to scrap the scheme was not addressed.
The PVV members note that in recent years the number of AOW buyers almost tripled between 2011 and 2013.
De leden van de PVV-fractie merken op dat in de afgelopen jaren het aantal AOW-inkopers bijna is verdrievoudigd tussen 2011 en 2013.
Asks whether the change allows qualifying persons to also buy AOW for a non-working partner.
With this amendment, is it possible for those who meet the requirements to also buy AOW for a non-working partner?
Is het met deze wetswijziging mogelijk voor hen die aan de gestelde eisen voldoen tevens AOW in te kopen voor een niet werkende partner?

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division supports the bill tightening voluntary AOW buy-in conditions but objects to the five-year employment requirement as being at odds with the AOW's character as a people's insurance without regard to work history, and advises revising it. The government's reply explains why the employment requirement is justified as a means to curb misuse, while also adjusting the explanatory memorandum and adopting the redactional comments.
concerns: The employment requirement for voluntary buy-in is said to conflict with the AOW's principle as a people's insurance in which work history plays no role, so the Afdeling advises further justification or adaptation.

The Afdeling considers that a higher minimum premium already largely resolves the misuse, so the additional employment requirement may be unnecessary; the government argues the requirement remains justified to curb misuse.
Redactional comments, including explicit retroactivity to 24 March 2014 and clarifying that EEA and Swiss periods count under Regulation 883/2004, were adopted.

33937.s: The bill amends the Medicines Act to implement EU Directive 2012/26/EU on pharmacovigilance, mainly by adjusting the Medicines Evaluation Board's arbitration procedures, marketing authorisation holders' notification duties, and the Public Health Inspectorate's obligations. It also removes some existing provisions and adds cross-references to the directive.
33937.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary to implement the EU directive, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: that it is necessary, to implement Directive 2012/26/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 October 2012 amending Directive 2001/83/EC as regards pharmacovigilance, to amend the Medicines Act

dat het noodzakelijk is dat ter implementatie van richtlijn 2012/26/EU van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 25 oktober 2012 tot wijziging van richtlijn 2001/83/EG, wat de geneesmiddelenbewaking betreft, wijzigingen worden aangebracht in de Geneesmiddelenwet

parties: Asks whether the bill goes beyond the directive, what emergency justifies the Union emergency procedure, and how administrative burden compares with benefits.
Is the bill an exact implementation of the directive, or does it go further than the directive on some points?
Is het wetsvoorstel een exacte uitwerking van de betreffende richtlijn, of gaat het wetsvoorstel op punten verder dan de betreffende richtlijn?
Welcomes the improved monitoring but asks whether the Netherlands retains enough own national powers to intervene and whether the instruments suffice to protect public health.
To what extent does the government think the Netherlands still has sufficient own powers to intervene at national level?
In hoeverre vindt de regering dat Nederland nog voldoende eigen bevoegdheden heeft om op nationaal niveau in te grijpen?
Argues each member state should be able to withdraw a doubtful medicine immediately without needing agreement of two or more states, and asks for justification of current limits.

However, they are of the view that each member state must itself be able to decide whether a medicine about which there is doubt over quality, safety or efficacy should be immediately withdrawn from the market.

Zij zijn echter van mening dat iedere lidstaat zelf moet kunnen bepalen of een medicijn, waarbij twijfel is over de kwaliteit, veiligheid of werkzaamheid, per direct uit de markt dient te worden genomen.

33946.s: The bill shortens the duration of continued allowances (voortgezette uitkering) for former political office holders such as ministers, members of the House, provincial executives and mayors, from up to ten years before retirement age to a maximum of five years. It also adjusts related wage-base rules and transitional provisions so that current office holders keep the old rules under certain conditions.
33946.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the need for proportionate legal-status arrangements for political office holders and by the consultation with municipal and provincial bodies, without offering a justification for new executive powers.
q: This bill aims to reduce the duration of the continued allowance that can be paid to a former political office holder for up to ten years before retirement age to a maximum of five years.

Dit wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe de duur van de voortgezette uitkering die gedurende maximaal tien jaar voorafgaande aan de pensioengerechtigde leeftijd aan een gewezen politieke ambtsdrager kan worden verstrekt, terug te brengen tot een maximale duur van vijf jaar.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D / Artikel I (wijziging artikel 13d)
defining pensionable salary rules via statutory cross-reference

parties: Supports a sober, purposeful allowance and the shortening, but asks about the position of acting mayors under the transitional rules and whether the cutback limit has truly been reached.
On the other hand, they are of the view that the limit of the cutbacks has now been reached.
Anderzijds zijn zij van mening dat de grens van de versoberingen nu is bereikt.

Accepts the shortening and the differing rules for political office holders, but asks the government to nuance the claim that the limit has been reached and to justify the position with evidence on candidate recruitment.

Can the government elaborate on this? Are there, incidentally, studies known showing that people, when deciding whether to aspire to a political office, are partly guided by the arrangements for political office holders?

Zijn er overigens onderzoeken bekend waaruit blijkt dat mensen bij het al dan niet ambiëren van een politiek ambt zich – mede – laten leiden door de voorzieningen die er voor politieke ambtsdragers zijn?

Asks why the allowance is not abolished entirely, questions why political office holders deserve privileged treatment, and argues the arrangements remain more generous than those for ordinary citizens.

The SP members ask whether the government has also considered terms other than five years."

Note: the most direct critical statement is: "Zij vragen de regering of zij erkent dat dit vervreemding van de politiek in de hand werkt en de geloofwaardigheid van politici ondermijnt." (English: They ask whether the government acknowledges that this fosters alienation from politics and undermines the credibility of politicians.)
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of de regering ook andere termijnen dan vijf jaar heeft overwogen.
Supports the view that the shorter allowance period is no longer fitting in an era of austerity and expected longer working lives, and agrees versobering is not an end in itself.
These members endorse the position that this benefit duration is no longer appropriate in a time when all kinds of provisions are being cut back and everyone is expected to work longer.

Deze leden onderschrijven de stelling, dat deze uitkeringsduur niet langer passend is in een tijd waarin allerlei voorzieningen worden versoberd en waarin van iedereen wordt verwacht dat hij langer doorwerkt.
Asks for an empirical basis for the five-year term and for the justification of the continued allowance, noting the explanation is only summary and rests on a prior commitment to the Tweede Kamer.
Can the government further explain on what the five-year period is based?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarop de termijn van vijf jaar gebaseerd is?
Asks whether a 7 or 8 year term would better serve attractiveness of office, how risks differ between full-time and part-time functions, and about the transitional rules for repeated appointments.
Has research been done on whether a term of 7 or 8 years would better fit keeping the political office attractive?
Is er onderzoek gedaan of een termijn van 7 of 8 jaar niet beter aansluit bij de het aantrekkelijk houden van het politieke ambt?

33964.s: The bill amends the Wft to introduce a new Chapter 1.7 on remuneration policy for Dutch financial undertakings, capping variable pay at 20% of fixed pay (with exceptions for staff working abroad), banning guaranteed variable pay, capping severance at one year's fixed pay, and requiring clawback of variable pay. It also places the supervision of these rules with DNB and the AFM and extends supervisors' powers over groups and subsidiaries.
33964.j: The memorandum justifies the supervisor rule-making powers as a way to implement European rules and address technical matters, noting that the Wft basis already exists in lower regulation.
q: Besides the bill's provisions, the supervisors may set further rules, including to implement European rules.
Naast bepalingen van het wetsvoorstel kunnen de toezichthouders nadere regels stellen, onder meer ter implementatie van Europese regels.
d: supervisor rules on drawing up, adopting, evaluating and amending remuneration policy and on pay components
supervisor rules on the manner of publishing remuneration policy
supervisor consent for exceptional variable pay to retain staff above the cap
p: Detailed remuneration rules are left to supervisors through supervisory regulations rather than the statute itself.
Supervisors may approve variable pay above the statutory cap for retention purposes, subject to conditions set in the statute.

parties: Asks whether the bonus cap and severance rules are necessary, proportionate, EU-compatible, and whether they harm the competitiveness and level playing field of the Dutch financial sector.
They note that this law must be workable in practice for employees and employers in this sector and must not worsen our investment climate.
Zij merken op dat deze wet in de praktijk werkbaar moet zijn voor werknemers en werkgevers in deze sector en deze wet ons vestigingsklimaat niet moet doen verslechteren.
Supports the bill but worries about circumvention through allowances, pension top-ups and compensating fixed salary increases, and asks for stricter limits and ratio rules.
However, the PvdA members are concerned about possible avoidance constructions.
Wel zijn de leden van de PvdA-fractie bezorgd over mogelijke ontwijkingsconstructies.
Welcomes the bonus cap but asks how the government will prevent circumvention via foreign contracts, exceptions and salary increases.
Can the government explain why it wants to make an exception to the ban on guaranteed bonuses for first-year contracts, ask the SP members.
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom zij een uitzondering wil maken op het verbod van gegarandeerde bonussen voor eerste jaarcontracten, vragen de leden van de SP-fractie.
Supports the aim but questions the need for legislation now, asks the government to take the Council of State's critical advice seriously and to explain frequent departures from it.
Does the government share the CDA members' view that advice from the Council of State's Division must be given heavy weight in the legislative process?
Deelt de regering de opvatting van de leden van de CDA-fractie dat advisering van de Afdeling zwaar moet worden meegewogen in het wetgevingsproces?
Asks technical questions on publication duties for small firms, circumvention through salary increases and the scope of exemptions.
The PVV members would like to know to what extent this is an obligation.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zouden graag willen weten in hoeverre dit een verplichting is.
Shares the aim but argues the scope reaches staff without risk influence, is disproportionate, and that competition and removing implicit guarantees would be more effective.
These members are however critical of the way the government intends to achieve this.
Deze leden zijn echter kritisch op de manier waarop de regering dit denkt te bereiken.
Supports a non-excessive remuneration culture but asks how the exact scope is determined, how exceptions outside collective agreements are limited, and how conflicting foreign law is handled.
These members ask how it will be prevented that after this legislation takes effect, new routes are sought to maintain the current remuneration culture with its excesses.
Zij vragen hoe voorkomen wordt dat na het inwerking treden van deze wetgeving opnieuw gezocht wordt naar andere routes ten einde de huidige beloningscultuur met haar uitwassen in stand te houden.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advises on a draft bill tightening rules on remuneration policy of financial undertakings (bonus cap of 20% of fixed pay, severance limits, clawback), raising concerns about justification, scope, EU free movement, property rights and delegation. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepts several points, partly adapts the bill (transitional rules for severance, narrower severance scope, deleted performance-based clawback) and rejects others such as the broad personal and territorial scope.
concerns: Justification for the new, stricter remuneration rules is insufficient given recently adopted measures whose effects are not yet known; the government added explanation but kept the rules.
The very broad scope across financial and even non-financial undertakings and all staff is not sufficiently tied to the purpose; the government rejected narrowing scope but explained its choices.
The bill restricts free movement of services and establishment and may conflict with EU directives on maximum harmonisation; government clarified the directive is minimum harmonisation.
Property protection under Article 1 First Protocol ECHR and Article 17 Charter is affected; transitional law added for severance limits but not for other restrictions.
Delegating to a ministerial regulation the rules on converting variable pay into fixed pay is inappropriate; the delegation was removed.
Severance cap interferes with collective bargaining and freedom of contract; government reverted the severance scope to the consultation version.
Unclear criteria such as 'healthy' capital position, scope of 'main activities' and the toezichthouder's discretion need clearer statutory definition; the explanatory memorandum was expanded.
Redactional remarks on the term 'rechtshandelingen' and the wording of Article 1:116 were addressed.

33982.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2013/11/EU and Regulation 524/2013 on alternative and online dispute resolution for consumer disputes in the Netherlands, setting requirements for ADR bodies, procedures, information duties and the designation of bodies by the minister. It also amends the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming and the Wet op het financieel toezicht to link them to the new designation regime.
33982.j: The memorandum justifies the designation and supervision powers as necessary to implement the EU directive and regulation and to ensure quality of ADR bodies.
q: The responsible minister may designate an organisation as an ADR body within the meaning of this Act or withdraw such a designation.
Onze Minister die het aangaat kan een instantie aanwijzen als instantie tot buitengerechtelijke geschillenbeslechting als bedoeld in deze wet of een aanwijzing intrekken.
d: designation and withdrawal of ADR bodies
further rules on complaint handling and requirements for financial ADR bodies
p: The minister gains discretion to designate and withdraw ADR bodies, with publication in the Staatscourant and notification to the European Commission as the only checks.

parties: Asks what concretely changes for consumers and businesses given that the existing Dutch ADR system is already high quality, and questions the costs and the risk of reduced transparency for consumers.
Can the government explain what exactly will change for consumers and businesses on the basis of this bill?
Kan de regering ingaan op de vraag wat op basis van dit wetsvoorstel exact zal veranderen voor consumenten en het bedrijfsleven?
Questions the criteria for accessibility of ADR bodies, the ministerial designation and supervision of bodies, and possible arbitrariness in admissibility rules.
Do these members understand correctly that the dispute bodies falling under the directive will be subject to more ministerial supervision than now?
Begrijpen deze leden het verder goed dat de geschilleninstanties die onder de richtlijn vallen meer dan nu onderworpen worden aan toezicht door de Minister?
Asks how much national policy room remains under the implementing act and which important choices can still be made.

Asks about the effectiveness of the safety-net committee when businesses refuse cooperation, the proportionality of the one-year submission term, and the adequacy of information duties for businesses.
Is it correct that if a business is unwilling to cooperate with an assessment by this safety-net committee, the consumer is left empty-handed?
Klopt het dat wanneer een ondernemer niet bereid is mee te werken aan een beoordeling door deze vangnetcommissie, de consument alsnog met lege handen staat?
Questions the added value and necessity of the implementing legislation for the Netherlands, given the successful existing system, and the basis for claims of low compliance costs.
These members ask what the added value of this implementing legislation is for the Netherlands.
Deze leden vragen wat de meerwaarde is van deze implementatiewetgeving voor Nederland.
Questions whether ministerial designation and reporting powers fit a largely independent, self-regulating sector, and whether a separate law is preferable to integration into existing codes.
What necessity does the government see in the Dutch context for the control mechanisms created by the implementing act?
Welke noodzaak bestaat er volgens de regering in de Nederlandse context voor de controlemechanismen die met de implementatiewet ontstaan?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division supported the bill implementing the EU ADR directive for consumer disputes but objected to placing it in a standalone act rather than an existing code, and asked for clarification on the erkenningsregelingen, the scope of damages, and a wording error in the Dutch consumer definition. The government's reply rejected the main point on a standalone act (citing the feasibility of meeting the 2015 deadline) but followed the advice on the existing recognition schemes, the definition correction, and most drafting remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling found the choice for a standalone implementation act unconvincing and advised placing the rules in an existing law such as the Civil Code, Code of Civil Procedure or the Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming.
The Afdeling advised clarifying the relationship between existing recognition schemes for dispute bodies and the bill, and adapting those schemes where necessary.

The Afdeling advised clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that the directive's scope covers only part of material damage, noting the Commission's expert-meeting position does not bind the Court of Justice.
The Afdeling pointed out an erroneous negation in the Dutch version of the directive's consumer definition and advised contacting the Commission and Council secretariat for rectification.
The Afdeling made numerous redactional remarks, most incorporated, but the advice to replace 'gezondheidswerkers' with 'hulpverleners' was not followed.

33991.s: The bill repeals article 6a.21a of the Telecommunicatiewet and article 6.14a of the Mediawet 2008 to bring the rules on programme services into line with European law. The explanatory memorandum states the repeal has no effect on regulatory burden and takes effect the day after publication.
33991.j: The memorandum justifies the repeal by the need to comply with EU law and an infringement procedure, with no new powers granted.
q: That means the access-related obligations these articles refer to can only be imposed on providers of these services after a market analysis

Dat betekent dat de met toegang verbandhoudende verplichtingen waar artikel 6a.21a van de Telecommunicatiewet en artikel 6.14a van de Mediawet 2008 op zien aan aanbieders van deze diensten uitsluitend kunnen worden opgelegd na een marktanalyse

parties: Asks why the government did not explain choosing removal over amending the provisions and why it did not await the outcome of the infringement procedure.
Why is the outcome of the infringement procedure not awaited?
Waarom wordt de uitkomst van de inbreukprocedure niet afgewacht?
Regrets the removal of the articles but understands the government's choice given the conflict with European law, and asks no further questions.
However, they understand the government's choice in connection with the conflict with European law.](Dutch text)
Zij begrijpen echter de keuze van de regering in verband met de strijdigheid met het Europees recht.

34085-X.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2014
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2014

34189.s: The bill establishes a temporary toll on the Blankenburgverbinding and the ViA15 motorways to help finance them, with the minister setting tariffs by ministerial regulation and a toll decision that must be withdrawn once net revenues cover the toll target. It also creates enforcement tools, including administrative fines, roadside stops and immobilisation of vehicles whose keeper cannot be traced, and a review report to parliament every four years.
34189.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial powers by the need for efficient collection and enforcement, given that foreign and untraceable keepers cannot be reached by post, and it notes the statutory obligation to withdraw the toll once the target is met.
q: To nonetheless achieve effective enforcement of the toll payment obligation, Article 15 of the bill provides for the possibility of network supervision.
Om toch tot een effectieve handhaving van de betalingsplicht van de tolheffing te komen, voorziet artikel 15 van het wetsvoorstel in de mogelijkheid tot toezicht op het netwerk.
d: toll decision for the two road sections
designated vehicles exempt in calamities and maintenance
payment deadlines, road marking and payment method
designation of enforcement officers and rules on removal and disposal of vehicles
designation of applicable EU directive and interoperable tolling rules
p: Enforcement officers may stop vehicles, impose an immediate fine on the driver, and immobilise, move or dispose of a vehicle, with objection and appeal afterwards.
The minister alone may adopt, amend or withdraw the toll decision, subject to public inspection and appeal to the Council of State.
The minister may grant discretionary exemptions from toll on grounds of traffic flow, public order or the general interest.
Administrative fines escalate by statute with two increases and can lead to a writ of execution, with the toll obligation folded into the fine.
Keepers can be released from toll liability only in limited cases, and the driver then becomes liable.

parties: Asks how the executive will enforce tolls against foreign plates, what powers the inspector gets, and how the Chamber is informed about details still to be worked out.
How will the government ensure toll collection from vehicles not registered in the Netherlands that use these links?
Hoe gaat de regering inzetten op de inning van de tol bij niet in Nederland geregistreerde voertuigen die gebruik maken van de genoemde verbindingen?
Critical of the bill's structure, the project-specific legislation, the reminder fee, and the lack of a payment arrangement for vulnerable users; cites the Council of State's objections.
The Council of State considers this an undesirable development that does not fit the rule-of-law principle that legislation should lay down general rules rather than regulate an individual case.

De Afdeling acht dit een ongewenste ontwikkeling, die niet goed past bij het rechtsstatelijke uitgangspunt dat wetgeving bedoeld is voor het stellen van algemene regels en niet voor de regeling van een individueel geval.
In principle opposed to road tolling; holds that roads should be financed by the state from the infrastructure fund and asks about the effects on traffic and the transport sector.
They hold that construction and maintenance of roads should be financed by the central government from the Infrastructure Fund, and for this reason do not support this bill.
Zij zijn van mening dat de aanleg en het onderhoud van wegen moet worden gefinancierd door het Rijk vanuit het Infrastructuurfonds en om deze reden onderschrijven deze leden dit wetsvoorstel niet.
Asks whether tolling could last longer than budgetarily necessary given objections, whether foreign-plate payment is secured, and about the immediate reminder without a prior invoice.
The CDA asks whether there is a risk that the toll remains in place longer than financially/budgetarily necessary because objections and appeals can be lodged.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering wil aangeven of het risico bestaat dat de tolheffing langer blijft bestaan dan financieel/budgettair noodzakelijk is, doordat er zienswijzen en/of bezwaren ingediend kunnen worden.
Supports the user-pays principle but raises questions on fraud risk, fine procedure for drivers with unknown residence, and whether this is legally tenable compared with account holders.
Do these members correctly understand that these drivers, when passing a toll route, must themselves actively look for a physical or online payment point?
Begrijpen deze leden goed dat deze bestuurders, wanneer zij een toltraject passeren, zelf actief op zoek moeten naar een fysiek betaalpunt of een betaalpunt via internet?
Raises privacy concerns about sending invoices versus reminders without a prior infringement, questions on enforcement fairness for foreign plates, and asks about reliability in extreme weather.
These members have questions about this argument, because the bill will communicate in all sorts of ways that a toll road is being used.
Genoemde leden hebben vragen bij dit argument omdat volgens het wetsvoorstel op allerlei manieren zal worden gecommuniceerd dat gebruik wordt gemaakt van een tolweg.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised that the toll-collection system for the Blankenburg and ViA15 links (free-flow, with no invoice or reminder) is disproportionately burdensome for citizens and should be reconsidered, with a reminder or invoice added before fines, and raised concerns about fines for non-resident drivers, technical reliability, separation of private operator tasks, procedure for amending tolls, legal protection for erroneous charges, enforcement powers, and the need for the new law. The minister's reply largely adopted the advice: a payment reminder was added, fines were justified, enforcement powers and remedies were added, and the Wbm was retained as the basis but replaced by this law.
concerns: The system without invoice or reminder was considered disproportionately burdensome for citizens; the government added a payment reminder for account holders with known addresses.
Burden on non-resident drivers with foreign plates who cannot be traced; the government justified direct enforcement and fines but did not adopt a security-deposit alternative.
Concerns about technical reliability of free-flow recognition and missing foreign experience; the government gave recognition rates and examples and added cost coverage details.
Enforcement powers to stop vehicles and remedies against them were missing; government added the provisions and remedies.
Separation of public and private tasks of the private collector needed to be explained; a new section 3.4.6 was added to the explanatory memorandum.

Legal protection against wrongly collected tolls should lie with the administrative court rather than the civil court; the government kept civil jurisdiction for account-based claims and clarified this, though the advice was not fully followed.
Need for a new project-specific law instead of using the existing Wbm was questioned; the government explained why the Wbm was unsuitable and the law was kept.

34198.s: The bill amends the Wft and related financial-markets laws to ring-fence derivative positions held by intermediaries for clients so they are protected if the intermediary fails, and to extend DNB's resolution and intervention powers to the parent companies of Dutch banks and insurers. It also makes technical changes to licensing, cross-border rules, the Wwft and kansspelen levies, the Faillissementswet, and accountant rotation rules.
34198.j: The memorandum justifies the DNB and Minister powers by reference to the evaluations of the Interventiewet and the SNS REAAL nationalisation, which recommended extending intervention to holding companies, and says ministerial rules are technical.
q: The effectiveness of the transfer arrangement can be increased by giving DNB the power to include the parent company of a bank and/or insurer in the transfer arrangement.
De effectiviteit van de overdrachtsregeling kan worden vergroot door DNB de bevoegdheid te geven om de moedermaatschappij van een bank en/of verzekeraar te betrekken in de overdrachtsregeling.
d: rules on cooperation agreements with non-EU supervisors
additional rules on management, investor information and custody for investment funds
rules on market operator oversight body requirements
Artikel V, onderdeel B (art. 3 Wwft lid 9)
exemptions from Wwft obligations, with conditions attached
Artikel V, onderdeel B (art. 3 Wwft lid 10)
Minister may grant exemptions from Wwft obligations on request
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 1:104 lid 1 sub m)
Adds a ground for the supervisor to withdraw a licence when a firm fails to pay supervision levies, as a last-resort measure after ordinary collection steps.
Artikel I, onderdeel I (art. 2:69c) and Artikel II, onderdeel U
Gives the AFM discretion to permit fund managers to carry on certain additional activities.
Artikel I, onderdeel 3:159c lid 2 and Artikel III, onderdeel F (art. 213ar Fw)

Lets DNB prepare a transfer plan for, and petition bankruptcy of, the parent company of an insurer, allowing DNB to bypass ordinary creditor and court processes; DNB must be heard before a parent company is declared bankrupt..
Extends the Minister of Finance's expropriation powers to claims (vorderingen) held against a distressed firm, not only its assets and securities.
Adjusts thresholds for qualifying holdings and declarations of no objection, mostly technical.
Artikel I, onderdeel 3:33c and 4:87a (adequate administration of derivatives assets)
Requires intermediaries to keep an adequate administration of derivative assets, enforceable by supervisors.

parties: Asks why the derivatives protection is needed separately, whether it follows from MiFID/EMIR given the Raad van State's view, and whether DNB's objection process is sufficiently independent.
The Raad van State indicates that this is not the case.
De Raad van State geeft namelijk aan dat dit niet het geval is.
Asks for motivation of why the Netherlands goes further than Germany, England and France and why the Minister persisted despite the Raad van State's advice.
