Why is more weight given to calls from the market than to the advice of the Raad van State?
Waarom wordt er meer gewicht gegeven aan de roep vanuit de markt dan het advies van de Raad van State?
Questions the necessity of the derivatives protection and the proportionality of withdrawing licences for unpaid supervision fees.
The CDA members ask the government about the necessity of this part of the present bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering naar de noodzaak van dit onderdeel van onderhavig wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes the extension of Interventiewet powers to parent companies and asks about the record on SNS and other institutions.
The SP members welcome the amendments to the Interventiewet because the parent company is now also included.
De leden van de fractie van de SP juichen de wijzigingen in de Interventiewet toe omdat nu ook de moedermaatschappij erbij wordt betrokken.
Asks for the progress of the evaluation of the public-offer obligation, which the Minister promised to report to parliament on.
These members ask whether the government can indicate how far the evaluation has progressed and when the Chamber will be informed about it.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe ver de evaluatie gevorderd is en wanneer de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd zal worden.
Asks why DNB rather than the Minister should have the transfer instrument against parent companies of insurers and how DNB and the Minister coordinate.
What are the advantages of this and why is this power not placed solely with the Minister, these members ask.
Welke voordelen heeft dit en waarom wordt deze bevoegdheid niet alleen bij de Minister neergelegd, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks why the government uses a royal decree rather than an amendment to fix the conflicting audit rotation provisions, arguing that an amendment would give more transparent legislation.
The VVD members think that more transparent and understandable legislation would result if an amendment note were chosen.
De leden van de fractie van de VVD denken namelijk dat er meer transparante en begrijpelijke wetgeving ontstaat indien wordt gekozen voor een nota van wijziging.
Asks whether it is now clear to audit firms which rules apply from 17 June 2016 and whether the law gives enough clarity on rotation and the transitional arrangement.
The PvdA members ask whether it is now clear to the audit organisations concerned which regulations will apply to them from 17 June 2016.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of voor de betreffende accountantsorganisaties nu duidelijk is welke regelgeving vanaf 17 juni 2016 voor hen gaat gelden?
Expresses surprise that part of the bill conflicts with EU law, asks which advice and reviews were received, when the government first knew, and what lessons it draws.
A part of the bill therefore turns out simply not to be in line with the relevant European regulation.
Een deel van het wetsvoorstel blijkt dus gewoon niet in overeenstemming te zijn met de relevante Europese verordening.
Asks since when the Minister knew of the conflict between the Wta and the EU regulation and whether the government agrees with the legal analysis of an outside law firm.
Does the government fully agree with the analysis of the law firm NautaDutilh?
Gaat de regering volledig mee in de analyse van advocatenkantoor NautaDutilh?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board advised on the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2016, raising major objections to a new directive power to order removal of likely unsuitable financial policymakers, and concerns about derivatives protection outside bankruptcy and the customs anti-money-laundering provisions. The government's reply accepts dropping the directive power and the customs provisions from the bill and addresses the other points by clarifications and adjustments.
concerns: The necessity of the new directive power for likely unsuitable policymakers is not convincingly motivated and should be justified or dropped; the government dropped this part of the bill.
The directive power is too broad and should be limited to urgent cases where the person will almost certainly fail the suitability test; the government reconsidered and removed it.

Derivatives protection outside bankruptcy does not follow from EMIR or Mifid and needs justification, including compatibility with EU free movement rules; the government added justification in the explanatory memorandum.
Several redactional and technical corrections were made, including to article 2:99 and the Wge provisions.
The expanded expropriation power under article 6:2 Wft and the broader resolution trigger for parent insurers need clearer explanation; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

34279.s: The bill amends the Wet langdurige zorg, the Jeugdwet, the Wmo 2015, the Zorgverzekeringswet and the Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg to allow temporary bridging care at home, to let the SVB approve personal budget contracts, and to let the Zorginstituut grant temporary subsidies for autism treatment. Many details are left to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders.
34279.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying details such as conditions, duration and procedures must be worked out in consultation with stakeholders and that SVB control over contracts is needed for labour law compliance.
q: The SVB can already refuse payments under the Wmo 2015 implementing regulation and Article 8 of the Youth Act if they conflict with the law applicable to the employment contract.

De SVB kan op grond van artikel 2 van de Uitvoeringsregeling Wmo 2015 en artikel 8 van de Jeugdwet nu al betalingen weigeren als die in strijd zijn met het recht dat van toepassing is op de geldende arbeidsovereenkomst.
d: conditions for bridging care at home
ARTIKEL I, G and H (art. 11.1.1 and 11.1.2)
conditions and manner of temporary subsidies for autism treatment
contract between personal budget holder and care provider
contract between client and provider paid from personal budget
entry into force by royal decree, possible retroactive effect
p: The Wlz-uitvoerder may collect amounts owed by enforcement order (dwangbevel), which creates an executory title without involving a civil court.
Decisions by youth care providers are treated as decisions under the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens, which limits the data protection appeal route available to citizens.
ARTIKEL I, A and C (art. 3.1.1 and 3.3.6)
Temporary bridging care at home may be granted ex officio by the Wlz-uitvoerder without meeting ordinary eligibility conditions, with details set by ministerial regulation.

parties: Asks the government to specify which conditions for personal budget bridging care will not apply and asks why the Jeugdwet information provision is being changed.
The VVD members ask whether the government can nonetheless go further into other specific conditions that will not apply.
de leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering toch nader kan ingaan op andere specifieke voorwaarden die niet van toepassing zullen zijn.
Asks whether bridging care should be legally guaranteed for clients and how quality of care in logeeropvang will be safeguarded without the Wtzi requirement.
In what way is the quality of care during respite stays safeguarded?
Op welke wijze wordt de kwaliteit van zorg van het logeren geborgd?
Criticizes the sloppy repeated amendments, questions the vague 'redelijke afstand' standard, the SVB approval burden, and the lack of consultation with providers and patient organisations.
Which tasks of the Zorginstituut Nederland still need to be clarified.
Welke taken van het Zorginstituut Nederland verder verduidelijkt moeten worden.
Seeks clarity on bridging care duration of thirteen weeks, reasons for excluding PGB, budget effects, and agrees with the Raad van State that SVB approval raises administrative burden.
Can the government concretely describe what a reasonable distance is?
kan de regering concreet omschrijven wat een redelijke afstand is?
Asks who determines a reasonable distance and a beschermende woonomgeving, and whether the AMvB could impose Wtzi-like requirements anyway.
What is a reasonable distance in this case and who determines it, ask these members.
Wat is in dit geval een redelijke afstand en wie bepaalt dat, zo vragen deze leden.

Asks for the full list of conditions that will not apply to bridging care, the timing of the ministerial regulation, and how child privacy is protected under the Jeugdwet change; also questions retroactive application of parental contribution.
These members would like clarification on how the child's privacy remains guaranteed in this context.
Graag ontvangen genoemde leden een verheldering over hoe in dit kader de privacy van het kind gewaarborgd blijft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet langdurige zorg, Wmo 2015, Jeugdwet, Zorgverzekeringswet and Burgerlijk Wetboek, mainly technical fixes, and flagged three points: dropping the requirement to submit a municipal grant decision with a forced-placement request, the SVB pre-approval of personal budget contracts raising administrative burden, and unlimited retroactive effect. The government reply accepted the advice on retroactivity (limited it), partly accepted the point on the forced-placement requirement by reconsidering it in a broader context, and addressed the administrative burden by explaining the SVB's new competence.
concerns: Dropping the requirement to attach a municipal grant decision to a forced-placement request needs reasoned justification given municipalities' responsibility for youth care, and the government reconsidered it in a broader context.
Administrative burden from SVB pre-approval of personal budget contracts should be addressed in the explanatory memorandum, which the government then expanded.
Unlimited retroactive effect conflicts with legal certainty and should be limited to listed cases with justification, which the government adopted.

34288.s: The bill amends the Temporary Experiment Act on ballots and central vote counting so that municipalities can experiment with a new, simpler polling-station ballot design (including party logos and candidate photos) to speed up and improve counting and promote independent voting. It extends the Act's validity from 2018 to 2021 and extends the Act's experimental scope to in-person voting in the Netherlands.
34288.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated deviations as necessary because the new ballot cannot be used within the Kieswet's current rules, and limits them by clausulation, parliamentary laying, municipal consent and a time limit.
q: To prevent experimentation on a very broad scale, the legal basis has been further limited.
Om te voorkomen dat in zeer ruime mate zou kunnen worden geëxperimenteerd, is de grondslag nader geclausuleerd.
d: deviation from specified Kieswet articles for ballot experiments
deviations from Kiesbesluit and Kiesregeling for experiments
requirements for candidate photos and their registration
p: Minister may designate municipalities for ballot experiments, subject to the municipal council's consent.
Allows temporary departures from specified Kieswet provisions by AMvB and ministerial regulation, limited to listed articles and functions, with prior parliamentary laying before both chambers.
Lets the central ballot board remove candidates' photos or reject lists where the self-declaration or ministerial technical requirements are not met, with a right of appeal to the Council of State.
Artikel I, onderdeel E and Artikel II
Extends the experiment act's validity to 2021 and gives direct appeal to the Council of State against logo and photo decisions.

parties: Asks why electronic voting experiments were not included and whether the change of not printing candidate names will confuse voters.
The VVD members cannot shake the impression that no longer listing candidates' names on the ballot forms is a major change and that voters will look at it strangely.

De leden van de VVD-fractie kunnen zich niet aan de indruk onttrekken dat het niet meer vermelden van de namen van de kandidaten op de stemformulieren voor kiezers een grote verandering is en dat kiezers daar vreemd tegen aan zullen kijken.
Asks about usability testing, experience with low-literacy voters, and the criteria by which municipalities are selected for experiments.
The PvdA members ask on what criteria the Minister of the Interior selects the municipalities in which an experiment is held.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen op grond van welke criteria de Minister van BZK de gemeenten aanwijst waar een experiment wordt gehouden.
Asks about the purpose of two different ballots in a display and how the secrecy of the vote is guaranteed.
How can ballot secrecy be properly guaranteed this way?
Hoe kan op deze manier het stemgeheim op een goede manier worden gewaarborgd?
Warns that logos and photos may steer voting, possibly extending the campaign into the polling booth and conflicting with the Kieswet, and asks about the risk of more errors.
The CDA members ask the government whether this does not extend the election campaign into the polling station.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering, of hiermee niet de verkiezingscampagne wordt voortgezet tot in het stemlokaal.
Questions voter confusion from casting two votes on one ballot and whether invalid candidate numbers should be regulated in the law itself rather than a decree.
Should that not be expressly regulated at the level of the law itself?
Moet dat niet uitdrukkelijk op het niveau van de wet zelf geregeld worden?

Argues the list-then-candidate-number method is unclear, may be unconstitutional because it treats parties rather than persons as elected, and that deeming a party-only vote a valid vote for the list leader is problematic.
In the Constitution, particularly Articles 4 and 53, reference is made to electing 'members of parliament' and not to political parties.
In deze Grondwet – en dan met name in de Artikelen 4 en 53 – wordt er gesproken van het kiezen van «leden voor het parlement» en niet van politieke partijen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised proceeding with the bill extending experiments with a new ballot in polling stations, but asked for the BES islands to be included, for the arrangement of the polling station (secrecy of the vote) to be explained, and for the 2014 evaluation to be supplemented. The government's reply accepted the polling-station and evaluation points and rejected the BES inclusion, citing legislative restraint.
concerns: The Afdeling argued experiments should be allowed on the BES islands, since participation is voluntary and BES ballots already resemble the proposed model; the government kept the BES exclusion citing legislative restraint.
The explanatory memorandum should address the secrecy of the vote (stemgeheim) rather than only voter privacy, and the polling-station layout should be set out in the general measure and explained.
The explanatory memorandum should separate the effect of the new ballot from the 2014 relaxation of ink colours when attributing the drop in invalid votes abroad.
The memorandum should give exact figures on votes cast for a party list without a candidate choice during the 2014 experiment.
Editorial remarks on the wording of article I were adopted, and the rules on candidate photos were moved to a ministerial regulation.

34378.s: The bill amends the Dutch Works Councils Act to clarify the works council's consent right over pension arrangements, including pension-related implementing agreements and regulations, and adds a consent requirement for moving pension agreements to foreign pension providers or non-Dutch insurers. It also requires employers to inform the works council in writing of changes to implementing agreements or regulations and repeals a provision of the Pensions Act that applied works council rules to transfers abroad.
34378.j: The memorandum justifies the consent requirement for transfers abroad by pointing to different supervisory and financial assessment frameworks that affect the pension working condition, and rejects an SER recommendation on attributing fund board decisions to the employer.
q: Transferring a pension scheme to a foreign pension provider also affects the pension working condition through the supervisory framework and local financial assessment framework that apply there.

Het overbrengen van een pensioenregeling naar een buitenlandse pensioenuitvoerder heeft via het daar geldende toezichtkader en het lokale financieel toetsingskader ook gevolgen voor de arbeidsvoorwaarde pensioen.
p: Employers must inform the works council in writing as soon as possible of planned changes to pension implementing agreements or regulations, strengthening worker-representative oversight rather than executive power.

parties: Worries about regulatory burden and administrative costs for firms, and asks whether the non-exhaustive list will create clarity or disputes between the works council and the employer over consent rights.
The members are concerned about the regulatory burden and extra administrative costs for businesses arising from this proposal.
De leden maakt zich zorgen om de regeldruk en extra administratieve lasten voor bedrijven die voortvloeien uit dit voorstel.
Asks how the legal procedure works if the works council disputes whether an implementation element affects pensions, how long it lasts, and whether the burden of proof should shift to the employer.
Asks whether the bill is discriminatory by nationality and whether works councils have enough knowledge to give meaningful consent.
Does the government agree that consent should be prevented from being given by a works council with too little knowledge?
Deelt de regering de mening dat voorkomen moet worden dat instemming gegeven moet worden door een OR met te weinig kennis?
Asks about gaps in protection when pension transfers occur without employee consent, retroactive effect, and whether the foreign-transfer rule complies with EU law.
Is the specific provision in line with European law?
Is de specifieke bepaling in overeenstemming met Europees recht?
Raises the Council of State view that consent for foreign placement may restrict free movement of services, and proposes reversing the burden of proof in unclear cases.
Is it possible to shape such a procedure with a reversed burden of proof?
Is het mogelijk om een dergelijke procedure met omgekeerde bewijslast vorm te geven?

Asks who represents pensioners and former participants when the indexation clause changes, and whether the accountability body should get an advisory right; also asks about legal risk for pension funds when the non-exhaustive list leads to disputes.
How are the interests of pensioners and former participants represented in this case?
Hoe worden de belangen van pensioengerechtigden en gewezen deelnemers in dit geval vertegenwoordigd?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill giving the works council (OR) a consent right on pension arrangements is acceptable, but that the consent requirement for placing a pension with a foreign pension institution or insurer needs a justification, as it may restrict free movement of services. The government's reply reports that the advice was followed by supplementing the explanatory memorandum with a justification.
concerns: The consent requirement for placing pensions with foreign institutions or insurers may restrict free movement of services under Article 56 TFEU and needs justification and proportionality review.
The distinction between domestic and foreign pension providers for the works council consent right is unclear in its rationale, since the Pensioenwet rules are not what the OR consent concerns.

34396.s: The bill revises the administrative fine provisions in the Dutch social security laws to cap fines at the maximum criminal fine under article 23(4) of the Penal Code, with intent-based fine categories, following a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling. It also widens the power to issue a warning instead of a fine and revises the transitional law of the Wet aanscherping handhaving en sanctiebeleid SZW-wetgeving.
34396.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need for an effective enforcement practice in complex implementation and to give warnings a legal basis, to be elaborated in the Boetebesluit socialezekerheidswetten.
q: Furthermore, the possibility of issuing a warning instead of an administrative fine is widened, for which a delegation basis is included in the fourth paragraph of the relevant articles.

Verder wordt de mogelijkheid van het geven van een waarschuwing in plaats van een bestuurlijke boete verruimd, waarvoor een delegatiegrondslag in het vierde lid van de desbetreffende artikelen wordt opgenomen.
d: Article I-XV (fourth paragraph of each law)
situations in which a warning may be given instead of a fine
p: Removes the transitional provisions tying fines to pre-existing conduct, which narrows protection for persons whose violations occurred before the new regime.

parties: Asks why the government amends the Fraudewet rather than only the Boetebesluit, and questions the rigidity and the discretion left to implementers in the culpability criteria.
Does the government agree with the VVD that amending only the Boetebesluit would suffice to ensure that people who commit fraud without culpability are not fined?

Is de regering het daarom met de leden van de VVD-fractie eens dat alleen een aanpassing van het boetebesluit volstaat om ervoor te zorgen dat mensen die niet verwijtbaar frauderen niet worden bestraft met een boete?
Supports a more proportionate fine regime but asks whether the new ruling requires statutory guarantees against disproportionate fines and how the time limit is reflected.
Does the ruling not require laying down new safeguards to guarantee proportionate fines, either in the law or in the Boetebesluit?
Vereist de uitspraak niet het vastleggen van nieuwe waarborgen om evenredige boeteoplegging te garanderen, of in de wet of in het Boetebesluit socialezekerheidswetten?

Criticises the government for not following the Nationale ombudsman's recommendations, not involving debt relief, and not respecting the seizure-free allowance, and asks how proportionality is guaranteed without an AMvB.
How can it be guaranteed without a general administrative order (AMvB) that the fine imposed is proportionate?
Hoe kan zonder een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) worden geborgd dat de boete die wordt opgelegd evenredig is?
Welcomes the bill for taking account of culpability and broadening warnings, but asks for more reasoned motivation on legal equality and uniform criteria.
The Council of State warns that the complexity of the proposed fine system may lead to legal inequality.
Zo waarschuwt de Raad van State ervoor dat de complexiteit van het voorgestelde boetestelsel kan leiden tot rechtsongelijkheid.
Supports the change but doubts its sufficiency and feasibility, asking about retroactive reduction of earlier fines, recidivism, and the ombudsman recommendations not followed.
They would find it fair if this bill took effect retroactively and also applied to fines imposed before the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling.
Zij zouden het billijk vinden wanneer dit wetsvoorstel met terugwerkende kracht in werking treedt en ook geldt voor boetes die voor de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad van Beroep zijn opgelegd.

Supports adjusting the fine system to the ruling but asks whether the government will act on the Raad van State advice on legal protection and whether a split between administrative and criminal parts is considered.
Can the government give a reasoned justification for not having chosen the option of a self-designed fine system?
Kan de regering dragend motiveren waarom ze daar niet voor heeft gekozen?

Questions whether alternative solutions to the legal problems identified by the Raad were considered and asks about the feasibility of municipalities applying criminal categories such as intent and culpability.
To what extent is there also a risk that effectiveness comes under further pressure because municipalities, given their core tasks, are not experienced in applying criminal-law categories?

In hoeverre bestaat ook het risico dat de effectiviteit verder onder druk komt te staan doordat gemeenten vanuit hun eigenlijke taakuitoefening niet bedreven zijn in het toepassen van strafrechtelijke categorieën?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft bill amending social security acts' administrative fine regime (Wet aanscherping) following a CRvB ruling and Nationale ombudsman report, advising a redesign of the fine system because the opzet/grove schuld distinction creates complexity and inequality in enforcement, and to justify or revise the approach. The government's nader rapport largely rejects redesign, keeps the bill, adds clarifications on opzet, a Boetebesluit with uniform gradations, and a 2016 evaluation.
concerns: The Afdeling warns the opzet/grove schuld distinction increases complexity and enforcement inconsistency across UWV, SVB and municipalities, and asks for a reasoned justification or redesign.
The Afdeling finds the bill unclear on what the intent (opzet) and gross negligence must be directed at, and asks for clarification, which the government adopted in the text.
The Afdeling flags risk of unequal treatment (rechtsongelijkheid) under the new fine system and asks for reasoned measures to promote equality.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the effectiveness of the fine mechanism in light of the ombudsman's doubts, which the government answers only by deferring to a 2016 evaluation.
The Afdeling asks for a self-contained explanatory memorandum, which the government partly accommodated by revising the text.

34459.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 to give the NPO a clearer steering role over public broadcasters while preserving their programming freedom, and to organise representative public participation. It removes the Minister of OCW's approval of board appointments at the NPO and RPO and moves appointments of supervisory board members to an independent advisory committee, with the Minister bound to take its advice unless a narrow ground applies.
34459.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the NPO's stronger steering role, which makes greater distance from the government desirable to protect broadcasters' independence and avoid the appearance of political interference.
q: To that end, this bill removes the Minister of OCW's role in appointing board members and places the recruitment and selection procedure for supervisory board members outside the Minister.

Daarvoor wordt in dit wetsvoorstel de rol van de Minister van OCW bij de benoeming van bestuurders geschrapt en wordt de wervings- en selectieprocedure voor de benoeming van toezichthouders buiten de Minister geplaatst.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 2.5, lid 1 en 4-6)
appointment of supervisory board members via independent advisory committee
p: The Minister must take the appointment advisory committee's advice unless it conflicts with law, due care or other weighty interests, and must report deviations to the Tweede Kamer.
Artikel I, onderdelen D en I (artikel 2.8, lid 3 en 2.60f, lid 3)
The Minister's consent right over appointment, suspension and dismissal of NPO and RPO board members is removed, leaving those decisions to the supervisory boards.

parties: Asks what instruments the Minister has to intervene when public broadcaster board or supervisory members clearly underperform, given appointments occur without ministerial involvement and outside democratic control by the Staten-Generaal.
They also ask what instruments the Minister has to intervene in the case of clear underperformance by board members or supervisory members of the public broadcaster.
Tevens vragen zij wat het instrumentarium van de Minister is om in te grijpen bij evident wanpresteren van bestuurders of toezichthouders van de publieke omroep.
Welcomes the appropriate distance between the Minister and appointments and dismissals at public broadcasters, and asks whether the government considers the Mohandis/Segers motion implemented.

They note with satisfaction that the government is now convinced that an appropriate distance between the Minister and the appointment and dismissal of board and supervisory members of the public broadcaster is necessary.

Zo stellen de leden tot hun tevredenheid vast dat de regering er nu van overtuigd is dat een gepaste afstand tussen Minister en de benoeming en het ontslag van bestuurders en toezichthouders bij de publieke omroep noodzakelijk is.

Asks what the marginal review of the appointment committee's advice by the Minister entails, which 'other weighty interests' justify deviation, and how reporting to the Tweede Kamer will avoid person-identifiable information; also questions whether NPO broadcasters have binding advisory rights in the coordination framework.
These members mainly ask what is meant by 'other weighty interests' as a motivation to deviate from the advice.
Deze leden vragen vooral wat wordt bedoeld met «andere zwaarwegende belangen» als motivatie om af te wijken van het advies.

Argues the NPO's prior control over programme content (budget, format, content frameworks, rights) amounts to prior censorship that may conflict with Article 7(2) of the Constitution and Article 10 ECHR, and that broadcasters lack effective legal remedies.
Does the government share the view that prior supervision is thereby a fact: broadcasters do not determine programme content if the content frameworks have already been set by the NPO?
Deelt de regering de mening dat voorafgaand toezicht daarmee een feit is: omroepen bepalen niet de inhoud van programma's als de inhoudelijke kaders al zijn vastgesteld door de NPO?

Welcomes removing the Minister's role in appointing board members and widening independence, but finds the marginal review and the vague 'weighty interests' wording unclear and asks how the NPO-broadcaster relationship changes in practice.
The members do note, however, that the Minister still performs a marginal review of the selection advisory committee's advice for candidates for the supervisory board.
De genoemde leden constateren wel dat de Minister nog steeds een marginale toets doet op het advies van de benoemingsadviescommissie voor selectie van kandidaten voor de raad van toezicht.

Asks whether the Tweede Kamer will be informed when the Minister departs from a binding appointment recommendation, questions how non-identifiable reporting contributes to transparency, and asks whether the advisory council and broadcaster objection procedures are adequate, noting the lack of a fast independent procedure.

Asks for clarification of whether the Minister's deviation from the advisory committee must be tested only against the Mediawet or against the law more broadly, and why the NPO's coordinating role is changed to a steering role.
These members ask for further explanation and interpretation.
Deze leden vragen om een nadere toelichting en interpretatie.

Questions the constitutionality of prior control by the NPO over broadcasters' programmes, the shrinking room for broadcasters to determine content, and the practical unavailability of objection because oral disapprovals are not formal decisions.
The aforementioned member has questions about this form of exercising influence by the Minister.
Het lid plaatst vraagtekens bij deze vorm van uitoefening van invloed door de Minister.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised proceeding with the draft amendment to the Mediawet 2008 on public broadcasting appointment procedures, but asked for changes to make the appointment advice non-binding in wording and to clarify what informing the Tweede Kamer entails. The government's reply accepted both points, removed the word 'bindend', and clarified that the Chamber is only informed of non-adoption of advice and the legal grounds, without personal data.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the wording 'bindend advies' was inconsistent with the minister's power to deviate from the advice, and asked for it to be removed.
The Afdeling warned that informing the Tweede Kamer about persons concerned risks reputational harm and privacy intrusion, and asked for clarification or protection of personal privacy.
The Afdeling made a minor redactional remark, adding 'ervoor' after 'raad van toezicht' in articles 2.5 and 2.60c.

34468.s: This omnibus housing bill (Veegwet wonen) makes technical and limited-policy amendments to the Huisvestingswet 2014, Huurtoeslag law, Woningwet and several other housing laws. Key changes include an integrity-screening refusal ground for housing permits with an eight-week decision period, a fixed-maximum administrative fine in the Leegstandwet, eight-year limits on housing-corporation supervisory board terms, and expanded data-sharing with the tax authority.
34468.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as correcting wrong references, redactional errors and clarifying provisions, and adding delegation provisions needed for better implementation.
q: It is considered desirable to regulate these data-provision obligations at the level of a formal statute.
Het wordt wenselijk geacht deze verplichtingen tot gegevensverstrekking op het niveau van wet in formele zin te regelen.
d: ARTIKEL II, onderdeel Z (Woningwet art. 46, tweede lid)
percentage of eligible households and rent rules for corporation lettings
ARTIKEL II, onderdeel Z (Woningwet art. 46, tweede lid)
requirements on how corporations establish household income
rules on tax authority data provision for integrity and fitness assessments
ARTIKEL IX, onderdeel QQ/FF (Woningwet art. 55, derde en vijfde lid)
retention rules for household income data and cost of business operations
ARTIKEL IX, onderdeel R (Woningwet art. 45, zesde lid)
scope of new-build activities and services by affiliated companies
ARTIKEL IX, onderdeel II (Woningwet art. 59, tweede lid)
mandating sanitation powers to the borgingsvoorziening
ARTIKEL II, onderdeel D (Huisvestingswet art. 25, ttweede lid)
requesting integrity advice from the Bureau bevordering integriteitsbeoordelingen
p: Municipalities may refuse housing conversion or merger permits on integrity grounds, with the integrity bureau consulted and a fixed decision timeframe set out in the law.
The tax authority must provide data the minister deems necessary to assess fitness and integrity of corporation directors and supervisory members.
Clarifies that the Amsterdam enterprise chamber has exclusive competence to dismiss supervisory board members of housing corporations.
Sets an eight-year maximum for supervisory board membership and lets the supervisory board ensure tenants can nominate members when no organisation does so.
Assigns the power to commission the accountant's audit to the supervisory board rather than the management or general meeting.

parties: Has no further questions on the technical amendments.
these members have no further questions.
deze leden hebben geen verdere vragen.

Asks how the Autoriteit woningcorporaties interprets the rules in practice and whether it is acting in the spirit of the intended improvements, and requests transition arrangements and a publishable assessment framework for splitting activities.
These members are receiving signals that the Aw does not do this in practice.
Deze leden krijgen signalen dat de Aw dit in de praktijk echter niet doet.

Critical of policy changes on municipal steering of liveability and allocation, possible conflict with equal treatment, the removal of tenant and residents' committee roles, and the transfer of profits from affiliated companies away from tenants.
These members also ask why additional rules alongside the housing ordinance can exist for pitches but not in other neighbourhoods.
Deze leden vragen ook waarom er voor standplaatsen wel extra regels naast de huisvestingsverordening zullen kunnen bestaan en waarom dat in andere wijken niet kan.
Asks what services housing corporations may provide to subsidiaries and tenant organisations and why these are of general interest, and whether market parties could perform them.
It is unclear, however, exactly what kind of work this concerns and why these two categories would be of general interest.
Onduidelijk is echter, om wat voor werkzaamheden precies gaat, en waarom deze beide categorieën van algemeen belang zouden zijn.

Questions the risk assessment behind allowing corporations to perform work for other corporations without a joint venture, and asks how transparency of these activities is guaranteed for municipalities and tenant organisations.
How is the transparency of these activities guaranteed at all times?
Hoe wordt de transparantie van deze activiteiten te allen tijde geborgd?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the Veegwet wonen may proceed to the Tweede Kamer, but asked the government to better justify why two categories of housing association activities (services for affiliated companies and for tenant organisations) are designated as services of general economic interest, in particular why markets cannot already provide them satisfactorily. The minister's nader rapport explains the designation with the principle that social assets must always benefit services of general economic interest, and adopts the redactional remarks, without changing the designation itself.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum insufficiently explains the nature of the activities and why market operators cannot already provide them satisfactorily, so the designation as SGEI needs motivation.
Several redactional and technical corrections to article references and wording were made as proposed.

34485-IIB.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2016 budget for the Other High Councils of State and the Governors' cabinets (IIB), raising appropriations for the Raad van State, the Algemene Rekenkamer, and the Governors' cabinets while lowering the Nationale ombudsman's spending. The bill sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2016, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The need has become apparent for an amendment to the budget of the Other High Councils of State and Governors' Cabinets (IIB) for 2016.
De noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de overige Hoge Colleges van Staat en Kabinetten van de Gouverneurs (IIB) voor het jaar 2016.

34550-III.s: This bill establishes the 2017 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs (including the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency), the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services. It sets the appropriations in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2017.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) attached to this law for the year 2017 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34594.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Hoogezand-Sappemeer, Menterwolde and Slochteren into a new municipality, Midden-Groningen, abolishing the three existing ones from the date of reorganisation. It makes transitional adjustments to the Housing Market Measures Act 2014 II, the Safety Regions Act annex, and allocation of legal succession under the general reorganisation rules.
34594.j: The memorandum justifies the merger as a voluntary consolidation of the three municipalities and explains the financial position and supervision history, without justifying any new executive powers.
q: This bill concerns the voluntary merger of the municipalities Hoogezand-Sappemeer, Menterwolde and Slochteren in the province of Groningen.
Dit wetsvoorstel betreft de vrijwillige samenvoeging van de gemeenten Hoogezand-Sappemeer, Menterwolde en Slochteren in de provincie Groningen.
d: commencement date set by royal decree

parties: Sees the merger as voluntary and strengthening provincial administration; raises no questions or remarks.
The bill gives the VVD members no cause to make remarks or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
Asks whether public support is sufficient and wants monitoring of residents' engagement after the merger, with a municipal response if indifference grows.
It is important, these members argue, to monitor after the merger whether and how the new municipality lives among its residents.
Het is zaak, zo menen de aan het woord zijnde leden, na de samenvoeging te monitoren of en hoe de (nieuwe) gemeente onder de inwoners leeft.

Asks for the reasons behind opposition in the Menterwolde council and for a fuller account of residents' values, stressing that restructuring should come from below and keep government close to citizens.
In this regard the CDA members miss a consideration of the values that the residents of Menterwolde find important in a restructuring.
De leden van de CDA-fractie missen in dit verband een beschouwing over de waarden die de inwoners van Menterwolde in een herindeling van belang vinden.

34639.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht to implement EU regulation 1286/2014 on key information documents for packaged retail and insurance-based investment products. It gives the AFM power to ban or restrict the sale of insurance with an investment component and related financial services, as provided for in Article 17 of the regulation.
34639.j: The memorandum justifies the new AFM power as required by Article 17 of the regulation and limits its use to exceptional cases where existing rules are insufficient.
q: The power may be used where the activities give rise to serious concern regarding investor protection, orderly functioning of markets, or financial stability.
De bevoegdheid kan worden gebruikt, indien de hiervoor genoemde activiteiten aanleiding geven tot ernstige bezorgdheid met betrekking tot beleggersbescherming
p: The AFM may impose bans or restrictions on insurance products with an investment component and related financial services, conditional on the regulation's criteria, consultation of other supervisors, prior notice to EIOPA and publication on its website.

parties: Asks who checks whether the essential-information document is accurate and whether checks happen before or after issue, and what recourse investors have if information proves wrong.
They ask who checks this. And does this happen beforehand or afterwards?
Zij vragen wie dat controleert. En gebeurt dit vooraf of achteraf?

Welcomes the extra rules for retail investment products and asks whether the AFM intends to use its new power to restrict or ban insurance-based investment product sales, and why the transposition options on reporting breaches were not used.
Does the AFM already intend to use this power?
Is de AFM al voornemens deze bevoegdheid te gaan gebruiken?
Has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The CDA members have read the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

Supports greater transparency but asks who checks the document contents, whether the AFM will do so, how consumers with less financial knowledge are involved, and when the regulator may ask producers to inform investors of sanctions.
Who checks the content of these pages? Will the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) do this?
Wie controleert de inhoud van deze pagina’s? Zal de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) dit gaan doen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing EU Regulation 1286/2014 on PRIIP key information documents, raising no substantive remarks and only redactional points on the transposition table. The Minister of Finance replied in a nader rapport that the redactional remarks were incorporated and some technical wording changes were made to article 1:77c.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the transposition table indicate which provisions are already in national law and which leave room for policy choices, and the government incorporated the redactional remarks.

34666.s: The bill removes the obligation for municipalities to update zoning plans and development control ordinances within ten years, pending the Environment and Planning Act, provided the plans are made electronically available. It also repeals two transitional provisions of the Introductory Act to the Spatial Planning Act.
34666.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the change by the expected entry into force of the Environment and Planning Act, which contains no comparable obligation, and by the burden of conversion for municipalities.
q: Upon entry into force of that act the obligation to update under the Wro lapses, and the duty does not return in the Environment and Planning Act.
Met de inwerkingtreding van die wet vervalt immers actualiseringsplicht van de Wro en de plicht komt niet terug in de Omgevingswet.
p: Municipalities are no longer obliged to update zoning plans within ten years if the plans are electronically accessible, reducing a periodic review duty that protected citizens' planning certainty.

parties: Asks for an explanation of the early deadline for a single environmental plan and whether entrepreneurs, e.g. in agriculture, are adequately protected against uncertainty from outdated plans.
Has sufficient account been taken of entrepreneurs' fear, for example in the agricultural sector, of uncertainty from possibly lacking up-to-date plans for ten years?

Is hierbij voldoende rekening gehouden met de vrees van ondernemers -bijvoorbeeld in de agrarische sector – voor onduidelijkheid door het mogelijk voor een periode van tien jaar ontbreken van actuele plannen?
Supports removing redundant state tasks but insists citizens and businesses must keep the ability to object to zoning plans and changes, and questions the length of the ten-year transition.
These members therefore want the government's guarantee that this amendment does not diminish the ability of citizens or entrepreneurs to object to zoning plans or proposed changes to them.

Deze leden willen dan ook graag de garantie van de regering dat deze wetswijziging niets afdoet aan de mogelijkheden voor burgers of ondernemers om bezwaar aan te tekenen tegen de bestemmingsplannen of voorgenomen wijzigingen daarin.
Asks whether a ten-year transition could leave plans nearly twenty years old and whether a shorter transition period was considered.
Is it not undesirable that this could lead to zoning plans that are nearly twenty years old?
Is het niet ongewenst dat dat kan leiden tot bestemmingsplannen die bijna twintig jaar oud zijn?
Asks how the government will ensure that freed-up funds are actually spent on municipal preparation for the Omgevingswet and what follows if they are not.
These members ask how the government will ensure that the funds released by abolishing the update obligation are actually used for preparing and drafting a municipal environmental plan.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen hoe de regering ervoor gaat zorgen dat de middelen die vrijkomen door het vervallen van de actualisatieplicht daadwerkelijk worden ingezet voor de voorbereiding en het opstellen van een gemeentelijk omgevingsplan.

Views the change with surprise and urges care; wants residents involved and their rights safeguarded, and asks whether municipalities could use the bill to leave unwelcome update requests unresolved, with what remedies.
In their view it must be absolutely clear that the rights and possessions of the residents of the Netherlands are safeguarded in an understandable way up to the last moment.

Daarbij moet naar de mening van de leden van de SP-fractie absoluut duidelijk zijn dat de rechten en bezittingen van de inwoners van Nederland op begrijpelijke wijze tot op het laatste moment geborgd zijn.
Supports the abolition so municipalities can focus on new plans, but asks whether the ten-year transition period can be shortened to reduce uncertainty for initiators.
These members ask to what extent it is possible to shorten the ten-year period for adopting one or more environmental plans.
Deze leden vragen in hoeverre het mogelijk is om de termijn van tien jaar voor het vaststellen van een of meerdere omgevingsplannen te beperken.

34675.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to add a new article 9.2.2.1a allowing general administrative orders (AMvB) to require removal of asbestos and asbestos-containing products, asbestos pollution, and asbestos waste, including a ban on possessing asbestos roofs. It also adds asbestos definitions and makes several technical amendments.
34675.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by citing a Council of State advisory opinion that the existing article 9.2.2.1 lacked adequate statutory basis for an asbestos roof ban, and the need to regulate active removal where health risks arise.
q: The bill contains an explicit basis for imposing by AMvB an obligation to remove asbestos or asbestos products from buildings.
Het wetsvoorstel bevat een expliciete grondslag om bij amvb een verplichting op te leggen om asbest of asbestproducten uit bouwwerken te verwijderen.
d: rules on possession, use, handling and disposal of substances and mixtures with health or environmental risks
obligation to end use and remove asbestos or asbestos products, remove asbestos waste, take measures and remediate pollution
requirements for remediation measures and exemption from parts of soil protection chapter IV for such pollution
designation of bodies performing conformity assessments for ecodesign rules
designation of other categories of hazardous waste that may not be mixed
p: Allows an AMvB to impose duties on owners to actively remove asbestos roofs, pollution and waste at their own cost, even where they are not at fault, with some limits on soil protection law applying.
Clarifies that possession of substances can itself be regulated, removing ambiguity about whether a passive state can be targeted by rules.

parties: Asks whether a 2024 deadline is practically feasible and whether the state may require owners to replace roofs that are not in a dangerous state, raising due-process and property concerns.
Questions whether imposing removal costs on owners is reasonable, given past cabinets did not judge the situation dangerous, and doubts enforcement is workable given shortage of qualified removers.
Moreover, at the round-table meeting of 4 October 2017 it became clear that there are insufficient qualified asbestos removers in the Netherlands to meet the 1 January 2024 deadline.

Bovendien is bij het rondetafelgesprek van 4 oktober 2017 over de sanering van asbestdaken duidelijk geworden dat er onvoldoende gekwalificeerde asbestverwijderaars beschikbaar zijn in Nederland om de beoogde deadline van 1 januari 2024 te halen.
Asks about adequacy of the subsidy budget, enforcement and inspection uniformity, and whether the owner should bear costs of dumping by others.
These members ask regarding the subsidy scheme whether the remediation task is currently progressing sufficiently and whether the subsidy budget will be sufficient in the coming years.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen ten aanzien van de subsidieregeling of op dit moment de saneringsopgave voldoende vordert en of het subsidiebudget wel voldoende is in de komende jaren.

Positive about the ban but asks how municipalities as competent authority will enforce it given capacity, and asks who weighs the consequences of mandatory removal and how undue burdens on individuals are prevented.
These members ask the government who bears responsibility for this and who will weigh this judgment.
Deze leden vragen de regering wie hiervoor verantwoordelijkheid draagt en wie dit oordeel zal afwegen.
Supports phasing out asbestos quickly but asks about compensation for owners, monitoring of self-removal below 35 m2, and illegal dumping enforcement.
However, these members are of the view that the government should take into account costs that may fall on citizens or businesses as a result of a ban.
Deze leden zijn echter wel van mening dat de regering rekening dient te houden met kosten die als gevolg van een verbod bij burgers of bij bedrijven kunnen neerkomen.
Wants stronger state capacity for inspection and enforcement and central procurement of removal capacity to prevent dumping and substandard work.

To prevent this, these members say there must be strong investment in expanding capacity of safety and inspection services and in expanding subsidy schemes and practical support for residents and businesses.

Om dit op te voorkomen zal volgens deze leden sterk moeten worden ingezet op enerzijds verruiming van de capaciteit voor de veiligheids- en inspectiediensten en anderzijds op verruiming van subsidieregelingen en praktische ondersteuning aan bewoners en bedrijven.
Supports phase-out but raises concerns about burdens on the agricultural sector, costs, and whether current protocols are unnecessarily restrictive and should be independently tested.
Is the government willing to review again and have independently tested working methods, measurements and protocols that could be safer, faster and cheaper, for example by TNO?

Is de regering bereid om dit nog eens tegen het licht te houden en werkwijzen, metingen en berekeningen van protocollen die veiliger, sneller en goedkoper zouden kunnen zijn onafhankelijk te laten testen (door bijvoorbeeld TNO)?
Critical of the proportionality assessment of the ban and its costs, notes the risk of improper removal and dumping, and urges a more risk-differentiated approach informed by health experts.

The SGP members raise critical comments on the government's considerations leading to the conclusion that the consequences of the asbestos roof ban for owners are generally not disproportionate to the aims served by the ban.

De leden van de SGP-fractie zetten kritische kanttekeningen bij de overwegingen van de regering die leiden tot de conclusie dat de gevolgen van de invoering van het asbestdakenverbod voor eigenaren van gebouwen met een asbestdak in algemene zin niet onevenredig zijn in verhouding tot de doelen die met dat verbod worden gediend.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises proceeding with the bill amending the Wet milieubeheer to allow asbestos roof and asbestos-waste removal obligations by AMvB, but asks for clarification of the general compensation regime and considers a specific compensation scheme for the asbestos roof ban. The government's nader rapport explains that the existing compensation rules suffice, that a specific scheme is not needed, and accepts the redactional remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how individual hardship from the AMvBs is prevented under the general compensation rules, and the government added a detailed explanation of the compensation principles and their application.
The Afdeling suggested a specific compensation scheme with a delegation basis for the asbestos roof ban to improve legal certainty, but the government concluded no such scheme is warranted.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on terminology (CAS-number, asbesthoudend product) and cross-references, which the government adopted.

34684.s: The bill inserts a new chapter into the Aviation Act that prohibits landing designated 'risk flights' (incoming from third countries and posing a high risk of drug smuggling) at airports not designated for them. The Minister of Justice and Security, in agreement with the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, may designate such flights and airports by ministerial decision, and the Economic Offences Act is amended to make violations punishable.
34684.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation as needed because a statutory list would be too rigid and must adapt to changing drug-smuggling risks and airport capacity.
q: A formal statutory regulation would be too rigid and would insufficiently account for possible changes in the flights falling under the 100% control regime.
Een formeel-wettelijke regeling zou te rigide zijn en te weinig rekening houden met mogelijke veranderingen met betrekking tot de vluchten die onder het 100%-controleregime vallen.
d: amendments to EU air traffic rules applying under Dutch aviation law
designating third-country flights as risk flights
designating airports for landing of risk flights
p: The ministers are given discretion to designate flights and airports, with the memorandum noting the designation is a generally binding rule shielded from administrative objection and appeal, limiting judicial remedy for affected airlines and airports.

parties: Asks how the 100% control regime affects deterrence and detection, whether smuggling shifts to other routes, how military flights are checked, and how passengers are informed about the controls.
The members speaking request attention to the negative experiences people may have due to the controls.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen aandacht voor de negatieve ervaringen die mensen kunnen ondervinden door de controles.
Shares the premise that the current situation is undesirable and has no questions at this stage.
These members currently have no questions about the proposal.
Deze leden hebben vooralsnog geen vragen over het voorstel.

Supports the aim but questions whether the military-flight exclusion should be set in the statute rather than in a regulation, and whether the risk designation should attach to countries rather than individual flights.
Should the risk not instead be linked to the specific country, so that once a country is determined to be a risk country, all ordinary commercial flights automatically constitute a risk?
Moet het risico niet juist gekoppeld worden aan het specifieke land, zodat bij vaststelling dat een bepaald land een risicoland is, automatisch alle gewone verkeersvluchten een risico vormen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised proceeding with the bill banning high-risk drug-smuggling flights from landing at airports other than Schiphol, but raised the need to consult the Bonaire island authorities under WolBES. The government's nader rapport reports that the Bonaire executive college was subsequently consulted, raised questions on controls and risk designation, and that these did not lead to amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum be supplemented on whether the Bonaire island authorities (bestuurscollege) were consulted under articles 207-208 WolBES, and if not, that consultation take place.

34693.s: The bill makes the 'begeleid rijden' (accompanied driving) experiment permanent, allowing 17-year-olds to obtain a category B licence under supervision, with a registered supervisor's pass and conditions on supervisors set by general administrative order. It adds offences for supervisors who drive or supervise under the influence or without a valid pass, and aligns the beginner period and related provisions with the 2014 and 2016 amendments.
34693.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated conditions by the need to make supervisor checks workable and by the experiment's evaluation showing benefits for road safety.
q: When preparing the experiment, the system of a supervisor's pass was chosen.
Bij de voorbereiding van het experiment is gekozen voor de systematiek van een begeleiderspas.
d: additional conditions for B licence at age 17, pass application, supervisor requirements
design and format requirements for the supervisor's pass
rules on licence and driving conduct a supervisor must meet while supervising
p: The Dienst Wegverkeer may declare a supervisor's pass invalid if it was issued on incorrect data or erroneously, with validity ending seven days after notification.

parties: Asks what weight can be given to a non-significant 26% risk reduction and whether broader data from insurers, police and prosecutors were considered before definitive introduction.
The VVD members want to know what value can be attached to this finding, since according to the SWOV and the explanatory memorandum this outcome is not statistically significant.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen weten welke waarde aan deze uitspraak kan worden gehecht, aangezien deze uitkomst volgens de SWOV en de MvT niet statistisch significant is.
Calls the evaluation weak because it relies on a voluntary questionnaire and asks for accident-registration-based analysis and data on accident perpetrators.
Furthermore, the PVV members find the evaluation of the experiment rather deficient.
Verder vinden de leden van de PVV-fractie de gedane evaluatie van het experiment nogal gebrekkig.
Asks whether an earlier evaluation point, after about two years, can be written into the law and whether SWOV can study registered accidents.
Is the government willing to include an earlier evaluation moment in the law, after for example two years?
Is de regering bereid al eerder een evaluatiemoment in de wet op te nemen, na bijvoorbeeld twee jaar?
Asks the government to justify why the non-significant results still support the policy and asks how accompanying-driver requirements are checked, including for foreign licences.
These members ask the government to argue why this percentage is not statistically relevant.
Deze leden vragen de regering te beargumenteren waarom dit percentage statistisch niet relevant is.
Questions why definitive introduction is justified on an inconclusive study and why the follow-up research SWOV itself calls for is not awaited.
Why is it concluded on the basis of a statistically non-significant study that definitive introduction is justified?
Waarom wordt op basis van een statistisch niet significant onderzoek geconcludeerd dat definitieve invoering gerechtvaardigd is?
Asks about the unduly high share of participants who drove unaccompanied, about unclear legal consequences if an accompanying driver has been drinking, and about further road-safety measures.
The CDA members believe there is uncertainty about situations in which the accompanying driver has been drinking.
De leden van de CDA-fractie menen dat onduidelijkheid bestaat over situaties waarin de begeleider gedronken heeft.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill making supervised driving (begeleid rijden) for 17-18 year olds permanent, asking the government to clarify liability when a supervisor's licence has lapsed and to align the beginner period for those who obtain other licences first. The government accepted the first point with clarified explanatory notes and declined the second, arguing the difference in beginner period is justified.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not address whether a young driver is punishable when the supervisor's authority has been withdrawn; the government kept the offence limited to the supervisor and clarified the notes.

The differing beginner period for young people who first obtain another licence before the B licence is illogical and should be adjusted; the government rejected this and clarified the explanatory memorandum instead.
The licence-holder supervisor pass wording in article 111a was clarified, and related errors in a previous 2016 law were corrected.

34729.s: The bill amends the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet) and the implementing act for the EU Insolvency Regulation to bring them in line with Regulation (EU) 2015/848, adding a group coordination procedure with a right of appeal, updated cross-references, and a standard claim form. It is mainly a technical implementation of EU cross-border insolvency rules.
34729.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary implementation of the directly applicable EU regulation, without new delegated powers.
q: Whereas, to implement Regulation (EU) 2015/848 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20 May 2015 on insolvency proceedings, certain amendments to the Bankruptcy Act are necessary

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat ter uitvoering van Verordening (EU) 2015/848 van het Europees Parlement en de Raad van 20 mei 2015 betreffende insolventieprocedures (PbEU 2015, L 141) enige wijzigingen in de Faillissementswet nodig zijn;

parties: The SP asks whether a court may refuse or postpone secondary insolvency proceedings only if local creditors are sufficiently protected in the main proceedings, which it calls a very important condition.
Is it correct that the judge may only do this if the protection of local creditors is nevertheless sufficiently taken into account in the main insolvency proceedings?
Klopt het dat de rechter dit alleen mag doen als alsnog in de hoofdinsolventieprocedure voldoende rekening gehouden wordt met de bescherming van plaatselijke schuldeisers?

34730-III.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services by adjusting appropriations through a first supplementary budget. It also sets the entry-into-force rule for these budget changes, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2017 where the Staatsblad appears on or after that date.
34730-III.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes as technical budget adjustments (carry-over, wage and price indexation, pension premium compensation) rather than new powers.
q: The proposed bill aims to make changes for the year 2017 to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the budget statement of the Cabinet of the King (IIIB), and the budget statement of the Commission for Oversight of Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2017 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA), de begrotingsstaat van het Kabinet van de Koning (IIIB) en de begrotingsstaat van de Commissie van Toezicht betreffende de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (IIIC).

34765.s: The bill replaces the unilateral buy-out of small pension entitlements by automatic value transfer to a new pension provider, and lets pension providers transfer or forfeit very small entitlements under conditions set by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial publication. It also removes the individual objection right when entitlements are actuarially recalculated to a higher pension age and extends the pension register's role in matching providers.
34765.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated AMvB rules as needed to phase and control automatic transfer of existing small entitlements so as to avoid unintended financial consequences for providers.
q: That general administrative order must ensure that the transfer of those existing small pensions takes place in a phased and controlled manner, also avoiding unintended financial consequences for pension providers.

Met die algemene maatregel van bestuur moet worden gerealiseerd dat de overdracht van die bestaande kleine pensioenen gefaseerd en gecontroleerd plaatsvindt waarmee ook ongewilde financiële consequenties voor pensioenuitvoerders worden voorkomen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 66, lid 10 Pensioenwet)
nadere regels on calculating buy-out value
Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 70a, lid 6 Pensioenwet)
further rules on transfer of small pension rights and calculation of transfer value
Artikel I, onderdeel R (artikel 220b, lid 4 onder a Pensioenwet)
conditions for transfer of existing small entitlements
Artikel II, onderdeel G (artikel 78, lid 10 Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling)
nadere regels on setting buy-out value
Artikel II, onderdeel J (artikel 81a, lid 6 Wvb)
further rules on transfer value under occupational pension scheme
Artikel II, onderdeel S (artikel 214a, lid 4 onder a Wvb)
conditions for transfer of existing small entitlements
Artikel I, onderdeel K (artikel 83, lid 3 Pensioenwet)
rules on collective conversion to higher pension age (described in explanatory memorandum)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel E (artikel 55, lid 6 Pensioenwet)
Pension providers may let very small entitlements (under 2 euro per year) lapse on leaving, with a carve-out for members moving to another member state who have been informed.
Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 66 Pensioenwet) and Artikel I, onderdeel I (artikel 70a)
Pension providers gain the unilateral right to buy out or automatically transfer small pensions, removing the member's individual objection right for new cases and extending the transfer power.(a)
Artikel I, onderdeel K (artikel 83 Pensioenwet) and Artikel II, onderdeel L (artikel 91 Wvb)
The individual objection right in collective transfers is removed where pension rights are converted to a higher statutory pension age, subject to conditions.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (artikel 51) and Artikel II, onderdeel D (artikel 62)
The pension register is given a new role as a central matching tool so providers can query which provider a former member now accrues pension with.

parties: Asks whether afkoop should remain as fallback where transfers fail, citing Raad van State concerns that the participant's position is insufficiently considered.
The VVD members share the view of the Council of State, the Pension Federation and the Association of Insurers that it is already foreseeable that transfer will not always be possible.

De leden van de VVD-fractie delen de mening van de Raad van State, de Pensioenfederatie en het Verbond van Verzekeraars dat nu al te voorzien is dat waardeoverdracht niet in alle gevallen mogelijk zal zijn.
Asks how participant freedom of choice is safeguarded under the proposal and whether scenarios keeping afkoop possible were considered.
The PVV members ask the government to explain in more detail how the pension participant's freedom of choice is safeguarded in the proposed bill.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen de regering uitgebreider toe te lichten hoe de keuzevrijheid van de pensioendeelnemer is geborgd bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Supports the reform but questions the optional nature of transfers, lack of solvency consideration, retroactive effect, and the lapse of very small pensions without participant information.
The bill is mainly written from the interest of the pension provider and not so much from the interest of the participant.
Het wetsvoorstel is vooral geschreven vanuit het belang van de pensioenuitvoerder en niet zozeer vanuit het belang van de deelnemer.
Asks whether participants can opt out of automatic transfer, whether afkoop should remain as fallback, and about the rights implications of lapsing very small pensions.
The D66 members request further explanation of the difference in treatment between existing very small pension entitlements and those arising after the bill takes effect.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen een nadere toelichting op het verschil in behandeling tussen bestaande heel kleine pensioenaanspraken en na inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel te ontstane hele kleine pensioenaanspraken.
Questions the consequences for workers in flexible employment, the financial effects on funds, and whether participants can still act to prevent lapse of very small pensions.
The SP members ask whether a participant can still take action if the participant does not want the very small pensions to lapse.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen of een deelnemer nog acties kan ondernemen als de deelnemer niet wilt dat de hele kleine afspraken vervallen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the Wet waardeoverdracht klein pensioen, raising major concerns about the abolition of buy-out options with no fallback for failed transfers, the weakened position of the participant in transfers, the absence of a waiting period and possible tax consequences when very small pensions lapse. The government's reply largely declined to add a buy-out fallback, deferring it to a three-year evaluation, and rejected a participant consent role, while adding explanation on tax and partly accepting the waiting-period point.
concerns: Absence of a buy-out fallback where transfers fail (e.g. self-employment or no-pension employers) leaves outcomes unprovided for; the Afdeling asked for a provision now rather than deferring it.
The participant has insufficient say in transfer decisions; the government rejected restoring participant involvement, citing efficiency and the collective interest.
Lack of a waiting period before transfer or lapse of small pensions, which the Afdeling said should be considered to protect returning workers; the government addressed it only partly.
Tax consequences (revisierente) when very small pensions lapse were missing from the explanatory memorandum; the explanation was added after the advice.

Transfer should not be conditional on the funding deficit of the transferring fund only when the funder chooses, a discrepancy the Afdeling questioned; the government justified the asymmetry as a balancing of interests.

34792.s: The bill keeps the mandatory deductible (verplicht eigen risico) in health insurance unchanged for 2018 by suspending the indexation and increase provisions in paragraphs two and three of article 19 of the Zorgverzekeringswet. It takes effect on 1 January 2018 and uses the expedited entry-into-force route of the Wet raadgevend referendum to avoid delay.
34792.j: The memorandum justifies the accelerated entry into force by saying that a higher mandatory deductible for insured persons must be prevented and that the entry into force cannot be postponed.
q: This option is used because it prevents the undesirable disadvantage of a higher mandatory deductible for insured persons.
Van deze mogelijkheid wordt gebruik gemaakt omdat hiermee het ongewenste nadeel van een hoger verplicht eigen risico voor verzekerden wordt voorkomen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill not indexing the mandatory deductible (verplicht eigen risico) for 2018 may proceed, but that the explanatory memorandum should address the new cabinet's challenges on controlling collective healthcare spending and disposable household income. The minister's reply accepts the explanatory-memorandum additions on structural effects and leaves the broader spending choices to a future cabinet.
concerns: The Afdeling stressed that not indexing the deductible raises collective healthcare spending and pressures disposable incomes, and asked for this to be addressed; the reply agrees on the structural effects but leaves the spending-control choice to a future cabinet.
The Afdeling asked for explanation in the explanatory memorandum of the structural effects and burden on premium payers, which the government added.

34819.s: The bill gradually phases out the tax deduction for homeowners with no or little mortgage debt, reducing the deductible share from 2019 and letting a ministerial regulation lower the percentage by 3 1/3 percentage points each year from 2020. The deduction is abolished from 1 January 2048 and the entry into force is set for 2018 by invoking the advisory referendum act's article 12.
34819.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial power by the need to implement the phase-out in steps and the timing of the tax authority's system changes.
q: At the start of each calendar year the percentage referred to in article 3.123a, second paragraph, is replaced by a different percentage through a ministerial regulation.
Artikel 10.6bis Bij het begin van het kalenderjaar wordt het in artikel 3.123a, tweede lid, vermelde percentage bij ministeriële regeling vervangen door een ander percentage.
d: annual reduction of phase-out percentage for mortgage-free deduction
p: The yearly percentage of the deduction is set by ministerial regulation rather than by statute, though the reduction formula is fixed in the law.
Invoking article 12 of the advisory referendum act to set an early entry into force bypasses the normal timing of parliamentary procedure.

parties: Asks about timing of related tax bills, distributional effects, WOZ value distribution and simplification of the eigenwoning regime.
What does the government mean by its remark that it can agree with further simplification of the owner-occupied home scheme?
Wat bedoelt de regering met de opmerking dat het zich kan vinden in een verdere vereenvoudiging van de eigenwoningregeling?
Asks about behavioural effects on mortgage repayment and budgetary consequences of a one-year delay.
The PVV members ask what behavioural effects this measure will produce.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen welke gedragseffecten deze maatregel teweeg brengt.
Calls the phase-out painful for people who already repaid, asks for transparency on forecasts and the referendum exclusion, and questions the sufficiency of repayment incentives.
The CDA members regard the phase-out of the Hillen deduction as a painful measure for taxpayers who have already repaid their mortgages.
De leden van de CDA-fractie achten de uitfasering van de Hillen-aftrek een pijnlijke maatregel voor belastingplichtigen die nu reeds hebben afgelost.
Requests detailed revenue and household data by home value cohort.
The D66 members would like insight into the total additional tax revenue from this measure in 2021.
De leden van de D66-fractie zouden graag inzicht krijgen in de totale extra belastinginkomsten als gevolg van deze maatregel in 2021.
Notes the Raad van State considers the owner-occupied regime very complex and requires expert help in common situations, and asks about international practice and distributional effects.
The SP members note that the Council of State describes the owner-occupied home scheme as very complex.
De leden van de SP-fractie merken op dat de Raad van State de eigenwoningregeling als zeer complex bestempelt.
Asks for effects tables through 2048 and for information on older low-income people who will newly pay tax.
The PvdA members therefore ask the government to also prepare this table for the years up to and including 2048.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering dan ook deze tabel ook op te stellen voor de jaren tot en met 2048.
Asks how robust the revenue estimate is and for comparisons of owners and renters with similar characteristics.
These members ask how robust this estimate is.
Deze leden vragen hoe robuust deze raming is.

Argues people who repaid in good faith could not foresee abolition and cannot reverse repayments; asks whether a transitional exception or compensation should apply and challenges the justification for treating older people differently.
These members note that people who in good faith repaid their mortgage early, intending to use the Hillen scheme, could not have foreseen that the scheme would be abolished.

De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie constateren dat mensen die in goed vertrouwen hun hypotheek versneld hebben afgelost, met de bedoeling van de regeling Hillen gebruik te kunnen maken, niet konden vermoeden dat deze regeling zou worden afgeschaft.
Criticises government reliability and the claim of financial unsustainability, which the SGP considers unfounded because the scheme was already in the baseline.
It is strange first to encourage repaying the mortgage debt and then to levy tax on it.
Het is vreemd om eerst te stimuleren de hypotheekschuld af te lossen om daarna belasting te heffen.
