Questions the urgency of the bill, its complexity versus the government's stated simplification goals, and the link to a lower eigenwoningforfait and the 2017 announcements.
The DENK members ask why the bill, which should take effect in 2019, must absolutely be dealt with now.
De leden van de DENK-fractie vragen waarom het wetsvoorstel, welke in werking zou moeten treden in 2019, persé nu al behandeld moet worden?
Asks for clarification of household purchasing-power effects and how disproportionate impacts on homeowners are avoided.
How is it prevented that this law has disproportionate effects on the incomes of homeowners?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat deze wet disproportionele effecten heeft op de inkomens van huizenbezitters?
Requests breakdowns of the number of households negatively affected by household type and income and wealth levels.
Can the government break this down by all household types and specify especially for elderly people at different income and wealth levels?
Kan de regering dit uitsplitsen naar alle typen huishoudens (alleenverdiener, paar met kinderen, etc.) en in het bijzonder specificeren voor ouderen met verschillende inkomens- en vermogensniveaus?
Seeks insight into the distribution of the tax benefit by income decile and by household group.
The D66 members would like insight into the distribution by income of the tax benefit enjoyed from not having to pay the eigenwoningforfait.
De leden van de D66-fractie willen graag inzicht in de verdeling van het belastingvoordeel dat wordt genoten als gevolg van het niet hoeven betalen van het eigenwoningforfait naar inkomen.
Asks whether coalition parties had the abolition in their election programmes.
The GroenLinks members ask to what extent the coalition parties had the abolition of the Hillen scheme in their election programmes.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen in hoeverre de coalitiepartijen de afschaffing van de regeling Hillen in hun verkiezingsprogramma hadden staan.
Criticises the speed of treatment as a political quick fix and questions government reliability and the policy vision behind the measure.
The SP members ask the government what vision on the housing market lies behind this measure.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering welke visie op de woningmarkt schuilgaat achter deze maatregel.
Worries about pensioners with little other means and asks for detailed income effects and responses to position papers.
They are mainly concerned about the group of people who have built up pension in their own home and otherwise have few further means.
Zij maken zich vooral zorgen over de groep mensen die pensioen heeft opgebouwd in het eigen huis, en daarnaast weinig verdere middelen heeft.
Asks about technical options to protect existing cases and lower-valued homes from the phase-out.
The aforementioned members would like to be informed about the technical possibilities to limit the phase-out so that existing cases are no longer affected.
De voorgenoemde leden willen graag geïnformeerd worden over de technische mogelijkheden de uitfasering van de regeling Hillen zodanig te beperken dat «bestaande gevallen» niet meer worden geraakt.
Questions the distributional effects, the referendum exclusion for tax legislation, and the claimed 15.5-month implementation need.
Is it correct that article 5 of the Advisory Referendum Act does not list tax legislation as one of the subjects that cannot be put to a referendum?
Klopt het, dat in artikel 5 van de Wet raadgevend referendum, belastingwetgeving niet genoemd wordt als één van de onderwerpen, die niet in een referendum aan de bevolking voorgelegd kunnen worden?
Requests case-based income effects, an evaluation clause after four years, and assurance the Tax Administration can check the rules.
Furthermore, the CDA members request the government to add an evaluation provision to the bill, so that four years after entry into force the phase-out of the Hillen deduction is evaluated.

Verder verzoeken de leden van de CDA-fractie de regering een evaluatiebepaling aan het voorliggende wetsvoorstel toe te voegen, zodat vier jaar na inwerkingtreding de uitfasering van de Hillen-aftrek geëvalueerd wordt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill phasing out the Hillen-regeling (deduction for owner-occupiers with little or no mortgage debt) over 30 years may proceed, but the explanatory memorandum should address the broader future position of the owner-occupied home in the tax system and the income effects on different taxpayer groups. The government's reply (nader rapport) states it has added income-effect information to the explanatory memorandum, limited to disposable income, and acknowledges the need for prudence and simplification without adopting a fundamental system change.
concerns: The Afdeling questions the effectiveness of the Hillen-regeling and the need for a broader strategic end goal for the tax treatment of the owner-occupied home, which the government addresses only partly by pointing to the coalition agreement.

The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address the income effects of the phase-out on distinct categories of taxpayers, mainly older homeowners, which the government addresses by adding information limited to disposable income.

The Afdeling notes the cumulative and complex succession of changes to the owner-occupied home regime and the resulting loss of predictability, to which the government responds with acknowledgement of prudence but no specific simplification proposal.

34828.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Bedum, De Marne, Eemsmond and Winsum into a new municipality called Het Hogeland and adjusts the boundary of Zuidhorn. It also designates Het Hogeland as successor for transitional matters under the general municipal reorganisation act and updates several related statutes and lists.
34828.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the larger scale needed for substantive tasks and the wish to bring policy under direct democratic control, not by any new executive power.
q: The new scale also makes more integrated work possible, and the municipal enlargement meets the four municipalities' wish to reduce the number of partnerships and bring policy and implementation under direct democratic control.

Ook biedt de nieuwe schaalgrootte de mogelijkheid om meer integraal te werken en komt de gemeentelijke opschaling tegemoet aan de wens van de vier gemeenten om het aantal samenwerkingsverbanden te verminderen en beleid en uitvoering onder directe democratische controle te brengen.

parties: The VVD finds the bill unproblematic and has no comments or questions.
The bill gives the VVD members no reason to make comments or ask questions.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie geen aanleiding tot het maken van opmerkingen en het stellen van vragen.
The CDA asks the government to send the merger advice and the province's view to the House, arguing that publication on a website is not the same as submission to parliament.
These members are of the view that publication on a website cannot be equated with submission to the House of Representatives.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat publicatie op een website niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met indiening bij de Tweede Kamer.
D66 notes the merger came from the bottom up and was unanimously adopted, and has no further questions at this stage.
These members read that this reorganisation came from the bottom up and was unanimously adopted in all four municipal councils.
Deze leden lezen dat deze herindeling van onderop heeft plaatsgevonden en in alle vier de gemeentegraden unaniem is vastgesteld.
GroenLinks asks how residents, civil society and local politics were involved in preparing the merger and how access to facilities is guaranteed.
These members ask the government to explain again how residents, civil society organisations and local politics in the municipalities were involved in preparing the merger proposal.

Deze leden vragen de regering om nog eens nader uiteen te zetten hoe de inwoners, maatschappelijke organisaties en de lokale politiek van de betreffende gemeenten betrokken zijn geweest bij de totstandkoming van het voorstel tot gemeentelijke herindeling.
The SP questions whether there is majority popular support for the merger, why no citizen consultation was held, and whether the financial projections of efficiency gains are realistic.
According to these members, reorganisations should only take place from the bottom up, if the population supports them.
Herindelingen zouden volgens deze leden alleen plaats moeten vinden van onderaf, als hiervoor steun is van de bevolking.
The ChristenUnie endorses the merger and has no further questions at this stage.
These members endorse the planned merger of these municipalities.
Deze leden onderschrijven de voorgenomen samenvoeging van deze gemeenten.

34845-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement for the other High Colleges of State and the Governors' cabinets (IIB) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting spending and commitments for the Raad van State, Algemene Rekenkamer, Nationale ombudsman, Kanselarij Nederlandse Orden and the Governors' offices. The explanatory memorandum details the budgetary effects of these adjustments, such as higher asylum-appeal case costs and delayed IT work at the Raad van State.
34845-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to updated case forecasts and delayed IT work, without invoking new powers.
q: This forecast leads to an increase in the expenditure estimate of EUR 2.1 million.
Deze prognose leidt tot een verhoging van de uitgavenraming van € 2,1 mln.

34864.s: The bill supplements the Omgevingswet with soil protection rules, adding a new emergency/toevalsvondst regime for contamination posing unacceptable health risks, tolerance duties for owners, and cost recovery, while repealing the Wet bodembescherming. It also adds an emergency soil regulation power allowing ministerial rules to deviate from the normal AMvB procedure for up to twelve months.
34864.j: The memorandum justifies the emergency soil regulation power by saying that following the normal statutory procedure for an AMvB would take too much time where a provision is immediately needed.
d: emergency rules on environmentally burdening activities deviating from art. 4.3
delegating subsidy implementation and decisions to provincial or municipal bodies
rules on fertiliser application and soil protection as health/environment purpose
municipal board orders owners to take temporary protective measures and may act itself
p: Allows a minister to set binding soil rules by ministerial regulation, departing from the statute, without the normal AMvB procedure, for up to twelve months extendable once by six months.
Municipal board may order owners to take urgent protective measures, act itself if they do not comply, and recover costs, based on a broad reasonableness standard for health risks.
Introduces tolerance duties for property holders at the discretion of the municipal board, with appeal open against the tolerance decision.

parties: Asks how much policy autonomy municipalities get, who weighs interventions requiring access to land, and how the shift toward general rules and fewer soil investigations fits with health risks.
What policy freedom do the municipalities have in this matter?
Welke beleidsvrijheid hebben de gemeenten in dezen?

Worries that broader discretion for decentral authorities could make rules softer than under the old system and asks whether municipalities have the technical knowledge to weigh decisions independently.
Those administrative bodies can indeed set rules that are more lenient than the rules under the old system, they believe.
Die bestuursorganen kunnen immers regels stellen die soepeler zijn dan de regels onder het oude systeem, zo menen zij.
Asks whether municipalities have enough capacity and expertise for the broader powers, whether there is a testing framework for standards and permits, and how legal protection is ensured.
why no testing framework has been included on the basis of which material standards are set or permit applications are assessed, also in view of enforcement and legal protection?

Bovengenoemde leden vragen tevens waarom er geen toetsingskader is opgenomen op basis waarvan materiele normen worden gesteld of vergun-ningsaanvragen worden getoetst, ook gelet op handhaving en rechtsbescher-ming?

Fears the flexible weighing framework will give much less protection to people and the environment, citing the Council of State's concern about large discretion for authorities with limited knowledge and enforcement resources, and wants firm standards and the polluter-pays principle kept.
We recognise ourselves in the critical notes of the Council of State about the large degree of policy freedom for authorities that often have little knowledge and experience in this file
Wij herkennen ons in de kritische noten van de Raad van State over de grote mate van beleidsvrijheid voor overheden die vaak weinig kennis en weinig ervaring hebben op dit dossier

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the Aanvullingswet bodem Omgevingswet to proceed after adjustments, notably extending the toevalsvondst instrument to environmental and dispersion risks and allowing the polluter to be pursued. The government's nader rapport largely accepted the points on the toevalsvondst instrument and clarified the text, while defending its position on the zorgplicht and the polluter's liability.
concerns: The Afdeling advised extending the toevalsvondst instrument to environmental and dispersion risks, which the government addressed by reframing the instrument and pointing to other tools, without full extension.

The Afdeling advised allowing the polluter to be addressed under the toevalsvondst instrument; the government declined to include the polluter but pointed to alternative instruments and cost recovery options.
The Afdeling asked for a definition of toevalsvondst and a more readable, self-contained regime, which the government adopted.
The Afdeling asked for safeguards against disproportionate burdens on owners of contaminated land, which the government addressed through reasonableness and proportionality limits.

The Afdeling flagged the need for a detailed motivation and comparison tables in the implementing regulations to show equivalent protection levels, which the government answered only in general terms.

34882.s: The bill amends the Wet basisregistratie personen so that data on children who were stillborn or for whom a Dutch deed records that the child was not alive at registration can be added to the personal record of a parent who was registered as resident at the time of birth, upon request. It sets a four-week deadline for municipalities, requires documents and a sworn translation, and allows removal of the data on request.
34882.j: The memorandum justifies the change as a simple way to record data on children born lifeless, noting parents remain free to ask a court to convert the deed into a birth and death certificate.
q: Through this amendment, data on the child concerned can be recorded in the BRP on the parent's personal record, upon request, in a simple manner.
Door deze wetswijziging kunnen alsnog op eenvoudige wijze gegevens over het desbetreffende kind in de BRP worden opgenomen op de persoonslijst van de ouder die daarom verzoekt.
d: detailed data to be recorded in the BRP

parties: Asks the government to justify the option for parents to have a previously made registration removed and how this affects the BRP system.
Can the government further justify why this has been chosen?
Kan de regering nader motiveren waarom hiervoor is gekozen?
Welcomes the bill as based on parents' wishes and stresses care in procedures and wording for bereaved parents.
For these members the starting point of this amendment is the explicit wish of the parents of these deceased children.](Note: see JSON below)
Voor deze leden is het uitgangspunt voor deze wijziging de uitdrukkelijke wens van ouders van deze overleden kinderen.
Asks how civil registrars will assess requests, how they will be informed, and how hospitals and funeral services will be informed.
In addition, the members of the D66 faction would like to know how it is ensured that civil registry officials are provided with all information necessary for the proper implementation of this act.

Daarnaast vernemen de leden van de D66-fractie graag hoe er gewaarborgd wordt dat de ambtenaren van de burgerlijke stand voorzien zijn van alle informatie die noodzakelijk is voor een juiste uitvoering van deze wet.
Asks for a clear description of when a civil registrar may decline a request, and at which stages of pregnancy certificates are issued.
These members would like a clear description of the cases in which an official may decide not to act on such a request.
Deze leden zouden graag een duidelijke omschrijving zien van de gevallen waarin een ambtenaar kan besluiten geen gevolg te geven aan zo'n verzoek.
Asks about differences in rules for children born before and after 24 weeks of pregnancy and in the registration duty, and about possibly different names.
These members ask about the precise differences between children born before and after 24 weeks of pregnancy.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen naar de precieze verschillen tussen kinderen die voor én na 24 weken zwangerschap geboren worden.

34909.s: The bill inserts a new article 212rb into the Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet) that ranks qualifying senior non-preferred debt instruments of credit institutions and investment firms immediately after ordinary unsecured claims and ahead of subordinated claims, implementing EU Directive 2017/2399. It applies to bankrupt entities that were institutions under the BRRD at issuance, and enters into force on a date set by royal decree.
34909.j: The memorandum justifies the rank change as required by the TLAC standard and the directive, and the entry-into-force delegation is purely technical.
q: This act enters into force on a date to be determined by royal decree.
Deze wet treedt in werking op een bij koninklijk besluit te bepalen tijdstip.
d: date of entry into force by royal decree

parties: Asks how often bail-in has been used across member states, whether the new category materially changes bail-in outcomes, and whether eligible capital will increase.
They emphasise the importance of a correctly executed bail-in to protect the position of taxpayers and view the bill against that background.
Zij benadrukken het belang van een correct uitvoerde bail-in ter bescherming van de positie van belastingbetalers en bezien het wetsvoorstel tegen die achtergrond.

Asks why this harmonised approach was chosen over simpler alternatives, the tax treatment of interest, transparency of the new instrument, and how the risk weighting of sovereign bonds interacts with the bill.
In this regard these members ask on what basis the government considers the proposed approach in this bill to be the right one.
Hierbij vragen deze leden waar de regering op baseert dat de voorgestelde manier in onderhavig wetsvoorstel ook de juiste is.

Supports harmonisation and simplified bail-in but asks about MREL compliance of banks, the expected rise in bail-inable liabilities, the advantages of the French approach, and the reasons for urgent entry into force.
For these members the starting point is that the taxpayer must not become the victim of banking problems.
Voor deze leden staat voorop dat de belastingbetaler niet de dupe mag worden van bancaire problemen.

Asks how certain it is that failing banks will be recapitalised fully at the expense of shareholders and creditors, whether state aid could still occur, and whether there is genuinely no national policy room.
The GroenLinks members ask how much certainty the government has that banks in trouble will be fully recapitalised at the expense of shareholders and creditors.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen hoeveel zekerheid de regering heeft dat banken in problemen volledig ten koste van aandeelhouders en schuldeisers worden geherkapitaliseerd.

Questions whether the supervisor has full power to decide who takes a haircut, whether systemically important banks are too complex and too big to fail, and asks why deposits and separation of activities are not addressed.
These members ask the government whether the supervisor has full power and may decide who must take a haircut.
Deze leden vragen de regering of de toezichthouder de volledige macht heeft en mag beslissen wie een haircut moet nemen.

34918.s: The bill amends the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften and the Wet justitiële en strafvorderlijke gegevens so that prosecutors and the College van procureurs-generaal can pass vehicle-owner data to the Minister of Foreign Affairs, who notifies holders of diplomatic immunity whose traffic offences cannot be sanctioned. It thus allows a notification procedure for persons with immunity under international law who commit traffic violations.
34918.j: The memorandum justifies the data transfers by the Gerechtshof's 2014 ruling that no administrative sanction can be imposed on persons with diplomatic immunity, so notification via the ministry is the only remaining step.
q: the public prosecutor provides the data referred to in article 4, first paragraph, second sentence, to the Minister of Foreign Affairs for the purpose of sending a notification to this vehicle holder.

verstrekt de officier van justitie de gegevens, genoemd in artikel 4, eerste lid, tweede volzin aan Onze Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken ten behoeve van het versturen van een notificatie aan deze kentekenhouder.
d: transfer of vehicle-holder data to Minister of Foreign Affairs for notification
College van procureurs-generaal may provide criminal justice data to Minister of Foreign Affairs
p: Prosecutors may transfer identifying data on registered vehicle holders to the Minister of Foreign Affairs for notification in cases where sanctions cannot be imposed due to immunity.
The College van procureurs-generaal is authorised to supply criminal justice data to the Minister of Foreign Affairs for notifications.

parties: Asks whether a formal note verbale and further measures such as publishing names or lists of repeat offenders are feasible, pressing for stronger enforcement against diplomats' violations.
Is the government willing to strengthen the effect of the notification letter by making it a formal note verbale?
Is de regering bereid het effect van de notificatiebrief te verzwaren door hier een formeel «note verbale» van te maken?
Asks what happens if a diplomat ignores notification letters or is a repeat offender, and whether the Vienna Convention should be renegotiated.
Have diplomatic steps been taken to amend the problem areas of the Vienna Convention in international forums?
Zijn er diplomatieke stappen ondernomen teneinde in internationaal verband de knelpunten in het Verdrag van Wenen te wijzigen?
Stresses that everyone must obey the law, including diplomats, and asks whether notification letters will reach the right persons and whether lists of offending missions will be published.
From that perspective it is appropriate that everyone who behaves on the road or in public space in a manner contrary to the law be held to account, including those with diplomatic immunity.
Vanuit dat perspectief is het gepast dat een ieder die zich op de weg of in de publieke ruimte gedraagt op een wijze die strijdig is met de wet, daarop aangesproken wordt.
Welcomes the bill as the least far-reaching action consistent with the Vienna Convention and asks how the public prosecutor and the Foreign Ministry will coordinate on repeated non-response.
These members endorse the government's view that it is undesirable that persons who commit traffic offences cannot be held to account for them.
De leden van de D66-fractie onderschrijven het standpunt van de regering dat het onwenselijk is dat personen die verkeersovertredingen begaan daar niet op kunnen worden aangesproken.
Questions whether notification letters are enough, asks why the sending state's embassy is not addressed under Article 41, and whether the Vienna Convention limits can be explored further.
The said members want to know what happens when there is a repeat offender.
Voornoemde leden willen weten wat er gebeurt als sprake is van een recidivist.
Doubts that a notification alone will change behaviour, asks whether administrative or criminal sanctions are truly barred, and asks about wheel clamping, towing and persona non grata options.
From what does the government infer that a person who commits a traffic offence and does not want to pay the fine will change their behaviour merely because of a notification?

Waaruit leidt de regering af dat iemand die een verkeersovertreding begaat en de desbetreffende boete niet wil betalen, zijn gedrag voortaan zal gaan aanpassen naar aanleiding van enkel een notificatie?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill allowing the CJIB to pass traffic offence data on diplomats to the Foreign Minister for notification letters does not conflict with the Vienna Convention, but asked for the explanatory memorandum to address that and to justify the CJIB's assigned task. The government's reply states both points were addressed in the revised memorandum, and no separate amendment to the CJIB's establishing decree is needed.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether the notification letters comply with Article 31 of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations, which the government did by adding a section on this point.

The Afdeling asked for a basis in the CJIB establishing decree (instellingsbesluit) or a separate amendment for the CJIB to carry out the notification task for the Foreign Minister, which the government rejected as unnecessary.
The Afdeling noted the explanatory memorandum lacked clarity on the implementation arrangements, with protocols to follow, and the reply does not separately address this.

34936.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of Kingdom Relations by adding supplementary appropriations, mainly for reconstruction and emergency aid on the Windward Islands and for a World Bank trust fund tranche. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 17 April 2018, with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
34936.j: The memorandum justifies the supplementary appropriations by the need for reconstruction on Sint Maarten and strengthened border control, with subsequent payments depending on decisions of a steering group.
q: The following payments depend on decision-making in the steering group.
De volgende stortingen zijn afhankelijk van besluitvorming in de stuurgroep.

34960-V.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, adjusting spending and revenue figures across policy and non-policy articles in line with the spring memorandum. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2018 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34972.s: The bill sets general rules for digitalisation of public administration: it allows the government to make certain electronic standards mandatory, requires information security rules, and establishes a generic digital infrastructure for electronic public services, including public and private identification means, recognition of private providers, and access requirements. It delegates detailed rules to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial regulations, and gives the minister supervisory and intervention powers, including interrupting access to services.
34972.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegations by the need for flexibility and technical detail, since the bill is a framework law and standards and technical requirements change quickly.
q: the bill is a framework law setting out main matters, and for reasons of flexibility it is appropriate to give detailed (technical) elaboration in implementation

het wetsvoorstel het karakter heeft van een kaderwet waarin hoofdzaken zijn geregeld en het om redenen van flexibiliteit opportuun is gedetailleerde (technische) uitwerking in de uitvoering vorm te geven
d: designation of mandatory electronic standards and implementing rules
information security rules for access to electronic services
rules on generic digital infrastructure and connection obligation
required authentication assurance levels per service; temporary low-level access
exceptions to acceptance duty for specific target groups
extended use of public identification means
policy rules on checking technical specifications of admitted means
rules on use of public identification means
requirements and procedure for recognition of business identification services
rules on use of designated business attributes
minister may designate alternative business means for specific groups
rules on processing of personal data including BSN
experiments deviating from the Act for up to four years
connection schedule determining timing of acceptance duties
p: The minister may interrupt access to electronic services of public bodies or designated organisations, and of identification means, on suspicion of misuse or non-compliance, without a judicial or parliamentary step.
The minister may impose enforcement orders under administrative coercion and administrative fines on organisations and their managers for breaches of recognition rules.
Public bodies may depart from the acceptance rules for specific groups by ministerial regulation, narrowing the range of identification means citizens can use.
Experiments may deviate from the Act's provisions by general administrative order for up to four years, with a report to parliament.

parties: Asks why standards are non-imperative, whether the Chamber will be informed of general administrative orders, and how liability and costs of blocking eID means are arranged.
Will the House be informed if a general administrative order is adopted to set a standard?
Wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd als wordt overgegaan tot het vaststellen van een algemene maatregel van bestuur?
Asks about monitoring, supervision of subnational bodies, the role of the Agentschap Telecom, and whether a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure applies to the general administrative orders.
The CDA members ask whether a pre-consultation procedure applies to this and, if not, why not.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of hierop een voorhangprocedure van toepassing is en zo nee, waarom niet.
Positive about mandatory open standards and the Minister's duty of care, but asks about cost burdens on citizens, identity fraud victims, privacy design and audit publication.
The D66 members further ask how implementing bodies and service providers can determine the required reliability level for electronic identification, and whether there is supervision of this.
Verder vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden toe te lichten hoe uitvoeringsorganisaties en dienstverleners kunnen bepalen wat het vereiste betrouwbaarheidsniveau is bij elektronische identificatie?
Doubts whether the Netherlands is ready for digital voting, citing security risks and outdated software, and asks whether it is wiser to wait for better technology.
Would it not be wiser to wait for that technology before moving to digital voting?
Is het niet verstandiger om op die technologie te wachten alvorens over te gaan op digitaal stemmen?
Asks why accreditation rather than tender is not chosen for private login means, and who supervises private means used in the public domain.
What is your response to the claim that one private means makes the government means more expensive?
Wat is uw reactie op de stelling dat één privaatmiddel het overheidsmiddel duurder maakt?
Questions the Ministry of Interior taking on tendering, supervision, audits and DigiD provision together, and asks whether the bill contains sufficient checks and balances.
Does the present bill contain sufficient checks and balances on this point?
Bevat het voorliggende wetsvoorstel op dit punt voldoende checks and balances?
Asks how the government implements GDPR rights of access and rectification and how open-standards compliance is monitored, since supervision occurs within the same policy line.
Can the government explain whether this is a case of the butcher inspecting his own meat?
Kan de regering toelichten of hier sprake is van een slager die eigen vlees keurt?
Asks for clarification on the relation between the bill and BES-island regulation and the Frisian language act.
These members would welcome further clarification from the government on this matter.
Deze leden zouden graag een nadere toelichting van de regering hieromtrent ontvangen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the nota van wijziging to the Digital Government Act, raising points on the procedure for recognising and admitting private login means, including undefined grounds for refusal ('zwaarwegende redenen') and the lack of a transitional arrangement on suspension or withdrawal. The government's nader rapport accepted the advice on these points and amended the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The vague ground 'zwaarwegende redenen' for refusing, suspending or withdrawing private login means should be specified in the statute itself, including the Bibob criterion and the possibility of involving the Landelijk Bureau Bibob.
Users of a suspended or withdrawn private login means need a transitional period, so the minister should be able to oblige the holder to continue its activities temporarily for continuity of access.
The role of the certifying body's conformity declaration versus the minister's own decision requires clarification, and the ministry must have sufficient in-house ICT expertise to verify it.
Editorial remarks have largely been adopted and some legal-technical adjustments made to the bill.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised against sending the Wet digitale overheid to the Tweede Kamer until it was substantially revised, mainly on the minister's lack of binding powers over standards, weak oversight, the public-private login balance, and the BSN criteria. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepted some points (new powers, a general delegation basis, clearer machtiging rules) and rejected others, such as the statutory BSN criteria and the recognition of attributes.
concerns: The minister lacked binding powers to enforce technical standards and to annul conflicting standards; the government added binding instruction powers and standard-enforcement rules.
Oversight was weak, relying on regular interbestuurlijk toezicht and inspectors ill-suited to digital systems; the government kept the existing oversight structure and added an audit duty.
Access to government as a basic right should not depend on private parties; the government agreed public means are provided for citizens but rejected a general right in the statute for now.
The selection of private login means lacked a clear, open procedure; the government relied on tender criteria and a later ministerial regulation rather than changing the statute.
Statutory criteria should govern extension of BSN use to organisations outside government; the government said this falls outside the bill's scope.
Processing of personal data needs clearer limits under the GDPR and clearer informing of citizens; the memorie van toelichting was supplemented.
Authorisation (machtiging) should have reliability levels and protection for the authorised person; the bill and explanation were adjusted.
Several drafting points, including moving key GDI elements such as MijnOverheid and BSN-Koppelregister into the statute and clarifying definitions, were partly taken over.

35089.s: The bill amends several education and higher-education laws and the Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren so that staff at public schools and institutions are employed under private civil-law employment contracts instead of public-law appointments, and excludes certain public employers from that law. It also removes statutory personnel provisions and replaces them with employer-set personnel rules and consultation obligations.
35089.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the aim to harmonise employment conditions and fit rules to education practice, with the consultation duty reflecting agreements between social partners and the ministry.
q: The obligation to consult on the legal status of staff and to record the consultation method in writing follows from agreements between the social partners and the ministry.

De opdracht om overleg te voeren over de rechtspositie van het personeel en om de wijze van overleg tussen werkgevers en werknemers schriftelijk vast te leggen, vloeit voort uit de afspraken tussen de sociale partners en OCW.
d: personnel legal status regulation by competent authority
p: Art. II B, J; Art. III; Art. IV; Art. V; Art. VI
Removes statutory personnel provisions and shifts the regulation of staff legal status to employers, subject only to consultation with employee associations.

parties: Asks what the bill means in practice for public-education staff and why TO2 knowledge institutions such as TNO are not carved out like NWO.
Unlike for organisations such as NWO, this bill does not appear to make an exception for TO2 institutions such as TNO, so staff of these knowledge institutions would fall under civil-servant law.

Anders dan voor organisaties als NWO 1 , lijkt dit wetsvoorstel geen uitzondering te maken voor de TO2-instellingen 2 , zoals TNO, zodat medewerkers van deze kennisinstellingen wel onder het ambtenarenrecht gaan vallen.
Agrees that two employment regimes in education are undesirable and has no further questions.
These members endorse the government's view that it is undesirable to have two regimes for the legal position of education staff and have no further questions.

Deze leden onderschrijven de opvatting van de regering dat het niet wenselijk is in het onderwijs twee regimes voor de rechtspositie van het onderwijspersoneel te laten bestaan en hebben verder geen vragen.

Welcomes ending civil-servant status but questions whether retained consultation and deugdelijkheid provisions are consistently justified, and asks about the legal subject bearing duties and sanctions.
They ask the government whether this starting point has been applied consistently throughout the present bill.
Zij vragen de regering of dit uitgangspunt in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel steeds consequent is toegepast.
Values the retained legal-position and consultation provisions as constitutionally required deugdelijkheidseisen subject to sanctions, and asks whether the government shares this view.
The Constitution obliges the legislature to include deugdelijkheidseisen in the law.
De Grondwet verplicht de wetgever om deugdelijkheidseisen op te nemen in de wet.
Asks why no provision parallel to secondary vocational education is made for a new public university, and whether mandatory consultation is necessary where a cao is not generally binding.
They ask whether in that situation the position of the competent authority does not require more protection.
Zij vragen of in die situatie de positie van het bevoegd gezag niet meer bescherming vereist.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill aligning education sector laws with the normalisation of civil servants' legal position, questioning the mandatory organised-consultation and pay-scheme provisions as superfluous under private labour law. The government's reply rejects removing the rules on pay-scheme determination and organised consultation, but accepts dropping the mandatory dispute-resolution provisions in the consultation protocol.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the organised-consultation provisions superfluous and advises deleting them, which the government rejects as they form part of the guarantees tied to decentralisation of pay-setting.
The Afdeling considers the provision that the competent authority arranges the legal position of staff superfluous after normalisation, which the government rejects to make responsibility explicit.
The Afdeling advises removing the mandatory dispute-resolution rules for consultation protocols, which fit poorly in a normalised system, and the government accepts this.

35095-V.s: This bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting commitments and expenditures across policy and non-policy articles, as part of the Najaarsnota. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for 2018 is amended, as shown in the attached statement.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2018 wordt gewijzigd

35179.s: The bill amends the Trade Register Act 2007 and the Dutch anti-money laundering act (Wwft) to require registration of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) of companies and other legal entities, with restricted access for competent authorities and a duty for obliged entities to report discrepancies. It also creates an administrative fine and periodic penalty regime for failure to supply UBO data, and requires foundations to keep registers of payments.
35179.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as necessary for workability and technical detail of the EU directive implementation, and the executive powers as required for effective enforcement and proportionate privacy protection.
q: To promote workability, article 10a(2) of the Wwft provides a delegation basis to determine, per type of company or other legal entity, who must in any case be regarded as ultimate beneficial owner in the Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018.

Ter bevordering van de uitvoerbaarheid wordt in artikel 10a, tweede lid, van de Wwft voorzien in een delegatiegrondslag, om in het Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018 per type vennootschap of andere juridische entiteit te bepalen wie in elk geval dient te worden beschouwd als uiteindelijk belanghebbende.
d: Artikel I, D (Handelsregisterwet art. 15a, tweede lid, e)
classes of economic interest in UBO registration
Artikel I, D (Handelsregisterwet art. 15a, derde lid, b)
categories of documents evidencing economic interest
Artikel II, B (Wwft art. 10a, derde lid)
categories of natural persons deemed UBO per entity type
Artikel I, J (Handelsregisterwet art. 28, tweede lid)
designation of competent authorities with access to UBO data
Minister of Finance imposes administrative fines for UBO non-compliance
Artikel I, A/B (Handelsregisterwet art. 2, onderdeel d; general delegation to restrict access for privacy)
restrictions on access to UBO data to protect privacy (via Handelsregisterbesluit 2008)
p: The Minister of Finance gains power to impose periodic penalties and administrative fines on entities that fail to supply UBO information, with fines capped at the fourth category.
Artikel I, J and K (Handelsregisterwet art. 28 and 38a)

Competent authorities and the FIU gain unrestricted access to UBO information without the entity being informed, with access limited to a defined group designated by general administrative order and subject to confidentiality duties.
Artikel I, D and H (Handelsregisterwet art. 15a, 21, 25)
Privacy protection for UBO data is provided through a shielding procedure with objection and appeal under the General Administrative Law Act, with the regime to be elaborated by administrative order.

parties: Worries that limited access for financial gatekeepers and public disclosure endanger the safety of entrepreneurs and their families, and questions privacy and the legal basis under EU and human rights law.

These members find it unfortunate that gatekeepers in the financial sector have only limited access to relevant information in the register, while privacy-sensitive information can become accessible to people with improper intentions.

Deze leden vinden het ongelukkig dat poortwachters in de financiële sector slechts beperkte toegang hebben tot relevante informatie uit het register, terwijl privacygevoelige informatie toegankelijk kan worden voor mensen met oneigenlijke bedoelingen.
Asks technical questions about member-state options, feasibility of the deadline, handling of incorrect data and mosque registration.
The members of the PVV faction ask whether this date is feasible.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of deze datum haalbaar is.
Supports the register against money laundering but worries about the large impact on entrepreneurs, the scope of access, and privacy rulings by the Data Protection Authority and EDPS.
However, the scope, in particular the accessibility of the register, causes problems in practice, the CDA members believe.
Echter zorgt de reikwijdte van met name de toegankelijkheid van het register in de praktijk voor problemen, zo menen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Asks about proportionality of extra data fields, privacy protections, who decides on shielding requests and whether an independent judge should decide, and safeguards for access logs.
Has consideration been given to assigning this decision-making power to an independent judge?
Is er overwogen om deze beslissingsbevoegdheid neer te leggen bij een onafhankelijke rechter?

Argues the register is too weak against tax evasion and laundering, that burdens fall on ordinary firms, and that it should be tightened before implementation, with questions on loopholes and enforcement.
The SP members are of the view that a UBO register that threatens to turn out this way should first be tightened before being implemented.
De leden van de SP-fractie zijn van mening dat een UBO-register dat zo dreigt uit te pakken, eerst aangescherpt dient te worden, alvorens geïmplementeerd.

Fears the register offers too few tools against tax evasion and terrorist financing, urges a central shareholders register as complement, and asks whether restricted access and exemptions undermine effectiveness.
They fear that the UBO register in its current form offers too few tools for combating tax evasion, terrorist financing and money laundering.
Zij vrezen dat het UBO-register in de voorliggende vorm te weinig handvaten biedt in de bestrijding van belastingontduiking, terrorismefinanciering en witwassen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Implementation Act for the registration of ultimate beneficial owners of companies under the amended fourth anti-money laundering directive, focusing on the scope of the UBO register, in particular exclusions for certain entities and religious bodies, and on European coordination. The government's reply states it has added explanation on the reasons for excluding certain legal entities and on the scope and purpose of the directive.
concerns: The Afdeling asks the explanation to justify the exclusion of certain legal entities (non-business associations, owners' associations, other private legal persons, religious bodies) and their risk assessment against the directive's scope.
The Afdeling asks the explanation to address alignment with other Member States on which entities are included in UBO registers, given the aim of cross-border transparency.

35188.s: The bill requires registration and licence plates for agricultural and forestry tractors, low-speed vehicles, mobile machines and trailers, introducing periodic technical inspection under EU Directive 2014/45/EU and allowing a 40 km/h speed increase and a central exemption system. It sets transitional conversion rules for existing vehicles and related amendments to tax, motor-vehicle and driving-instruction laws.
35188.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for practical designation of vehicle categories and conversion procedures, aligned with EU regulation.
q: Rules shall be laid down by or pursuant to a general administrative order on how first registration and ownership transfer of the vehicles referred to in the third paragraph are applied for.
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de wijze van aanvragen van de eerste inschrijving en tenaamstelling van de voertuigen, bedoeld in het derde lid.
d: ARTIKEL I, A.1.b (art. 37, eerste lid, onderdeel a, 2°)
designation of agricultural/forestry tractors, low-speed vehicles and mobile machines subject to registration
ARTIKEL I, A.2 (art. 37, tweede lid, onderdeel c)
designation of trailers exempt from plate requirement
rules on how first registration and ownership transfer of pre-existing vehicles is applied for
p: Exempts pre-existing vehicles from the speed-related registration and plate obligations, with a sunset date, and lets the RDW grant central exemptions in place of road managers.

parties: Asks about enforcement capacity, penalties, possible bans on converted vehicles, and whether the regime could lead to additional taxes.
Is there sufficient knowledge among police and enforcement officers to detect and enforce (speeding) offences committed with this type of vehicle?
Is er voldoende kennis aanwezig bij politie en handhavers om (snelheids-)overtredingen die met bezit of gebruik van dit type voertuig worden begaan op te sporen en te handhaven?
Asks about the rationale for the EU infringement, effects on road safety, costs per tractor and enforcement budget.
What budget has been made available for enforcing this new obligation?
Welk budget beschikbaar gesteld is voor de handhaving van deze nieuwe verplichting.
Asks why the government did not follow the Council of State's advice to split the bill and whether the sector's conditions can be justified.

The government does not follow this advice, partly because the sector has indicated that it finds the registration and number plate obligation acceptable only if there are also benefits attached to it.

De regering geeft aan dit advies niet te volgen, mede vanwege het feit dat de sector heeft aangegeven de registratie- en kentekenplicht alleen acceptabel te vinden als er ook voordelen voor hen aan de kentekening zijn verbonden.
Accepts the government's choice not to split the bill but asks it to minimise costs and burdens, especially for historic vehicles.
These members urge the government to keep these to a minimum for farmers, growers and other owners of tractors and similar vehicles.
Deze leden drukken de regering op het hart deze tot een minimum te beperken voor boeren, tuinders en andere eigenaren van tractoren en dergelijke.
Asks why the government did not limit compulsory number plates as the Council of State suggested, and questions road-safety effects of removing the warning triangle plate.
Why the government, in view of the criticism from the Council of State, did not choose to limit the compulsory number plate requirement.
Waarom de regering, gelet op de kritiek van de RvS, er niet voor heeft gekozen om de verplichte kentekening te beperken.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill requiring registration and number plates for all agricultural tractors, low-speed vehicles and mobile machines, which affects about 580,000 vehicles, be limited to fast tractors or split into a part needed for transposing Directive 2014/45/EU and a part implementing parliamentary motions, and raised issues about physical inspection, timing of the APK obligation, and transposition tables. The government's reply rejected the split on grounds of sector support and coherence, explained why registration is necessary for effective enforcement, extended the conversion period to 20 May 2020, and deferred plate requirements for existing vehicles to 1 January 2025.
concerns: The Afdeling argued the bill's scope, covering about 580,000 vehicles while the directive concerns only about 7,000 fast tractors, is not necessary and should be limited; the government rejected this, arguing registration of all tractors is needed for effective enforcement.

The Afdeling questioned whether the RDW could physically inspect all 270,000 tractors in time and doubted the enforceability of registration without inspection; the government kept the approach without inspection but adjusted the conversion period and plate obligation.

The Afdeling advised splitting the bill into a directive-transposition part and a part implementing parliamentary motions to avoid delay; the government declined, citing the link between the topics and sector support.

The Afdeling advised clarifying from when fast tractors must pass inspection after registration and considering early information for stakeholders; the government added a conversion period to 20 May 2020 and extended the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling advised including a transposition table and avoiding references to the earlier explanatory memorandum; the government declined, arguing a table already exists in a related regulation and the memorandum is self-contained.

35210-IX.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2019 budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), changing commitments, expenditure and revenue by article. The accompanying explanatory memorandum itemises budgetary changes above materiality thresholds for each article.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement annexed to this act.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35269.s: The bill makes a technical amendment to the Wet op het kindgebonden budget: if a separate pending bill raising the income limit for couples is enacted, a provision in that bill (article I, part B, under 2) lapses. It also provides that this bill enters into force at the same time as that pending bill.
q: Whereas We have considered that it is desirable to index the child-related budget on 1 January 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat het wenselijk is om het kindgebonden budget op 1 januari 2020 te indexeren

parties: The VVD understands the government's reasoning for reversing non-indexation and has no further questions.
The members of the VVD faction have no further questions about this amendment.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben geen nadere vragen over deze wijziging.
D66 asks how the extra spending is absorbed within the national budget and what the effect on purchasing power is, given the small income effects.
These members ask the government to explain further how the extra expenditure is absorbed within the national budget.</br>
Deze leden vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de extra uitgaven worden opgevangen binnen de rijksbegroting.

The SP questions the shift from the original bill to the urgent bill, why an earlier amendment was dropped, the source of financing, and the inconsistent treatment of the negative purchasing-power effect.
Why was the negative purchasing-power picture for parents on minimum and modal income not a problem in the original bill, and is it now cited as the main argument for urgent legislation?

Waarom was het negatief koopkrachtbeeld van ouders op het minimum en modaal inkomensniveau bij het oorspronkelijke wetsvoorstel geen probleem en wordt het nu als belangrijkste argument aangevoerd voor de spoedwetgeving?
The PvdA finds it unjust that only parents from 2013 onward are compensated for a Tax Office error dating to 2008, and asks whether a reporting system like the WW Dagloonbesluit could be used.
Does the government consider it fair that some parents are compensated and others are not?
Vindt de regering het rechtvaardig dat sommige ouders wel worden gecompenseerd en andere weer niet?
The SGP asks how the EUR 60 million structural cost is concretely absorbed within the national budget and whether SZW funds are reallocated.
How concretely will the extra expenditure be absorbed within the national budget?
Hoe worden de extra uitgaven concreet opgevangen binnen de Rijksbegroting?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill raising the income threshold of the kindgebonden budget for couples raises no remarks and should be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply, which accompanied the transmission to the King, notes only that the budgetary consequences of the bill were explained further in the memorie van toelichting.

35287.s: The bill sets new rules for dividing pensions on divorce or dissolution of a registered partnership, making conversion of the accrued old-age and partner pension into the default split (50/50) unless the ex-partners opt out or agree otherwise within six months. It also amends the Pensioenwet, Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling, tax laws and Civil Code provisions to implement this and abolishes certain pension-provider consent rights.
35287.j: The memorandum justifies the default conversion by noting that pension providers rarely deviate from the standard split and that automatic division improves outcomes for ex-partners.
q: This bill provides that a pension provider proceeds to divide the old-age pension by conversion, unless the ex-partners indicate they do not want the division (opt-out) or have made a deviating agreement on the division of the pension.

Dit wetsvoorstel regelt dat een pensioenuitvoerder overgaat tot verdeling van het ouderdomspensioen door conversie, tenzij de ex-partners aangeven dat zij de verdeling niet willen (opt-out) of dat zij een afwijkende afspraak over de verdeling van het pensioen hebben gemaakt.
d: calculation and division of pension, data registration, information and costs
further rules on refusal of abusive deviating agreements
p: Pension division shifts to automatic conversion by pension providers unless ex-partners act within six months, reducing the need for individual action.
Pension providers may refuse to implement deviating agreements where abuse is apparent, a discretionary power for the provider rather than the individual.

parties: Asks how pension information and data flows to pension providers are legally secured and whether the process at the start of divorce gives enough clarity.
Worries that conversion as default is irreversible and occurs without spouses being obliged to consider their pension arrangements, and that the partner with fewer rights may be less protected.
A third disadvantage is that conversion is irreversible and happens by default without spouses who divorce being obliged to think about their pension provision.
Een derde nadeel is dat conversie onomkeerbaar is en standaard plaatsvindt zonder dat gehuwden die willen gaan scheiden verplicht zijn om na te denken over hun pensioenvoorziening.
Welcomes the automatic arrangement but asks about the scope of the bill, excluding unmarried cohabitants, and about the grounds for pension providers to refuse deviating agreements.
What is the reason that besides registered partnership or marriage, other forms of partners are not included in the pension scheme?
Wat is de reden dat naast het geregistreerd partnerschap of huwelijk niet andere vormen van partners voor de pensioenregeling worden meegenomen?
Asks whether people get enough guidance at the start of divorce and enough room to act during the six-month reaction period, and whether unmarried cohabitants can opt in.
The GroenLinks members ask whether people have enough room to act during the six months in which they can respond to their pension fund's communication.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen of mensen wel genoeg handelingsperspectief hebben gedurende de zes maanden dat zij kunnen reageren op de communicatie van hun pensioenfonds.
Asks how citizens and divorce professionals will be informed about the new law given the low awareness of the current one.
The SP members ask the government how it will inform citizens and divorce professionals about the new law given the unfamiliarity of the current law.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering op welke manier zij burgers en scheidingsprofessionals gaat informeren over de nieuwe wet gezien de onbekendheid van de huidige wet.
Asks whether the bill improves the position of the lower-earning partner, the income effects of limiting partner pensions, and how the government will inform stakeholders.
The 50PLUS members ask whether this bill aims to improve the financial position of the lower-earning partner.
De leden van de 50PLUS-fractie vragen of dit wetsvoorstel tot doel heeft om de financiële positie van de minstverdienende partner te verbeteren?

Questions whether the bijzonder partnerpensioen should be removed from automatic division, whether divorce lawyers' duty of care protects clients, and whether vulnerable ex-partners face financial harm from conversion and tight implementation timelines.
Is the government willing to keep the bijzonder partnerpensioen and include it in the division only at the request of participants?
Is de regering bereid om het bijzonder partnerpensioen te behouden en alleen op verzoek van deelnemers mee te nemen in de verdeling?
Asks technical questions about small partner pensions falling under the Wet waardeoverdracht klein pensioen and whether voluntary opt-in for unmarried cohabitants could be made workable.
The D66 members ask whether it is correct that by not dividing accrued entitlements below the buy-out amount, small special partner pensions may arise.](Note: evidence_en as translated)

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of het klopt dat door niet verdelen van opgebouwde aanspraken lager dan het afkoopbedrag (artikel 66 van de Pensioenwet) kleine bijzondere partnerpensioenen kunnen ontstaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Wet pensioenverdeling bij scheiding 2021, which makes conversion the default and automatically divides pensions, raising concerns about unmarried cohabitants, abuse-based refusal of agreed splits, and transitional law. The minister's reply largely accepted the remarks: the memorie van toelichting was supplemented, the refusal ground was reformulated, and the transitional instemming requirement was kept for practical reasons while cohabitants were left outside the scheme pending a uniform partner definition.
concerns: The Afdeling said the draft wrongly linked the nullity of an agreement to the pension provider's refusal on grounds of abuse, and advised reformulating article 7, paragraph 3; the government reformulated it.

The Afdeling doubted the feasibility for pension providers of the abuse refusal ground given no criteria for misuse, and asked for explanation or amendment; the government clarified the memorie van toelichting but declined to set further rules by lower regulation for now.

The Afdeling asked why unmarried cohabitants, after acceptance by the pension provider as partners, could not be brought under the scheme or given a statutory option; the government kept them outside for now, citing the lack of a uniform partner definition and reluctance to impose consequences they chose to avoid.

The Afdeling asked whether the instemming requirement for conversion could be dropped for divorces in the two years before entry into force; the government declined because the group is hard to identify and the benefit does not outweigh the uncertainty.

The Afdeling asked the memorie van toelichting to address prenuptial clauses excluding pension division, the relation to the pension agreement, and related points; the government supplemented the explanatory memorandum.

35300-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2020 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (budget chapter IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January 2020. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget's policy articles on tax administration, financial markets, public-private financing, international financial relations, export credit guarantees, the VAT compensation fund and customs, and the related performance indicators.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2020 belonging to this act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no objections to the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Finance and the National Debt and advised submitting them to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport reports that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.

35368.s: The bill implements the access-regulation, switching-provider and geographic network-survey provisions of the EU European Electronic Communications Code in the Telecommunications Act. It lets the ACM impose access obligations on cables and facilities where replication is economically inefficient or physically impossible, sets switching rules for internet access providers, and empowers the Minister to demand coverage information from providers for a geographic survey.
35368.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technology-dependent, frequently changing technical detail that is set out by ministerial regulation, and says the ACM's competence is not restricted.
q: These are detailed, mostly technology-dependent rules. These rules are expected to change frequently.
Het gaat hierbij om gedetailleerde, veelal techniekafhankelijke voorschriften. Deze techniekafhankelijke voorschriften zullen naar verwachting veelvuldig wijzigen.
d: compensation of subscribers for non-compliance with switching rules
cases in which receiving provider must offer switching service
information to be demanded from providers for geographic survey, including three-year forecasts
manner and form of supplying information and publication of survey results
p: The Minister may compel providers to supply network coverage information and forecasts, with a ban on knowingly or grossly negligently providing misleading information, and must share confidential data only under safeguards.

The independent regulator ACM gains power to impose access obligations on network operators where replication is blocked, subject to proportionality, consultation with the Commission and a five-year review.

parties: Asks how the regulator ACM will assess replication feasibility given its capacity, and about the relation between Telecomcode powers and existing regulation.

Can the government indicate how this way of working differs from the current approach and whether the ACM has sufficient capacity to judge the physical possibilities for replication within a reasonable period?

Kan de regering aangeven in hoeverre deze wijze van werken verschilt ten opzichte van de huidige wijze en of de ACM over voldoende capaciteit beschikt om binnen een redelijke termijn een oordeel te geven over de fysieke mogelijkheden voor replicatie?
Asks whether self-regulation will work in practice and whether additional measures are needed beyond the bill, and how 'new networks' are defined as an exception to ACM obligations.
How does the government define 'new networks'?
Supports access regulation where replication is inefficient, and asks why the Raad van State's advice on separate phased implementation was not followed.
Can the government explain why no changes were made to paragraph 2 of the explanatory memorandum after this advice?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom na dit advies geen wijzigingen zijn aangebracht in paragraaf 2 van de memorie van toelichting?

35395.s: The bill amends article 7e of the Kadasterwet so that the Kadaster (land registry) may use an electronic seal under EU regulation 910/2014 instead of a qualified electronic signature when signing messages in fully automated processes. It also makes related publication-law amendments tied to the pending Wet elektronische publicaties, and gives retroactive effect to the change back to 26 September 2019.
35395.j: The memorandum justifies the change by the incompatibility of fully automated signing with the eIDAS requirement of personal control, and by the risk that land-registry services would otherwise halt when the certificate expired.
q: With the present amendment, the use of the electronic seal by the Kadaster is made legally possible.
Met de voorliggende wetswijziging wordt het gebruik van het elektronisch zegel door het Kadaster wettelijk mogelijk gemaakt.

parties: Asks whether the total extra costs for notaries have been assessed and why the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens was not consulted, raising oversight and advisory review points.
The members speaking also ask why the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens was not consulted.
De aan het woord zijnde leden vragen voorts waarom de Autoriteit Persoons-gegevens niet geconsulteerd is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Kadasterwet on electronic signing of fully automated messages raises no remarks and should be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport notes that the bill was supplemented with technical amendments to the Wet elektronische publicaties-related definitions of kennisgeving and mededeling in several laws, without changing substance.

35450-III.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statements (first supplementary budget) of the Ministry of General Affairs, the King's Cabinet and the Commission for the Supervision of Intelligence and Security Services, raising appropriations by thousands of euros. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 May 2020.
35450-III.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for a modification of the departmental budget statements, without any delegation or new powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA)
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA)

35458.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean Netherlands anti-money laundering and terrorist financing act (Wwft BES) and the financial markets act (Wfm BES) to align with FATF standards, harmonise the PEP definition, expand information sharing between supervisors, the FIU, tax and investigative authorities, extend the scope to building materials traders, and strengthen supervisors' enforcement tools including fines, penalty payments and public disclosure. It also tightens cash-movement reporting rules at customs and narrows the professional secrecy shield for notaries.
35458.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers and delegations by FATF standards, identified implementation gaps and practical enforcement and information-sharing problems.
q: To prevent criminal funds from entering the financial system through these parties or terrorism being financed, these parties must meet certain requirements.
Om te voorkomen dat met behulp of via deze partijen criminele gelden in het financieel systeem komen of terrorisme wordt gefinancierd, moeten deze partijen aan bepaalde eisen voldoen
d: designating additional valuables or goods as liquid funds
categories of natural persons deemed ultimate beneficial owners
exemptions from risk assessment for sectors with clear inherent risks
risk factors to be considered in customer due diligence
simplified due diligence products, transactions and dealer categories
data to be declared on carried cash
exemption of professional carriers from cash declaration duties
threshold amounts for high-value goods and building materials trade
p: Supervisors may share confidential data with tax, police, prosecution and the FIU, subject to purpose limitation and privacy safeguards.
Penalty payments and fines are extended to refusal to cooperate with supervisors.
Supervisors may publicly disclose fines and penalty payments, with a waiting period and discretion to refrain where disclosure would undermine supervision.
Notaries lose their professional secrecy vis-a-vis supervisors and the FIU for reporting and supervisory purposes, while the advocate regime remains unresolved.
Customs gain power to request declarations for cash below the threshold where criminal links are suspected and for unaccompanied cash shipments.
The FIU may demand information from any service provider it deems to hold relevant data, with no explicit judicial authorisation.

parties: Asks for quantitative data on money-laundering scale, justification for thresholds and PEP definitions, the basis for fines, and whether the evaluation timing is too early to assess effectiveness.
What steps are being taken to arrive at more quantitative data on the scale of the money-laundering problem?
Welke stappen worden gezet om tot meer kwantitatieve data over de omvang van de witwasproblematiek te komen?

Questions the reasoning that smaller islands carry lower risk, asks why gambling is not included preventively, and asks about the capacity and budget of the FIU and the status of financial institutions on the islands.

Asks about consultation with the notarial organisation, the timing of the review of lawyers' professional confidentiality as a fundamental right, and why the Cbp BES objections and gambling extension were not adopted.
Rightly, the D66 members note that confidentiality between client and lawyer is a fundamental right.
Terecht lezen de leden van de D66-fractie dat de vertrouwelijkheid tussen rechtszoekende en advocaat een grondrecht is.

Questions whether a ministerial regulation can designate high-risk relationships given privacy intrusion, the basis for the threshold and remote gambling exclusion, and the proportionality of cash-transport rules.
The GroenLinks members read that the Cbp BES states that designating a type of business relationship or service as high-risk constitutes an intrusion on the client's private life.

De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie lezen dat het Cbp BES aangeeft dat toewijzing van een type zakelijke relatie of dienstverlening als vormend een hoog risico, een inbreuk vormt op de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de cliënt.

Asks why gambling is not regulated despite links to crime, what effects non-regulation has, and how data exchange with Dutch supervisors is safeguarded given that the GDPR does not apply to the BES islands.

The SP further asks how the government will supervise the proper handling of these personal data and their exchange between the BES islands and Dutch supervisory bodies, since the GDPR does not apply to the BES islands.

Voorts vragen zij de regering hoe zij gaat toezien op de juiste behandeling van deze persoonsgegevens en de uitwisseling hiervan tussen de BES-eilanden en de toezichthoudende instellingen in Nederland, aangezien de AVG niet van toepassing is op de BES-eilanden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill tightening anti-money-laundering and terrorist-financing rules in the Caribbean Netherlands (Wwft BES), raising concerns on the vague PEP definition, the scope of data sharing with supervisors and investigative bodies, the basis for adding building-materials traders, and practical enforcement. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, adding motivation, a narrower PEP definition with a one-year cut-off, a clearer purpose limitation for data sharing, and an annex comparing the measures with European Netherlands rules.
concerns: The open-ended definition of politically exposed persons is unclear and hard to apply in practice, so the definition should be clarified; the government added a one-year cut-off and expanded the explanatory notes.

The necessity and proportionality of expanded sharing of personal data with supervisors and investigative bodies was insufficiently demonstrated, so the nature and scale of practical problems must be explained.
Data sharing for any statutory task risks conflicting with purpose limitation under the GDPR; the law should specify the legal purposes for which recipients may use the data.
The choice of building-materials traders as new obliged entities, based on the WODC risk analysis, needs further motivation, which the government supplied in the explanatory notes.

Effectiveness is at risk from de-risking by correspondent banks and from the absence of supervisors and notaries in the Caribbean Netherlands, which the government addressed only by explaining the context and cross-border notary regime.
The government corrected the bill, clarifying that the PEP rule covers direct family members and close associates and removing the provision on notarial confidentiality.

35467.s: The bill amends the Dutch Competition Act and the ACM establishment law to implement EU Directive 2019/1, strengthening the Authority for Consumers and Markets' investigative, fining, interim-measure and cross-border enforcement powers. It adds an ACM-specific delegation to set suspension and dismissal conditions for board members by ministerial regulation, and requires a court authorisation for inspections of non-residential premises and vehicles.
35467.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers as required by the directive's minimum-harmonisation obligations and the need for effective enforcement and independence of national competition authorities.
q: The European Parliament and the Council find that many national competition authorities lack the necessary guarantees of independence and the powers to enforce competition law effectively.

Het Europees Parlement en de Europese Raad constateren evenwel dat het vele nationale mededingingsautoriteiten ontbreekt aan de noodzakelijke waarborgen voor hun onafhankelijkheid, alsmede bevoegdheden om het mededingingsrecht doeltreffend te kunnen handhaven.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (artikel 3, achtste lid, Instellingswet ACM)
conditions for suspension and dismissal of ACM members
rules on fine immunity or reduction (clemency)
p: Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 10, derde lid, Instellingswet ACM)
Removes the responsible Ministers' power to annul ACM competition decisions of general scope, to protect the regulator's independence.
Allows the ACM to impose interim measures by standalone order in urgent competition cases after only a preliminary investigation.
Extends the requirement of a prior judicial authorisation to inspections of non-residential premises, terrains and vehicles, which the bill strengthens as a check on executive inspection powers.
Gives the ACM power to formally establish past infringements without imposing a sanction, for use in damages proceedings.</description_en>

parties: Asks how cross-border fine collection and administrative burden will work and how quality of competition authorities across member states is ensured.
In this regard, these members ask how the process of collecting fines and acting on each other's behalf will work.
Hierbij vragen deze leden hoe het proces van het innen van boetes en het optreden voor elkaars rekening in werking gaat.
