Asks about the detection function of the ACM, the deterrent effect, the scope of national competition law, and the risk of enforcing fines for conduct not illegal in the Netherlands.

Does the government see a risk in having to collect fines in situations that would not be classified as an infringement in the Netherlands, or is that risk absent or negligible since competition law has now been sufficiently harmonised?

Ziet de regering een risico in het moeten innen van boetes in situaties die in Nederland niet als een overtreding zouden worden gekwalificeerd, of is dat risico er niet of nihil daar de mededingingswetgeving inmiddels voldoende is geharmoniseerd?

Welcomes the independence of competition authorities but worries about misuse of cross-border fine enforcement by politically pressured member states, and questions whether ministers' power to annul ACM decisions should be retained.
These members note that in some member states the independence of institutions is under heavy pressure, even where EU law requires that independence.
Deze leden constateren dat in sommige lidstaten de onafhankelijkheid van instituten zwaar onder druk staat, ook wanneer het Unierecht die onafhankelijkheid vereist.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised removing the proposed article 53b Mw implementing nemo tenetur for competition information requests, since the general principle in article 5:10a Awb already covers it, plus several drafting remarks. The government reply accepts the advice, deletes article 53b, and also makes several further adjustments and drafting corrections.
concerns: A specific nemo tenetur provision in the Mededingingswet is unnecessary because article 5:10a Awb already covers the principle, so the proposed article 53b should be deleted unless its necessity is justified.
Several drafting points on the transposition table, cross-references and the clemency provisions (article 85c and 89ga Mw) are to be corrected.

35476.s: The bill temporarily suspends the Awb rules allowing a penalty payment (dwangsom) and an appeal against failure to decide in time on asylum residence permit applications under the Aliens Act 2000, for one year. It also requires the Minister of Justice and Security to report to parliament every three months on compliance with statutory decision deadlines.
35476.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension by rising processing times, mounting penalty payment costs of up to EUR 40 million and IND staff being diverted to handling appeals, and states it is practically unavoidable for a limited period.
q: In view of this, it is almost unavoidable that, to support the intended measures, appeal against failure to decide in time on asylum applications is excluded for a period of one year, provisionally, and no penalty payments can be incurred.

Gelet daarop is het vrijwel onontkoombaar dat, ter ondersteuning van de bedoelde maatregelen, zo spoedig mogelijk voor – voorlopig – een periode van een jaar bij het niet tijdig beslissen op asielaanvragen beroep tegen dat niet tijdig beslissen wordt uitgesloten en er geen dwangsommen kunnen worden verbeurd.
p: Removes citizens' right to a penalty payment and to appeal to a court against the IND's failure to decide asylum applications on time, shifting protection away from applicants toward the executive's administrative capacity.
Requires the Minister to report to parliament every three months on whether asylum decisions meet statutory deadlines.

parties: Supports suspending penalty payments for asylum seekers and asks about the cost and whether the bill's extension mechanism and appeal provisions function as intended.
These members therefore find it very sensible that the government suspends the possibility of penalty payments for late IND decisions with this bill.
Deze leden vinden het daarom zeer verstandig dat de regering de mogelijkheid voor dwangsommen bij niet tijdige beslissingen van de IND met dit wetsvoorstel opschort.
Asks why the government submitted its own bill when a members' bill on permanent abolition already exists.
Why does the government find it necessary to submit its own bill when a members' bill already exists that provides for permanent abolition of the penalty payment scheme for asylum seekers?

Waarom vindt de regering het nodig zelf een wetsvoorstel in te dienen terwijl er al een initiatiefwetsvoorstel is ingediend die ziet op het permanent afschaffen van de dwangsomregeling voor asielzoekers?
Asks about the timing of the permanent regulation and whether the issue will be resolved this cabinet period.
Is it expected that the matter of these penalty payments will be brought to an end still in this cabinet period?
Wordt verwacht dat de kwestie van onderhavige dwangsommen nog deze kabinetsperiode tot een einde wordt gebracht?
Understands the government's position but values a reliable government that decides promptly and carefully, and asks questions on the bill, including the appeal to the administrative court.
At the same time they attach great value to a reliable government that decides quickly and carefully.
Tegelijkertijd hechten zij grote waarde aan een betrouwbare overheid die snel en zorgvuldig beslist.

Says the backlog was caused by the government itself and questions whether removing the right to appeal to the administrative court is disproportionate, and whether the open-ended extension mechanism is democratically acceptable.
The aforementioned members ask whether it is therefore not disproportionate to restrict a fundamental right of citizens, as the Council of State also states.
Voornoemde leden vragen of het daarmee niet disproportioneel is een fundamenteel recht van burgers in te perken zoals ook de Afdeling stelt.

Questions why the government did not adopt the Council of State's advice to set an end date and to keep the administrative court appeal, and why a permanent law is planned while the temporary bill is automatically extended.
The Council of State advises keeping the appeal option before the administrative court.
De Afdeling adviseert de beroepsmogelijkheid bij de bestuursrechter in stand te laten.
Argues suspension must not become a free pass for the IND and asks what hard, measurable targets the government sets to enforce timely decisions.
Suspending the penalty payment must not become a free pass to sit back.
Het opschorten van de dwangsom mag geen vrijbrief voor achterover leunen worden.
Asks why the government delayed this amendment despite known problems, and what alternatives exist if the temporary bill is rejected or delayed, and asks about the timing of the permanent bill.
As far as the SGP members are concerned, literally precious time has been lost in the preceding months.
Wat de leden van de SGP-fractie betreft, is in de achterliggende maanden letterlijk kostbare tijd verloren gegaan.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the temporary suspension of penalty payments (dwangsommen) for late asylum decisions by the IND may be justified, but that excluding appeal to the administrative court for non-timely decisions goes further than necessary and that a sunset clause (horizonbepaling) should be added. The government's reply accepts that the appeal exclusion cannot be justified for long and adjusts the bill to apply the appeal route again after one year, but rejects the sunset clause and keeps the suspension of penalty payments.
concerns: Excluding the appeal to the administrative court against non-timely decisions goes further than strictly necessary and conflicts with the general Awb framework; the government adjusted the bill so the appeal route applies again after one year.

The Afdeling advised adding a sunset clause (e.g. 1 April 2021) so the temporary law expires, given the government's own expectation that the problem would be resolved by 2021; the government declined.
Removing access to the administrative court for asylum seekers weakens their legal protection, which the government partly addressed by restoring the appeal after one year.

35485.s: The bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) through a fourth supplementary budget, adding funds for municipal support measures. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2020, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35494.s: This omnibus bill amends several Dutch social security and labour laws, including child benefit, survivors' and old-age pensions, working conditions for pregnant workers, unemployment and sickness benefits, and minimum wage rules. It also transfers, via a later general administrative order, responsibility for special relief (bijzondere onderstand) in the Caribbean Netherlands to a public body after parliamentary pre-consultation.
35494.j: The memorandum justifies control regulations as needed for a proper, lawful implementation of the schemes and notes that the transfer of special relief will be regulated via an order subject to parliamentary pre-consultation.
q: These requirements do not go further than strictly necessary for the proper implementation of this act.
Deze voorschriften gaan niet verder dan strikt noodzakelijk is voor een juiste uitvoering van deze wet.
d: XVIII/Wet WIA art. 86-117 (Invoeringswet I-BES art. 18.3, lid 2)
transfer of special relief responsibility to a public body in the Caribbean Netherlands
control requirements for old-age pension recipients
control requirements for survivors' pension recipients
control requirements for accident insurance claimants
control requirements for sickness benefit claimants
data to be shared with labour inspectorate for minimum wage enforcement
p: V (Cessantiawet BES art. 12a) and other BES laws

Replaces separate enforcement provisions with the general administrative law title 5.2 on supervision, applying general enforcement powers to benefit recipients while excluding some safeguards in sections 5.18 and 5.19.
Limits the labour inspectorate's enforcement base for wage set-offs to the statutory minimum wage, removing the attachment-free amount as a supervised floor.

parties: Asks whether UWV will actually apply the lower garnishment exemption as promised after the Ombudsman's critical report, so that people do not fall below subsistence level.
Can the government elaborate on this and guarantee that UWV will adhere to the garnishment exemption as formulated in the bill, so that people no longer fall below the subsistence minimum?

Kan de regering hier nader op ingaan en kan de regering garanderen dat het UWV zich aan de beslagvrije voet gaat houden zoals geformuleerd in het wetsvoorstel, zodat mensen niet langer onder het bestaansminimum terecht komen?
Worries that the Inspectie SZW may no longer need to check whether employers deduct too much wages, which could harm the financial security of employees and debtors.
Does the importance of financial security for the employee/debtor not outweigh the interest in a simpler process for the Inspectie SZW?
Staat het belang van bestaanszekerheid voor de werknemer/schuldenaar in dit geval niet boven het belang van een simpeler proces voor de Inspectie SZW?
Asks about the financial consequences for people subject to garnishment and about the privacy implications of health data exchange by the SVB.
In addition, these members ask what health data the Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) will be able to exchange, and with whom.
Daarnaast vragen deze leden wat met wie de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB) de gezondheidsgegevens straks kan «uitwisselen»?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Verzamelwet SZW 2021 and made no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport confirms this and reports only minor redactional improvements and a technical renumbering following parliamentary treatment of another bill.

35539.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality and the Animal Health Fund to fund culling costs and implementation of the scheme for ending mink farming. The bill contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum text was available.
q: is amended, as appears from the relevant budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

35548.s: The bill harmonises pension rules for political office holders (ministers, state secretaries, MPs, provincial executives, members of the European Parliament) with those for civil servants, including partner and orphan pensions, re-integration support and reimbursement rules. It also amends the Gemeentewet and Provinciewet on travel-cost allowances and ancillary benefits for local and provincial officials.
35548.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that the rules are technical, that the arrangement follows the civil-servant regime, and that the re-integration maximum budget gives choice and quality assurance.
q: It is now proposed to give former political office holders access to a maximum re-integration budget to be set by or under a general administrative order.
Voorgesteld wordt thans de gewezen politieke ambtsdragers de beschikking te geven over een bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur vast te stellen maximum budget voor re-integratie
d: re-integration plan rules, costs, maximum amounts and provider requirements
franchise for pension base, via Besluit pensioen politieke ambtsdragers
re-integration rules for former provincial executive members
periods of non-payment and holiday rules set by general administrative order
Voorzitter decides on cost reimbursements, care provision and official car use
occupational health care facility for ministers, to be set in Voorzieningenbesluit
p: Re-integration plans must be approved by the Minister, and detailed rules and provider requirements are left to a general administrative order.
The Minister may buy out a pension if transfer attempts have failed five times and five years have passed, a discretionary option.
Benefit payments may be withheld in listed circumstances, with the Minister able to act at the beneficiary's request.
Official car with chauffeur may be provided on advice of the National Coordinator Terrorism and Security for the chair.

parties: Asks why the partner pension departs from the StvdA advice and whether the law must be amended again before 2026, and how it aligns with the divorce pension bill.
Why does the government choose a different approach than the one advised by the StvdA for the new pension system?
Waarom kiest de regering voor een andere invulling dan geadviseerd door de StvdA voor het nieuwe pensioenstelsel?

Argues the legislature must assess ABP changes itself since government is responsible for its pension policy, and asks how voluntary waiver of Appa benefits remains a personal decision free from political pressure.
These members find it fundamentally fine to follow the ABP, but that does not relieve the legislature of assessing whether the changes the ABP implements are desirable.
Deze leden het in hoofdlijn prima om het ABP te volgen, maar dat ontslaat de wetgever er niet van om te beoordelen of de wijzigingen die het ABP doorvoert wel wenselijk zijn.
Asks for justification of the new grounds for reimbursing career-orientation costs and for how job-search duty compliance is monitored and by whom.
What shows that such a provision is necessary?
Waaruit blijkt dat een dergelijke voorziening nodig is?
Demands a quantitative overview of gains and losses to judge whether retroactive effect is needed and a real information campaign so affected persons are informed of pension changes.
They would like a quantitative overview of advantages and disadvantages in the various situations, so they can themselves judge whether retroactive effect is necessary or not.
Zij zouden graag een kwantitatief overzicht ontvangen van voor- en nadelen in de verschillende situaties, teneinde zelf te kunnen beoordelen of terugwerkende kracht wel of niet noodzakelijk zou zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the draft bill amending the Algemene pensioenwet politieke ambtsdragers and related pay and pension acts, and advised submitting it to the House of Representatives. Because the Afdeling raised no points, no separate government reply was needed and the minister simply forwarded the bill.

35557.s: The bill temporarily allows courts to postpone bankruptcy petitions and suspend enforcement against businesses hit by COVID-19 liquidity problems, and lets the Minister for Legal Protection extend community-service deadlines and allows video hearings in penitentiary complaint procedures. It also temporarily disapplies the household-sharing norm in the Participatiewet for self-employed people receiving the bridging scheme until 1 July 2021.
35557.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the urgency of COVID-19 disruption to courts, enforcement and prisons, and by the need to protect businesses and prisoners' access to justice.
q: No appeal lies against the court's decisions under this article.
Tegen de beslissingen van de rechtbank als bedoeld in dit artikel staat geen rechtsmiddel open.
d: end date of disapplying household-sharing norm via royal decree
Minister extends community-service execution deadlines by up to twelve months
court discretion to suspend bankruptcy petitions and enforcement, with own-judgement criteria
royal decree sets commencement and extends expiry of chapter 2
p: Courts may suspend creditors' bankruptcy petitions and enforcement for up to six months, with summary judicial review and a no-appeal rule for the court's decisions.
The Minister for Legal Protection may extend court-set community-service deadlines by up to twelve months, overriding judicial determinations.

parties: Asks why the Tax Authority is exempt from the payment deferral and whether courts can properly test domino effects and fraud, and disputes the workload estimate of the judiciary.
Can the government indicate why it believes the position of the Tax Authority in this case differs from other creditors, such as banks?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom zij van mening is dat de positie van de Belastingdienst in dit geval verschilt van andere schuldeisers, zoals bijvoorbeeld banken?
Asks how courts should assess business prospects and liquidity causes under the deferral criteria and whether the deferral delays unavoidable bankruptcies.
These members ask the government how the court is to assess whether a business has future prospects, while the future is so uncertain for entrepreneurs right now.
Deze leden vragen de regering hoe de rechtbank moet beoordelen of een bedrijf toekomstperspectief heeft, terwijl de toekomst juist nu zo onzeker is voor ondernemers.
Asks whether retroactive effect could affect bankruptcies already final before entry into force and whether this should be excluded explicitly.
Should it not be explicitly stated that the retroactive effect explicitly does not apply to this situation?
Zou niet expliciet moeten worden opgenomen dat de terugwerkende kracht expliciet niet op deze situatie ziet?
Welcomes exempting the Tozo from the cost-sharing norm but presses for overdue research on its housing effects, which parliament had requested by motion, and asks why the Tax Authority is exempt.
The aforementioned members impatiently ask when the research into the effects of the cost-sharing norm on people's housing will come to the House.
Voornoemde leden vragen vol ongeduld wanneer het onderzoek naar de effecten van de kostendelersnorm op de huisvesting van mensen naar de Kamer komt.
Argues the cost-sharing norm should be suspended for all regular benefit recipients, not only self-employed, to avoid unequal treatment, and asks about the administrative burden and budget.
These members ask whether the government is willing to also abolish the cost-sharing norm in the Participation Act, at least for the duration of the emergency package.
Deze leden vragen of de regering bereid is de kostendelersnorm ook te schrappen in de participatiewet, in elk geval voor de duur van het noodpakket.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the exclusion of the Belastingdienst from the temporary payment-deferral scheme for debtors during COVID-19 be justified convincingly or dropped, since other creditors also show forbearance. The government's reply keeps the exclusion, arguing that tax collection is a core state task with its own legal framework and that the existing tax relief package already serves the same purpose, and it adds an extension of the Tozo rules.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned why the Belastingdienst should be excluded from the temporary payment-deferral scheme when other creditors are covered, and asked for a convincing justification or removal of the exception.
The Afdeling asked that, if the exception is kept, the explanatory memorandum explain how the Belastingdienst will handle bankruptcy petitions during the scheme's duration.

35566.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to add definitions for pyrotechnic articles, theatre pyrotechnics and fireworks, and to make the import of such articles into the Netherlands subject to the rules of article 11a.2. It removes the requirement for the relevant minister's involvement in several consent and approval provisions of article 11a.2 and deletes article 11a.1.
q: In paragraph 3, subparagraph a, and paragraph 5, subparagraph b, the words 'Our relevant Minister, or' are deleted.
In het derde lid, onderdeel a, en in het vijfde lid, onderdeel b, vervalt: Onze betrokken Minister, of.
p: Removes the requirement that the relevant minister be consulted or agree before certain decisions under article 11a.2 are taken, leaving those decisions to the other designated authority.

v.summary: The Council of State advised in 2017 against sending a bill to parliament until concerns were addressed: the need for an approval scheme for importers of theatre pyrotechnics and fireworks was not convincingly justified, it may conflict with the Services Directive, the health-protection extension was poorly reasoned, and administrative burdens were not described. The 2020 government reply withdraws the bill, citing a Benelux 'pyropas' scheme that makes the approval scheme unnecessary.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not show that an import-stage approval scheme would effectively reduce illegal fireworks trade and consumer dangers, nor why stricter enforcement of existing rules is insufficient.
The approval scheme falls under the Services Directive and requires a heightened justification under Article 16, which the explanatory memorandum does not provide.
The extension of the legal basis to protection of human health applies only to imports, which appears arbitrary given that the dangers arise at use by consumers.
The memorandum does not address the administrative and bestuurlijke burdens of the scheme for businesses and the competent authority.

35570-X.s: This bill fixes the 2021 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Defence and the 2021 budget statement for the Paresto operating agency, in thousands of euros. It contains only budget figures and the standard entry-into-force provision, with no delegation or new executive powers.
q: The departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Defence attached to this Act for the year 2021 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that it had no remarks on the draft 2021 Defence budget bill (begrotingsstaat Defensie X) and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport confirms that the Afdeling could agree with the proposals for the 2021 budget bills, noting one non-blank opinion concerning the Ministry of Finance budget, and mentions some further amendments in annexes.

35575.s: The bill introduces a national CO2 levy (CO2-heffing industrie) on greenhouse gas emissions from industrial installations, waste incineration and nitrous oxide plants, with dispensation rights deducting from the levy base. It creates a new chapter in the Environmental Management Act for industrial annual emissions reporting, monitoring plans, a register of dispensation rights and enforcement powers for the Dutch Emissions Authority (NEa).
35575.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for technical detail on monitoring, reporting and allocation rules, aligned with the EU ETS framework, and by the NEa's expertise.
q: The NEa board is, in certain cases, authorised to determine the industrial annual emissions ex officio.
Het bestuur van de NEa is, in bepaalde gevallen, bevoegd om ambtshalve de industriële jaarvracht vast te stellen.
d: Artikel 16b.3 lid 3 Wm (via Art. II E)
rules on determining and registering industrial annual emissions and verification
Artikel 16b.5 lid 2 Wm (via Art. II E)
rules for combined heat and power installations and heat transfer
Artikel 16b.7 lid 4-5 Wm (via Art. II E)
when monitoring plans are required and application procedure
Artikel 16b.13 lid 2 and 16b.14 lid 2 Wm (via Art. II E)
opening, managing and blocking accounts in the dispensation register
Artikel 16b.15 lid 1 Wm (via Art. II E)
fees for opening and maintaining register accounts
Artikel 16b.17 lid 2-4 Wm (via Art. II E)
calculation of dispensation rights, reduction factor and allocation-based rules
Artikel 16b.20 lid 2 and 16b.22 lid 3 Wm (via Art. II E)
content of industrial monitoring methodology plans and amendments
Artikel 16b.23 lid 2 Wm (via Art. II E)
content of the industrial activity level report
Artikel 71j lid 3 Wbm (via Art. I F)
conditions for exemption of CO2 transferred for geological storage
Artikel 71p lid 3 Wbm (via Art. V A)
determination of the forward price of greenhouse gas allowances used in the tariff
p: The NEa board may unilaterally set industrial emissions and dispensation rights on a conservative estimate when reports are missing or deemed deficient, subject to objection and appeal.
The NEa board may block or close accounts and reset dispensation rights to earlier levels on suspicion of fraud or misuse.
The NEa board may declare reports non-compliant up to ten years after the reporting year, extending the period of exposure for operators.
Levy collection is assigned to the Dienst Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit under the Minister of Finance rather than the Tax Administration, placing it under direct ministerial authority.
The NEa must publicly disclose decisions and reports relating to dispensation rights, subject to the Open Government Act.

parties: Asks how the government ensures the levy gives sufficient incentive, whether it can be aligned with EU ETS, and how carbon leakage is monitored and minimised.
The VVD members ask how the government guarantees that the levy will very probably provide sufficient incentive to make the investments needed to reach the reduction target.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de regering waarborgt dat de heffing met grote waarschijnlijkheid voldoende prikkel geeft om de investeringen te doen die nodig zijn met het oog op het behalen van het reductiedoel.
Asks the government to justify why carbon leakage risk is considered minimised and why dispensation rights are transferable.
The PVV members request the government to further justify why the risk of leakage of employment and CO2 emissions abroad is considered minimised.
De leden van de PVV-fractie verzoeken de regering om nader te motiveren waarom het risico op weglek van werkgelegenheid en CO 2 -uitstoot naar het buitenland wordt geminimaliseerd.
Worries about carbon leakage, insufficient subsidies and infrastructure, and questions EU-law compatibility and the ex-post dispensation system, citing Raad van State and PBL criticism.
In this context they are concerned about the rapid rise in minimum prices per tonne of CO2 emissions in connection with possible leakage effects.
Zij maken zich in dat kader zorgen over de snelle oploop in minimumprijzen per ton CO 2 -uitstoot in verband met mogelijke weglekeffecten.
Supports the levy as a first step but asks for clarification on the probability of achieving the reduction target, avoidance routes, and whether QMV decision-making could reduce leakage.
The D66 members ask how it is prevented that the CO2 levy is evaded and how escape routes are closed off.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen hoe wordt voorkomen dat de CO 2 -heffing wordt ontweken en hoe ontsnappingsroutes zijn dichtgeschroeid.
Considers the proposal does not give the certainty needed for the 2030 target and wants the levy tightened and the industry emissions target raised.
They are therefore critical of the bill and would like to see the CO2 levy tightened.
Zij zijn daarom kritisch op het voorliggende wetsvoorstel en zouden graag zien dat de CO 2 -heffing wordt aangescherpt.

Argues the dispensation and trading mechanisms undermine effectiveness, that the speelveldtoets relied on industry-supplied information, and that the allocation of dispensation rights lacks openness and risks a black box.
Supports the step but questions the narrow scope, the crisis-justified delay, and the transferability of dispensation rights allowing relatively polluting installations to continue.
Cost-effective emission reduction requires CO2 pricing that is as broad as possible.
Kostenefficiënte emissiereductie vraagt om een zo breed mogelijke beprijzing van CO 2 .
Argues the levy is too weak, covers only industry, and that dispensation rights turn polluting into a right, calling for a uniform levy across all sectors.
The Partij voor de Dieren members are of the view that the CO2 levy as now designed contradicts the polluter-pays principle and is a weak incentive.

De leden van de Partij voor de Dieren-fractie zijn echter van mening dat de CO 2 -heffing zoals deze nu is vormgegeven, in strijd is met het principe «de vervuiler betaalt» en een zwakke prikkel is die zo niet leidt tot verandering.
Asks what the added value of a national levy is given the raised EU target and its consequences for the EU ETS, and about waste incineration and heat benchmarks.
They have several questions, including on the added value of a national levy in light of the raised European CO2 reduction target and its consequences for the EU ETS.

Zij hebben enkele vragen, onder meer over de toegevoegde waarde van een nationale heffing in het licht van de verhoogde Europese doelstelling voor CO 2 -emissiereductie en de gevolgen daarvan voor het EU ETS.
Asks for more insight into the precise effects of the levy on national CO2 emissions and carbon leakage risk.
Precisely because these targets are so important, these members find it important to gain insight into the precise effect of this levy on national CO2 emissions.
Juist omdat deze doelstellingen zo belangrijk zijn vinden deze leden het belangrijk om inzicht te krijgen in het precieze effect van deze heffing op de (nationale) CO 2 -uitstoot.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft CO2 levy for industry, raising concerns about effectiveness, the taxpayer and payment system, the tariff review provisions, the surplus-allowance recalculation, the minimum CO2 price for electricity, and EU ETS and state aid compatibility. The government's reply accepted most points by clarifying the text and memorandum, while defending the design against carbon leakage and EU ETS objections, and deferring the state aid analysis.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the front-loaded allowances and the timing of the reduction target would effectively drive investment, and asked for a fuller justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling doubted compatibility with the ETS Directive given carbon leakage risk and the interaction with the Market Stability Reserve, and asked for further explanation; the government rejected the concern while adding some explanation.
The Afdeling flagged possible selectivity under EU state aid rules because some emitters are excluded, and asked for objective justification; the government deferred this to ongoing analysis.
The Afdeling asked which party is taxpayer and how liability is allocated when the installation operator changes, and the government clarified the operator definition and successor liability.
The Afdeling noted that the statutory tariff review provisions in the bill were better placed in the explanatory memorandum, and the government moved them.

The Afdeling found the statutory text and explanation on recalculation of surplus allowances inconsistent and asked for alignment; the government aligned the memorandum with the bill and explained the procedure.

The Afdeling advised that the taxpayer provision for the minimum CO2 price for electricity generation be aligned with the industry levy and that the change be handled in parliament, and the government adjusted the definition.

35593.s: The bill adds to the Public Health Act a municipal task to offer prenatal home visits, through the youth health care organisation, to pregnant women and families in vulnerable situations, with the municipal council setting the size of that target group. It makes a conforming change to article 14 so the municipal task can be delegated under the existing rules.
35593.j: The memorandum justifies the municipal task as a way to give practical effect to prenatal home visits within existing legislation and national standards, with an evaluation after about four years.
q: To implement and give content to the prenatal home visit, maternity care providers and youth health care professionals will use this bill in conjunction with existing legislation.

Om uitvoering en invulling te geven aan het prenataal huisbezoek wordt door de verloskundig zorgverleners en de professionals van de JGZ-organisaties gebruik gemaakt van het voorliggende voorstel van wet in samenhang met vigerende wetgeving.
d: Artikel I A (artikel 2, tweede lid, onder i)
municipality determines size of prenatal home visit target group
p: Artikel I A (artikel 2, tweede lid, onder i)
Municipalities gain discretion to define the target group for prenatal home visits, a decision that determines who receives the service and affects the local budget.

parties: Asks why the rules are fixed in law given fragmentation risk, and whether municipal budgets will suffice, asking for earlier evaluation.
Is the government willing to assess at an earlier stage whether municipal budgets are sufficient to effectively implement prenatal home visits?
Is de regering bereid al in een eerder stadium te bezien of de gemeentelijke budgetten toereikend zijn om een effectieve invulling te geven aan het verrichten van prenataal huisbezoek?

Asks whether visits remain voluntary without indirect pressure, whether neighbourhood data could wrongly label families as vulnerable, and why no statutory legal basis was included for advising referrals.
Does this not run the risk that the neighbourhood one lives in determines whether the municipality labels one as vulnerable?
Wordt hiermee niet het risico gelopen dat de wijk waarin men woont bepaalt of men door de gemeente als kwetsbare wordt bestempeld?
Stresses that visits must stay voluntary and privacy must be guaranteed, asks for concrete criteria for information sharing by midwives and for evaluation data to be shared with parliament.
Doubts whether the EUR 5.3 million budget and EUR 190 per visit are sufficient and asks about timing and monitoring.
The SP members doubt whether this budget is sufficient, given the number of disadvantaged neighbourhoods in the Netherlands.
De leden van de SP-fractie betwijfelen of dit voldoende budget is, mede gezien de hoeveelheid kansarme wijken in Nederland.
Supports the measure but asks for shared lessons across municipalities and an earlier evaluation after two years rather than four.
These members believe that a promised quantitative and qualitative evaluation after four years is too long to wait in that light.
Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat een toegezegde kwantitatieve en kwalitatieve evaluatie na vier jaar in dat licht te lang op zich laat wachten.
Stresses parental responsibility for child-rearing, asks for confirmation that compulsion is excluded, and questions the vague definition of vulnerability and risk of stigmatisation.
The SGP members ask the government to confirm that forced prenatal visits are excluded.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering te bevestigen dat het uitgesloten is dat er sprake kan zijn van gedwongen prenataal bezoek.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet publieke gezondheid to add a municipal duty to conduct prenatal home visits, raising no substantive remarks and recommending that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that the redactional recommendations were incorporated into the explanatory memorandum and that the intended entry-into-force date was moved from 1 January 2021 to 1 July 2021 at the request of field parties.
concerns: The Afdeling made only redactional remarks, which the government incorporated into the explanatory memorandum.

35629.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean environmental act (Wet vrom BES) so that the general administrative order (AMvB) can set environmental quality requirements for installations that the island councils then flesh out through island ordinances, and it allows the ministry to require specific island rules. It also gives the minister and island executive a dwangbevel (enforceable payment order) to recover unpaid penalty payments and costs, with objection via court summons that does not suspend enforcement unless the court so orders.
35629.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by respect for local autonomy, local conditions on the islands, flexibility to respond to changing circumstances, and the national minister's retained responsibility for environment.
q: Therefore it is proposed to add an additional option to article 5.1 providing that the general administrative order may specify that island ordinances set further rules for installations on the specified subjects or categories of cases.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld om een extra mogelijkheid aan artikel 5.1 toe te voegen die erin voorziet dat bij de algemene maatregel van bestuur waarin op grond van het eerste lid milieuregels kunnen worden gesteld aan inrichtingen voor de daarbij aangegeven onderwerpen of categorieën van gevallen kan worden bepaald dat bij eilandverordening nadere regels worden gesteld
d: environmental rules for installations to be set by island ordinance
deviating case-specific requirements (maatwerkvoorschriften) by the competent authority
quality requirements for bathing establishments to be set by island ordinance
p: Shifts detailed installation environmental rule-making from the national executive to island governments, within quality requirements fixed in the AMvB.
Gives the minister and island executive an enforceable payment order with executory force, while objection is possible through court summons and enforcement is suspended only if the court orders.

parties: The VVD has read the bill with interest and has no questions.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no questions about it.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben daarover geen vragen.
The CDA has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The members of the CDA faction have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met interesse kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.
D66 asks whether licensing, supervision and enforcement capacity on the islands is adequate to implement and enforce the amendment.
These members therefore ask the government whether licensing, supervision and enforcement (VTH) have sufficient capacity on the islands to implement and enforce this amendment.
Deze leden vragen daarom de regering of vergunningverlening, toezicht en handhaving (VTH) voldoende capaciteit heeft op de eilanden voor het uitvoeren en handhaven van deze wetswijziging.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Wet volkshuisvesting, ruimtelijke ordening en milieubeheer BES on environmental aspects of establishments has no remarks and should be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes a single clarification to proposed article 10.5a, paragraph 1, adding the words on bestuursdwang or the owed dwangsom, and transmits the amended bill.

35638.s: The bill approves the government's intention to denounce part IV of the 1964 European Code of Social Security for the European part of the Netherlands, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: is approved for the European part of the Netherlands
wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland

parties: Asks whether other states have denounced parts of the Code, what consequences denunciation has, and for an overview of treaties that conflict with Dutch law.
Is the expectation that other member states will still do so?
Is de verwachting dat andere lidstaten dit nog wel gaan doen?
Asks whether a lower replacement rate with a longer minimum duration would comply with the Code and whether other EU countries are in breach.
They ask whether there are other EU countries that do not comply with Part IV of the Code and therefore intend to denounce it or have already done so.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen of er andere EU-landen zijn die niet aan deel IV van de Code voldoen en daarom voornemens zijn om op te zeggen of al hebben opgezegd.

Argues the government's justification for denouncing the treaty is unclear, since denouncing a treaty rather than adjusting national law requires 'good reasons', and asks the government to explain its reasoning and feasibility assessment.
In this context, the GroenLinks members consider the government's justification for denouncing Part IV of the European Code of Social Security unclear.
In deze context, achten de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie de door de regering geleverde onderbouwing voor het opzeggen van deel IV van de Europese Code inzake sociale zekerheid onduidelijk.

Questions the government's assumption about the legislative prerogative of future cabinets and parliament, and whether denunciation is justified given that treaties should only be denounced in exceptional circumstances.
Does the government endorse the principle that treaties can only be denounced in exceptional circumstances?
Onderschrijft de regering het uitgangspunt dat verdragen alleen in bijzondere omstandigheden kunnen worden opgezegd?
Strongly opposes denunciation during the pandemic and calls for its withdrawal, and asks why social partners in the Stichting van de Arbeid were not consulted before such a far-reaching decision.
First, the PvdA members find it incomprehensible that there has been no contact with the social partners in the Labour Foundation about this denunciation.
Allereerst is het wat betreft de leden van de PvdA-fractie het onbegrijpelijk dat over deze opzegging geen contact is geweest met sociale partners in de Stichting van de Arbeid.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised the government to submit the bill approving denunciation of Part IV of the European Code of Social Security, raising no substantive objections but offering editorial remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) states it followed the editorial remarks by adding a paragraph on the status of the revised Code and a new point 3 confirming Dutch unemployment legislation complies with the revised Code and ILO Convention No. 102.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to address the status of entry into force of the revised European Code of Social Security and whether Dutch unemployment legislation complies with it and ILO Convention No. 102; the government added a paragraph and a new point 3 accordingly.

35656.s: The bill amends the Criminal Code and Code of Criminal Procedure to implement EU Directive 2019/713 on combating fraud and counterfeiting of non-cash payment instruments. It defines non-cash payment instruments, widens offences on possessing, transferring and distributing such instruments, and adds the computer offence of Article 138c to the list in Article 67 Sv so that special investigative powers can be used.
35656.j: The memorandum justifies the extension of investigative powers as necessary to implement Article 13 of the Directive, which requires effective investigative powers for these offences.
q: Because the application of these powers may be important for investigating this computer offence, Article 138c Sr is added to Article 67 Sv to implement Article 13.
Omdat de toepassing van deze bevoegdheden van belang kan zijn voor de opsporing van dit computerdelict, wordt artikel 138c Sr ter implementatie van artikel 13 aan artikel 67 Sv toegevoegd
p: Artikel II (artikel 67 lid 1 onder b Sv)
Adds Article 138c Sr to the offences for which special investigative powers such as data search and seizure and remote computer investigation may be used.

parties: Asks whether victims can always file a report and what happens when police refuse to record a complaint about internet fraud.
At the same time these members have taken note of complaints from Dutch citizens who wanted to report internet fraud but were not helped by the police.
Tegelijkertijd hebben deze leden kennisgenomen van klachten van Nederlanders die aangifte wilden doen van internetfraude, maar door de politie niet werden geholpen.
Questions whether the reporting channels give enough urgency to online financial crime and whether victims get adequate, targeted protection.
Victims of online financial crime are often hit for tens of thousands of euros and often face a reluctant officer who considers it a civil matter.
Slachtoffers van online financiële criminaliteit worden vaak voor (tien)duizenden euro's getroffen en worden vaak geconfronteerd met een weigerachtige verbalisant.
Asks how far the directive changes existing Dutch law and cross-border judicial cooperation, and whether workload increases can be absorbed.
Welcomes that the government incorporated the Council of State's advice and has no further questions.
They note with approval that the government has incorporated the advice of the Council of State's advisory division.
Zij constateren met instemming dat de regering de adviezen van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft verwerkt.
Asks about the subjective fraudulent intent element, the minimum maximum penalties and uneven enforcement across member states, questioning how the directive is applied.
Can the government explain why the minimum maximum penalty has consistently been chosen?
Kan de regering aangeven waarom steeds is gekozen voor de minimale maximumstraf?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2019/713 on combating fraud with non-cash payment instruments, noting that the explanatory memorandum should clarify how each conduct in the Directive is implemented, notably acquisition-type conduct under article 232(2) Sr. The Minister's reply accepts the advice and states that the article-by-article explanation of article 232(2) Sr has been supplemented.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should specify, conduct by conduct, how each non-cash payment fraud conduct from the Directive is implemented in article 232(2) Sr.

It is unclear whether acquisition, appropriation, distribution and making available conduct not explicitly listed already falls under existing criminal offences, so clarity is needed on the meaning of the elements.

35665.s: The bill amends the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act to bring electronic heating devices for tobacco under its product rules, and creates a legal basis for ministerial regulation setting standardized (neutral) appearance requirements for cigarettes. Some provisions are dated to take effect alongside implementing regulations.
35665.j: The memorandum justifies the new delegation by saying the existing basis in art. 2.3 of the decree does not cover appearance rules, so a statutory basis is needed to set detailed standardized cigarette appearance requirements for public health.
q: Moreover, article 2(1) of the Act, which forms the basis for article 2.3 of the decree, only allows requirements on composition and technical specifications of tobacco products and e-cigarettes by general administrative order, not on appearance.

Daar komt bij dat in artikel 2, eerste lid, van de wet – dat de grondslag vormt voor artikel 2.3 van het besluit – de mogelijkheid biedt om bij algemene maatregel van bestuur eisen te stellen aan de samenstelling en de technische eisen van tabaksproducten en elektronische sigaretten.
d: appearance requirements for cigarettes (colour, markings, shape, size)
packaging requirements and rules for electronic heating devices
ban or conditions on distance sales of electronic heating devices, including age verification
p: Creates a statutory basis allowing the minister to set detailed, binding standards on the appearance of cigarettes by ministerial regulation, with the statute listing only broad categories of permitted requirements.

parties: Asks how the government will ensure a balanced presentation of research on tobacco products, given the Council of State's criticism of how study results were portrayed.
The Council of State, in its advice, repeatedly criticises in the bill how the research results on the harmfulness of the various tobacco and related products are presented.

De Raad van State heeft in zijn advisering op diverse plekken in het wetsvoorstel kritiek op de weergave van de onderzoeksresultaten over de schadelijkheid van de verschillende tabaks- en aanverwante producten.
Questions the evidential basis for standardised cigarette appearance, the risk of illegal trade and the exclusion of vaporisers, and asks for research that the government has not yet done.
Has the government investigated whether smokers may switch to lower-quality, cheaper products or even the cheapest illegal tobacco brands?
Heeft de regering onderzocht of rokers mogelijk zullen overstappen naar producten van lagere kwaliteit en prijs, of wellicht zelfs naar de goedkoopste, illegale tabaksmerken?
Supports the rookvrije generatie goals but asks for clarity on the breadth of the electronic device definition, packaging rules, enforcement capacity and the timing of implementing regulations.
The CDA members ask whether the government can explain whether there is a risk that this definition could be interpreted too broadly.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten of hiermee niet het risico bestaat dat deze definitie te breed geïnterpreteerd kan worden.
Agrees with working towards a smoke-free generation and applying the same rules to electronic heating devices as to normal cigarettes.
The D66 members share the government's view that we must work towards a smoke-free generation and that the same rules should apply to electronic heating devices as to normal cigarettes.

De leden van de D66-fractie delen de mening van de regering dat we naar een rookvrije generatie toe moeten werken en dat voor elektronische verhittingsapparaten dezelfde regels moeten gaan gelden als voor normale sigaretten.
Asks how the age-verification system for online sales will work and whether it is reliable, and how the lower harm of e-cigarettes was weighed in the proposal.
What does such an age verification system look like in practice?
Hoe ziet een dergelijk leeftijdsverificatiesysteem er in de praktijk uit?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on a bill tightening rules on electronic heating devices for tobacco and imposing a new statutory power to set appearance requirements for cigarettes, raising a tension with the cannabis coffeeshop experiment, the presentation of research findings, and the need for the new delegation. The government's reply accepted the requests to clarify the explanatory memorandum, added justification for the new delegation and a differentiated entry-into-force, and explained why it sees no conflict with the experiment.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not adequately justify the necessity of the new delegation for setting appearance requirements on cigarettes, and the government added a fuller motivation in a new section.
The bill's stricter regime for vaporizers may conflict with the cannabis coffeeshop experiment; the government disagreed that a conflict exists but added clarifications to the memorandum.
Research findings on the harmfulness of heated tobacco were incompletely presented and one source was unclear; the government precisified and supplemented the memorandum.

35674.s: The bill extends the period during which designations of military airfields under the Aviation Act remain valid, from twelve years after the 2008 amendment to 1 January 2030. It also replaces the transitional provision so that the Minister of Defence must report annually to the States General on progress in adopting airport decisions.
35674.j: The memorandum justifies the extension by pointing to appeals and the need for more time to adapt noise rules from the Ke to the Lden system.
q: As the above shows, more time is again required to realise the transition from designations of aviation sites to airport decisions.
Zoals uit het vorenstaande blijkt, is andermaal meer tijd vereist om de overgang van aanwijzingen van luchtvaartterreinen naar luchthavenbesluiten te kunnen realiseren.

parties: Argues the twelve-year period is too long for airports already in use and questions whether residents and local governments were consulted early enough and whether alternatives were examined.
Nevertheless, these members believe that it should not take more than twelve years before airport decisions are adopted, especially for military airports already in use.

Desalniettemin zijn deze leden van mening dat het niet langer dan twaalf jaar zou moeten hoeven duren alvorens Luchthavenbesluiten zijn afgevaardigd, zeker voor militaire luchthavens die reeds in gebruik zijn.

Stresses strong public opposition to the expansion of military airfields and questions the quality control of environmental impact assessments and the length of the extension to 2030, asking for the burden to be reconsidered.
However, these members prefer that this heavy burden be reconsidered.
Het heeft echter de voorkeur van deze leden dat deze hoge belasting wordt heroverwogen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending the period during which aanwijzingen under the Luchtvaartwet for military aerodromes retain their validity and introducing an annual reporting duty. The Afdeling raised no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer; the government's reply only supplied a Kamerstuk number that was not yet known at the time of advice.

35683.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport through a fifth supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures, adjusting spending and receipts across policy articles in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment to take effect from 18 December 2020 and gives no new powers to the executive.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for 2020 (fifth incidental supplementary budget on Corona measures)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2020 (5e incidentele suppletoire begroting inzake Coronamaatregelen)

35692.s: The bill approves the 2018 Benelux police cooperation treaty and, to implement it, amends the Dutch Criminal Code and Criminal Procedure Code so that foreign police officers operating in the Netherlands are treated as Dutch officials for criminal law and use-of-force purposes. It also allows foreign officers to continue arrests on international trains or ships and requires a review of the treaty's effectiveness within three years.
35692.j: The memorandum justifies the cross-border powers by the treaty's aim of simpler operational cooperation and by the need for foreign officers to be as competent with their powers as domestic officers, while stating that no new powers beyond national law are granted.
d: departure timing for arrested persons returned abroad
p: Allows foreign officials to continue an arrest on Dutch territory and hold the person for up to six hours before handover abroad, with prompt transfer to Dutch officers as the only safeguard.
Extends criminal-law and use-of-force protections and powers to foreign public officers operating in the Netherlands, applying Dutch rules to them on equal footing with Dutch officials.
Requires the minister to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the law and treaty.

parties: Asks how cross-border pursuit is bounded, whether powers of Benelux services are sufficiently aligned, and how special units' criminal liability and training are arranged.
Can the government further explain which obstacles currently still exist?
Kan de regering nader toelichten welke belemmeringen op dit moment nog bestaan?
Asks for the basis of the cost estimate and why the data-sharing clause does not require an explicit basis in national or EU law, as the Data Protection Authority advised.
Can the government further explain why that interpretation was not used for a formulation requiring an explicit basis in national or EU law?
Kan de regering verder toelichten waarom met die uitleg niet gekozen is voor een formulering die een expliciete grondslag in het nationale recht of het Unierecht vereist?
Asks whether cross-border pursuit extends to all offences including minor ones, and why the Netherlands keeps the bailiff model while partners may waive it.
Can no practical situations be envisaged in which one cannot wait for an official of the host state?
Zijn er geen (praktische) situaties te bedenken waarbij er niet gewacht kan worden op een ambtenaar van de gaststaat?
Insists that Dutch rules keep applying when foreign police act on Dutch territory or use Dutch information systems, and asks whether detailed implementing agreements will be submitted to the House.
Can the government indicate how this will remain guaranteed?
Kan de regering aangeven op welke wijze dit gewaarborgd blijft?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Benelux police treaty bill inadequately implements the obligation in Article 49 to equate the criminal liability of visiting and host state officials, since offences that only apply when committed by or against an official were not covered, and suggested also addressing offences with aggravated penalties. The government's reply accepted these points, extended the equalisation to further offences in the Criminal Code and adjusted the entry-into-force provision.
concerns: The bill does not sufficiently implement the obligation under Article 49 of the Benelux police treaty to equate criminal liability of foreign officials for offences that only apply when committed by or against an official.
Equalisation should also extend to offences that only carry a higher penalty when committed by or against an official, and the explanatory memorandum should address this.

35746.s: The bill amends the Dutch Animal Act (Wet dieren) to update animal health rules on a number of minor points, including allowing the minister to require holders to inform buyers of disease, adding administrative fine powers for two provisions, and removing the obligation to regulate fees for expert valuers. It also makes technical adjustments to publication timing, EU decision implementation, and the Economic Offences Act.
35746.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the buyer-notification power by disease control needs and the fining extension by the need for effective enforcement and protection of animal and public health.
q: With a view to effective enforcement, it is desirable that the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality has the power to impose administrative fines as a deterrent.

Met het oog op een effectieve handhaving is het wenselijk dat de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit de bevoegdheid heeft om, bij wijze van lik-op-stuk, bestuurlijke boetes op te kunnen leggen
d: publication of animal disease control regulations taking immediate effect
obligation on holders to inform third parties about suspicion or infection
p: The minister may oblige animal holders to inform buyers about disease, limited to cases where the seller already holds buyer contact details.
The minister may impose administrative fines for violations of articles 5.15(1) and 8.4, extending fining powers.

parties: Asks what the information duty requires of keepers and how keepers gain clarity about their obligations, given the duty is conditional on the seller holding buyer contact details.
So what does the 'information duty' actually entail? What must a keeper do or not do, when does he comply, and when is there a failure to comply?
Wat houdt dan de «informatieplicht» in? Waar moet een houder straks wel en niet aan voldoen, wanneer voldoet hij aan de plicht, en wanneer is sprake van het verzaken hiervan?
Doubts the voluntary information duty will work in practice, asks which enforcement instruments will guarantee compliance, and asks about culling capacity during outbreaks.
These members doubt whether the information duty will work in practice if it is applied on a voluntary basis, especially given the large number of keepers involved.
Deze leden hebben twijfels of de informatieplicht in de praktijk tot zijn recht zal komen wanneer dit op vrijwillige basis gebeurt, zeker gezien het om een grote hoeveelheid houders gaat.
Has no questions on the bill at this stage.
These members currently have no questions about it.
Deze leden hebben daarover op dit moment geen vragen
Asks for a broader ban on self-killing of animals and asks about the enforceability for animal police, and calls for clearer language about mass gassing or killing of animals.
These members ask the government henceforth to speak of the mass gassing or killing of animals instead of using a euphemistic term such as 'culling'.
Deze leden vragen de regering voortaan te spreken van het massaal vergassen of doden van dieren in plaats van een verhullende term als «ruimen» te gebruiken.
Asks how compliance with the information duty will be monitored and enforced, and whether problems have arisen in practice with keepers not informing buyers.
How does the government expect to keep track of compliance with this information duty? How does it intend to enforce this information duty?
Hoe verwacht de regering zicht te houden op de naleving van deze informatieplicht? Op welke wijze wil zij deze informatieplicht handhaven?
Asks for disease contingency plans to be made current and public, and for transparency about how expert appraisers value animals in compensation.
Does the government want to properly arrange or resolve this in the short term?
Wil de regering dit op korte termijn goed regelen of oplossen?
Argues that the scope and meaning of the ban must be defined by the legislator and experts rather than left to future court interpretation, and asks how the AMvB and convenant will be specified.

It should not be up to the judge to interpret what is meant by 'the intrinsic value of the animal'; such provisions must be drawn up by experts and scientists, then defined by the legislator, so that judges can test against them.

Het zou immers niet aan de rechter moeten zijn om te interpreteren wat verstaan wordt onder «de intrinsieke waarde van het dier»; dergelijke bepalingen moeten door experts en wetenschappers worden opgesteld, vervolgens door de wetgever worden gedefinieerd, zodat rechters daaraan kunnen toetsen.
Stresses that the convenant's elaboration is crucial for judging the amendment and hopes it will be finalised quickly.
They wish to emphasise, however, that the elaboration of the convenant dierwaardige veehouderij is of crucial importance for the substantive assessment of the amendment.
Zij willen echter benadrukken dat de uitwerking van het convenant dierwaardige veehouderij van cruciaal belang is bij het inhoudelijk beoordelen van de wijziging.

Objects that the amendment is an empty reference to a not-yet-drafted AMvB, so no judgement is possible; notes the Raad van State criticised the delayed entry into force as contrary to the Constitution.
These members point out that what is now before us is merely an empty reference to a general administrative order (AMvB) yet to be drafted.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat wat er nu voorligt, slechts een lege verwijzing is naar een nog op te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB).
Asks whether the government takes account of enforceability, other EU member states' approaches, and whether only essential behavioural needs should be covered.
These members wish to point out that the point is to prevent clear welfare problems.
Deze leden willen erop wijzen dat het erom gaat dat duidelijke welzijnsproblemen worden voorkomen.

Questions the scientific basis produced under time pressure, the timetable for the convenant, the missing socio-economic impact analysis, and the lack of budget, and asks the government to postpone entry into force.
Because of this time pressure, a number of scientists drew up a document that has been met with considerable criticism, at least from the agricultural sectors.
Vanwege deze tijdsdruk hebben een aantal wetenschappers een stuk opgesteld dat door in ieder geval de landbouwsectoren met veel kritiek is ontvangen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Wet dieren to update animal health rules and make technical adjustments, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply notes that a technical addition was made to empower the minister to impose administrative fines for violations of notification and cooperation duties under articles 5.15 and 8.4.

35755.s: The bill adds a provision to the Dutch Civil Code making any consumer gift-card clause that limits validity to less than two years unreasonably onerous in standard terms. It exempts contracts concluded before the provision takes effect and sets the entry-into-force date by royal decree.
35755.j: The memorandum justifies the change as strengthening consumer protection and notes that enforcement stays with the consumer authority ACM, which has already assessed the provision as enforceable.
q: The present amendment adds a provision to the above-mentioned section, which will apply to gift cards in place of article 6:236, under g, of the Civil Code.
Onderhavige wetswijziging voegt een bepaling toe aan bovengenoemde afdeling, die komt te gelden voor cadeaubonnen in plaats van artikel 6:236, onderdeel g, BW.

parties: Asks whether self-regulation was considered before legislating, why two years was chosen when the industry standard is three, and whether the rule applies retroactively.
Why was a minimum validity of at least two years chosen in the bill when the Keurmerk already uses three years?
Waarom is er dan gekozen in het wetsvoorstel voor een geldigheidsduur van minimaal twee jaar?
Asks for data on current validity periods and questions the legal clarity of two overlapping statutory provisions and the absence of a generic rule.
Why was a generic provision not chosen?
Waarom is er niet gekozen voor een generieke bepaling?

Raises legal certainty concerns about the lack of a statutory definition of cadeaubon, the risk of two categories of vouchers, and enforcement by the ACM; also asks for ACM and ATR advice to be addressed.
It is feared, however, that because there is no statutory definition and sections g and t of article 6:236 BW overlap, two categories of gift vouchers will persist.
Gevreesd wordt echter dat door het ontbreken van een wettelijke definitie en samenloop van onderdelen g en t van artikel 6:236 BW er twee categorieën van cadeaubonnen blijven bestaan.
Supports the bill but asks whether consumers are adequately informed about expiry dates and whether a statutory definition would allow circumvention through alternative vouchers.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill extending the minimum validity of gift vouchers to two years in Book 6 of the Dutch Civil Code. The Afdeling had no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the House of Representatives, so no government reply was needed.

35764.s: The bill amends the Bibob Act to expand information sharing between administrative bodies, including a new tip power for bodies, disclosure of danger conclusions and fiscal penalty data, and extends Bibob screening to environmental plan changes and water board permits. It also makes related amendments to the Omgevingswet, Wmg and Wet personenvervoer 2000.
35764.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the expanded information sharing and tip powers as necessary to strengthen integrity risk assessment and reduce facilitation of criminal activity, citing proportionality and privacy safeguards.
q: This is necessary for a more effective signalling function towards other administrative bodies to enable a better risk assessment by administrative bodies.
Dit is nodig voor een effectievere signaalfunctie naar andere bestuursorganen om een betere risico-inschatting door bestuursorganen mogelijk te maken
d: fiscal penalty data sharing for own investigations
p: Authorizes tax authorities to disclose fiscal penalty data about third parties to administrative bodies for Bibob investigations, expanding executive access to personal data.
Creates tip powers and inter-agency information sharing, enabling bodies to flag and exchange information on persons without the subject's knowledge.
Allows refusal of environmental plan amendments applications under the Bibob framework.

parties: Asks whether the tip power covers offences committed abroad and how the reach of the tip power works in practice, and whether the AFM can share information with the LBB.
Can the government sketch, with more examples, when administrative bodies can use the tip power?
Kan de regering aan de hand van meer voorbeelden schetsen wanneer bestuursorganen de tipbevoegdheid kunnen gebruiken?
Asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens can adequately supervise data sharing between administrative bodies and how the cumulative expansion of powers is checked.
Can the government explain how supervision of data sharing is arranged in this amendment?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe het toezicht op het datadelen in deze wetswijziging is geregeld?

Questions whether a person can inspect danger conclusions about them, whether the wording on contributing to danger and straw-man constructions is too broad, and what safeguards apply when a tip is received.
These members ask which safeguards are built into implementation to ensure that a person about whom a tip has been received is still objectively assessed.
Deze leden vragen welke waarborgen er in de uitvoering zijn ingebouwd die ervoor zorgen dat een betrokkene, nadat er een tip over hem/haar is ontvangen, toch objectief wordt getoetst.

Warns of privacy intrusion from extending the tip power to administrative fines, cites the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens' advice to remove that part, and asks for a check by the LBB on reliability and lawfulness of shared information.

The AP advises very clearly to delete that last part from the bill, because the amount of data and number of persons about whom tips could be given would expand so much that privacy intrusion becomes greater.

De AP adviseert, heel duidelijk, om dat laatste gedeelte uit het wetsvoorstel te schrappen, omdat de omvang van de gegevens en het aantal betrokkenen waarover dan zou mogen worden getipt, dusdanig wordt uitgebreid dat er sprake is van een grotere inbreuk op de privacy.
Asks how administrative bodies know which body to tip and whether shared information is verified, warning against sharing vague or unfounded suspicions given privacy protection.
If not, how can it be prevented that administrative bodies also share vague or unfounded suspicions with each other?
Zo nee, hoe kan voorkomen worden dat bestuursorganen ook vage of ongefundeerde vermoedens met elkaar gaan delen?

Asks about municipal powers to impose licensing requirements and Bibob tests for specific business categories and how local policy relates to the national Act; notes continued circumvention by property owners.
They ask about the coherence between local Bibob policy lines and the national Bibob Act when designating categories where a Bibob test is possible or mandatory.
Zij vragen naar de samenhang tussen de lokale beleidslijnen Bibob en de landelijke Wet Bibob bij de aanwijzing van categorieën waar een Bibob-toets mogelijk, dan wel verplicht is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet Bibob to expand information sharing between administrative bodies and to create a specific legal basis for tax authorities to share fine data, raising concerns about distinguishing types of tax fines. The government's reply accepts the advice, clarifies which fine categories may be shared and why, and amends the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that it be clear whether only final tax fines or also contested and annulled fines may be shared, and that necessity and proportionality be justified per category.
Extra care is needed to justify sharing data on fines that were not upheld, since the fine did not remain in force in those cases.

35791.s: The bill amends Book 1 of the Dutch Civil Code for the Caribbean Netherlands to add safety to the child's welfare duty and to state that parents may not use psychological or physical violence or other degrading treatment in raising a child. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree and delegates no rule-making power.
q: In the care and upbringing of the child, parents shall not apply psychological or physical violence or any other degrading treatment.
In de verzorging en opvoeding van het kind passen de ouders geen geestelijk of lichamelijk geweld of enige andere vernederende behandeling toe.

parties: Supports the explicit ban on violence in upbringing and asks the government to speed up the reporting and advice points for domestic violence.
They stress that, alongside clear legal anchoring, shaping the necessary information and assistance is of great importance.
Zij benadrukken dat, naast een duidelijke wettelijke verankering, het vormgeven van de benodigde voorlichting en hulpverlening van groot belang is.
Welcomes a clear norm on violence in child rearing on the BES islands and asks about preventive effects and court outcomes.
They consider it important that, especially on a point such as violence in child upbringing, there is no room over what is permitted and what is not, including on the BES islands.
Zij achten het van belang, dat zeker op een punt als geweld in de opvoeding van kinderen, er geen ruimte bestaat over wat is toegestaan en wat niet, ook op de BES-eilanden.
Supports the ban but presses on the status of meldpunten, the absence of a meldcode and a possible Jeugdwet for the BES, and asks for reporting on effectiveness.
Furthermore, the above-mentioned members ask whether there is not broader reason to arrive at a Youth Act for the BES.
Voorts vragen de bovengenoemde leden of niet breder aanleiding is om tot een Jeugdwet voor de BES te komen.
Supports uniform legal treatment but questions how far the ban has changed case law that still accepts a justified corrective slap in specific circumstances.
These members have the impression that case law still in specific circumstances proceeds from a responsible corrective slap within the framework of parental corrective right.

Deze leden hebben de indruk dat in de jurisprudentie in specifieke omstandigheden bijvoorbeeld nog steeds wordt uitgegaan van een verantwoorde corrigerende tik in het kader van het ouderlijk tuchtigingsrecht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending Book 1 of the Dutch Civil Code for the Caribbean Netherlands (BES) to prohibit physical or mental violence and degrading treatment of children in care and upbringing. The Afdeling made no substantive remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, and the minister's reply simply forwards the bill.

35818.s: The bill amends article 9.6 of the Environmental Management Act to update the legal basis for rules requiring contracting authorities to take clean vehicle minimum targets into account in procurement, implementing EU Directive 2019/1161. It replaces the title and article 9.6.1, which now allows an algemene maatregel van bestuur to set those rules, and takes effect on 2 August 2021.
35818.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to update the legal basis after the directive's citation title changed, so that a new ministerial regulation can implement the amended directive.
q: The newly proposed article 9.6.1 of the Wm will provide the legal basis for adopting a new ministerial regulation.
Het nieuw voorgestelde artikel 9.6.1 van de Wm zal de wettelijke basis gaan bieden voor het vaststellen van een nieuwe ministeriële regeling
d: rules on procurement of clean road vehicles and minimum targets

parties: Asks how the EU minimum procurement targets were set, whether they are adjusted, and whether the targets are feasible for the Netherlands.
These members ask on what basis these minimum targets were set and determined.
Deze leden vragen waarop deze minimumstreefcijfers zijn gebaseerd en vastgesteld.
Questions why the Netherlands sets higher minimum targets than other member states and whether the implementation makes cars unaffordable and burdens the transport sector.
The PVV members want to know why the Netherlands applies the highest minimum target until 2025 for public procurement of clean light and heavy commercial vehicles.

De leden van de PVV-fractie willen van de regering weten waarom Nederland tot aan 2025 het hoogste minimumstreefcijfer hanteert voor overheidsopdrachten voor het aandeel schone lichte bedrijfsvoertuigen en schone zware bedrijfsvoertuigen.
Accepts delegation to a ministerial regulation but asks for a pre-consultation provision (voorhangbepaling) to guarantee parliamentary involvement.
However, these members ask to include a pre-consultation provision in the law so that parliamentary involvement in the ministerial regulation is guaranteed.
Wel vragen deze leden om een voorhangbepaling op te nemen in de wet, zodat parlementaire betrokkenheid bij de invulling van de ministeriële regeling gegarandeerd is.
Doubts that enforcement through civil summary proceedings is effective and asks why a supervisory body was not designated instead.
These members ask why some form of supervision of enforcement of the applicable rules has not been assigned to a supervisory body.
