Deze leden vragen waarom er niet een vorm van toezicht op de handhaving van de van toepassing zijnde regels is belegd bij een toezichthoudende instantie.
Argues the obligations are too minimal given the EU room for more ambitious targets and asks for alignment with the Klimaatakkoord and a zero-emission target for heavy vehicles.
However, the draft ministerial regulation shows that the minimum is being done, not the maximum.
Uit het concept van de ministeriële regeling blijkt echter dat het minimale wordt gedaan, en niet het maximale.
Asks why higher targets permitted by the directive were not chosen and how municipalities will be supported with rising short-term costs.
These members wonder whether there is a distinction in costs for municipalities between, for example, 2020 and 2027 and the subsequent period 2027–2035.
Deze leden vragen zich af of er een onderscheid is in de kosten voor gemeenten tussen bijvoorbeeld 2020 en 2027 en de daaropvolgende periode van 2027–2035.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Wet milieubeheer to implement EU Directive 2019/1161 on clean and energy-efficient road vehicles. The Afdeling had no substantive remarks and advised submitting the bill to the Tweede Kamer, so no government reply was needed.

35836.s: The bill temporarily allows higher education institutions to enrol students for academic year 2021–2022 who could not meet prior-education or admission requirements because of COVID-19, provided they meet them later, and halves the full statutory tuition fee for that year. It also creates a legal basis for an extra travel allowance for students and temporarily raises the maximum student loan for tuition credit.
35836.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to the ministerial regulation by the unpredictability of the coronavirus crisis, which requires flexibility to respond to unforeseen circumstances.
q: Because the development of the coronavirus crisis cannot be predicted, the provision was formulated so as to leave room to anticipate unforeseen circumstances.
Omdat de ontwikkeling van de coronacrisis zich echter niet laat voorspellen, is ervoor gekozen de bepaling zodanig te formuleren dat er ruimte bestaat te anticiperen op onvoorziene omstandigheden
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (artikel 7.37d, lid 6 WHW)
detailed enrolment conditions and institutional policy topics
Artikel II, onderdeel B (artikel 13.2a, lid 2 Wsf 2000)
eligibility, amount and grant method of extra travel allowance
p: Institutions may admit students who do not meet statutory prior-education or admission requirements, a temporary discretionary power exercised under institutional policy and subject to later de-enrolment obligations and an appeal route to the complaints committee.
Eligibility and amount of the extra travel allowance are left to a ministerial regulation, with retroactive allowance permitted and the usual travel-allowance rule disapplied.

parties: Asks whether institutions may still refuse students lacking entry requirements, how COVID-related delay is proven, and whether the reasoning for halving tuition for first-years is consistent.
Asks for data on students who progressed through the soft admission route and for research on lessons for the hard-cut admission principle.
These members also ask whether the government is researching what can be learned from the temporary soft cut about the hard cut as an organising principle.
Tevens vragen de voorgenoemde leden of de regering onderzoek doet naar wat we van de tijdelijke zachte knip over de harde knip als inrichtingsprincipe kunnen leren.
Supports the measures and asks about study delay forecasts and the reason tuition for institutional fees is lowered but not for non-funded programmes.
The members further ask why institutional tuition is lowered while tuition at non-funded institutions is not.
De leden vragen voorts wat de reden is dat het instellingscollegegeld wel verlaagd wordt en het collegegeld van niet-bekostigde instellingen niet.
Objects that graduated bachelor students are excluded from tuition compensation and that travel compensation differs unfairly between students.
Can the government explain why this group is treated differently from those who still continue studying, they ask.
Kan de regering toelichten waarom deze groep anders wordt behandeld dan zij die nog doorstuderen, zo vragen zij.
Asks why students who started and completed a one-year programme in 2020/2021 are not covered by the compensation scheme.
The members ask the government whether, on these grounds, a compensation scheme should also be sought for one-year students.
De leden vragen de regering of op basis van deze redenen er ook gezocht moet worden naar een compensatieregeling voor de eenjarige studenten.
Asks how the government prevents the extra entitlements from increasing study delay and how the COVID delay criterion is interpreted and applied equally across institutions.
Does the government intend a broad interpretation and, if so, how is it ensured that students at different institutions can claim comparable entitlements, they ask.
Beoogt de regering een ruime uitleg en zo ja, hoe wordt gewaarborgd dat studenten bij verschillende instellingen een vergelijkbare aanspraak kunnen maken, zo vragen zij.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill with temporary COVID-19 measures for higher education and student finance for 2021-2022 and raised no substantive remarks, recommending submission to parliament. The minister's nader rapport confirms the bill was submitted with an updated explanatory memorandum that clarifies a few points, including references to service documents and financial and travel-allowance details.

35845.s: The bill suspends indexation of the basic child benefit amount and the extra child benefit amount under the General Child Benefit Act for 2022 and 2023, and lowers the 2024 indexation percentage by 0.1 percentage point. The suspension provision expires on 1 January 2025.
35845.j: The memorandum justifies the measure as removing financial bottlenecks in implementation at UWV, SVB and BKWI and notes that the SVB sees no feasibility issue, without delegating any new power.
q: Notwithstanding Article 13, second and third paragraphs: a. the amounts referred to in Articles 7a, second paragraph, and 12, first paragraph, will not be changed from 1 January 2022 for the years 2022 and 2023

In afwijking van artikel 13, tweede en derde lid: a. worden de bedragen, genoemd in de artikelen 7a, tweede lid, en 12, eerste lid, met ingang van 1 januari 2022 over de jaren 2022 en 2023 niet gewijzigd

parties: Asks how the extra funds for UWV, SVB and BKWI will be spent and wants measurable effectiveness and efficiency made visible for later evaluation.

The members consider it important that this bill also makes clear what the efficiency and effectiveness of the money to be spent is, so that it can also be taken into account in the evaluation of the entire implementation.

De leden vinden het van belang dat ook bij dit wetsvoorstel duidelijk gemaakt wordt wat de doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid van het te besteden geld is, zodat deze ook meegenomen kunnen worden in de evaluatie van de gehele uitvoering.
Asks for the child benefit amount with and without indexation and whether parents with severely ill children should be exempted from non-indexation.
The D66 members also ask whether the government has considered exempting parents with a child living at home who needs intensive care from this non-indexation.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen daarnaast of de regering heeft overwogen om de ouders met een thuiswonend kind dat intensieve zorg nodig heeft vrij te stellen van deze niet-indexatie.
Finds the non-indexation highly undesirable, asks about alternatives and the euro impact per income group, and objects that agency problems are placed on parents.
These members find it undesirable that problems at the implementing agencies end up on the plate of parents.
Deze leden vinden dat het onwenselijk dat problemen bij de uitvoeringsorganisaties op het bordje van ouders komen te liggen.
Asks why a higher AOF premium was not chosen, and what non-indexation means for child poverty and for Caribbean Netherlands.
Is the assumption of the PvdA members correct that non-indexation of child benefit will increase the number of children in poverty?
Klopt de aanname van de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat door het niet-indexeren van de kinderbijslag het aantal kinderen in armoede zal toenemen?
Doubts the balanced financing and why parents should fund implementation investments rather than general revenue; asks about alternatives considered.
Why is this investment not covered from general funds?
Waarom wordt deze investering niet gedekt uit de algemene middelen?
Questions the rationale for choosing child benefit as the funding source, suggests employers or the labour market instruments as alternatives, and asks about child poverty figures.
Therefore, would it not be more logical to seek a larger share of the funding from employers, instead of from the child schemes?
Ligt het daarom niet voor de hand om een ruimer deel van de dekking bij werkgevers te zoeken, in plaats van bij de kindregelingen?
Questions necessity and motivation, asks the government to take the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk's critical advice seriously, and says the choices undermine the image of a fair government.
They ask the government to take this government advisory body seriously and to respond to the separate points of the advice after all.
Zij vragen de regering dit adviesorgaan van de regering serieus te nemen en alsnog op de onderscheiden punten van het advies in te gaan.
Considers it unfair that agency costs are borne by parents with children, including those with intensive care needs, and calls for other funding.
The BIJ1 member does not find it fair that the government's implementation costs should be paid at the expense of child benefit.
Het lid van de fractie van BIJ1 vindt het niet eerlijk dat uitvoeringskosten van de overheid ten koste moeten gaan van de kinderbijslag.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill not to index the basic child benefit amount and the extra child benefit amount for 2022, 2023 and partly 2024, and raised no remarks. The minister's reply (nader rapport) is included but the government simply accompanies the bill, so no points required a response.

35854.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adding an eighth supplementary budget for COVID-19 measures of about 779 million euros in extra expenditure on the public health article. It sets the amendment to take effect on 4 June 2021 and includes no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35872.s: The bill abolishes the collectivity discount on health insurance premiums by deleting references to it in the Zorgverzekeringswet and replacing article 18 with a narrower provision on exchanging citizen service numbers between employers and insurers. It enters into force on a date set by royal decree and leaves the abolition of the discount itself to statute rather than delegation.
35872.j: The memorandum justifies abolishing the collectivity discount by pointing to the NZa analysis and the social character of health insurance, and it notes the NZa can still supervise discounts above 5 percent of the premium base.
q: Abolishing the collectivity discount simplifies the NZa's task, since it no longer needs to supervise the discount offered on health insurance.

Het afschaffen van de collectiviteitskorting brengt een vereenvoudiging mee van de taak van de NZa, aangezien er niet langer toezicht hoeft te worden gehouden op de geboden collectiviteitskorting voor de zorgverzekering.

parties: Asks for legal advice obtained, the NZa's rejection of open norms, and monitoring of effects on premiums and minima.
The VVD members would like to know which external or internal legal advice was obtained regarding the abolition of the collective discount and the bill.

De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag weten welke externe of interne juridische adviezen er zijn ingewonnen met betrekking tot het afschaffen van de collectiviteitskorting c.q. het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks why no evaluation clause is included and whether minimum criteria or alternatives were considered.
The D66 members note there is no evaluation provision in the law.
De leden van de D66-fractie lezen geen evaluatiebepaling in de wet.
Asks for better justification of abolishing only the premium discount, the NZa's oversight role, and whether the level playing field holds.
Can the government better justify why it chose only to prohibit the premium discount option?
Kan de regering beter onderbouwen waarom er «alleen» gekozen is de optie korting op de premie te verbieden?
Supports abolition but asks about effects on municipal policies for minima and possible premium rises.
They support abolishing the collective discount but still have some questions and remarks about it.
Zij steunen de afschaffing van de collectiviteitskorting, maar hebben hierover nog wel enkele vragen en opmerkingen.
Asks why the voluntary own-risk scheme is not addressed and why the effective date is 2023 rather than 2022.
Hence the GroenLinks members ask why abolishing the own risk is not part of this bill, if increasing solidarity is the goal.
Vandaar dat de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vragen waarom het afschaffen van het eigen risico geen deel is van dit wetsvoorstel, als vergroten van de solidariteit het doel is.
Values tailored collective arrangements but questions remaining cross-subsidy risks, prevention funding, and payment default risks.
They also see, however, that the collective discount no longer appears to be the appropriate instrument to facilitate these collectives.
Zij zien echter ook dat de collectiviteitskorting niet meer het passende instrument blijkt te zijn om deze zorgcollectiviteiten te faciliteren.
Asks about positive and negative effects on stakeholders and about communication before the 2023 switching season.
The Volt members ask whether the government can explain both the positive and negative effects of abolishing the collective discount on all identified stakeholder groups.

De leden van de Volt-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten wat zowel de positieve als negatieve gevolgen zullen zijn van het afschaffen van de collectiviteitskorting op alle geïdentificeerde stakeholdergroepen.
Asks whether the effects of abolition on different groups can be evaluated and whether monitoring will actually be carried out.
The JA21 members ask whether it is possible to evaluate the effects of abolishing the collective discount for different groups.
De leden van de JA21-fractie vragen of het mogelijk is om de gevolgen van afschaffing van de collectiviteitskorting voor verschillende groepen te evalueren.
Asks whether alternatives to full abolition were considered and whether the government will evaluate effects.
Has the government considered prohibiting only the practice of financing through premium surcharges and cross-subsidisation, instead of abolishing the collective discount permanently?
Heeft de regering overwogen om, in plaats van het definitief afschaffen van de collectiviteitskorting, alleen de praktijk van financiering door premieopslag en kruissubsidiëring te verbieden?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division has no remarks on the draft bill abolishing the collective discount in the Health Insurance Act and advises submitting it to the House of Representatives. The minister's reply (nader rapport) is included in the text.

35881.s: The bill amends the Nuclear Energy Act so that, for certain permit changes concerning the duration of nuclear activities that have no greater environmental effects, the General Administrative Law Act, the environmental law provisions and the Environmental Management Act do not apply to preparing the decision. It thereby broadens public participation exemptions for such permit amendments and aligns the text with the Omgevingswet timing.
35881.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption by arguing that such permit changes usually produce no greater environmental effects, need no environmental impact assessment, and do not create a different installation, so the regular procedure adds little.
q: In that case, such a permit change usually also does not lead to any greater adverse environmental effects than the existing permit allows.
In dat geval zijn van een dergelijke wijziging van de vergunning veelal ook geen andere of grotere nadelige gevolgen voor het milieu te verwachten dan volgens de geldende vergunning zijn toegestaan.
p: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel 2 (artikel 17, vierde lid, Kernenergiewet)

Certain permit amendments for nuclear installations are exempted from the procedural rules of the General Administrative Law Act and environmental law, reducing public participation and procedural protection for those decisions.

parties: The VVD has no further questions or comments on the bill.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the documents accompanying the Amendment of the Nuclear Energy Act (broadening of public participation) and have no further questions or comments.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de stukken behorend bij de Wijziging van de Kernenergiewet (verruiming inspraak) en hebben geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
D66 expresses interest but has no questions or comments at this stage.
These members currently have no further questions or comments on this.
Deze leden hebben hier op dit moment geen verdere vragen of opmerkingen over.
CDA supports the bill's aim but asks about the fee burden on licence holders under the Besluit vergoedingen Kernenergiewet and whether it obstructs operating a nuclear facility.
Does the government see these costs as an obstacle to operating a nuclear installation?
Ziet de regering deze kosten als een sta-in-de-weg bij het exploiteren van een nucleaire inrichting?

GroenLinks asks why an environmental impact assessment is not mandatory for every reconsideration or change of operating life, and whether public participation under the Aarhus Convention is guaranteed for each update.
Why is the law not amended so that an environmental impact assessment is required for every decision of a competent authority, including extension of operating life?
Waarom wordt de wet niet zo aangepast dat bij iedere beslissing van een bevoegde autoriteit, waaronder levensduurverlenging, een milieueffectrapportage vereist wordt?

JA21 worries that open public participation on operating life invites activist delaying tactics and asks whether the procedure has enough safeguards against abuse, and whether it gives courts a basis to make far-reaching political decisions.
These members wonder whether the UOV offers sufficient procedural safeguards to prevent such abuse of participation.
Deze leden vragen zich af of de UOV voldoende procedurele waarborgen biedt om dergelijk misbruik van inspraak te voorkomen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the bill widening public participation in the Nuclear Energy Act (Kernenergiewet), and advised submitting it, but asked the explanatory memorandum to address possible consequences of the 'Varkens in Nood' CJEU ruling. The government's reply declined that redactional remark, arguing the ruling has no direct effect on this bill and will be addressed in the upcoming Awb amendment and answers to parliamentary questions.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to discuss possible consequences of the 'Varkens in Nood' ruling for the bill, which the government declined as the ruling has no direct effect here.

35890.s: The bill amends the Framework Act on independent administrative bodies (Kaderwet zbo's) to adjust annual report submission deadlines and transmission to parliament, allows the minister to set rules by ministerial regulation on the content of evaluations of individual bodies, and removes the statutory requirement that a published efficiency report be submitted. It also amends the Framework Act on advisory bodies to govern transfer of archives, and changes accountant reporting duties in several health and aviation laws.
35890.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by arguing that sending annual reports directly to parliament is a legacy 'service' no longer needed, and that a ministerial regulation allows evaluation rules to be set flexibly.
q: From that perspective, sending the body's annual report to both chambers of the States General is a 'service' that dates from a time when such annual reports were not easily accessible to everyone.

Vanuit dat oogpunt bezien is het verzenden van het jaarverslag van het zbo aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal een «service» die nog stamt uit de tijd dat dergelijke jaarverslagen niet eenvoudig voor eenieder inzichtelijk waren.
d: ARTIKEL I, E (article 39, new second paragraph of Kaderwet zbo's)
content and organisation of evaluation reports on individual zbo's
p: ARTIKEL I, C and D (articles 18 and 35 Kaderwet zbo's)

Annual reports of independent bodies are sent to parliament later and the separate efficiency report requirement is removed, reducing information available to parliamentary oversight, though the annual report obligation itself remains.

parties: Asks why disclosure of ancillary positions of board members is not included in this bill and how the replacement of the efficiency statement would ensure efficient spending of public funds.
The VVD members would like a further clarification of those instruments.
Graag krijgen de leden van de VVD-fractie een nadere verduidelijking van die instrumenten.
Asks how many zbo's must disclose ancillary positions, whether the obligation is sharp enough, and whether publication on a website suffices instead of submission to parliament.
Moreover, these members are of the opinion that publication on the internet cannot be equated with sending to the House of Representatives.
Overigens zijn deze leden van mening dat publicatie op internet niet gelijkgesteld kan worden met toezending aan de Kamer.

Calls for full transparency on ancillary positions of all members, questions government oversight of disclosure, and worries that the optional efficiency test and ministerial rules undermine uniformity and enforcement.
These members advocate full transparency regarding the ancillary positions of members of zbo's and advisory bodies.
De leden van de SP-fractie pleiten voor volledige transparantie als het gaat om de nevenfuncties van leden van zbo’s en adviescolleges.
Asks why the efficiency assessment is not fixed in the statute, how efficiency can be operationalised, and whether the accountant is a suitable checker, while awaiting the broader evaluation.
These members ask why it would not be appropriate to stipulate in the bill that at least this component is addressed in the regulation.
Deze leden vragen waarom het dan niet aangewezen is om in het wetsvoorstel te bepalen dat in ieder geval dit onderdeel in de regeling aan bod komt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill amending the Kaderwet zbo's and the Kaderwet adviescolleges, criticizing the limited scope of the underlying evaluation, the unclear relation to the broader ongoing evaluation, and the tension between ministerial responsibility and parliamentary oversight of zbo's. The government's nader rapport accepted the need for clearer context and adjusted the explanatory memorandum, but maintained that the bill implements previously announced limited changes within the existing framework.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for fuller explanation of the relation between this bill and the broader 'brede evaluatie', given the limited methodology of the earlier evaluation; the government added context in paragraph 2.1 but treated the bill as a limited improvement within existing policy.

The Afdeling observed that limited ministerial responsibility for zbo's restricts parliamentary oversight and that direct hearings of zbo staff create tension with ministerial accountability; the government acknowledged the tension and added text, but held that the limits are inherent to the chosen framework.

35908.s: The bill implements the second Bank Recovery and Resolution Directive (BRRD II) for investment firms and bank-specific provisions not covered by the SRM Regulation, amending the Wft and Faillissementswet. It gives De Nederlandsche Bank new resolution powers, including temporary suspension of payment and delivery obligations before resolution, bail-in and write-down powers, contractual recognition clauses, and approval powers for bridge institutions.
35908.j: The memorandum justifies the new and delegated powers by the need to ensure effective resolution of failing banks and investment firms, as required by BRRD II and to fill gaps left by the SRM Regulation.
q: It is strongly preferable that the bankruptcy of certain banks be prevented, because these banks perform critical functions whose loss would have considerable and undesirable consequences.
Het verdient evenwel de sterke voorkeur dat het faillissement van sommige banken wordt voorkomen, omdat deze banken bepaalde kritieke functies vervullen
d: DNB may require EU parent to ensure subsidiaries include recognition clauses in contracts
DNB determines duration of suspension of payment and delivery obligations
DNB may prohibit certain distributions where MREL/buffer requirements are not met
DNB may decide to resolve a central institution and affiliated banks
DNB may instruct trading venues to suspend trading in financial instruments
DNB applies for licences for bridge institutions; AFM may grant temporary exemptions
p: DNB may suspend payment and delivery obligations of a failing institution and its counterparties before any resolution decision, limited in time and subject to proportionality criteria.
DNB may dismiss or appoint management and supervisory board members of an institution in resolution, with discretionary criteria not fixed in advance.
Financial contracts governed by third-country law must recognise DNB's resolution powers, and DNB assesses claims of impossibility.
DNB may restrict creditors' enforcement rights and suspend termination rights of third parties during suspension.

parties: Asks whether open norms used in the directive, which give DNB broad discretion, could prevent uniform application, and whether the Council of State's criticism of the rank-ordering rule and open terms is addressed.
Does the government agree that open norms may prevent uniform application, since there is more room for interpretation for member states?
Deelt de regering de mening dat juist open normen ertoe kunnen leiden dat er geen uniforme toepassing zal plaatsvinden?
Questions the government's power to suspend deposit obligations and how it fits the depositor guarantee, and asks who decides on failure and on the necessity of powers.
Suspending obligations regarding deposits eligible for the deposit guarantee scheme is a far-reaching measure.
Opschorting van verplichtingen ten aanzien van het voor het depositogarantiestelsel in aanmerking komende deposito's is een vergaande maatregel
Asks who determines that an entity will fail, who assesses alternative measures, and who judges that exercising a power is necessary, and notes the Council of State's criticism of open norms.
The CDA asks how it is determined that an entity will fail, who assesses whether alternative measures are possible, and who judges whether exercising the power is deemed necessary.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hoe wordt vastgesteld dat een entiteit zal falen, wie beoordeelt of er nog alternatieve maatregelen mogelijk zijn en wie oordeelt of de uitoefening van bevoegdheid noodzakelijk wordt geacht.
Doubts the bill solves the too-big-to-fail problem, suspects the moratorium is a disguised bailout, and questions whether the no-creditor-worse-off principle is respected in bail-in.
The members ask whether the moratorium is not a disguised form of bailout and request an explanation.
De leden vragen de regering of het moratorium niet een verkapte vorm van bailout is en vragen om een toelichting.

Criticises the asymmetry between the resolution framework and state aid rules that permit bailouts, and the lack of clear definitions of financial stability, solvency and failing or likely to fail, which give room for discretion.
The GroenLinks members express their concern about the asymmetry between the resolution mechanism (BRRD) and the state aid framework that has arisen.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie uiten hun zorgen over de asymmetrie die ontstaan is tussen het afwikkel- en resolutiemechanisme enerzijds (BRRD) en het staatssteunkader anderzijds.

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division advised on the Dutch bill implementing EU directive 2019/879 on bank and investment firm loss absorption and recapitalisation, raising points on vague open criteria granting DNB discretion, legal certainty of subordination rules for equity claims in insolvency, unclear interaction with the regulation, transition arrangements and the late implementation deadline. The government's reply (nader rapport) largely explains its choices, clarifies the explanatory memorandum in several places and adds technical corrections.
concerns: Vague open criteria such as 'passend' and 'redelijk' give DNB broad discretion without clarification, undermining legal certainty for financial institutions; the government declined to define them in the bill but did not provide further explanation of the weighing involved.

The ranking of subordinated equity-related claims in insolvency and its effects on the no-creditor-worse-off principle were insufficiently explained; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented on the ranking and its application.

The proposal goes beyond what the directive requires on ranking of equity-related claims, and the relationship with EU law needed further justification; the memorandum was supplemented to address this.
Implementing measures for the regulation and directive, including a transposition table, should be described; the government added an introductory passage and a transposition table.

DNB should be expressly empowered to set suitable transition periods for institutions under the directive's provisions; the government explained DNB's existing competence and adjusted the explanatory memorandum.
The explanatory memorandum should address the consequences of the exceeded implementation deadline of 28 December 2020; a passage was added.
Several drafting corrections were proposed and adopted, including wrong article references, numbering and terminology.

35917.s: The bill extends the Temporary Act on Administrative Measures for Counterterrorism by five years, to expire on 1 March 2027, and adds a legal basis for processing sensitive and criminal personal data for the Minister's powers. It also amends the evaluation deadline to 1 September 2024 and tidies some definitions and references.
35917.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the extension by the continuing terrorist threat and the effectiveness shown in the evaluation, and cites a parliamentary motion requesting a five-year extension.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State and in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved as follows.
Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal
p: Allows the Minister to process sensitive and criminal personal data, lifting the GDPR prohibition, where necessary for the powers under the Act, with destruction required after five years.
Extends the duration of the temporary counterterrorism administrative measures by five years, prolonging the executive's restrictive powers such as travel and area bans."}

parties: Supports the extension for protecting national security and asks about the upcoming counter-terrorism strategy and how measures are weighed against alternatives.
They endorse the need to extend this temporary law given the added value it offers in protecting national security.
Zij onderschrijven de noodzaak van de verlenging van deze tijdelijke wet door de meerwaarde die het biedt in het beschermen van de nationale veiligheid.

Questions the justification for renewal given the critical WODC evaluation, the lack of proportionality reasoning against a lower threat level, and the unsubstantiated claim of contribution to national security.
These members share the analysis of the Dutch Bar Association and the Council of State's advisory division that the necessity of extending this law is insufficiently substantiated.

Deze leden delen de analyse van o.a. de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten (NOvA) en de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: de Afdeling) dat de noodzaak van verlenging van deze wet onvoldoende is onderbouwd.

Considers the Twbmt effective and proportionate and asks why renewal is for a fixed term rather than a permanent law, and how the motion's calls to reduce workload and strengthen the person-focused approach were implemented.
The CDA members ask why the Twbmt was again extended to 1 March 2027 rather than made a permanent administrative counter-terrorism law.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen waarom is gekozen voor het opnieuw verlengen van de Twbmt tot 1 maart 2027 en niet voor een permanente wet bestuurlijke maatregelen terrorisme.
Objects to placing these coercive measures under administrative law rather than with independent judges and questions whether less intrusive alternatives were available.
Although these members support the added value of the law's instruments such as the reporting duty, area ban and travel ban, they object to placing these powers under administrative law.

Hoewel voornoemde leden de meerwaarde van de instrumenten uit de wet, zoals de meldplicht, het gebiedsverbod en het uitreisverbod steunen, hebben zij bezwaar tegen het onderbrengen van deze bevoegdheden in het bestuursrecht.
Asks why the power to impose these liberty-restricting measures was not transferred to the independent judiciary, invoking lessons from the Toeslagenaffaire about controlling government powers.
Would it not be obvious that such far-reaching measures, which deeply intrude on personal liberties, should be imposed by the independent judge rather than an administrative body?

Ligt het niet voor de hand om dit soort ingrijpende maatregelen die diep in de persoonlijke vrijheden van betrokkenen ingrijpen [...] niet te laten opleggen door een bestuursorgaan, maar door de onafhankelijke rechter?
Asks what measures the government took to reduce the workload and strengthen the person-focused approach, as the motion requested, and how the evaluation's other recommendations were addressed.
What measures has the government taken in this law to reduce the workload, and how has this part of the motion been addressed?
Welke maatregelen heeft de regering in deze wet genomen om de werkbelasting te verlagen, hoe is aan dit onderdeel van het dictum gehoor gegeven?

Worries about proportionality, effectiveness and necessity, notes measures are imposed by an administrative body rather than a judge, and asks for further evaluation before extension as the Council of State advised.

In line with the Council of State's advice, these members would first like to see a further evaluation and reconsideration of the proposal, because the measures under the law mean far-reaching interference with various fundamental rights.

In lijn met het advies van de Afdeling zouden deze leden graag eerst een nadere evaluatie en heroverweging van het voorstel willen zien, omdat de maatregelen die voortkomen uit de wet verregaande inmenging in diverse grondrechten betekenen.
Criticises the exclusive focus on jihadism and argues that right-wing extremism, the fastest growing threat, receives insufficient attention, asking for specifics on how it is monitored.
This member notes that the law specifically describes how it aims to give impetus to tackling terrorism, yet only cites jihadism as an example.
Dit lid merkt op dat specifiek wordt benoemd hoe wordt beoogd een impuls te geven aan de aanpak van terrorisme, maar dat hierbij enkel jihadisme als voorbeeld wordt genoemd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in July 2021 that the proposed five-year extension of the temporary counter-terrorism administrative measures act (Twbmt) was insufficiently justified given the critical evaluation and changed threat picture, and that the grounds for processing special and criminal personal data were too broad. The government's reply of September 2021 expanded the justification, limited the special categories of data and added a retention period, but kept the extension and did not shorten it.
concerns: The extension of the Twbmt by five years was insufficiently motivated in light of the evaluation's critical findings and the changed threat level; the government expanded the justification but kept the extension.

Processing of special categories of personal data should be limited to data revealing religious or philosophical convictions, since the broader grounds did not meet the proportionality and data minimisation requirements; the government narrowed the grounds accordingly.
A shorter extension period and differentiation among the measures should have been considered given their limited use; the government did not shorten the period.

Procedural safeguards for processing special and criminal personal data were insufficiently addressed, including the role of the NCTV as mandated body; the government added a retention period and explained GDPR safeguards.
Redactional corrections were made to the bill's heading and article wording.

35925-IIB.s: This bill establishes the 2022 budget statute for the Hoge Colleges van Staat, the governors' cabinets of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, and the Electoral Council, setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
35925-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded budget overview and the extra resources for the Raad van State by reference to advice from the Raad van State and the IBO, and to new statutory tasks such as the Wet Open Overheid and the Klimaatwet.
q: The Cabinet of the Governor of Aruba has the task of supporting the Governor of Aruba in his capacity as representative of the King as head of the Aruban government.
Het Kabinet van de Gouverneur van Aruba heeft tot taak het ondersteunen van de Gouverneur van Aruba in zijn hoedanigheid van vertegenwoordiger van de Koning als hoofd van de regering van Aruba.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2022 budget bill for the other High Councils of State, Governors' Cabinets and the Electoral Council (IIB) and raised no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, sent with the 2021 budget package, reports that the Afdeling had no remarks on the 2021 bills except one non-blank opinion on the Ministry of Finance budget, to which the minister responds in an annex.

35935.s: The bill provides temporary rules implementing the two EU SIS regulations on border checks and police and judicial cooperation, designating which Dutch authorities may access and directly query the Schengen Information System. It lists authorities such as the Minister of Justice and Security, the police, the Marechaussee, customs and the Public Prosecution Service, and expires by royal decree once the implementing act takes effect.
35935.j: The memorandum justifies the bill by the short timeframe until the implementing act takes effect, and notes that a later general administrative measure is used to designate authorities so the law need not be amended when tasks change.
q: Given the short timeframe until February 2022, when the second part of the SIS regulation provisions is expected to take effect, it is efficient for the legislator to designate the nationally competent authorities in this bill.

Gelet op het korte tijdsbestek tot februari 2022, wanneer het van kracht worden van het tweede deel van de bepalingen van de SIS-verordening wordt voorzien, is het voor de wetgever efficiënt de nationaal bevoegde autoriteiten aan te wijzen bij dit wetsvoorstel.

parties: Asks how the delegation to an AMvB for designating competent authorities may later change authority tasks, and how the GDPR affects cooperation and border checks.
In this context, the members ask what could be a reason to change the task of a national competent authority in the future and request the government to address this.

Daarbij vragen de aan het woord zijnde leden wat een aanleiding kan zijn voor het wijzigen van een taak van een nationaal bevoegde autoriteit in de toekomst en zij verzoeken de regering hierop in te gaan.

Asks why the government will designate competent authorities by AMvB rather than ministerial regulation and whether it will commit to this, and questions whether the terminology difference implies differing powers.
These members ask whether the government can commit to this actually happening.
Deze leden vragen of de regering kan toezeggen dat dit daadwerkelijk zal gebeuren.

Asks why the legal basis for designating national authorities was not chosen in earlier implementation laws and what choice will be made in the forthcoming act, and questions the lack of data on fingerprinting by posts.
Can the government explain this? Which choice will be made later in the forthcoming Uitvoeringswet EU-verordeningen grenzen en veiligheid?
Kan de regering dit toelichten? Welke keuze wordt straks gemaakt bij de Uitvoeringswet EU-verordeningen grenzen en veiligheid?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised that the bill providing temporary rules for the SIS regulations must create a statutory basis for designating all national authorities entitled to access and search SIS, and that the designation of authorities should be by general administrative order rather than ministerial regulation. The government's reply accepts the advice on designating all authorities in the bill itself, but rejects the delegation change, designating the authorities directly in the bill because of the short timeframe.
concerns: Designation of all national authorities with SIS access rights must be regulated by statute to satisfy legality and knowability requirements, and the government followed this by regulating access in the bill.

Delegating designation of competent authorities to a ministerial regulation is inappropriate for an essential element of the SIS scheme and should instead be done by general administrative order; the government rejected this by designating the authorities directly in the bill.

35944.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, implementing the 12th incidental supplementary budget on corona measures, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 15 October 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35962.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/1152 on transparent and predictable working conditions by amending Dutch civil code Book 7, the Flexible Working Act and the Posted Workers Act. It adds employer duties on training, information to workers, protection against dismissal and adverse treatment, and a right to request more predictable work.
35962.j: The memorandum justifies the bill as a necessary transposition of the EU directive and notes that Dutch law already provides the remedies, with no new powers for the executive.
q: This act enters into force on 1 August 2022.
Deze wet treedt in werking met ingang van 1 augustus 2022.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel D (7:655 lid 1 onder i, sub 2°)
days and hours on which unpredictable-schedule workers may be required to work

parties: Asks how the directive contributes to labour market adaptability, whether it will be evaluated, and what practical effects employers face given the lack of consultation.
Is the government planning to evaluate this directive in light of the improvements needed in the labour market?
Is de regering voornemens om deze richtlijn te evalueren in het licht van de benodigde verbeteringen op de arbeidsmarkt?
Asks why the most minimal implementation was chosen, what broader options existed, and how terms like 'largely unpredictable work pattern' and training categories should be understood.
These members ask what the reason is that the government chooses the most minimal implementation of this directive.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen wat de reden is dat de regering kiest voor de meest minimale implementatie van deze richtlijn.
Takes note of the bill and has no further questions or comments.
The aforementioned members have no further questions and/or comments on this.
De eerdergenoemde leden hebben hierover geen verdere vragen en/of opmerkingen.

Argues the bill leaves workers insufficiently protected: the employer can still deviate from the secondary-employment ban on objective grounds, no balancing of interests is included, and the objective justification is only assessed afterwards, so workers lack certainty.
These members believe this still insufficiently protects employees, because it remains possible to deviate from it.
Echter, deze leden zijn mening dat dit werknemers nog onvoldoende beschermt, dit omdat het mogelijk blijft om hiervan af te wijken.
Objects to excluding domestic workers from several provisions, which weakens their position, and questions the vague formulation of secondary-employment exceptions likely to cause litigation.
In the view of the GroenLinks members, these exceptions weaken the position of the domestic worker even further.
Naar mening van de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie verzwakken deze uitzonderingen de positie van de huishoudelijk werker nog verder.
Asks for proportionality and subsidiarity justification, clarification of mandatory training, and whether the on-call notice period is proportionate.
The SGP members ask the government to elaborate on the proportionality and subsidiarity regarding this directive.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering nader in te gaan op de proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit ten aanzien van deze richtlijn.
Supports EU-level action but criticises the lack of evaluation clause and of sector input, and asks why sectors such as agriculture were not exempted, with burdens falling on small employers.
The absence of both an internet consultation on the directive and an SME test has also meant that little input from sectors on the workability of the proposal was provided.
Het ontbreken van zowel een internetconsultatie over de richtlijn als de MKB-toets heeft er ook toe geleid dat er weinig input vanuit sectoren geleverd is op de werkbaarheid van het voorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill implementing EU Directive 2019/1152 on transparent and predictable working conditions, raising points on exempting domestic workers from free training and from predictable-work requests, on the three-month response period for small employers, and on the implementation for seafarers and fishers. The government's reply accepts the need to motivate these exemptions, explains the reasons for them, corrects the references and exceptions for seafarers and fishers, and adopts the drafting remarks.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the necessity of exempting domestic workers from free mandatory training costs, given that the exemption creates a difference in legal position not clearly justified by the motion; the government justified it by reference to the lighter labour regime for personal services.

The Afdeling asked for a substantive motivation of excluding domestic workers from the right to request more predictable working conditions; the government explained that the consequences of late responses by private employers would be large.

The Afdeling asked why a three-month response period for small employers is necessary; the government explained that small employers face greater difficulty responding quickly and may need external advice.

The Afdeling questioned whether the broader implementation for seafarers and fishers is permitted under the directive and whether it amounts to a national addition; the government corrected the references and exceptions to follow the directive's minimum rules.
The Afdeling made redactional remarks on the wording of the notification duty and on changes to employee information being provided as soon as possible, which the government adopted.

35971.s: The bill amends the Public Health Act to allow the minister, by ministerial regulation, to require COVID coronatoegangsbewijzen (CTB) from people entering workplaces, including employees, self-employed and volunteers, in CTB-obliged sectors and in other designated terrains, with an exception where the employer provides a comparable protection level. It also lets the executive designate further terrains and extends the CTB requirement to workplace visitors, subject to proportionality and temporary-measure safeguards.
35971.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to limit SARS-CoV-2 transmission in workplaces and keep sectors open, while stressing that the powers are temporary and subject to necessity, proportionality and parliamentary consent.
d: Artikel I, C (art. 58ra, achtste lid Wpg)
CTB obligation for persons entering workplaces in the CTB-regulated sectors
Artikel I, C (art. 58ra, negende lid Wpg)
designation of other terrains where CTB required for workplace access and visitors
Artikel I, C (art. 58ra, achtste en negende lid Wpg)
alternative protection measures that exempt employers from the CTB obligation
p: Artikel I, C (art. 58ra, achtste en negende lid Wpg)

Allows the minister by regulation to impose CTB requirements on workers and visitors across newly designated workplaces, with a temporary and proportionality-bound framework subject to parliamentary consent.
Artikel I, C (art. 58ra, dertiende lid Wpg)
Prohibits requiring a result from persons for access to activities or workplaces unless rules under this article have been set, extending executive control over access conditions.

parties: Asks how the executive's proportionality and subsidiarity are guaranteed and how Parliament can influence the ministerial regulation that will fill in much of the scheme.
How is the House of Representatives involved in the ministerial regulation and how can it still influence it, since much is still to be elaborated?
Hoe wordt de Tweede Kamer betrokken bij de ministeriële regeling en hoe kan het daar nog invloed op uitoefenen, aangezien veel nog uitgewerkt gaat worden?
Considers the workplace CTB unacceptable and unjustified, questioning its effectiveness and asking the government to withdraw the bill.
The PVV members find it unacceptable that the government wants to go so far as to require vaccination or testing for unvaccinated citizens to go to work.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vinden het onacceptabel dat de regering zo ver wil gaan met het voorstel dat een vaccinatie of test nodig wordt voor ongevaccineerde burgers om naar hun werk te gaan.
Questions whether the measure is necessary and suitable and whether it infringes fundamental rights, especially for vulnerable and flexible workers.
Is the necessity and legal basis for infringing fundamental rights then not lacking?
Ontbreekt dan niet de noodzaak en de juridische basis om grondrechten aan te tasten?
Objects to the rushed, highly controversial bill and asks for the government to explain the criteria, necessity, and legal basis of the measures.
the government has now decided urgently to proceed with this extremely controversial bill.
heeft de regering nu met spoed besloten over te gaan tot dit uiterst controversiële wetsvoorstel.

Finds necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity insufficiently justified given infringements on privacy and bodily integrity, and prefers a general administrative order over a ministerial regulation.
The SGP members consider the necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity of this proposal insufficiently substantiated.
De leden van de SGP-fractie achten de noodzakelijkheid, proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit van dit voorstel onvoldoende onderbouwd.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that a draft amendment to the Public Health Act extending corona access certificates to workplaces and visitor locations needed revision, mainly because the optional employer-led model and the consultation requirement were complicated and potentially conflict-generating. The government's reply accepted the advice, removed the optional model in favour of mandatory ministerial rules, adjusted personal scope, exceptions for care visitors, and wording, and asked that the revised bill be sent to parliament.
concerns: The optional employer-led model for COVID certificates at work was complicated and its effectiveness doubtful, so the Council advised that the legislator itself should make the choice for mandatory certificates.
Differentiated employer-level application would create a fragmented patchwork hard to supervise and enforce, and the works council consent requirement could delay urgent action.

Requiring certificates for visitors to care facilities touches the home sphere and contact with relatives, so the proportionality weighing should be explained and the statutory exceptions for relatives and lawyers included in the law.
The bill's wording did not make clear that the certificate requirement is a mandatory obligation, so this should be stated explicitly in the statutory text.
The personal scope of the proposed provision was unclear regarding employers, interns, suppliers and other non-employees, so it should be broadened and explained.

36088.s: The bill temporarily lowers the VAT rate on gas, district heating and electricity and the excise duties on fuel and heating oil in 2022, with scheduled reversal from 1 January 2023. It also includes transitional rules for VAT on supplies straddling the change dates and retroactive effect for certain excise and Caribbean duty adjustments.
36088.j: The memorandum justifies the tax cut as a temporary measure to dampen high energy prices for households, without statutory delegation of new powers.
q: The reduction of VAT on energy and the fuel excise is temporary and expires at the end of this year.
De verlaging van de btw op energie en de brandstofaccijns is tijdelijk en vervalt eind dit jaar.

parties: Asks which alternatives were considered, what factors would justify extending the measures, and whether energy suppliers will pass the VAT cut on in full.
The VVD members have taken note of the bill with approval and have a few questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben enkele vragen.
Accepts the need for blunt urgent measures but asks about the cliff effect when measures end in 2023 and about more targeted purchasing-power policy.
These members understand the need to take blunt measures in urgent situations and see the link between these fiscal purchasing-power measures and the energy allowance paid via the municipalities.

Deze leden begrijpen de noodzaak om in urgente situaties grove maatregelen te treffen en zien de samenhang van deze fiscale koopkrachtmaatregelen met de energietoeslag die via de gemeenten verstrekt zal worden.
Asks why rates such as VAT, energy tax and ODE were not lowered, questions retroactivity and feasibility, and asks how suppliers will pass on the VAT cut.
To what extent has the government considered lowering the level of various schemes or rates, such as VAT, energy tax, the ODE or fuel excise duties, additionally from 1 January 2022?

In hoeverre heeft de regering overwogen om de hoogte van diverse regelingen, c.q. tarieven van bijvoorbeeld de btw, de energiebelasting en de ODE (Opslag Duurzame Energie en Klimaattransitie) of brandstofaccijnzen (aanvullend) te verlagen per 1 januari 2022?
Asks for the government's decision framework on conditions for policy decisions to be shared with parliament, and asks for evaluation of the measures given possible future energy shocks.
The CDA members ask the government whether it is possible to share this assessment framework with the House for the treatment of the Tax Plan 2023.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering of het mogelijk is om dit afwegingskader voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2023 met de Kamer te delen.
Considers the compensation insufficient and unfairly distributed, and asks why better alternatives such as a higher untaxed mileage allowance were not chosen.
These members find it unacceptable that a large part of the population is financially strained, fears debt and has to save on daily groceries.
Deze leden vinden het onacceptabel dat een groot deel van de mensen het financieel krap heeft en kampt met angst voor schulden en moeten besparen op dagelijkse boodschappen.

Asks why the excise cut is 21 percent, why other measures were not chosen, and why the revenue cover uses higher gas revenues rather than taxing top incomes; also asks for a commitment on more targeted future help to be followed up.
The SP members would like to know why this percentage was chosen.
De leden van de SP-fractie willen graag weten waarom voor dit percentage is gekozen.
Accepts the generic measures given limited short-term options but asks how the government ensures energy suppliers pass on the VAT cut and whether pass-through is monitored and evaluated.
However, these members ask the government to explain how it ensures that energy suppliers pass the VAT reduction on to households.
Wel vragen deze leden de regering om toe te lichten hoe de regering ervoor zorgt dat energieleveranciers de btw-verlaging doorberekenen aan huishoudens.
Questions why the bill was sent late and not via faster emergency legislation, citing the Chamber's budget right, and argues the generic VAT cut mainly benefits higher incomes.
Why was the budgetary right of the House not taken into greater account?
Waarom is niet meer rekening gehouden met het budgetrecht van de Kamer?
Disputes that the government cannot act quickly, cites 2020 support schemes, and asks whether the generic approach is appropriate and how the government will determine whether measures are temporary.

The BBB member disagrees with the statement in the introduction that there are not many possibilities to directly dampen the effects of current price increases through government measures during the year.

Het lid van de BBB-fractie is het niet eens met het volgende in de inleiding gestelde: «Er zijn niet veel mogelijkheden om met overheidsmaatregelen gedurende het jaar direct de effecten van de huidige prijsstijgingen als gevolg van de energiecrisis te dempen.

Asks for purchasing-power effect analyses, a status update on a motion establishing a commission on minimum living standards, and clarification of the legal basis for shifting revenue between tax and non-tax envelopes.
This member has the impression that the proposed measures and their size are based not on an analysis of purchasing-power effects but on a consideration of available funds.
Dit lid heeft de indruk dat de voorgestelde maatregelen en de omvang ervan niet gebaseerd zijn om een analyse van de koopkrachteffecten, maar op een overweging over de beschikbare middelen.
Argues the VAT and excise cuts are fossil subsidies that sustain dependence on fossil fuels and benefit high earners, and calls for targeted compensation and climate-aligned income policy.
These members are of the opinion that lowering VAT on energy and the excise on petrol, diesel and LPG are fossil subsidies.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het verlagen van de btw op energie en de accijns op benzine, diesel en LPG fossiele subsidies zijn.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Wet aanvullende fiscale koopkrachtmaatregelen 2022, which cuts VAT on energy and excise on fuel, criticising its effectiveness, lack of attention to climate policy, and insufficient consideration of alternatives. The government's nader rapport defends the choices, cites implementation limits and the temporary nature of the measures, and adds two technical amendments.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether the broad, untargeted tax cuts are effective and efficient, and the government acknowledges generic compensation is less effective but defends it given implementation constraints.
The Afdeling finds the explanatory memorandum does not address the relationship with climate policy, and the government added a passage on this relationship.
The Afdeling asks for a fuller discussion of alternatives, and the government explains why alternatives such as a subsidy scheme, energy tax adjustment, or toeslag changes were not feasible in 2022.
The government amended the bill because the Douane could not implement the excise filing obligation, so the relevant article of the Wet op de accijns is suspended.

36097.s: The bill amends the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs through a first supplementary budget, mainly concerning housing portfolio changes, adding about 965.8 million euro in commitments and a 95 million euro change in expenditure with 60 million euro in receipts. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 10 May 2022, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V)
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2022

36169.s: The bill amends the Dutch Climate Act to add a definition of the European Climate Law and to make Dutch 2050 emission reduction a binding net-zero target aligned with EU law. It also raises the 2030 reduction target from 49% to 55% and requires the government to take measures ensuring compliance with EU reduction obligations.
36169.j: The memorandum justifies the change by stating that the 2050 target must be aligned with the EU's climate law, since deviating from the European goal would conflict with the principle of Union loyalty.
q: Therefore the reduction target for 2050 in article 2, first paragraph, is changed into a binding norm of climate neutrality.
Daarom wordt het reductiedoel voor 2050 in artikel 2, eerste lid, gewijzigd in een bindende norm van klimaatneutraliteit.

parties: Argues the 55% target should be binding and asks why the government did not follow the Raad van State advice that a binding target is necessary.
Why does the government not follow the Council of State advice that a binding target is necessary?
Waarom gaat de regering niet mee in het advies van de Raad van State dat een bindende doelstelling noodzakelijk is?
Supports the government's choice not to make the 2030 target binding because the EU obligation already has direct effect, but questions why the issue is revisited in 2024.
They share the government's view that a binding target is not necessary because the EU reduction obligation is already unconditionally formulated and has direct effect.
Zij delen de opvatting van de regering dat een bindend doel niet nodig is omdat de reductieverplichting in de Europese klimaatwet al onvoorwaardelijk geformuleerd is en rechtstreekse werking heeft.
Asks what consequences follow from missing the 2030 target, how compliance is tested, and what effect a binding target has on litigation such as Urgenda.
These members ask what effect making the target binding has on legal cases, for example Urgenda.
Deze leden vragen welk effect het bindend maken van de doelstelling heeft voor rechtszaken, bijvoorbeeld Urgenda.
Says the bill is inconsistent: the government claims a binding target is unnecessary while aligning the Climate Act with binding EU law, and calls for a higher target of at least 65%.
On the one hand the government claims a binding target is not necessary because there is already binding European legislation.
Aan de ene kant beweert de regering dat een bindende doelstelling niet noodzakelijk is, omdat er al bindende Europese wetgeving is.
Argues the non-binding 2030 goal offers no guarantee, that citizens cannot bring the state to court under the Climate Act, and that the target is insufficient under the precautionary principle.
Why does the government state that citizens cannot take the government to court on the basis of the Climate Act?
Waarom stelt de regering dat burgers de overheid niet voor de rechter kunnen slepen op basis van de Klimaatwet?
Asks whether the EU-level obligation is sufficiently binding and enforceable, and how the Dutch target relates to the more ambitious EU Climate Act and coalition commitments.
The government states that this provision has direct effect; is the European obligation, which is still to be further specified, sufficiently binding and also enforceable?

De regering geeft bij artikel 2, tweede lid, onder b aan dat deze zin directe werking heeft, is hiermee de Europese verplichting, welke nog nader ingevuld wordt, voldoende verplichtend en ook afdwingbaar?
Questions whether the bill is truly implementing legislation requiring an accelerated procedure, and whether the 55% target is feasible and what legal added value the compliance clause has.

Worries about adding statutory bases the realities and implementation capacity may not match, and asks whether the costs of missed targets could be shifted onto society via litigation by organisations such as Urgenda.

Are there interventions the government can build in to prevent, if the goals prove unattainable, that the costs are shifted onto our society because organisations like Urgenda take the state to court?

Zijn er interventies die de regering in kan bouwen om te voorkomen dat, als door omstandigheden blijkt dat de doelen níet haalbaar blijken, de kosten daarvan op onze samenleving worden afgewenteld, omdat organisaties zoals Urgenda de staat voor de rechter dagen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft amendment of the Dutch Climate Act implementing the EU Climate Law, criticising the absence of a post-2050 target, the unclear 2030 target and the lack of insight into consequences. The minister's reply clarified the EU obligations as a separate duty, explained the non-binding national target, and expanded the explanatory memorandum on Fit for 55 impacts.
concerns: The 2030 target is unclear because it is both a non-binding national target and 'without prejudice' to binding EU obligations; the minister separated the EU obligation into its own paragraph but kept the national target non-binding.
The Afdeling advised making the 2030 national reduction target binding (at least 55%), which the minister declined as legally unnecessary and risking confusion with EU obligations.
The absence of a post-2050 negative-emissions target differing from the EU Climate Law should be explained or the bill adjusted; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented instead.
Insight into the consequences of the fixed EU climate targets for national policy is needed; the minister added general explanation but stated concrete effects depend on later measures.

36196.s: The bill amends Article 21(4) of the Aliens Act 2000 so that refusal of an unlimited-duration residence permit for certain criminal aliens born in or arrived before age four in the Netherlands is possible for any serious offence carrying at least six years' imprisonment, not only drug trafficking with sentences over 60 months. It applies only to applications filed after entry into force.
36196.j: The memorandum justifies the expansion as protecting public order and addressing serious criminals, while noting the Council of State and advisory bodies asked for clarification of necessity.
q: The current bill falls within this scope.
het huidige wetsvoorstel valt binnen deze reikwijdte
p: Broadens the grounds on which the executive may refuse an unlimited-duration residence permit to long-term resident criminal aliens, extending refusal beyond drug trafficking to serious offences.

parties: Supports broader grounds to deny permanent residence to serious criminals and asks why the threshold is six rather than three years, but raises no check-related concern.
Crime must be tackled hard and must above all not pay.
Criminaliteit moet hard aangepakt worden en vooral niet lonen.
Asks for the scope of individual assessments, a proportionality safeguard for cumulative lesser offences, and an estimate of workload and administrative effects.
These members are, however, worried about the extra workload for the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND) and ask whether this is proportionate to the benefit of this amendment.
Wel maken deze leden zich zorgen over de extra werklast voor de Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND) en vragen of dit in verhouding staat tot het voordeel van deze wetswijziging.
Asks how arbitrariness in individual assessment and the sliding scale will be prevented, and what safeguards are built in, echoing the Council of State's doubts on necessity.
These members, however, also understand the remarks the Council of State made about the effectiveness and necessity of the proposal and therefore have some further questions.
Deze leden begrijpen echter ook de opmerkingen die de Raad van State heeft gemaakt over de doelmatigheid en noodzaak van het voorstel en hebben daarom nog enkele vragen.
Questions why the protection for those born or raised in the Netherlands should be removed when other criminal-law tools exist, and warns of counterproductive effects and lower sentencing by judges.
Surely there are other criminal-law instruments to protect society against criminal foreigners?
Er bestaan toch andere strafrechtelijke instrumenten om de maatschappij te beschermen tegen criminele vreemdelingen?

Doubts the necessity of the bill given no data on the group, questions proportionality criteria, and asks the government to reconsider the Council of State's alternative of extending protection to other permit groups.
In addition, these members give heavy weight to the substantial doubt that exists about the effectiveness and necessity of this bill.
Daarnaast weegt voor deze leden zwaar dat substantiële twijfel bestaat over de doelmatigheid en noodzaak van dit wetsvoorstel.
Understands dropping the arbitrary limitation to drug-related offences and supports the need to extend grounds beyond the Opium Act.
The ChristenUnie members have taken note of the bill with interest and understand that the government wants to remove the apparently arbitrary limitation to drug-related offences.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben er begrip voor dat de regering de kennelijk willekeurige beperking tot drugsgerelateerde misdrijven wil schrappen.
Supports extending grounds beyond drug offences but asks whether the individual assessment leaves too much room for arbitrariness and whether a judge rather than the IND should weigh interests.
These members ask the government whether this bill, which makes an individual assessment possible, does not leave too much room for arbitrariness.
Deze leden vragen de regering of dit wetsvoorstel, dat een individuele toets mogelijk maakt, niet teveel ruimte biedt aan willekeur.
Strongly opposes the bill as undermining equal treatment and rights of long-resident people, questioning its compatibility with Article 1 of the Constitution and its necessity.
This member asks the government how this bill is reconciled with the principle of equality and Article 1 of our Constitution.
Dit lid vraagt de regering hoe dit wetsvoorstel rijmt met het principe van gelijkwaardigheid en artikel 1 van onze Grondwet.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill removing the protection against expulsion for minors born or raised in the Netherlands with criminal records other than heavy drug offences, raising concerns about proportionality, the necessity for public order, and compatibility with EU/Turkey association law. The government's reply largely accepts the advice, clarifies the scope of the restriction to serious offences, adds a factual justification, and explains how the Besluit 1/80 and Ziebell framework applies.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the bill's cumulation rule could lead to expulsion for lesser offences, and the government narrowed the scope to specified serious offences with an individual assessment.
The Afdeling asked for factual and numerical justification of the necessity to protect public order, and the government added explanation though it did not provide case figures.
The Afdeling asked the government to explain how the bill relates to the EU/Turkey association law, and the government set out the Besluit 1/80 and Ziebell framework with an individual assessment.

The Afdeling noted inconsistency across residence permit types and the protection's arbitrary scope, and the government accepted the need for consistency by revising the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36200-IX.s: This bill formally establishes the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget statement (IXA), setting expenditure and revenue amounts in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes budget priorities, Tax Authority and customs measures, and financial-sector and public-private financing instruments, without delegating rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this law for the year 2023 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2023 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Finance and the National Debt, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36268.s: The bill makes a collection of technical amendments across several Infrastructure and Water Management laws, including new drinking water exemption powers by general administrative order, a new pyro-pass register under the Environmental Management Act, and updates to the Water Boards Act and Water Act. It also restores omitted appeal routes and corrects drafting errors in several statutes.
36268.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly by the need to implement the revised Drinking Water Directive, the Benelux pyro-pass decision and to correct omissions, with the ILT having reviewed enforceability.
q: Because the exemption power refers to and uses the phrase 'in any case', it remains possible to keep the obligations on materials and chemicals in force and not exempt them.

Door de vrijstellingsbevoegdheid met verwijzing en gebruik van de term «in elk geval» blijft de mogelijkheid bestaan om ook de verplichtingen met betrekking tot materialen en chemicaliën van toepassing te laten.
d: exempting very small collective water supplies from parts of the Drinking Water Act
exempting small collective water supplies from risk assessment requirements
designating data and access rules for the pyro-pass register
further rules for the pyro-pass register
fee for registration in the pyro-pass register
checks by market operators on the status of persons with specialist knowledge
data a requester must submit for exemption from a waste fee declaration
adjusting dollar amounts in line with the consumer price index
rules on flood probability or failure probability of primary flood defences
p: Creates a central register holding personal data for pyrotechnic specialist-knowledge checks, with access limited to necessary verification and purpose limitation for data protection.
Lets the public body apply administrative enforcement powers from the General Administrative Law Act to Bonaire, with local amounts set by the executive.

parties: Has no further comments at this stage on the collection bill.
For the time being, these members have no further comments.
Voorlopig hebben deze leden geen verdere opmerkingen.
Asks the government about the consequences of the one-year postponement of the noise action-plan review cycle under the Omgevingswet for affected residents and the new action plan.
What is the consequence of the one-year postponement of the review cycle for those affected by noise?
Wat is het gevolg van het jaar uitstel van de toets- en herzieningscyclus voor de geluidsgehinderden?
Asks what the consequences have been since 2019 of the missing fee basis for certificates under the Wet zeevarenden and whether new fees are desirable for the fisheries sector.

What have been the consequences since 2019 of the absence of this basis, and is it desirable for the fisheries sector that additional fees be introduced given the dire circumstances the sector currently faces?

Wat zijn tussen 2019 en nu de gevolgen geweest van het ontbreken van deze grondslag en is het wenselijk voor de visserijsector dat er extra tarieven komen gezien de erbarmelijke omstandigheden waarin de sector momenteel verkeert?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Verzamelwet IenW 2021, raising points mainly on the exemption for very small collective water supplies from the Drinking Water Act, asking for clarification of the conditions under the EU Drinking Water Directive and correction of the explanatory memorandum. The minister's reply reports that most advice was followed, including adding references to the directive's conditions and removing the erroneous reference to exemption from articles 7 to 12 and 16 onwards, and that drafting remarks were incorporated.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a reference in the explanatory memorandum to the conditions of the Drinking Water Directive for the exemption of very small collective water supplies.

The Afdeling noted that the explanatory memorandum wrongly stated the exemption covered articles 7 to 12 and 16 onwards of the directive, and that article 3(6) imposes no conditions, so the phrase should be dropped.
Redactional remarks in an annex, including relettering of article X subsections and a clarification of the entry-into-force provision, were incorporated.

36277.s: The bill establishes a temporary budget fund, the Transitiefonds landelijk gebied en natuur, to finance agricultural and nature measures aimed at reducing nitrogen deposition, greenhouse gas emissions, water quality problems and supporting sustainable farming.
