The Minister for Nature and Nitrogen manages the fund, may finance other measures in exceptional cases, and the fund closes on a date set by royal decree with no new receipts after twelve years.
36277.j: The memorandum justifies the fund manager's exceptional power to finance other measures by the need for area-based support and local acceptance, and says the Minister will seek external expertise from the Ecologische Autoriteit.
q: Article 3(a) contains a safety-net provision giving the fund manager the power to also finance measures aimed at other sectors.
In artikel 3, onder a, TwT is een vangnetbepaling opgenomen die de fondsbeheerder de bevoegdheid geeft om ook maatregelen te financieren die gericht zijn op andere sectoren
d: further rules on expenditure charged to the fund
other measures financed in exceptional cases on proposal
entry into force and expiry date set by royal decree
p: Allows the fund manager to finance measures outside agriculture and nature in exceptional cases, widening executive discretion over the budget beyond the stated purposes.
The Minister alone assesses and approves measures against broad criteria, with a multi-year programme submitted to parliament as the main control.
The Minister may engage advisers to support spending decisions from the fund.

parties: Questions whether essential objective ex-ante review of efficiency and effectiveness is secured, and how the Ecological Authority and state oversight of provinces will operate.
Nevertheless, these members fear that the government has mainly secured the essential objective review of efficiency and effectiveness after the funds are spent, rather than in advance.
Toch vrezen deze leden dat de regering de essentiële objectieve toetsing op doelmatigheid en doeltreffendheid vooral na besteding van middelen heeft geborgd, in plaats van vooraf.
Asks how integral review of provincial area plans is conducted, the criteria used, and whether the Kamer can see the assessment method.
The D66 members ask the government how the area plans are integrally reviewed by central government.}
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering op welke wijze de gebiedsplannen door de rijksoverheid integraal worden getoetst.
Argues the fund covers too many goals, lacks early controls on efficiency, and lacks regie on prioritisation, risking inefficient spending.
The bill does not show how control over efficiency is built in at an early stage.
Uit het wetsvoorstel blijkt niet hoe de controle op de doelmatigheid vroegtijdig is ingebouwd.
Asks for clear, enforceable nature targets and intermediate targets so that goals are measurable and binding.
These members find it unclear which enforceable nature targets the government is proposing.
Deze leden vinden het namelijk niet duidelijk welke afrekenbare natuurdoelen de regering voordraagt.
Asks about the international dimension, technical innovation funding, relocation of farms and effects of trade agreements such as EU-Mercosur.
If the government wants to reduce production and trade of agricultural products with a negative impact on nature, but meanwhile opens the doors to imports produced to lower standards.

Als de regering de productie, en daarmee de handel van landbouwproducten die een negatieve impact hebben op onze natuur naar beneden willen brengen, maar zij ondertussen de deuren openzet voor producten die uit het buitenland komen.

v.summary: The Council of State advisory division advised on the draft Transitiefonds landelijk gebied en natuur bill, asking that the fund's purpose and criteria explicitly tie financed measures to the broad area-based approach (NPLG) and that the 'exceptional cases' clause for non-agricultural and non-nature measures be clarified. The minister's reply partly followed the advice: a criterion on alignment with the area-based approach was added, while the purpose clause was left unchanged, and the exceptional-cases clause was clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The purpose and assessment criteria of the fund should expressly require that financed measures implement the broad area-based approach as set out in the NPLG; a criterion was added but the purpose clause was not changed.
The meaning of 'exceptional cases' allowing measures outside agriculture and nature to be financed is unclear and should be clarified; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented accordingly.
Paragraphs of article 2 were split into separate articles and the assessment criteria moved to the management provision to improve accessibility, and the explanatory memorandum was updated.

36295.s: The bill amends the Wmo 2015 and related laws to create a statutory duty for municipalities to coordinate an integrated approach to multiple problems across the social domain, including a new framework for data processing and for reporting concerns about people who may need care. It also introduces municipal reporting points for concerns, a legal basis for sharing personal and health data, and expands the definition of open mental health care.
36295.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need for an integrated approach to complex multiple problems and the current legal gap that prevents data sharing, while stressing that the coordinator gains no authority over other parties and that privacy safeguards are included.
q: The bill codifies a statutory duty for the municipal council to ensure coordination, but explicitly creates no enforcement power for the council: parties keep their own powers and responsibilities.

Het wetsvoorstel codificeert een wettelijke taak voor het college om onder andere te zorgen voor coördinatie, maar creëert daarmee nadrukkelijk géén doorzettingsmacht voor het college: partijen behouden hun eigen bevoegdheden en verantwoordelijkheden.
d: rules on how agreements between municipality and health insurers/relevant parties are made
content and standardisation of data provided to health insurers
further rules on the reporting point (meldpunt) and triage
which parties may be involved in investigation of multiple problems and on what task
rules on exchange of personal data, technical standards and security requirements
further rules on processing of personal data in the reporting-point file
p: Artikel I, M (Artikel 2.3a.1 e.v.) and T (Artikel 5.4.1–5.4.4)

Municipal authorities gain broad powers to investigate households and to collect and further process health and criminal-law data across social and adjacent domains, with a duty for professionals to share data unless they weigh serious reasons against it.
Professionals bound by medical confidentiality may disclose health data without the client's consent when they judge it necessary, bypassing the client's consent as the normal safeguard.
Municipal reporting points may process health and criminal data about persons reported as causing concern, for triage and referral.
Municipality may start an investigation into multiple problems on its own initiative when a request reveals possible multiple problems, without the citizen having formally asked.
Government must report to Parliament within five years on effectiveness and effects of the law in practice.

parties: Asks whether the bill will actually remove data-sharing obstacles, and how professionals keep independent judgment and confidentiality under municipal employment.
To what extent will the proposed amendments be decisive in removing obstacles to achieving an integrated support approach?
In hoeverre zullen de hier voorgestelde wijzigingen wel of niet doorslaggevend zijn in het wegenemen van belemmeringen om te komen tot een aanpak van integrale ondersteuning?
Notes the Raad van State advice to limit the bill was ignored, asks for an unpublished AMvB draft, and questions missing impact and evaluation tests.
The Council of State's advisory division explicitly advised limiting the bill to the legal bases deemed necessary for data processing and their elaboration.

De Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State (hierna: Afdeling) gaf een expliciet advies om het wetsvoorstel te beperken tot de voor de gegevensverwerking noodzakelijk geachte grondslagen (en de uitwerking daarvan).
Worries that third-party reports can trigger data sharing without consent or judicial review, and that the measure treats people with mental illness as second-class citizens.

Is a report from third parties alone not far too vulnerable? What if that third party wants to bully someone? Why does the government want this to be possible without a judge who can establish the truth?

Is enkel een melding van derden niet veel te kwetsbaar? Wat als die derde partij iemand wil pesten of anderszins dwarszitten? Waarom wil de regering dat dit kan zonder tussenkomst van een rechter die waarheidsvinding kan doen?
Questions the bill's reach beyond inter-organisational data sharing, the administrative burden, and whether a relative or caregiver can coordinate.
This bill will increase the administrative burden for both municipalities and care providers.
Dit wetsvoorstel zal de administratieve lastendruk voor zowel gemeenten als zorgaanbieders vergroten.
Asks why the government ignored the Council of State advice and how client privacy and data security are safeguarded when data are shared with multiple parties.
The SP members ask the government what risks are attached to sharing client data with multiple parties.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering welke risico's er zijn verbonden aan het delen van gegevens van cliënten met meer partijen.
Asks about impact on professional confidentiality and the client relationship, and why no implementation test was chosen despite KNMG calls.
The PvdA members further ask the government about the impact of the bill on professional confidentiality and the trust relationship between care provider and patient/client.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen de regering verder naar de impact van het voorliggende wetsvoorstel op het beroepsgeheim en de vertrouwensrelatie tussen zorgverlener en patiënt/cliënt.
Asks how non-consensual investigations for serious problems fit with the claim that the law is not based on coercion, and how the field's concerns about bemoeizorg are addressed.
Can the government explain how these two things fit together?
Kan de regering uitleggen hoe deze twee dingen samengaan?
Supports the bill's aim of a legal framework but has questions on whether it targets only highly complex cases.
They hope this amendment will remove problems in the field, but have some questions about it.
Zij hopen dat deze wetswijziging de problemen in het werkveld wegnemen, maar hebben daar nog enkele vragen over.
Asks whether the bill is too broad and lacks sufficient safeguards to protect private life, and whether it undermines local discretion in the social domain.

The SGP members mainly wonder whether this proposal does justice to the decentralisation of the social domain and whether the bill is not too broadly designed, so that insufficient safeguards are built in to protect private life.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen zich vooral af of met dit voorstel recht wordt gedaan aan de decentralisatie van het sociaal domein en of het wetsvoorstel niet te ruim is vormgegeven, waardoor onvoldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de persoonlijke levenssfeer te beschermen.
Supports the aim but stresses that data sharing must be strictly limited in purpose, access and security, and distinguishes requested help from situations where no help is asked.
A precondition for an amendment like this is therefore a clear delineation of who gets access to data, in what way (securely and safeguarded) and for what purpose.
Voorwaardelijk voor een wetswijziging als deze is dan ook dat er een duidelijke afbakening is van wie toegang tot gegevens krijgen, op welke manier (veilig en geborgd) en voor welk doel.
Raises feasibility concerns about OGGZ and asks whether a reporting right for professionals should be added to allow confidentiality to be breached in serious cases.
However, the D66 group also has concerns about the feasibility of Public Mental Health Care (OGGZ).
Echter heeft de D66-fractie ook zorgen over de uitvoerbaarheid van de Openbare Geestelijke Gezondheidszorg (OGGZ).
Argues that breaching medical confidentiality can sometimes help effective support and asks how handling can be ensured after dropping the consent-free processing basis.

While these members understand that medical confidentiality is a great good and important for trust in the profession, they think that breaching it can in some cases actually be beneficial for effective help for those involved.

Hoewel genoemde leden begrijpen dat het medisch beroepsgeheim een groot goed is en belangrijk voor het vertrouwen in de beroepsgroep, denken zij dat doorbreking in sommige gevallen juist voordelig kan zijn voor effectieve hulp voor betrokkenen.

Warns against misuse of the bill as a security tool and argues that the confidentiality protection of revised article 5.4.2 excludes professionals bound by professional codes, creating an anomalous distinction and risking avoidance of care.
Is it correct that the protection of the amended article 5.4.2, second paragraph, applies only to legally regulated professional secrecy?
Klopt het dat de bescherming van het gewijzigde artikel 5.4.2, tweede lid, uitsluitend geldt voor wettelijk geregelde beroepsgeheimen?

Asks why extra data processing is the chosen instrument, how misuse of the broad 'serious multiple problems' category is prevented, and requests that the AMvB on participating parties be received before entry into force.
The PVV members also remain critical of the choice to further define the circle of involved parties via a general administrative order (AMvB).
De leden van de PVV-fractie blijven daarnaast kritisch op de keuze om de kring van betrokken partijen via algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) nader vorm te geven.
Asks for concretisation of 'necessary' and 'serious reasons' for refusing data provision, to reduce handling uncertainty for professionals, and asks whether bemoeizorg should be anchored in the Wmo.
These members ask whether the government wishes to further concretise what the term 'necessary' means.
Deze leden vragen of de regering nader wil concretiseren wat het begrip «noodzakelijk» inhoudt.
Has no questions for the government at this stage.
At this moment they have no questions for the government.
Zij hebben op dit moment geen vragen aan de regering.

Asks whether the Raad van State should be asked for further advice on the nota van wijziging, and objects that the government insists on a detailed prescribed procedure for municipalities against the Council of State's advice.
The SGP members note that the government insists on prescribing a detailed procedure for municipalities, which runs counter to the advice of the Council of State's division.
De leden van de SGP-fractie constateren dat de regering eraan vasthoudt om gemeenten een gedetailleerde procedure voor te schrijven, wat haaks staat op het advies van de Afdeling.

Welcomes the attention to professional confidentiality but questions whether handling uncertainty is resolved, asks about a reporting right, and asks why professionals bound by professional codes are excluded.
At the same time they see that concerns in other sectors have not been resolved with the proposed amendment.
Tegelijk zien zij dat zorgen bij juist andere sectoren met de voorgestelde wijziging niet zijn weggenomen.
Warns that mixing care and security purposes and breaching confidentiality for involuntary trajectories risks care avoidance, and notes there is no clear separate legal basis yet for bemoeizorg.
The SP members also see that care professionals warn of the risks of care avoidance when professional confidentiality is breached in involuntary trajectories under this bill.

De leden van de SP-fractie zien ook dat zorgprofessionals waarschuwen voor de risico's voor zorgmijding wanneer het beroepsgeheim wordt doorbroken in het kader van onvrijwillige trajecten via dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks for data on how many reported persons accepted voluntary help, whether citizens know about the local reporting points, and how municipalities' support is made accessible.
What percentage of the reported persons who were offered help voluntarily agreed to the offered help following the report?
Hoeveel (percentage) van de gemelde personen die hulp aangeboden gekregen hebben, hebben vrijwillig ingestemd met de aangeboden hulp naar aanleiding van de gemaakte melding?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised in October 2021 that the draft Wet aanpak meervoudige problematiek sociaal domein go beyond the necessary data-processing grounds by also prescribing how coordinated approaches must be organised (coordinator, casusoverleg, meldpunt), and urged strengthening client legal protection, clarity on controller responsibility and the scope of professional secrecy breaches. The government's reply largely accepts the privacy and legal-protection points, narrowing secrecy-breach grounds, clarifying controller roles and client complaint routes, while retaining the coordinator and procedural framework as necessary for legal certainty and effective support.
concerns: The Afdeling advised limiting the bill to strictly necessary data-processing grounds and deleting provisions prescribing how coordinated approaches are organised, which the government only partly accepted by keeping the coordinator and procedural framework.

The Afdeling found the far-reaching intrusion on privacy (Art. 10 Grondwet, Art. 8 EVRM) insufficiently safeguarded and asked for stronger legal protection of vulnerable clients, which the government addressed by expanding the explanation on client rights and complaint routes.
The open norm 'goed hulpverlenerschap' as ground for breaching professional secrecy was judged insufficiently bounded and was replaced by a more concrete purpose criterion.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on who is controller for the data processing when the coordinator works for a party other than the municipality, and the government clarified that the employing party or college is controller.
The unclear switching between a consent-based investigation and one initiated by a professional without client cooperation was addressed by explaining the strict conditions and retention rules.

The Afdeling asked for assurance that professionals and partners are adequately trained in privacy and data sharing; the government pointed to existing support programmes and tools without fully resolving the capacity concern.

The Afdeling questioned the future delegated regulation on technical standards and data-exchange formats and their investment consequences; the government decided not to introduce such rules for now but to set security requirements by AMvB.
The Afdeling noted the meldpunt provision went too far into organisation details, and the government deleted the sentence on regulating meldpunt organisation.

36349.s: The bill amends the Aliens Act 2000 to extend the decision period for applications for provisional residence permits for family reunification with asylum status holders to nine months, with possible extension for complex cases. It also allows the refusal of asylum-related temporary residence permits to be avoided where delays are objectively excusable and extends the general decision period for asylum-related residence permit applications by up to three months.
36349.j: The memorandum justifies the longer decision period by the complexity of family reunification cases and adopts the Council of State's advice to add an excusability safeguard for exceptional cases.
q: The Minister may extend this term in case of special circumstances related to the complex nature of processing the application.
Onze Minister kan deze termijn verlengen in geval van bijzondere omstandigheden die verband houden met het complexe karakter van de behandeling van de aanvraag.
d: extending nine-month decision period in complex family reunification cases
p: The minister may extend the decision period beyond the regular term in cases of particular complexity, with the extension tied to specified circumstances.
A residence permit may not be refused for late decisions where the delay is objectively excusable due to special circumstances, a safeguard for applicants.</description_en>
Decision periods for asylum permit applications may be extended by up to three months in duly justified cases needed for proper and complete assessment.</description_en>

parties: Asks whether the IND will actually use longer deadlines, whether extra workload from notifying decisions is undesirable, and how the discretionary grounds for extension rank against each other.
Worried about legal certainty of the extension grounds and asks for a juridical basis for categorical three-month extensions and for keeping applicants informed.
Can the government legally substantiate that it is permissible to categorically establish that the decision period is extended by three months, ask the members of the D66 faction.
Kan de regering juridisch onderbouwen dat het toegestaan is categoriaal vast te stellen dat de beslistermijn met drie maanden wordt verlengd, zo vragen de leden van de D66-fractie.
Understands the temporary need for longer deadlines but asks which other asylum deadlines deviate from EU directives.
The members of the CDA faction ask the government to make clear whether, in addition to these adjustments, other decision deadlines in our asylum legislation deviate from EU law.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering inzichtelijk te maken of er naast deze aanpassingen nog andere beslistermijnen in onze asielwetgeving afwijken van het Unierecht.
Argues the bill is a structural change without implementation testing, opposes open-ended extensions, and asks for a binding end term and transparency on backlogs.
Unlimited extension of the decision period is a far-reaching power, state the members of the GroenLinks and PvdA faction.
Het onbeperkt verlengen van de beslistermijn is een verregaande bevoegdheid, zo stellen de leden van de Groenlinks- en PvdA-fractie.
Asks how the bill relates to EU migration pact negotiations and requests quantitative insight into IND workload effects.
The members of the SGP faction ask how this proposal relates to the negotiations on the EU migration pact regarding the Procedures Directive and the Family Reunification Directive.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen hoe dit voorstel zich verhoudt tot de onderhandelingen over het EU-migratiepact ten aanzien van de Procedurerichtlijn en Gezinsherenigingsrichtlijn.
Strongly doubts conformity with EU law, the ECHR and the Children's Rights Convention, argues the workload is structural rather than exceptional, and asks for concrete statutory limits.
Extending decision periods offers relief only in the short term but thereby shifts the problem, because backlogs will continue to grow.
Het verlengen van beslistermijnen biedt louter op de korte termijn soelaas, maar verplaatst daarmee het probleem, omdat achterstanden verder zullen oplopen.
Believes longer deadlines counterproductively slow asylum procedures and asks whether the bill makes family reunification less attractive.
Everyone in the Netherlands has been calling for years that asylum procedures must be faster.
Iedereen in Nederland roept al jaren dat de asielprocedures sneller moeten.
Asks whether the bill respects objections to the August 2022 nareis suspension, which the Council of State rejected, especially harm to children and family life.
And then not so much the formal objections to postponing actual issuance of the mvv after a positive decision on the application.
En dan niet zozeer de formele bezwaren tegen uitstel van daadwerkelijke afgifte van de mvv na een positief besluit op de aanvraag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill extending asylum and family reunification decision deadlines in the Vreemdelingenwet 2000, raising concerns about unnormed extension grounds, notification timing, and the cumulative effect of stacked deadlines on family life. The government's reply accepts the notification point and adds guidance on extensions, but largely rejects the call for statutory limits and rejects the claim of unlawful stacking of deadlines.
concerns: Stacking of asylum and family reunification deadlines may separate families for long periods, affecting Article 8 ECHR, children's rights and Article 7 of the Charter; the government argues the cumulative effects were already assessed at EU level and the ECtHR cases are distinguishable.

The bill does not norm when exceptional circumstances justify extension beyond nine months nor set a time limit, so foreigners cannot foresee how long extensions last; the government declines statutory limits but will specify grounds and interim reporting in IND policy.

The bill allows a decision deadline longer than the Family Reunification Directive permits, since the notification of the decision must also occur within the nine-month period; the government accepts and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
No consultation, advice from the Adviesraad Migratie, or implementation test was carried out; the government explains urgency and that the IND has prepared implementation.

36350-III.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2023 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Office of the King, and the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services, effective retroactively from 1 June 2023. It contains only budget figure changes and no delegation of rule-making power or changes to oversight.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA), the budget statement of the Office of the King (IIIB), and the budget statement of the Supervisory Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (IIIC).

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA), de begrotingsstaat van het Kabinet van de Koning (IIIB), de begrotingsstaat van de Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (IIIC)

36358.s: The bill allows judges and court officials who have reached the mandatory retirement age of seventy to be temporarily reappointed as deputy judges or deputy councillors until the first day of the month after they turn seventy-three, moving the rule from the COVID-19 emergency act into the Wrra. It also extends the same regime to members of the Central Appeals Tribunal and the Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal, sunsets the provisions three years after entry into force, and requires an evaluation within eighteen months.
36358.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary extension by the backlog of cases and the shortage of judges caused by COVID-19 and age-related outflow, and says it preserves judicial independence while avoiding fixed-term appointments that would compromise it.
q: The bill is essentially a slightly modified continuation of the current scheme in the Second COVID-19 Omnibus Emergency Act on appointing deputy councillors and deputy judges after reaching the age of seventy.

Het wetsvoorstel vormt in essentie een licht gewijzigde voortzetting van de huidige regeling in de Tweede Verzamelspoedwet over de benoeming van raadsheren-plaatsvervangers en rechters-plaatsvervangers na het bereiken van de ontslagleeftijd van zeventig jaar.
p: Artikel I B (artikel 54a, eerste en vierde lid)

Reappointment of retired judges as deputy judges is made possible on a recommendation by the court board and the Council for the Judiciary, and the Minister then discharges them by royal decree at age seventy-three, with a sunset after three years.

parties: Asks about case mix handled by older substitute judges, whether courts can recall judges for specific areas, and whether structural measures and full-time work incentives are needed.
Can an estimate be made per legal area of which cases are handled by this group?
Kan een inschatting worden gemaakt per rechtsgebied welke zaken worden afgedaan door deze groep?
Strongly supports timely case handling and questions the reach of the scheme, asking whether retired judges could also train new judges and why the measure is temporary rather than permanent.
These members therefore strongly endorse the government's aim with the bill, but they have some questions about the implementation and scope of the bill.
Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van de regering met het wetsvoorstel dan ook ten zeerste, maar zij hebben nog enkele vragen over de invulling en reikwijdte van het wetsvoorstel.
Welcomes urgency but questions whether the extra appointments can close the shortage in three years, citing the Raad van State, and asks for missing figures on shortage and inflow/outflow.
Does the government share the Council of State's view that it is not plausible that the shortage can be eliminated in three years through the additional appointments the bill enables?
Deelt de regering de stelling van de Raad van State dat het niet aannemelijk is dat het tekort in drie jaar door de extra benoemingen die het wetsvoorstel mogelijk maakt, kan worden weggenomen?

Accepts the need for a fix but calls the bill far from ideal, blaming years of underinvestment, and asks whether the arrangement is voluntary for both judge and court board and whether it creates a right or duty to keep working.
These members do want to emphasise that this legislation is far from an ideal solution.
Deze leden willen wel benadrukken dat deze wetgeving een verre van ideale oplossing betreft.

Shocked that many criminal cases were dropped (seponeerd) due to staff shortages and asks on what criteria cases were dropped and how the problem appears nationally, and whether it also affects non-criminal cases.
For the BBB member it is new to hear that a large number of criminal cases are being dropped because of staff shortages.
Voor het lid van de BBB-fractie is het nieuw om te horen dat er een groot aantal strafzaken geseponeerd wordt omwille van personeelstekorten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on a bill letting judges and judicial officers work up to three more years as substitute judges after mandatory retirement at 70, that it is doubtful the judicial shortage can be solved in three years and that an evaluation clause should be added and concretised. The minister's reply adopts the advice, adds an evaluation clause requiring a report within 18 months, and adds a transitional provision.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts that the three-year temporary measure can close the judicial shortage given missing data and inexperienced new judges, but the government did not dispute the shortage analysis beyond planning an evaluation.
The Afdeling advises including an evaluation clause in the bill, in line with legislative guidelines, and concretising how the evaluation will be completed in time.
The Afdeling flags the need to set criteria for reappointment and to address possibly diminished individual suitability due to age, which the government addresses only in limited form.

36367.s: The bill is a technical omnibus amendment (Verzamelwet Omgevingswet) correcting cross-references, terminology, portfolio names and minor substantive points in the Omgevingswet and related laws. It also adjusts some delegation and procedural details, such as removing provincial power to set certain rules in the environmental ordinance and clarifying noise-sanitation transitional rules.
36367.j: The memorandum justifies the changes mainly as technical corrections, portfolio alignment and clarification of existing powers, and for the removal of art. 2.22(2) as duplicative of art. 2.8.
q: It contains no substantive changes in the area of supervision or enforcement.
Het bevat op het gebied van toezicht of handhaving geen materiële wijzigingen.
d: ARTIKEL I, A, 2 (art. 2.15, nieuw vierde lid)
rules on flood probability and failure probability of primary flood defences
ARTIKEL I, C (art. 2.18, eerste lid, onder g, onder 2°)
designation of Natura 2000 areas and special national nature areas exempt from conservation measures
cases where provinces or ministers decide on repeat environmental permit applications
rules making permits conditional on allocation of nitrogen deposition space
Minister may impose a tolerance duty on owners for specified energy and heat networks
municipalities, water boards and provinces may levy fees for permit and related applications
authorities whose consent is required may require the competent authority to pay costs of advice and consent requests
ARTIKEL X, K (Invoeringswet art. 5.1, derde lid)
transitional or deviating rules under the Omgevingswet and the supplementary acts
ARTIKEL XVIII/XVII (Wet luchtvaart and Wet milieubeheer delegations, generic)
adjusted cross-references to regulatory rules on aviation and environmental permits
p: Removes the explicit power of provincial executives to set certain rules in the provincial environmental ordinance, leaving the general delegation route.
Allows designated authorities to decide repeat permit applications and lets other bodies be designated as competent authority, widening executive discretion over permit allocation.
Gives consenting authorities the power to require payment of advice and consent costs from the competent authority.
Lets the infrastructure minister impose tolerance duties on rights holders for energy and heat networks after consultation with another minister.
Broadens the ministerial regulation power to deviate from Omgevingswet provisions and supplementary acts, with only inter-ministerial consultation as a constraint.
ARTIKEL VII (Elektriciteitswet 1998, arts. 9b, 9c, 20a) and VIII (Gaswet, art. 39b)

Allows ministers or provincial executives to forgo a project decision where another authority can decide, with notice requirements, and excludes these decisions from direct appeal to the administrative court.;

parties: Has no further questions on the bill.
The members of the VVD group have taken note of the documents.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de stukken.
Has no questions or comments on the bill.
The members of the CDA group have no questions or comments on the bill.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben geen vragen of opmerkingen bij het wetsvoorstel
Has taken note of the bill and asks no questions.
Zij zien af van het stellen van vragen.

Asks whether provinces should be given the same flexibility as municipalities to skip the project procedure for wind projects, and asks about compensation for higher implementation costs borne by subnational governments.
As the bill for the Environment and Planning Act now stands, the GroenLinks members understand, municipalities are given the option to forgo the project procedure for wind projects.
Zoals het wetvoorstel voor de Omgevingswet er nu uitziet, zo begrijpen de leden van de GroenLinks-fractie, krijgen gemeenten bij windprojecten de mogelijkheid om af te zien van de projectprocedure.

Asks the government to concretely explain expropriation under the Act and whether faster expropriation is intended, and asks whether hunters and falconers are burdened more than other permit applicants.
Does the government agree that through this change hunters and falconers are burdened more than other permit applicants?
Is de regering het ermee eens dat door deze wijziging de jagers en valkeniers meer bezwaard worden dan andere vergunningsaanvragers?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the Verzamelwet Omgevingswet 20, a technical omnibus bill amending the Omgevingswet and related laws, and advises submitting it to parliament. The minister's nader rapport notes that no substantive changes were needed but makes several technical, non-substantive amendments in consistency of terminology, aviation law references and transitional provisions.

36385.s: The bill amends the Wet langdurige zorg and the Algemene Kinderbijslagwet so that the CIZ may inform parents of children in intensive care about a possible right to doubled child benefit, and the SVB may grant that benefit ex officio with up to six months of retroactive effect. It also indexes child benefit amounts and lets the CIZ share personal data with the SVB, with several rules to be fixed later by ministerial regulation.
36385.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the non-take-up of the doubled child benefit among parents who already have a Wlz indication, and by aligning retroactivity with other benefit schemes.
q: These are parents who already have to arrange a lot with the government for their child: a great deal is already demanded of them.
Het gaat om ouders die al veel moeten regelen met de overheid voor hun kind: er wordt al veel beroep op hen gedaan.
d: detailed rules on CIZ data processing for notifying parents
p: The SVB may grant doubled child benefit ex officio on CIZ information rather than only on application, with retroactive effect of up to six months, and the parent may object only after notice.

parties: Asks whether the government guarantees that medical or personal data exchanged between CIZ and SVB will not leak, and whether the procedure for the other 75% of beneficiaries can be made more efficient.
Nevertheless, the VVD members ask the government whether it guarantees that medical or personal data will not end up on the street through this data exchange.
Toch vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie aan de regering of zij garandeert dat medische- of persoonsgegevens door die gegevenswisseling niet op straat belanden.
Welcomes the proposal as an important improvement for parents of children needing intensive care and as a way to counter non-take-up; has no further questions.
They consider the proposal an important improvement for parents of a child with intensive care and to counter non-use.
Zij vinden het voorstel een belangrijke verbetering voor ouders met een kind met intensieve zorg en om niet gebruik tegen te gaan.
Asks whether targeted informing of parents remains necessary once benefits are granted automatically, and whether automatic granting creates extra risk of reclaims from beneficiaries.
Can the government also confirm that there is no additional risk of reclaims due to the automatic granting of DKIZ?
Kan de regering daarnaast bevestigen dat er geen extra risico op terugvorderingen bestaat door het ambtshalve toekennen van DKIZ?
Asks how the measures relate to each other, whether informing parents is still needed under automatic granting, whether the AKW+ will be retained, and whether there is extra clawback risk.
Can the government also confirm that there is no additional risk of reclaims due to the automatic granting of DKIZ?
Kan de regering daarnaast bevestigen dat er geen extra risico op terugvorderingen bestaat door het ambtshalve toekennen van DKIZ?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill to simplify the double child benefit for intensive care, but asks the government to clarify whether the SVB must grant it ex officio after a CIZ signal, how to handle omissions, and how to handle erroneous ex officio grants. The minister's reply explains that granting is mandatory, adds safeguards (notifications, feedback loop, informing parents), clarifies retroactive recovery rules, and adjusts the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: Unclear whether the SVB is obliged or merely empowered to grant double child benefit ex officio after a CIZ signal; the minister confirms it is mandatory and clarifies Article 14 AKW.
Unclear how to proceed if ex officio granting wrongly fails to happen; the minister adds notification, feedback-loop and parent-information safeguards and a post-objection route.
Unclear how to handle benefits granted ex officio in error; the minister explains existing recovery and revision rules and the five-year review term apply.

36394.s: The bill creates a temporary statutory basis obliging municipal mayors and aldermen to provide material and immaterial reception to displaced persons from Ukraine, replacing emergency provisions of the Wvb, while the national Minister handles medical cost coverage. It delegates detailed rules to ministerial regulations, allows processing of health data, amends the COA Act to exclude displaced persons during the temporary period, and expires by royal decree no later than one year after the EU temporary protection ends.
36394.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying detailed rules on reception and health data must be set by ministerial regulation, and that emergency powers were not reinstated as disproportionate.
q: The present bill provides for a necessary amendment of the COA Act for that purpose.
Het onderhavige voorstel van wet voorziet in een daarvoor noodzakelijke wijziging van de Wet COA.
d: how municipalities provide reception, benefits and conditions for displaced persons
how the Minister provides medical care for displaced persons
rules on specific grant to municipalities for reception costs
specific safeguards for processing health data
p: Assigns municipal mayors and aldermen a reception task and the national Minister a medical care coverage task without new powers attached.
Allows municipalities and the Minister to process health data, subject to a four-year retention limit and ministerial safeguards.

parties: Asks how the statutory task shift from mayor to college affects municipal duties and how the bill relates to the decentralised asylum reception law.
The VVD asks whether the government can explain to what extent the statutory task changes by shifting attribution from mayors alone to the college of mayor and aldermen.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering kan toelichten in hoeverre de wettelijke taakstelling verandert door de verschuiving van attributie van de wettelijke taak van alleen burgemeesters naar het college van burgemeester en wethouders.
Welcomes replacing emergency law but urged caution earlier and wants a timely plan for the handover of reception to COA.
They are therefore pleased the government has submitted a replacement proposal, though they would have preferred it on a much shorter timeframe.](#)
Zij zijn dan ook verheugd dat de regering een vervangend voorstel heeft ingediend, al hadden deze leden het liever op een veel kortere termijn gezien.
Questions vague duration language, unequal regimes for asylum groups, and the legal protection of people wrongly removed from reception and the BRP.
These members would like a more concrete estimate and greater grip on the duration of this serious reception crisis.
Deze leden zien graag een concretere inschatting en meer grip op de duur van deze ernstige opvangcrisis.
Objects that broad delegation to ministerial regulations keeps key reception rules outside parliamentary view and questions whether the emergency still justifies the change.
Moreover, the proposed law places a considerable part of the regulation for the reception of Ukrainians outside parliament's view through delegation.
Bovendien plaatst de voorgestelde wet een aanzienlijk deel van de regelgeving voor de opvang van Oekraïners via delegatie buiten het zicht van het parlement.
Stresses that emergency powers must end as soon as strictly necessary and asks how that principle has been applied since April 2022.
They consider it necessary that the use of emergency state powers be ended as soon as possible.
Zij achten het noodzakelijk dat de inzet van staatsnoodrecht zo spoedig mogelijk wordt beëindigd.
Asks why the emergency is no longer treated as such when the numbers of displaced persons have stayed the same, and how the bill relates to the Spreidingswet.
What is the government's reason for no longer regarding the situation as an 'emergency' while the figures have remained the same?
Wat is de reden van de regering om de situatie niet meer als «nood» aan te merken, terwijl de cijfers gelijk zijn gebleven?
Asks about the transition after temporary protection lapses and how the structural basis for reception would work if another large influx occurs.
What does the period look like after this temporary protection lapses?
Hoe ziet de periode er na het vervallen van deze tijdelijke bescherming er echter uit?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on 8 June 2023, that the government had not sufficiently justified replacing the emergency-law articles 2c and 4 Wvb with a temporary statute, given that the underlying extraordinary circumstances had not changed, and raised concerns about feasibility, the relation to the Spreidingswet, and GDPR safeguards. The government's nader rapport of 29 June 2023 maintains that the extraordinary circumstances persist, explains the additional provisions needed, clarifies the coexistence with the Spreidingswet, and adds a ministerial-regulation safeguard for health data.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether the extraordinary circumstances justifying emergency law still exist and why a temporary statute is needed instead of continuing separate application of articles 2c and 4 Wvb; the government reaffirmed the circumstances persist and gave additional reasons for the statute.
The Afdeling found the explanatory memorandum too brief on why the statute is needed and on the short duration relative to the procedural effort; the government expanded the justification.

The Afdeling asked for more explanation of feasibility, the long-term perspective, and the coexistence of the Spreidingswet with the temporary regime, including which body coordinates reception; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.

The Afdeling required specific and suitable safeguards for processing special categories of personal data (health data) under the GDPR, to be fixed in the statute or by delegated rule; the government added a paragraph to article 6 providing for ministerial regulation of such measures.

36470-X.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (second supplementary budget), changing commitments, expenditure and receipts across the policy articles and non-policy articles, with an increase of about 289 million euros in expenditure. It also adds a 7.6 million euro transfer to the Defence materiel budget fund and includes a subsidy overview, and it takes effect retroactively from 1 December 2023.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2023

36484.s: The bill amends the Dutch accountancy laws to improve audit quality through audit quality indicators, stronger internal supervisory bodies at large audit firms, a power for the professional body (NBA) to assign an audit firm to public-interest entities that cannot find one, and transfer of supervision to the AFM. It also tightens disciplinary rules and changes NBA governance.
36484.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to create uniform, updatable quality indicators and to adapt rules to societal developments, with the NBA evaluating them periodically and reporting to the Minister.
q: The bill includes a power to assign, as a last resort, an audit firm to a public-interest entity.
Het wetsvoorstel omvat hiertoe een aanwijzingsbevoegdheid waarbij – als ultimum remedium – een accountantsorganisatie aan een organisatie van openbaar belang wordt toegewezen.
d: Artikel I, M (artikel 45a, eerste lid, Wet op het accountantsberoep)
maximum retention period for reported information
extend reporting duty to other categories of audits
costs of recognition of foreign qualifications charged to applicant
extend assignment regime to additional public bodies
further rules on assignment application and criteria
rules on exercise of AFM penalty-payment power
p: The NBA, a professional body, is empowered to assign an audit firm and set a reasonable fee binding on the parties, with the decision subject to appeal only in limited form.

Strengthens internal supervisory bodies of large audit firms with approval rights over profit distribution, investments and major decisions, shifting control from managing directors to internal oversight.
Reframes the quality control system so that audit work is under responsibility of an external accountant, without direct effect on state power.
Makes it optional rather than mandatory for the supervisor to take account of certain factors when supervising compliance, widening supervisory discretion.

Allows the Accountantskamer's appeal body to decide cases without a hearing when appeals are manifestly inadmissible, unfounded or well-founded, narrowing procedural protection for disciplined accountants.
Gives the AFM power to impose penalty payments and administrative fines to enforce new duties, with a finality condition before sanctions for breaches of the assignment duty.

parties: Questions whether the regulatory burden and extension of AQI reporting to regular license holders is proportionate and whether the regulation's effects are justified.
Has the government had an SME test carried out on the entire bill?
Heeft de regering een MKB-toets laten uitvoeren op het gehele wetsvoorstel?
Asks how controlekwaliteit is defined, who oversees the accuracy of AQIs, and how privacy risks of publishing indicators for small firms are addressed.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members note that the AFM does not supervise the accuracy of the AQIs.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie merken op dat de AFM geen toezicht houdt op de juistheid van de AQI’s.
Supports structural quality improvement but questions the designation power, which the Council of State and the science check say should be limited, and asks why the scope may be extended by AMvB.
Why has the government, despite this criticism, included a legal basis to extend the target group beyond public-interest entities?
Waarom heeft de regering in het wetsvoorstel, ondanks deze kritiek, een grondslag opgenomen om de doelgroep te kunnen verruimen buiten de organisaties van openbaar belang?
Worries about burden on small firms and asks why the Council of State's advice for a prior experiment was not followed and whether the Chamber should approve before extension.
How does the government view a provision guaranteeing that the Chamber must first approve again after evaluation before the target group is extended?
Hoe kijkt de regering aan tegen een bepaling die waarborgt dat de Kamer na evaluatie eerst weer akkoord moet gaan voordat de doelgroep wordt uitgebreid?
Asks why the evaluation is not in the statute and whether the Minister's discretion over indicators has set frameworks.
Is it correct that the evaluation of the law is not included in the statutory text itself?
Klopt het dat de evaluatie van de wet niet in de wettekst zelf is opgenomen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised (30 Nov 2023) on the Wet toekomst accountancysector, raising concerns about the privacy and cost burden of quality-indicator reporting with named accountants, the proposed making of accountant organisations liable for individual file failures (contrary to the existing responsibility split and the Audit Directive), and the scope of the designation power. The Minister's reply (12 Dec 2023) largely accepted the points: pseudonymisation of names, a phased rollout starting with PIE audit firms, reworded liability norm, and limiting the designation power to PIE audits (with a statutory basis for other categories).
concerns: Publishing named accountants in quality indicators is a serious privacy intrusion not adequately justified; the government introduced pseudonymisation of names.
Effectiveness of quality indicators is unproven and costs are passed on; the government phased the rollout and committed to evaluation but kept a reporting obligation.

Making audit firms directly liable for serious failures in individual files departs from the statutory responsibility split and is insufficiently motivated; the government reworded the norm and clarified shared responsibility.
The proposal's relation to the Audit Directive's supervision requirements needs substantive justification; the government reworded the provision and argued compatibility.
The designation power is an ultimum remedium lacking a structural solution and should be limited to the PIE segment; the government restricted it to organisations of public interest.
Compliance cost differentiation for small accountancy firms raised in consultation was noted but not clearly resolved.

36493.s: The bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate by adding €20 million in one-off supplementary funding for energy assistance to Ukraine, with retroactive effect to 22 January 2024. It does not delegate rule-making power or alter oversight, judicial review or citizens' legal protection.
q: Energy assistance Ukraine 7,500 20,000 27,500
Energiehulp Oekraïne 7.500 20.000 27.500

36547.s: The bill modernises the Dutch criminal offences of human trafficking (mensenhandel) and child trafficking in the Criminal Code and the Caribbean Netherlands Criminal Code, redefines the means and exploitation elements, and adds new offences of serious harm (ernstige benadeling) and profiting from exploitation, with aggravating grounds and conforming amendments. It also sets a five-year review obligation for the Minister of Justice and Security.
36547.j: The memorandum justifies the new serious-harm offence by the high evidentiary threshold for labour exploitation and the need to fill a gap in criminal law, and does not rely on delegated or executive powers.
q: In view of this, introducing the offence of serious harm forms a desirable additional rung on the criminal law ladder.
Met het oog daarop vormt de introductie van het misdrijf ernstige benadeling een wenselijke extra sport op de strafrechtelijke ladder.

parties: Asks whether the overlap between trafficking and serious harm and the vague thresholds leave legal certainty and the legality principle wanting.
This overlap means that, despite the examples in the explanatory memorandum, it remains unclear when there is exploitation in the sense of trafficking and when serious harm.

Deze overlap zorgt ervoor dat, ondanks het feit dat in de memorie van toelichting voorbeelden worden genoemd, het onduidelijk blijft wanneer er sprake is van uitbuiting in de zin van mensenhandel en wanneer van ernstige benadeling.
Supports easier proof of trafficking but asks about the role of prosecutors, the Arbeidsinspectie and the delineation of administrative versus criminal enforcement.
Supports the amendments and asks about the effectiveness and implementation of the bill.
The NSC members express support for the proposed legislative amendments and are enthusiastic about their potential impact in the fight against human trafficking.
De leden van de NSC-fractie spreken steun uit voor de voorgestelde wetswijzigingen en zijn enthousiast over de potentiële impact die deze kunnen hebben in de strijd tegen mensenhandel.
Questions whether the lower evidentiary threshold for serious harm is really lower given that coercion is not explicitly required.
These members note, however, that coercion, as in the original legislation, is not explicitly required.
Deze leden constateren echter dat dwang, net als in de oorspronkelijke wetgeving, niet expliciet noodzakelijk is.
Questions the low maximum penalties, the treatment of organ removal versus other exploitation, and the penalty for profiting from trafficking.
When someone must give up organs against their will or a child is sexually exploited against their will, twelve or fifteen years is really not enough.
Op het moment dat iemand tegen zijn zin organen moet afstaan of een kind tegen zijn zin seksueel wordt uitgebuit, volstaat twaalf of vijftien jaar echt niet.
Asks why separate offences for serious labour exploitation were not chosen, whether the threshold of serious harm is too high, and about passport confiscation.
These members want to prevent cases of serious labour exploitation from falling between the cracks.
Deze leden willen namelijk voorkomen dat gevallen van ernstige arbeidsuitbuiting tussen wal en schip vallen.
Welcomes clarifications but worries that the term ernstige benadeling is unclear and that victims of serious harm get less protection; asks for marital exploitation to be recognised.
These members therefore ask the government whether the amendment of current legislation does not in fact lead to less victim protection than before for victims of serious harm.
Deze leden vragen de regering daarom of de aanpassing van de huidige wetgeving niet leidt tot juist minder slachtofferbescherming dan voorheen als het gaat om slachtoffers van ernstige benadeling.
Hopes for better victim protection but argues the non-punishment principle should be codified in law, as the Public Prosecution Service and others advised.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the human trafficking modernisation bill, raising comments on the relation to the EU directive revision, the relation between criminal and administrative enforcement, and the term 'ernstige benadeling', and agreed with not codifying the non-punishment principle. The government's reply accepted the directive-related and terminology points by amending the explanatory memorandum and agreed on the non-punishment choice, so the bill proceeds with supplementary clarifications.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address how the bill relates to the planned revision of Directive 2011/36, which the government followed by adding a passage clarifying the implementing bill will follow separately.

The explanatory memorandum should address the relationship between administrative and criminal enforcement in combating trafficking and serious disadvantage in labour, which the government addressed by committing to review the inspectorate's approach.

The term 'ernstige benadeling' used in criminal law may cause confusion with the Labour Inspectorate's administrative definition, and the government followed the advice by clarifying the distinction in the memorandum and by the Inspectorate limiting its use of the term.

On the non-punishment principle the Afdeling agreed with the government's choice not to codify it in law, noting that prosecutorial and judicial discretion suffices, so no change was needed beyond explanation.

36560-X.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Article X) and the agency budget statement, recording final budget adjustments and realisation figures. It is a technical budget-closing law setting out spending and commitment mutations by article.

36565.s: The bill renames the national waste management plan (landelijk afvalbeheerplan) to circulair materialenplan in the Wet milieubeheer and related provisions. It adds a duty for administrative bodies that deviate from the circular materials plan in a draft or final decision to send a copy to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management within a week.
36565.j: The memorandum justifies the duty by the previously ineffective voluntary deviation procedure in the LAP, and the need for knowledge about when and why deviations occur to support the transition to a circular economy.
q: By legally regulating an obligation for the administrative body, competent authorities that must take the CMP into account and wish to deviate from it are bindingly required to inform the Minister.

Door een verplichting voor het bestuursorgaan bij wet te regelen, wordt het voor bevoegde gezagsorganen die bij het uitoefenen van hun bevoegdheden rekening moeten houden met het CMP, en hiervan wensen af te wijken, bindend de Minister hierover te informeren.
p: Artikel I F (new lid 4 of artikel 10.14 Wm)

Administrative bodies deviating from the circular materials plan must send a copy of the draft or final decision to the Minister, creating a binding notification duty that makes deviations visible to central government.

parties: Asks how the amendment will ensure uniform regulation and whether costs for lower governments will rise as use of the deviation procedure increases.
Supports circularity goals but asks about delays from the information duty, unclear consequences for non-compliance, and whether deviation findings will inform policy.
Can the government clarify what consequences non-compliance with the duty to provide copies will have?
Kan de regering verduidelijken welke consequenties het niet naleven van de verstrekkingsverplichting met zich mee zal brengen?
Asks about prior use of the deviation procedure, alternatives considered, whether the Raad van State advice was adequately met, and how the Minister will process copies and object.
These members ask whether this adequately addressed the advice of the Raad van State.
Deze leden vragen of hiermee afdoende tegemoet gekomen is aan het advies van de Raad van State.
Asks how the plan will be evaluated, how feedback will be incorporated, and notes the ILT's warning that no consequences for non-compliance may invite evasion.
How does the government see that, and why have no consequences been laid down for this?
Hoe ziet de regering dat en waarom zijn hiervoor geen consequenties vastgelegd?
Asks why the renaming precedes substantive changes, whether evaluation of the duty's clarity will occur, and why the term deviates from the EU directive.
These members ask the government to explain why it sees the need to depart from the European term.
Deze leden vragen de regering om toe te lichten waarom ze de noodzaak ziet om af te wijken van de Europese term.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum must clarify when a deviation from the circular materials plan (CMP) occurs, since the duty to provide a copy to the Minister depends on it. The government reply states that section 2.3 of the memorandum was supplemented with information and examples on when deviation occurs, and the entry-into-force date was moved to 1 September 2025.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not make clear when a deviation from the CMP occurs, so it must be clarified before the bill is submitted.

36583.s: The bill amends the amendments to the Penitentiary Principles Act to bring them into line with the Constitution, the ECHR and EU law. It removes audiovisual and auditory supervision of lawyer-client contacts and instead sets minimum visit and phone rights, with a ministerial power to temporarily extend them in exceptional circumstances.
36583.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial extension and regulation powers by the need for flexibility for exceptional circumstances and to keep the regime workable and secure, while restoring minimum contact rights required by higher law.
q: The Minister may allow a temporary extension of the provisions in the first and second paragraphs if there are special circumstances justifying a temporary extension.
Onze Minister kan een tijdelijke verruiming van het bepaalde in het eerste en tweede lid toestaan indien sprake is van bijzondere omstandigheden die een tijdelijke verruiming rechtvaardigen.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 40b, lid 4, 6 en 7)
temporary extension of visit and phone rights and detailed rules
application of temporary extension rules to intensive supervision wing
p: Artikel I, onderdeel F (artikel 40b, lid 4 en 6)
The Minister may grant or end temporary extensions of contact rights for detainees in extra secure facilities based on exceptional circumstances, with refusals open to appeal under article 72 Pbw.
The Minister may summarily reject requests for extension that are repeatedly manifestly unfounded, subject to appeal.

parties: Asks how other ECHR states limit confidential lawyer-client contact and what options exist, including AI monitoring, to restrict this relationship on national security grounds.
Do these specific countries, or other ECHR countries, have audiovisual supervision or any general supervision of conversations between legal assistant and detainee?
Kennen deze specifieke landen, of andere «EVRM-landen», audiovisueel toezicht of enig algemeen toezicht op de gesprekken tussen rechtsbijstandverlener en gedetineerde?
Questions why some blanket measures are retained for all detainees rather than assessed individually, citing proportionality concerns.
Can the government explain why this amending proposal chose to reverse certain generic measures but not others?
Kan de regering uitleggen waarom er in voorliggend wijzigingsvoorstel is gekozen om bepaalde generieke maatregelen wel terug te draaien en anderen niet?
Supports speedy introduction of the measures while asking whether auditory supervision would conflict with Article 6 ECHR and how to weigh detainees' privacy against public safety.
Can the government also confirm that no concrete and comparable case has been submitted to the European Court of Justice?
Kan de regering ook bevestigen dat er geen concrete en vergelijkbare zaak is voorgelegd aan het Europees Hof van Justitie?
Critical of the one-size-fits-all approach applied to all EBI and AIT detainees without individual assessment, echoing concerns of the Bar and the Council of State.
The D66 members are critical of the 'one-size-fits-all' approach to visual supervision of lawyer-client conversations and a maximum of two legal assistants.
De leden van de D66-fractie zijn kritisch op de «one-size-fits-all»-benadering van het visueel toezicht op advocaat-clientgesprekken en een maximum van twee rechtsbijstandverleners.

Asks what counts as an exceptional case under ECHR case law permitting restriction of confidential lawyer contact only on individual assessment, and whether individualised audiovisual recording was considered.
These members ask whether the government considered drafting a provision allowing audiovisual recordings between detainee and lawyer in EBI and AIT, based on an individual assessment.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering heeft overwogen om een bepaling te ontwerpen dat ziet op de mogelijkheid tot audiovisuele opnamen tussen de gedetineerde en diens advocaat in de EBI en AIT, dat berust op een individuele beoordeling.
Stresses respect for democratically adopted amendments but accepts overriding them where they conflict with higher law; asks for concrete limits on detainees' daily programme and rights.
These members also see that this changes when amendments are not feasible and conflict with higher law.
Deze leden zien echter ook dat dit anders wordt als amendementen niet uitvoerbaar zijn en in strijd zijn met hoger recht.

Asks whether the government intends to implement the Ellian and Helder amendments if the House adopts them again, given the existing Code of Criminal Procedure powers to record confidential conversations.
These members ask the government whether it intends to implement the bill including the Ellian and Helder amendments if the House of Representatives adopts them again.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij voornemens is het wetsvoorstel inclusief de amendementen Ellian en Helder uit te voeren indien deze opnieuw door de Tweede Kamer aangenomen worden.
Welcomes bringing the bill into line with higher law and asks that a ministerial regulation for temporary relaxation of regimes require advice from parties informed about the detainee's situation.
These members consider it important that when granting temporary relaxation, advice is requested from parties who know the detainee's situation.
Deze leden vinden het van belang dat bij het verlenen van een tijdelijke verruiming advies wordt gevraagd bij partijen die op de hoogte zijn van de toestand van de gedetineerde.
Understands the change given conflicts with the Constitution and EU law and hopes for swift progression to the Senate.
These members understand this amendment, given that the current bill, through two adopted amendments, conflicts with the Constitution and EU law.
Deze leden hebben begrip voor deze wijziging, in het licht van het feit dat het huidige wetsvoorstel – door een tweetal aangenomen amendementen – in strijd is met de Grondwet en het Unierecht.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill amending the Penitentiary Principles Act (aanvullende maatregelen tegen georganiseerde criminaliteit tijdens detentie) may proceed without remarks, as it replaces two amendments previously adopted by the House that were deemed unconstitutional and contrary to the ECHR and the Charter. The Minister for Legal Protection responded by noting that no remarks were made and only a technical change to article 40d, paragraph 3, letters d and e was introduced.
concerns: The Afdeling made no remarks on the bill; the government introduced only a technical cross-reference correction in article 40d(3)(d) and (e).

36625-V.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs through a second supplementary budget, changing commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2024.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2024

36655.s: The bill anchors the Maatschappelijke Raad Schiphol (MRS), a citizen and expert advisory council on aviation environmental quality around Schiphol, in the Wet luchtvaart and redefines its tasks, membership and appointment rules. It also transfers the ministerial power to propose and set experimental deviations from noise rules to a broader advisory process and makes related technical amendments to the Commissies Regionaal Overleg.
36655.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as implementing the Van Geel advice on the Schiphol consultation structure and leaves detailed design to ministerial regulation and internal regulations.
q: The proposed fourth paragraph provides that the Minister may dissolve the MRS and may set further rules on this by ministerial regulation.
Het voorgestelde vierde lid bepaalt dat de Minister de MRS kan ontbinden en hierover bij ministeriële regeling nadere regels kan stellen.
d: experimental deviations from noise-related rules at Schiphol
rules on tasks and composition of the MRS
MRS internal governance regulation (bestuursreglement) with ministerial approval
rules on dissolution of the MRS
p: The minister may dissolve the MRS by ministerial decision, with rules set by ministerial regulation and no statutory criteria stated in the bill.
Experimental deviations from noise rules may be set by ministerial regulation on the basis of a non-unanimous advisory opinion, with consultation and publication required.

parties: Asks whether the MRS's purpose is to let all residents be heard and whether the current central consultation body disappears with the new structures.
The PVV members ask whether the purpose of the MRS should not be to let the voice of all residents be heard.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of het doel van de MRS niet moet zijn om de stem van alle omwonenden te laten horen.
Fears that the Minister selecting and filtering information for the MRS undermines trust; argues for timely, unfiltered access to all information.
These members fear that information will be experienced as less reliable and less complete if the Minister is the party that selects and filters the relevant information for the MRS.
Deze leden vrezen dat informatie als minder betrouwbaar en minder volledig wordt ervaren, als de Minister de partij is die de relevante informatie voor de MRS selecteert en filtert.

Questions exclusion of aviation-sector residents and the lack of equal treatment of all parties; requests a guarantee that experiments do not reduce Schiphol capacity and asks about the criteria for the voorzitter's open circle.
These members ask whether the government can confirm that an experiment may not come at the expense of the capacity at Schiphol airport.
Om die reden vragen deze leden of de regering kan bevestigen dat een experiment niet ten koste mag gaan van de capaciteit op luchthaven Schiphol.
Asks for justification of the eight-week response deadline for the Minister, the ministerial-regulation basis for rules and dissolution, and whether dissolution is a last resort.

Positive about the bill but asks for publication of MRS advice, a statutory or minimum budget for the MRS, early involvement and a legal right to information; criticises the Minister appointing the chair, undermining independence.
These members are concerned about the independence of the MRS.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen over de onafhankelijkheid van de MRS.

Worries about representativeness, balance and effectiveness of the bodies; asks whether residents outside the 48 dB(A) contour and under flight routes are adequately represented and whether economic and government interests dominate the CRO.
They do, however, express concerns about the representativeness, balance and effectiveness of these bodies.
Zij uiten echter zorgen over de representativiteit, evenwichtigheid en slagkracht van deze organen.

Worries that residents' interests are insufficiently safeguarded; asks how the Ministry defines 'necessary information', which documents may be withheld, and whether the business sector should be excluded from the MRS.
These members ask how the ministry determines what 'the necessary information' precisely means.
Deze leden vragen hoe op het ministerie wordt bepaald wat «de nodige informatie» precies inhoudt.
Has no further questions at this stage.
They currently have no further questions.
Zij hebben daarbij op dit moment geen verdere vragen.

Asks how conflicts of interest of MRS members active in citizen groups are assessed, why aviation-linked residents and travel organisations are excluded, and whether the MRS is meant to bundle active anti-noise residents.

The JA21 member asks how the government assesses a possible conflict of interest among MRS members who are also active or board members of interest groups such as Minder Hinder Gooise Meren, Recht op Bescherming tegen Vliegtuighinder, etc., or who are or have been locally politically active.

Het lid van de JA21-fractie vraagt hoe de regering een mogelijk belangenconflict bij leden van de MRS die ook actief of bestuurslid zijn in belangengroepen zoals Minder Hinder Gooise Meren, Recht op Bescherming tegen Vliegtuighinder, etc. of ook (lokaal) politiek actief (geweest) zijn, beoordeelt.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division raised no substantive remarks on the draft bill amending the Aviation Act concerning Schiphol's normen- en handhavingstelsel and the Maatschappelijke Raad Schiphol, and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's reply forwards the advice and asks that the bill and explanatory memorandum be sent to parliament, with no separate points to answer.

36664.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2021/2167 on credit servicers and credit buyers into the Wft, Book 7 of the Civil Code and the Wet op de economische delicten, introducing a licensing requirement for servicing non-performing credit agreements and supervision of credit servicers and buyers by the AFM. It also adds consumer protections such as forbearance measures, notice of changes to credit terms and transfer information, and delegates detailed rules to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations.
36664.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying that detailed rules are placed in lower regulation as is standard practice, and that the directive itself requires these supervisory powers.
q: The bill also follows standard practice of implementing a main rule in the Wft as far as possible and placing its detailed elaboration in lower legislation and regulation.
Ook is aangesloten bij de staande praktijk om een hoofdnorm zoveel mogelijk in de Wft te implementeren en de nadere uitwerking van de hoofdnorm in lagere wet- en regelgeving te verwerken.
d: full or partial exemption from the servicer licensing requirement, with conditions
further rules on the notification to borrowers of transfers and collection
rules on the setup, administration and management of the segregated account for borrower funds
form and content of the notice from credit buyers to borrowers
data a credit buyer must report to the AFM on transfers
p: Allows a ministerial regulation to exempt servicers wholly or partly from the licensing requirement, with conditions attached.
Lets the AFM prohibit a foreign-based servicer from servicing in the Netherlands if the home supervisor's measures are insufficient, after notifying that supervisor.

parties: Asks why the directive was not transposed on time, whether the bill fits the coalition agreement's ban on new national add-ons, why eight member state options are only partly used, and how enforceability and AFM supervision costs are handled.
The VVD members consider the enforceability of regulation crucial.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vinden uitvoerbaarheid van regelgeving cruciaal.

Asks about the directive's place in the capital markets and banking union, why credit sellers are not regulated, why investment funds are exempt, the single licence application, and whether the AFM's supervisory mandate and staffing must change.
The NSC members ask whether the government can further explain whether the AFM's supervisory mandate needs to be adjusted.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen of de regering nader kan toelichten of het toezichtsmandaat van de AFM dient te worden aangepast?

Asks whether the Dutch supervisor can act against entities established in other member states given limited cross-border enforcement powers, and how coordination risks with weaker host-state supervision will be mitigated.
How can the government mitigate these risks and ensure that the Dutch supervisor retains control over what happens in the Netherlands?
Hoe kan de regering deze risico’s mitigeren en ervoor zorgen dat de Nederlandse toezichthouder controle houdt op wat er in Nederland gebeurt?
Has taken note of the bill and has no questions at this stage.
The D66 and ChristenUnie members have taken note of the implementation bill and have no questions at this time.

De leden van de D66-fractie en de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de implementatiewet richtlijn kredietservicers en kredietkopers en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.
Has taken note of the bill and has no questions at this stage.
The D66 and ChristenUnie members have taken note of the implementation bill and have no questions at this time.

De leden van de D66-fractie en de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de implementatiewet richtlijn kredietservicers en kredietkopers en hebben hierover op dit moment geen vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing the EU Directive on credit servicers and credit purchasers, noting that the explanatory memorandum did not address the consequences of the missed transposition deadline and that the scope of the new duty to inform consumers of changes to credit contract terms needed clarification.
