The Minister of Finance's reply accepts both points by adding a section on the consequences of late implementation and clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that the duty covers changes to general terms of the contract.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should address the consequences of exceeding the implementation deadline, particularly for credit servicers established in the Netherlands.
The explanatory memorandum should clarify the scope of the information duty when credit contract terms are changed, including whether it covers general terms.

36682.s: This omnibus bill makes numerous technical and corrective amendments across health-sector laws under the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, including reinstating a pharmaceutical shortage exemption basis after a Council of State ruling and streamlining identity checks for long-term care indications. It also amends inspection supervision assignments, disciplinary appeal routes, and procedural criteria for special medical procedure designations.
36682.j: The memorandum justifies the procedural delegation in Wbmv article 8 by citing unclear procedures causing appeals and the need for full implementation of EU rules.
q: Therefore it is proposed to add to the delegation basis in article 8, first paragraph, Wbmv that procedural criteria may also be included in a policy vision.
Daarom wordt voorgesteld om aan de delegatiegrondslag uit artikel 8, eerste lid, Wbmv toe te voegen dat tevens procedurele criteria in een beleidsvisie kunnen worden opgenomen.
d: Artikel II C (Geneesmiddelenwet art. 40, lid 3, onderdeel c)
conditions for temporary exemptions or dispensations for unregistered medicines
Artikel IX (Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen art. 8, lid 1)
procedural criteria for designation of institutions in policy vision
Artikel IX (Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen art. 8, lid 3)
conditions attached to and modification or withdrawal of designations
p: Artikel IX (Wet op bijzondere medische verrichtingen art. 8, lid 4)
The Minister may withdraw a designation of an institution if circumstances change, a discretionary power that expands executive authority over institutions.

parties: Asks whether the medicine-shortage amendment is a step toward responsible care or merely treats the effects of preference policy.
Said members ask the government whether this is a step toward responsible care.
Genoemde leden vragen de regering of dit een stap is naar verantwoorde zorg.
Welcomes anchoring the shortage-decision basis in law after the Council of State ruling, asking for a fast, careful process and clarity on timeline and administrative burden.
They hope for a swift and careful process so care providers can again operate under the statutory regime instead of the current tolerance situation.
Zij hopen op een snel en zorgvuldig proces zodat zorgverleners weer onder het regime van de wet kunnen functioneren in plaats van onder de huidige gedoogsituatie.
Supports the amendment but asks whether the government obtained legal advice, since the provision was added too late to be advised on by the Council of State, to avoid renewed annulment risk.
Said members therefore ask whether and how the government obtained some form of legal advice to prevent the Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet from again being declared void.
Genoemde leden vragen daarom of en hoe de regering een vorm van juridisch advies heeft ingewonnen om te voorkomen dat de Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet nogmaals onverbindend kan worden verklaard.
Supports the statutory basis for shortage decisions but worries about traders exploiting scarcity by selling medicines at higher prices.
However, these members are concerned about how traders who exploit the situation by selling medicines at higher prices in the Netherlands are dealt with.
Wel hebben deze leden zorgen over hoe er wordt omgegaan met handelaren die misbruik van deze situatie maken door medicijnen tegen een hogere prijs in Nederland te verkopen.
Has no questions for the government on the omnibus bill.
The members have no questions for the government.
De leden hebben geen vragen aan de regering.

Welcomes the legal fix but asks whether the Council of State was consulted, whether the solution is legally sound, and how it differs from the annulled provision, given the Council's doubts about generic authorisation.
Precisely because shortage decisions are so important and their impact if they cannot be issued generically, a robust solution is necessary, according to these members.
Juist vanwege het grote belang van tekortenbesluiten en de impact als deze niet generiek kunnen worden afgegeven is een robuuste oplossing noodzakelijk, volgens deze leden.
Positive about the shortage-decision fix but asks about more fundamental solutions such as domestic and European medicine production, and about identity verification by CIZ.
What is the status, for example, of organising more medicine production in the Netherlands and Europe to prevent shortages?
Hoe staat het bijvoorbeeld met het organiseren van meer geneesmiddelenproductie in Nederland en Europa om tekorten te voorkomen?

Agrees an omnibus bill should only contain technical changes and that the food-safety provision rightly goes into a separate bill; asks about the Wbmv change allowing more frequent designation of institutions.
An omnibus bill is only suitable for technical changes, clarifications and policy that is not expected to spark substantive political debate.
Een verzamelwet leent zich alleen voor technische wijzigingen, verduidelijkingen en beleid waarvan verwacht kan worden dat er over de wijzigingen geen inhoudelijke politieke discussie zal ontstaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised removing article X from the Verzamelwet VWS 2024, because raising Warenwet food-safety offences to crimes under the WED is a substantive change unsuited to an omnibus bill. The government accepted the advice, removed article X, and added amendments on the Geneesmiddelenwet following a Council of State ruling.
concerns: Article X, which turns intentional food-safety violations into crimes with higher penalties, is not a technical change and should be moved to a separate bill rather than sit in an omnibus law.
Reclassifying conduct as a crime brings special investigative powers that can affect the fundamental rights of those involved, requiring careful parliamentary scrutiny.

36691.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the 2022 Framework Agreement on a broad partnership and cooperation between the EU and its member states and the Kingdom of Thailand, as required under Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: In the government's view the treaty contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het verdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet.

parties: The VVD asks why critical raw materials are not addressed in the agreement and how the EU and the Netherlands will pursue cooperation with Thailand and individual ASEAN countries on them.
The members wish to ask the government why critical raw materials do not appear in the proposal.
De fractieleden willen de regering vragen waarom kritieke grondstoffen niet in het voorstel voorkomen.
The D66 supports strengthening ties with Thailand and a free trade agreement, and raises concern about labour exploitation in Thai supply chains and asks what the government will do to counter it.
The members of the D66 faction have concerns about various forms of exploitation in Thailand in the supply chains of companies that are also active in the Netherlands and the EU.
De leden van de D66-fractie hebben zorgen over verschillende vormen van uitbuiting in Thailand in de handelsketens van bedrijven die ook actief zijn in Nederland en de EU.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill approving the 2022 framework agreement between the EU, its member states and Thailand, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Foreign Affairs transmitted the advice to the King without any separate reply, as none was required.

36740-X.s: This Dutch bill is a Slotwet that amends the 2024 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Defence (X) and the agency budget statements, setting final realized figures and technical budget adjustments. It is a budgetary accounting instrument that does not delegate rule-making power or shift authority between the executive and checks.
q: Minister of Defence R.P. Brekelmans; Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2024 (Final Budget Act)
De Minister van Defensie R.P. Brekelmans Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2024 (Slotwet)

36745.s: The bill introduces a pre-start notification procedure requiring private schools (b3-schools) to notify the minister twelve weeks before starting education, allowing the inspectorate to review their plans and declare them not a school under compulsory education law before they open. It also adds hardship exceptions in practical and special secondary education and amends related laws, including an inspector's power to grant extended stay exemptions.
36745.j: The memorandum justifies the pre-start review as a proportionate and necessary preventive measure to guarantee safe, quality education from the start, given that current oversight only begins after the school opens.
q: Prior supervision is also necessary given the government's responsibility to guarantee the right to quality and safe education.
Het voorafgaande toezicht is tevens noodzakelijk gelet op de verantwoordelijkheid die de overheid heeft om het recht op kwalitatief en veilig onderwijs te garanderen.
d: Artikel I (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, art. 11b lid 8)
inspectorate decision that a private school initiative is not a school within compulsory education law
Artikel VII (Wet op de expertisecentra, art. 39a lid 1)
inspector grants exemption from maximum stay period in special secondary education
p: Artikel I (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, art. 11b leden 7-8)
The inspectorate may, within twelve weeks of notification and after consultation, decide that a planned private school is not a school, allowing pre-start executive review of private initiatives.
Artikel VII (Wet op de expertisecentra, art. 39a)
The inspector receives discretionary power to grant one-year renewable exemptions from the statutory maximum stay in special secondary education, subject to a commission report.

parties: Asks why the commitment to strengthen the gatekeeping function for non-funded schools has not been fulfilled and how the terughoudende toets will work in practice.

These members were concerned that intervention by the inspectorate is only possible once a school has already started, for example if it turns against the basic principles of the democratic rule of law.

Deze leden waren bezorgd dat pas als een school al van start is gegaan kan worden ingegrepen door de inspectie, bijvoorbeeld als een school zich in hun onderwijs keert tegen de grondbeginselen van de democratische rechtsstaat.
Supports the aim of preventing pupils attending schools that fail minimum citizenship and safety standards but asks how the inspectorate will make the prior check more than a paper checklist.
They ask the government to further explain how the Inspectorate of Education will ensure that the prior assessment becomes more than a one-off checklist on paper.
Zij vragen de regering nader toe te lichten hoe de Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) zal waarborgen dat de voorafgaande toets meer wordt dan een eenmalige checklist op papier.

Sees some value in the prior review of b3-schools but is very critical of bundling it with hardship measures, arguing this undermines proper parliamentary scrutiny and that the restriction on freedom of education needs thorough justification.
These members share the Council of State's view that, for the sake of legislative quality and careful parliamentary treatment, it is highly undesirable to treat these laws together.
Deze leden delen het standpunt van de Raad van State dat, omwille van de wetgevingskwaliteit en een zorgvuldige wetsbehandeling, het zeer onwenselijk is deze wetten samen te behandelen.
Asks why an internal study on strengthening the gatekeeping role for non-funded schools has not been shared and whether it can be provided, and why hardship fixes were not placed in a repair act.
These members ask why this study has not been shared and whether the government can share the study.
Deze leden vragen waarom dit onderzoek niet is gedeeld en of de regering het onderzoek kan delen.

Criticises the restriction on freedom of education under article 23 of the Constitution and the Council of State's finding that necessity, proportionality and feasibility lack a sound justification, and questions the bundling of the two parts.
These members share the Council of State's criticism of restricting article 23 of the Constitution, which regulates the right to freedom of education in the Netherlands.
Deze leden delen de kritiek van de Raad van State over het inperken van artikel 23 van de Grondwet dat het recht op vrijheid van onderwijs in Nederland regelt.

Asks why the government departs from legislative drafting guidelines by bundling two separate parts, notes the consequences for the Eerste Kamer's position, and asks for justification of necessity and proportionality and an evaluation clause.
Why does the government choose this, even though it departs from the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving (legislative drafting guidelines)?
Waarom kiest de regering hiervoor, ondanks dat ze hiermee afwijkt van de Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving?
Supports prior supervision of non-funded schools but asks whether the inspectorate has enough capacity and expertise to assess within twelve weeks and how to avoid discouraging good-faith initiators.
However, these members ask the government for further explanation of the feasibility of the assessment procedure.
Wel vragen deze leden de regering om een nadere toelichting op de uitvoerbaarheid van de toetsingsprocedure.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in September 2023 that the bill introducing pre-start inspection for unfunded b3 schools restricts freedom of school founding without adequate justification of necessity, proportionality and feasibility, and that the two parts of the bill should be split. The government's nader rapport of May 2025 defends the pre-start procedure, drops the WPO article 8 lid 3a criterion and narrows the inspection's assessment to documents submitted, but rejects splitting the bill.
concerns: Pre-start inspection of b3 schools restricts the freedom of school founding under Article 23 Constitution, and necessity and proportionality were insufficiently justified; the government maintains the restriction is proportionate and necessary.

The bill gives no evidence on the scale or seriousness of problems with unfunded b3 schools, so the necessity of the pre-start procedure is not demonstrated; the government points to internal research and recent rejected applications.

A paper-based pre-start check is of limited feasibility since civic education and school culture can only be assessed in practice, and the terms 'aantoonbaar niet voldaan' need clarification; the government adds explanation and removes WPO article 8 lid 3a as criterion.

The inspection's review scope under the proposed WOT article 11b(8) is broader than the documents submitted with the notification and should be limited to matters linked to the notification content; the government limits the criteria accordingly.

The two parts of the bill (b3 start procedure and hardship in vso and pro) lack substantive coherence and the b3 part may be contested, so they should be introduced as separate bills; the government does not follow this advice.

36781.s: The bill amends the Working Conditions Act so that a temporary-staffing agency (uitlener) must itself report notifiable workplace accidents involving its agency workers to the labour inspectorate, must check after such an accident how it happened and what measures are being taken, and must keep a file. The host employer (inlener) must notify the agency of such accidents and send it a summary of measures taken after the inspection.
36781.j: The memorandum justifies the new duties by weak inspection results and the need to protect vulnerable agency workers, and leaves detailed rules to a general administrative measure (AMvB).
q: The Aanjaagteam sees the package of recommendations as a closed system of clear regulation, with enforcement at every link in the chain and ex-post control.
Het Aanjaagteam ziet het pakket aan aanbevelingen uit dit rapport als een sluitend systeem van duidelijke regelgeving, met handhaving op elk deel van de keten en controle achteraf.
d: information to record in the agency's file on accidents
further rules on the duty to verify, the summary, and the file including retention period
p: Shifts part of the monitoring and reporting burden for workplace accidents from the public inspectorate onto private agencies and host employers, a delegation of enforcement detail rather than a reduction of checks on the executive.

parties: Asks whether the Labour Inspectorate can propose or require substantive solutions and how it will handle non-reporting and intent, and whether the Inspectorate's concerns were adequately addressed.
These members ask whether the Labour Inspectorate will also act against the entity that did not make this report if one of these reports is missing.
Deze leden vragen of de Arbeidsinspectie daarmee ook gaat handelen naar de entiteit die deze melding niet heeft gedaan, als één van deze meldingen uitblijft.
Supports the bill but asks why the Council of State's question about alternative instruments was not pursued and asks for intensified enforcement of the risk-inventory obligation.
Can the government indicate whether and how it will intensify enforcement of this obligation?
Kan de regering aangeven of en hoe zij de handhaving van deze verplichting gaat intensiveren?

Questions the proportionality and effectiveness of the broad approach against the advice of the regulatory burden advisory body, the limited sanctions, and whether the Inspectorate has enough capacity and can collect cross-border fines.
How does this broad, generic approach relate to the principle that regulation must be targeted and proportionate?
Hoe verhoudt deze brede, generieke aanpak zich tot het principe dat regelgeving gericht en proportioneel moet zijn?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet to introduce a reporting duty and follow-up duty for employment agencies after workplace accidents involving agency workers, noting that the measures mainly concern information exchange and do not alter responsibility allocation, and asked for explanation of additional measures and supervision of foreign-based agencies. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport replied by clarifying and supplementing the explanatory memorandum on follow-up measures, evaluation after five years, and enforcement against foreign agencies via EU cooperation mechanisms.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for clarification of how the intended effect of the measures will be realised in practice and whether additional measures are considered; the government added clarifications and pointed to a five-year evaluation.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of supervision and enforcement against agencies established abroad; the government explained EU cooperation mechanisms (ELA, IMI, Enforcement Directive) and added this to the memorandum.

36800-III.s: This bill sets the 2026 budget appropriations for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD), in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget context and the CTIVD's oversight role, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power and shifts no power towards the executive.
q: These are technical changes that, as part of the cost recharge to the budget of the King (I), lead to receipts in the budget statement of the Cabinet of the King.
Dit betreffen technische mutaties die in het kader van de doorbelasting naar de begroting van de Koning (I) tot ontvangsten leiden op de begrotingsstaat van het Kabinet van de Koning.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division had no remarks on the 2026 budget bills for the Ministry of General Affairs, the King's Cabinet and the Intelligence Oversight Commission, and advised submitting them to parliament. The minister's nader rapport adds technical amendments to several 2026 budget bills (Ministry of General Affairs and others) and confirms the planned submission date.

36817.s: The bill amends the Dutch Wet minimumbelasting 2024 (global minimum tax) to align it with OECD administrative guidance, adjusting rules on hybrid and transparent entities, joint ventures, deferred tax liabilities, reporting periods and transitional asset valuations. It also delegates further detailed rules to general administrative orders (AMvB) on deferred tax aggregation, allocation of covered taxes and related matters.
36817.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to give practical methods for tracking deferred tax liabilities and allocating taxes, in line with OECD administrative guidance.
q: To provide a method for tracking deferred tax liabilities that matches financial reporting practice, rules will be set by general administrative order under the proposed article 7.3, eleventh paragraph.

Om te voorzien in een methodiek om passieve belastinglatenties te volgen die aansluit bij de praktijk van de financiële rapportage worden op grond van het voorgestelde artikel 7.3, elfde lid, WMB 2024 bij algemene maatregel van bestuur regels gesteld.
d: ARTIKEL I, onderdeel F/H (artikel 7.3, elfde lid)
rules on tracking deferred tax liabilities and aggregated elections
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel I (artikel 7.5, tiende lid, onderdelen b en c)
allocation of covered taxes for cross-crediting, permanent establishments, hybrid entities and distributions

parties: Asks whether companies can manipulate the effective tax rate calculation and what the consequences of retroactive effect are for taxpayers.
These members ask the government whether companies have opportunities to manipulate the outcome through this rule.
Deze leden vragen de regering of bedrijven mogelijkheden hebben om de uitkomst via deze regel te manipuleren.
Raises legal certainty concerns about retroactive effect and asks whether a hardship clause or transitional law can protect taxpayers.
The NOB has rightly noted that this may create tension with the legal certainty principle.](Note: see evidence_en)
De NOB heeft terecht opgemerkt dat dit spanning kan opleveren met het rechtszekerheidsbeginsel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Second bill amending the Minimum Tax Act 2024, implementing internationally agreed administrative guidance, and raised no remarks. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that the Afdeling had no comments and that only some editorial changes were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36835.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code to implement the revised EU human trafficking directive, adding exploitation of surrogacy, forced marriage and illegal adoption to the list of trafficking forms and narrowing the client-liability offence to trafficking or child trafficking. It includes a conflict clause so that whichever of this bill or the separate trafficking-modernisation bill enters into force first sets the wording of article 273g.
36835.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required by the EU directive and explains that judges retain wide sentencing discretion, so no new statutory aggravating factors are needed.

parties: Asks how surrogacy and illegal adoption cases in weak-regulation countries fit the new offence and the extraterritorial jurisdiction extension.

In the context of these new provisions in the Criminal Code, combined with the amendment of the BIVR, these members ask how the government assesses situations in which intended parents deliberately choose countries with weak surrogacy or illegal adoption regulation.

In het kader van deze nieuwe bepalingen in het Wetboek van Strafrecht, in combinatie met de aanpassing van het BIVR, vragen voornoemde leden hoe de regering situaties beoordeelt waarin wensouders bewust kiezen voor landen met zwakke regelgeving rondom draagmoederschap of illegale adoptie.
Supports the bill but asks for effect estimates, monitoring of sentences and the explanation of unexecuted motions and delayed legislation.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill with interest.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the expanded offences fit existing provisions, whether institutions have capacity, and how the non-punishment principle and monitoring are secured.
The CDA members ask the government to explain further what consequences the extension of article 273f Sr and the broadening of article 273g Sr have for enforcement practice.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering nader toe te lichten welke gevolgen de uitbreiding van artikel 273f Sr en de verbreding van artikel 273g Sr hebben voor de uitvoeringspraktijk.
Warns that criminalising use of non-sexual services could burden citizens and businesses who cannot reasonably be expected to be alert to exploitation.
Asks for current estimates of forced prostitution and capacity devoted to trafficking investigation.
These members ask what the current estimates are of the number of people working under coercion in prostitution in the Netherlands.
Deze leden vragen wat de huidige schattingen zijn ten aanzien van het aantal personen dat onder dwang in de prostitutie werkt in Nederland.
Asks how employers will be made aware and how knowledge of trafficking will be assessed in the broadened liability for services.
How is awareness among employers and organisations raised so that they actively check whether services may be performed by victims of trafficking?
Hoe wordt het bewustzijn bij werkgevers en organisaties vergroot zodat zij actief controleren of diensten mogelijk door slachtoffers van mensenhandel worden uitgevoerd?
Asks whether refugees and homeless people are also treated as vulnerable groups needing extra protection and about the financial burden on organisations.
These members ask the government whether it also pays extra attention to refugees and homeless people.
Deze leden vragen de regering of zij ook extra aandacht geeft aan vluchtelingen en daklozen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill implementing EU Directive 2024/1712 on human trafficking, raising concerns about the narrow reading of forced marriage exploitation, the scope of the negligence variant for using services of trafficking victims (including labour exploitation), and the need to align with the parallel amendment bill. The government reply accepted the points, amending the explanatory memorandum and the cross-reference provision and clarifying the scope of the offences.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for justification of the broader negligence variant (ernstige reden te vermoeden) for non-sexual services, which goes beyond the directive's minimum; the government justified it on uniform protection grounds and added explanation.
The Afdeling asked for clarification of how labour exploitation signals should be assessed for the using-services offence, and the government added explanation to the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked that the explanation of the draagmoederschap, gedwongen huwelijken and illegale adoptie elements be aligned with the parallel amendment to the modernised trafficking offence, and that the cross-reference provision be adjusted, which the government did.

The Afdeling questioned whether the forced marriage exploitation element is read too narrowly as limited to the post-marriage context; the government clarified in the memorandum that conduct closely linked to concluding the marriage is also covered.

36850-V.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It also sets the budget unit as thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken voor het jaar 2025

36862.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean Aviation Act (Luchtvaartwet BES) to create a legal basis for public service obligations on thinly served air routes linking Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba to airports in the Kingdom, implementing the 2011 Multilateral Protocol on air transport liberalisation. It lets the Minister set such obligations by ministerial regulation, restrict access to one carrier for up to five years via tender, impose administrative enforcement and fines, and requires a report to parliament within seven years.
36862.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to keep essential air connections to Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for medical, educational and economic purposes, with the regulation's content left to case-specific assessment.
q: The bill and the legal basis it contains for a ministerial regulation are meant to form the framework for introducing public service obligations for Bonaire, Saba and/or Sint Eustatius.

Het wetsvoorstel en de daarin opgenomen grondslag voor een ministeriële regeling moeten het kader vormen voor de invoering van het instrument van openbaredienstverplichtingen ten behoeve van Bonaire, Saba en/of Sint Eustatius.
d: establishing public service obligations on routes
continuity, frequency, prices and minimum capacity rules
tender requirements, contract changes, duration, compensation parameters
p: The Minister may impose route obligations and restrict market access to a single carrier for up to five years by ministerial regulation, after consultation with the Aruban, Curaçao and Sint Maarten governments and affected parties.

The Minister gains administrative enforcement powers (bestuursdwang, penalty payments and administrative fines up to category six) with appeal rights applied by reference to the Awb and the Wet administratieve rechtspraak BES.
The Minister must report to the Staten-Generaal on effectiveness within seven years of a regulation taking effect.

parties: Core PSO requirements, tariffs and tendering rules are delegated to a ministerial regulation, removing them from direct parliamentary scrutiny, and the party asks for a pre-consultation procedure (voorhang).
This removes these essential choices from the direct view and control of the House.
Dit onttrekt deze wezenlijke keuzes aan het directe zicht en de controle van de Kamer.
have taken note of the bill and have no further questions.
hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.
Supports the goal of affordable fares between the BES islands and asks about the government's plans, compensation and costs under a PSO.
These members support the goal of the bill, as they believe affordable ticket prices between the BES islands are important for the economic and social development of these islands.

Deze leden onderschrijven het doel van het wetsvoorstel, omdat ze menen dat betaalbare ticketprijzen tussen de BES-eilanden van belang zijn voor de economische en sociale ontwikkeling van deze eilanden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division, in its 8 October 2025 opinion on the bill creating a legal basis for public service obligations (PSO) on Caribbean Netherlands air routes, asked for a fuller problem analysis, a motivation of the chosen approach with references to research reports, and clarification of when and how a PSO lapses after one month of non-use. In its 20 November 2025 reply the Minister adopted the advice, supplementing the explanatory memorandum and amending the bill to provide for monitoring and revocation of the ministerial regulation.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum's problem analysis and motivation for the PSO approach needed to be supplemented with references to research reports and the alternatives considered, which the government did.

The rule that a PSO lapses after a month without compliance left open how non-compliance is established, the effect on the ministerial regulation, and how stakeholders are informed; the bill and memorandum were amended accordingly.
The Multilateral Protocol offers PSOs as an option rather than an obligation, so the memorandum was clarified to explain that a domestic legal basis is needed only if the option is used.

36871.s: The bill amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000 and related laws to implement the EU Asylum and Migration Pact, including a new screening chapter, a two-status system (refugee and subsidiary protection) replacing the single status, abolition of the indefinite asylum residence permit, shortened asylum procedures and appeal deadlines, and new grounds for detention and residence restrictions for asylum seekers. It largely delegates technical detail to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations while keeping core elements in statute.
36871.j: The memorandum justifies delegation as needed for flexibility and speed in implementing EU regulations and technical detail, citing the primacy of the legislature and the EU-law implementation context.
q: Merely deleting national rules that now appear in the regulations, and only setting implementing rules where the regulations allow, is however not sufficient.
Het louter schrappen van nationale regels die voortaan in de verordeningen staan en het enkel stellen van uitvoeringsregels waar de verordeningen die ruimte bieden, is echter niet voldoende.
d: designating bodies in independent monitoring mechanism and rules for it
rules on validity and documents of residence titles
rules on family member residence permits and cases granted
recognition and accreditation of legal counsellors and NGOs, free counselling rules
asylum procedure rules implementing the Pact
conditions for assignment to a geographic area
designating safe third countries and safe countries of origin
detention for asylum seekers based on onderduikrisico (rules referenced)
p: The Minister gains expanded grounds to revoke asylum permits, including when grounds lapse or the person poses a risk to public order.
The Minister may reject asylum applications as manifestly unfounded in additional cases, shortening review.
New grounds for administrative detention of asylum seekers, including non-compliance with residence restrictions and onderduikrisico, extended to up to twelve months in some cases.
Residence restrictions may now be imposed to prevent absconding when an absconding risk exists.
The pre-decision hearing (voornemenprocedure) is abolished and the Minister may suspend decision deadlines for uncertain situations in countries of origin.
Appeal deadlines are shortened to one or two weeks in many asylum cases.

parties: Asks which provisions go beyond EU minimum standards and why, and how the streamlined system of the Vreemdelingenwet is kept workable.
On which parts of this bill does the government choose norms that are more lenient than the European minimum norms prescribed by the underlying provisions of the relevant directive?
op welke onderdelen van dit wetsvoorstel de regering kiest voor normen die soepeler zijn dan de Europese minimumnormen die de onderliggende bepalingen uit de desbetreffende richtlijn voorschrijven.
Warns that the reduced access to legal remedies and added workload for the judiciary weaken asylum seekers' rights and may be unjustified, and questions detention of children.
These members find it problematic that the legal position of asylum seekers is being weakened.
Deze leden vinden het problematisch dat de rechtspositie van asielzoekers wordt verzwakt.
Asks whether implementing agencies are equipped and whether the asylum procedure and return rules are workable, and whether national measures deviate from the Pact.
The CDA members ask whether the implementing organisations in the asylum chain are sufficiently equipped for the implementation of the Pact from 12 June 2026.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de uitvoeringsorganisaties in de asielketen voldoende zijn toegerust op de implementatie van het Pact vanaf 12 juni 2026.

Argues the bill does not fix core weaknesses of the asylum system and asks whether the government still aims for the strictest admission rules in the EU, questioning the complexity of the legal framework.
At the same time, these members express concern that the main flaws of the asylum system are not being resolved.
Tegelijkertijd spreken deze leden de zorg uit dat de belangrijkste weeffouten van het asielstelsel niet worden opgelost.
Asks how the strict nareis regime for subsidiary protection holders is protected against erosion through Article 8 ECHR court challenges.

How does the government prevent the stricter family reunification regime for subsidiary protection holders from being fully eroded through Article 8 ECHR procedures in which judges still enforce residence?
Hoe voorkomt de regering dat het striktere nareisregime voor subsidiair beschermden volledig wordt uitgehold via procedures op basis van artikel 8 EVRM, waarbij rechters alsnog verblijf afdwingen?
Asks how much national policy room remains and whether AMvB's will be subject to pre- or post-parliamentary review.
Is a pre-consultation or post-consultation procedure foreseen for General Administrative Orders (AMvB's) under this act?
Is voorzien in een voorhang- of nahangprocedure bij Algemene Maatregelen van Bestuur (AMvB's) op grond van deze wet.
Shares concerns about the new reception directive and the new regulations and asks questions of the government.
The new Reception Directive and new regulations require legislative changes.
De nieuwe Opvangrichtlijn en nieuwe verordeningen vragen om wetswijzigingen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Uitvoerings- en implementatiewet Asiel- en migratiepact 2026, raising concerns about extra burdens on IND and courts, overly broad delegation of regulatory power, insufficient safeguards for detention under the reception directive, immediate effect of optional national choices, the two-status system, abolition of the permanent asylum residence permit, shortened validity, and restrictive family reunification. The Minister's nader rapport largely accepts the need for clarification and supplementary motivation but maintains that most national choices are necessary, justified, or required by EU law.
concerns: The Afdeling warns that voluntary national choices with immediate effect add substantial burdens to IND and courts and require explicit justification; the government acknowledges the burdens and commits to monitoring and additional resources but keeps immediate effect.

The Afdeling finds delegation of regulatory power too broad and asks for narrowing and motivation; the government defends existing delegation practice and clarifies its choices in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asks for explanation of procedural and substantive safeguards in detention and geographic allocation under the reception directive, and of the uniform detention period; the reply addresses this only through amendments to delegation and the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling objects to immediate effect for existing legal relations, risking unequal treatment and legal certainty problems; the government justifies immediate effect and clarifies the transitional rules, including the voornemen procedure.

The Afdeling advises replacing the asylum residence permit with the residence title as the basis for lawful stay; the government disagrees, arguing the regulation's definitions and systematic incongruity do not require this.

The Afdeling questions whether the waiting period and limiting family reunification to the core family are necessary and proportionate, especially for unaccompanied minors; the government defends them as part of its restrictive policy.
The Afdeling asks for justification of abolishing the permanent asylum residence permit given alternative routes; the government argues it is required by EU law and expected to reduce inflow.
The Afdeling asks for better justification of the two-status system and its consequences for appeals and workload; the government clarifies its reasoning but keeps the system.

36880.s: The bill implements Regulation (EU) 2024/1157 on waste shipments and related EU environmental obligations by updating references in the Environmental Management Act, the Economic Offences Act, the Environmental Taxes Act and the General Administrative Law Act. It also adds a ministerial power to set waste-reduction targets, a power to regulate product safety and health alongside environment, and new sanctioned prohibitions for waste shipment violations.
36880.j: The memorandum justifies the new targets power as needed to answer the European Commission's objection that waste recycling objectives must be guaranteed in law and regulation.
q: To meet this objection from the European Commission, it is proposed to add to Article 10.4 of the Wm a basis to set, by ministerial regulation, objectives implementing European obligations

om aan dit bezwaar van de Europese Commissie tegemoet te komen, wordt voorgesteld om aan artikel 10.4 van de Wm een grondslag toe te voegen om ter uitvoering van Europeesrechtelijke verplichtingen bij ministeriële regeling doelstellingen
d: binding waste prevention, reuse and recycling targets
ARTIKEL I, B (artikel 9.5.2, eerste lid Wm)
product rules for health and product safety
p: Allows the minister by ministerial regulation to set binding waste targets in implementation of EU obligations, bypassing the need for a statutory target.
ARTIKEL I, B (artikel 9.5.2, eerste lid Wm)
Extends the purposes for which product rules may be made by general administrative order to include human health and product safety.

parties: Asks whether the ILT is interoperable with the EU platform, whether enforcement capacity is sufficient, and about the reduction of penalty categories from three to two.
Can the government explain to what extent the tightened European rules help keep valuable secondary raw materials within the Union.
Kan de regering uiteenzetten in hoeverre de aangescherpte Europese regels bijdragen aan het binnen de Unie houden van waardevolle secundaire grondstoffen
Asks for proof of no additional national burdens, questions proportionality of administrative offences, and asks about legal certainty and transitional arrangements.
Can the government concretely substantiate why, in its view, these changes do not lead to additional national obligations or burdens for the parties involved?
Kan de regering concreet onderbouwen waarom deze wijzigingen volgens haar niet leiden tot extra nationale verplichtingen of lasten voor betrokken partijen?
Supports strengthening control and enforcement over hazardous waste and asks whether enforcement services are adequately equipped and whether the government will provide extra resources.
Is the government willing to make extra people and resources available where necessary?
Is de regering bereid om zo nodig extra mensen en middelen ter beschikking te stellen?
Asks how clarity is ensured about punishable conduct, how administrative errors are prevented from leading to prosecution, and how criminal versus administrative enforcement is chosen.
How is it prevented that administrative mistakes or unclarities directly lead to criminal prosecution?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat administratieve vergissingen of onduidelijkheden direct tot strafrechtelijke vervolging leiden?

Questions whether environmental and health effects are adequately assessed and independently tested, whether expert health advice was obtained, and whether the partial implementation omits parts of the directive.
Does the government plan to better map such effects and have them tested independently?
Is de regering van plan om zulke effecten wel beter in beeld te brengen en onafhankelijk te laten toetsen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill implementing the revised EU waste shipment regulation, the environmental crime directive, the waste framework directive amendment and the Batteries Regulation, raising concerns about criminal-law legality in article 10.60 Wm, the justification for broader criminal offences, missing transitional rules and the justification for implementing the Batteries Regulation under the Environmental Management Act. The government's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended to address most points, including restoring references to subsidiary provisions, dropping two criminal offences, adding transitional rules and expanding the justification for choosing the Wm over the Warenwet.
concerns: Removing references to subsidiary provisions from article 10.60 Wm reduces clarity of which prohibitions are criminally enforceable, contrary to the lex certa requirement; the government restored the references.
Extension of criminal offences was not justified; the government dropped the references to articles 22(2) and 25(2) of the new EVOA as administrative enforcement fits better.
Absence of transitional law provisions for shipments under the previous EVOA; the government added a transitional provision.

The choice to implement the Batteries Regulation solely under the Environmental Management Act was insufficiently justified against the Warenwet alternative; the memorandum was supplemented with further reasoning.

36915-IIB.s: This bill amends the 2026 budget (first supplementary) for the other High Colleges of State, the Governors' cabinets and the Electoral Council, raising expenditure by about EUR 7.2 million with the largest increases for the Ombudsman, the Raad van State and the Algemene Rekenkamer. It makes the change effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 1 June 2026.
36915-IIB.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increases by referring to a higher expected caseload for the Raad van State's Vreemdelingenkamer and the use of end-of-year budget margins.
q: For 2027 there is a projection from the MPP of 7,717 cases.
Voor 2027 ligt er een raming van de MPP van 7.717 zaken.

36916.s: The bill restricts the retail sale of tobacco and related products to specialist shops only, with transitional exceptions for convenience stores until 2032 and for certain registered retailers. It also bans display of such products outside specialist shops, bans sales by state-run and certain institutions, and prohibits distance selling, backed by new delegations to lower regulation and administrative fines.
36916.j: The memorandum justifies the bans as a suitable measure to protect public health toward a smoke-free generation by 2040, and the delegations as needed to set detailed presentation and designation rules.
q: The ban is a suitable measure, because it is simple to implement for both retail outlets and the supervisor, and a sales ban is expected to lead to lower smoking prevalence.

Het verbod is een geschikte maatregel, omdat de maatregel voor zowel de verkooppunten als de toezichthouder, eenvoudig is uit te voeren en omdat een verkoopverbod naar verwachting zal leiden tot een lagere rookprevalentie.
d: rules on how tobacco products may be displayed in specialist shops and concealed elsewhere
designating categories of public bodies, institutions and businesses subject to the sales ban
designating seafarers' centres and proof of seafarer status
p: Sales restrictions on consumers are extended to additional institutions and categories designated by general administrative order, leaving scope to the executive.
Distance and cross-border sales of tobacco to consumers are banned outright in statute rather than in the decree.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill restricting sales of tobacco and vape products to specialist shops, raising points on the definition of speciaalzaak, freedom of establishment, consumer switching, enforcement against online sales, and the exclusion of Caribbean Netherlands. The minister's reply accepted most points by amending the definition, supplementing the explanatory memorandum, clarifying enforcement with the NVWA, and explaining why the bill does not apply to Caribbean Netherlands.
concerns: The definition of speciaalzaak is internally contradictory because retail sale is itself a service, so the definition was amended to exempt tobacco and product sales from the ban on other services.
The explanatory memorandum should address whether the sales ban is justified under the freedom of establishment of service providers under Article 15 of the Services Directive, and this was added.
The explanatory memorandum should address the effects of the phased ban on current vape users, who may switch to more widely available tobacco products, and this was substantiated.

Enforcement of the ban on sales through non-regular channels such as online and social media is doubtful, so the memorandum was supplemented on NVWA enforcement and cooperation with other supervisors, though full enforceability remains unestablished.

The exclusion of Caribbean Netherlands needs better justification given its insular context and the Bonaire executive's intention to regulate itself, and the memorandum was supplemented, though the reply maintains that application would be too far-reaching.

36943.s: The bill raises the mandatory deductible (verplicht eigen risico) under the Health Insurance Act by €60 for 2027, on top of indexation, by adding a special calculation rule in a new eighth paragraph of article 19. It also repeals the seventh and eighth paragraphs from 1 January 2028 and takes effect on 1 September 2026.
36943.j: The memorandum justifies the increase as a policy choice and explains that the amount is set by ministerial regulation so that the rounded, indexed figure can be published and take effect.
q: the amount obtained after applying paragraph b is set by ministerial regulation, after which that amount replaces the amount in the first paragraph
het na toepassing van onderdeel b verkregen bedrag wordt bij ministeriële regeling vastgesteld, waarna dat bedrag in de plaats treedt van het in het eerste lid genoemde bedrag
d: replacing the deductible amount after indexation and rounding
Artikel I, 2 (artikel 19, achtste lid Zvw, onderdeel c)
setting the 2027 deductible amount after the €60 increase

v.summary: The Raad van State's advisory division accepts the restart of indexation and the proposed €60 increase of the mandatory deductible (verplicht eigen risico) for 2027, but asks for better justification, a more consistent long-term balance between deductible and premium, and clearer analysis of municipal burdens and consultation with the VNG. The minister's reply largely accepts the points, clarifies the tranching and budgetary effects, and commits to consult municipalities if needed.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a clearer motivation of why the increase is €60 and how it fits a balance between co-financing and premium financing; the government adds explanation that the increase improves balance between affordability, accessibility and quality of care.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum address municipal support expectations, possible additional burdens on municipalities and whether consultation with the VNG took place; the government clarifies the instruments and commits to talks with VNG and municipalities if needed.

The Afdeling asks the explanation of the planned tranching (effect on budget, premium and chronically ill) to be expanded; the government argues the tranching effect on care use outweighs the revenue loss and quantifies it in the separate amendment.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum account for the compensating burden increase in the Voorjaarsnota 2026; the government says this is an indirect effect of broader decision-making and clarifies the point in the memorandum.

36952.s: The bill approves for the European and Caribbean parts of the Netherlands the 1998 OCCAR convention establishing the Organisation Conjointe de Cooperation en matiere d'Armement for joint defence procurement, and the 2004 OCCAR security convention as amended in 2025. The approval is required under article 91(1) of the Constitution before the Kingdom can be bound.
36952.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated powers as customary for comparable international organisations and states that Annex IV amendments are excluded from parliamentary approval under the Rijkswet goedkeuring en bekendmaking verdragen.
q: Article 41 contains a delegation of powers that is customary for similar organisations, from the Raad van Toezicht to the Director or a designated OCCAR staff member.
Artikel 41 bevat een voor soortgelijke organisaties gebruikelijke mogelijkheid tot het delegeren van bevoegdheden
d: Raad van Toezicht may delegate powers to the Director or to an OCCAR staff member to sign contracts
Raad van Toezicht adopts the security regulations that member states must comply with
p: A member state can be excluded from OCCAR membership by unanimous decision of the Raad van Toezicht, a body of executive representatives, without a parliamentary role.
Amendments to Annex IV on decision-making in the Raad van Toezicht are adopted by unanimous executive decision and enter into force without parliamentary approval.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises on a treaty-approval bill for the OCCAR defence procurement organisation and its amended security agreement, and raises no substantive remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport, forwarding the advice to the King, confirms the bill will be submitted without further changes.

36961.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Civil Code and the Wft to implement EU Directive 2024/2810 on multiple voting share structures for companies seeking admission to trading on a multilateral trading facility. It allows such structures under defined conditions, adds shareholder protections requiring double qualified majorities for certain decisions, and imposes transparency and identification duties on companies and MTF operators supervised by the AFM.
36961.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated transparency content by reference to the directive's requirements and the need for legal certainty, leaving detailed information to a general administrative order.
q: The information that must be disclosed in any admission document or in the directors' report is further specified in the implementing decision.
De informatie die openbaar moet worden gemaakt in enig toelatingsdocument of in het bestuursverslag wordt nader uitgewerkt in het implementatiebesluit.
d: Artikel I A (art. 2:118b, lid 6 BW) / Artikel I C (art. 2:228a)
transparency information via general administrative order under art. 2:391a(2) BW
content of information to be disclosed in prospectus and annual reports for multiple voting shares

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering made no substantive remarks on the draft bill implementing EU Directive 2024/2810 on multiple-voting-rights share structures and advised submitting it to parliament. The government's reply notes it made minor textual and explanatory adjustments (dropping a proposed definition and heading change, adding an enforcement power for the AFM) without changing the substance.
